article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 8,376 and warnings about its spread in Africa - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is grappling with a continuing Ebola virus disease outbreak. As of 5 October 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 8,376 Ebola cases and 4,042 deaths, with transmission continuing across the country and warnings that neighboring nations are at risk. United Nations appeals for additional resources to combat the outbreak, and the World Health Organization previously designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May, due to escalating regional risk. France pledged increased support during a visit to Kinshasa, with Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barro cautioning that faltering surveillance could hasten a resurgence. The report underscores cross-border threat and the need for sustained control measures to prevent further spread into Africa.

article.articleHeadline: Fidson Selected to Expand Influenza Treatment Access, Pandemic Preparedness
article.articleSummary: Influenza antiviral baloxavir marboxil will be developed as generic versions under MPP's voluntary license with Roche; Fidson Healthcare Plc is selected as one of eleven manufacturers across nine countries to sign sublicences, expanding production across regions including Brazil, China, and India. The move aims to diversify manufacturing capacity and strengthen pandemic preparedness by enabling rapid, quality-assured access to baloxavir. MPP Executive Director Charles Gore said implementation with manufacturers is underway to support product development and regulatory approval to make generics available quickly, combining global capacity with regionally focused production for a geographically diverse, resilient supply base. Roche VP Tamara Schudel called the milestone, noting that voluntary partnerships are critical for pandemic preparedness and rapid response.

article.articleHeadline: 世界の関心が薄れたエボラ出血熱、対策組織が抱くかつてない危機感
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever, whose global attention has waned, faces an unprecedented sense of crisis among response organizations.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding toward the largest recorded outbreak, with over 7,000 cases since May and roughly half deaths. Uganda had contained its outbreak earlier, but in DRC the situation remains unstable amid ongoing conflict, with millions displaced and complicating contact tracing. External aid workers face distrust, and local residents have attacked Red Cross volunteers, damaged ambulances, and hindered safe burial teams. Vaccination is deemed essential to ending the outbreak. CEPI has mobilized about $100 million to accelerate vaccine development, enabling Serum Institute of India to manufacture the Oxford University–developed ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine, while Moderna vaccine candidates enter safety and efficacy testing; trials are expected to begin this month, provided tracing capacity allows. Experts warn it could become the worst Ebola outbreak in history if not controlled.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Garbage is piling up, but the dustbin isn’t being cleaned; locals distressed: unsanitary conditions! Threat of an outbreak in Gandhigram Housing due to administrative negligence.
article.articleSummary: Rajkot's Gandhigram area, Nanavati Chowk Avas Yojana quarters, faces unsanitary conditions as garbage beneath and inside waste bins remains uncleansed. Municipal sanitation workers clear surface rubbish daily, but entrenched waste at bin bases rots, emitting a foul odor and attracting pests. The accumulating filth has raised concerns of rising mosquitoes, lizards, and other pests, with dengue, malaria, and other mosquito-borne diseases deemed a plausible threat. Residents question whether municipal health authorities’ negligence could trigger a major outbreak and have demanded immediate bin cleaning and regular fumigation/disinfection. They argue that surface cleaning is insufficient; proper sanitation and routine insecticide spraying at bin sites are essential. If an outbreak occurs, accountability remains disputed, and residents urge authorities to urgently sanitize and disinfect the waste bins to mitigate public health risk.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Reach 8,376 Amid Regional Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,376 confirmed cases and 4,042 deaths, according to Congolese health authorities as of 05 Oct 2026. Ongoing transmission in the DRC sustains risk to neighbouring countries amid population movement and cross-border spread. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya warns of regional risks as transmission continues. French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot, visiting the DRC, reaffirmed France's support and emphasized vigilance to prevent a resurgence of transmission. The World Health Organization (WHO) warns that sustained transmission in the DRC poses a cross-border risk, with neighbouring nations facing heightened risk due to cross-border movement.

article.articleHeadline: Spring gardening warning as Legionnaires threat lurks
article.articleSummary: Legionnaires' disease (legionellosis) dominated the South Island in the past year, with 54 of 152 nationally notified cases from September 2025 to August 2026. Health NZ reports 46 South Island patients hospitalised, contributing to 135 total hospitalisations nationwide. Regional distribution covers South Island (Nelson-Marlborough, Canterbury, South Canterbury, West Coast, Otago and Southland); Northern region (Northland and Auckland) with 49 cases and 46 hospitalisations; Midland (Waikato, Bay of Plenty, Taranaki, Tairāwhiti) with 38 cases and 32 hospitalisations; Central region (Hawke’s Bay to Wellington) with 11 cases, all hospitalised. Health officials advise gardeners to wear gloves and a well-fitting N95 mask, handle potting mix outdoors or in well-ventilated areas, dampen soil to reduce dust, and wash hands after gardening. Legionella thrives in moist environments; symptoms include flu-like illness such as cough, fever, shortness of breath, and others; seek medical advice if symptoms occur after exposure to potting mix."}{

article.articleHeadline: エボラ死者4000人超え、コンゴ史上最悪　東部で感染拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll tops 4,000, the worst in Congo's history, as infections spread in the east.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports the worst Ebola virus disease outbreak on record, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of Oct 2, 2026, government statistics show 4,018 deaths and 8,300 laboratory-confirmed infections across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. Globally, the outbreak is small compared with the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected about 28,600 and killed over 11,000. In the northeast, Ituri province shows some signs of slowing, while the eastern regions continue rapid spread. North Kivu remains affected, and in September South Ubangi declared an outbreak, becoming the seventh province involved. The response centers on containment, surveillance, and laboratory confirmation to curb transmission linked to the Bundibugyo strain.

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Dengue Cases Cross 20,000; Health Officials Say Trend Declining
article.articleSummary: Chennai dengue cases have crossed 20,000 this year, though authorities say the situation is stabilising and new infections are declining. Current data show 4,592 dengue cases with 16,254 tests conducted and 1,293 cases in September; no deaths. The higher figure reportedly reflects broader fever testing. Health Secretary Tariq Ahmed emphasised testing all fever cases and prompt clinical management. The Greater Chennai Corporation has 3,703 mosquito-control workers, runs over 100 fever clinics daily, and uses about 1,250 larvicide-spraying machines; drone-based larvicide spraying is underway in the Cooum river. Fines totaling Rs 7.2 lakh were issued for garbage disposal lapses. With the Northeast monsoon approaching, 1,400 of 1,600 km of stormwater drains are desilted (99%). 215 relief centres and 111 community kitchens are ready. Funds include Rs 1,100 crore to clear pending bills, Rs 300 crore loan, Rs 100 crore for monsoon works; long-term flood projects with World Bank/JICA; 15 IAS officers and seven ministers coordinating measures.

article.articleHeadline: 洗過再冰超致命！一家3口吃炒蛋集體中毒 專家：毀了保護膜　細菌全滲入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washed and refrozen—deadly! A family of three suffers mass food poisoning after eating scrambled eggs; experts say it damaged the protective barrier and bacteria fully penetrated.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-05, a mother and two other family members in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, China, developed severe acute gastroenteritis after eating scrambled eggs. Health authorities tied the outbreak to eggs that had been washed before refrigeration, which destroyed the shell’s water-soluble protective膜, opening thousands of microscopic pores and allowing Salmonella and other bacteria to penetrate the interior, contaminating both the yolk and white. Despite subsequent refrigeration, bacterial contamination could not be reversed. Laboratory assessment indicated a high probability of Salmonella proliferation within the washed eggs. Experts advise against washing eggs: dry wipe only if dirty, store with the large end up in the refrigerator at 0–4°C, and if eggs are washed, cook immediately or consume within 3 days, keeping them separate from raw foods to prevent cross-contamination.

article.articleHeadline: Study Reveals Shared Inflammation in Biliary Atresia and COVID-19
article.articleSummary: Biliary atresia and SARS-CoV-2–associated liver injury share antiviral defenses, double-stranded RNA responses, and interferon signaling in bile duct cells. Harbin, China–based researchers compared SARS-CoV-2–infected human liver organoids with biliary atresia liver tissue, identifying 164 shared genes and narrowing to 52 after stringent testing. Key genes STAT1, ISG15, and CXCL10 remained prominent; cholangiocytes (bile duct lining cells) showed higher activation of the shared pattern in COVID-associated liver samples (P = 0.00368). An independent biliary atresia dataset showed elevated expression of these genes in cholangiocytes. In vitro, synthetic dsRNA increased these genes and proteins, with CXCL10 showing the strongest rise. Mefloquine emerged as a potential candidate for further study, though no proven efficacy. Published in Frontiers in Immunology (2026), the findings suggest shared inflammatory stress responses across distinct liver diseases, warranting larger follow-up studies.

article.articleHeadline: 一家三口吃炒蛋中毒　专家提醒：鸡蛋保存前勿先水洗 | 健康 | 生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family of three poisoned after eating scrambled eggs; experts remind: Do not wash eggs before storage.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-05 in Shenyang, Liaoning, a family of three developed food poisoning after eating scrambled eggs. Investigations point to possibly spoiled eggs, and the eggs had been washed before storage, reviving questions about washing eggs. Sun Jing, from the Hubei Academy of Agricultural Sciences, notes that eggshells have microscopic pores and a natural protective cuticle that blocks bacteria and reduces moisture loss. Washing or soaking can remove this barrier, exposing the interior to bacteria such as Salmonella and increasing contamination risk, even with refrigeration. If eggs have been washed, they should not be stored long and should be cooked thoroughly as soon as possible; if immediate cooking isn't possible, refrigerate promptly. For lightly soiled shells, wipe with a dry cloth; avoid heavily soiled eggs. Tips: do not freeze eggs; avoid washing before storage; keep eggs separate from other foods; store with the large end up to keep the air cell intact.

triage.triage_reason: インドのタミル・ナードゥ州カルール地区における季節性デング熱対策に関する地方行政の通常対応で、症例数や重症度の情報もなく、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの地域流行疾患であり、本記事は地方自治体のルーチンのベクター対策活動を報じたもの。症例数・重症度データが無く、情報不足のためWATCH寄りの要素はあるが、異常性・社会的関心の高さは確認できずDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 山东启动农村"一老一小"流感疫苗免费接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shandong launches free influenza vaccination for rural elderly and young children.
article.articleSummary: Shandong Province launched free influenza vaccination for rural elderly and schoolchildren—the 'one old, one small' priority groups—providing one dose of trivalent influenza vaccine (split virion) at no cost. The initiative, issued by the Shandong Center for Disease Control and eight departments, began September 29, 2026. Eligible rural residents aged 65+ and students in compulsory education may receive vaccination at designated units; consult local CDC or clinics for details. Influenza activity in Shandong typically peaks November–March; early vaccination helps antibodies reach protective levels before the season. Since it takes 2–4 weeks to develop protection, September–October is ideal, though vaccination remains protective if timing differs. The program aims to reduce severe influenza complications among rural elderly and children.

triage.headline_ja: 山東省、農村部の高齢者と子ども向けにインフルエンザワクチン無料接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに対する通常の予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な公衆衛生事象ではない。
triage.notes: これは予防的なワクチン接種プログラムの広報記事であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。発生地域としてChinaが付与されているが、イベント自体が疾病発生でないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 歐家榮：猴痘個案上升　部分以交友程式尋找陌生性伴侶難以追蹤
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ou Jiarong: Monkeypox cases on the rise; some are using dating apps to seek unfamiliar sexual partners, making tracing difficult.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Hong Kong shows rising locally transmitted cases since August. As of 2026-10-05, the Centre for Health Protection reports 29 total cases this year: 22 local, 7 imported, with 20 new since August. All cases involve men who have sex with men; 15 local and 5 imported among these 20. High-risk sexual behavior reported, including sex with unfamiliar partners or multiple partners, and inconsistent condom use. About 60% of cases reported using dating apps to seek unfamiliar partners, complicating tracing, as many patients cannot provide contact details for sex partners, and some do not know infection sources. Authorities have intensified prevention on social media and dating apps, offered vaccination for high-risk groups, and opened an additional monkeypox vaccination center within the Centre for Health Protection building. Public urged to retain partners' contact methods to facilitate contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 区家栄：サル痘症例が増加、マッチングアプリで見知らぬ性的パートナーを探すケースが追跡を困難に
triage.triage_reason: 香港でMSMコミュニティ内のエムポックス地域感染が8月以降増加しており、出会い系アプリ利用による接触追跡困難という流行しやすさの要因があり、当局・メディアの関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は香港（中国特別行政区）内のローカル感染拡大に関する内容。重症度や国際拡大の明示的な記載はないが、接触追跡の困難さと継続的な曝露リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو إلى 8376 والوفيات إلى 4042 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 8,376 and deaths to 4,042 - Urdu Point.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,376 confirmed infections and 4,042 deaths, according to the DRC Ministry of Health in Kinshasa. The outbreak continues to spread within the country, with Africa CDC Director-General Jan Kasia warning of a threat to neighboring states as transmission persists. The United Nations has called for additional resources to bolster the response. In May, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing elevated regional risk. The report underscores ongoing transmission and international concern, highlighting the need for sustained funding and continued international support to mitigate spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が8,376人、死者数が4,042人に増加 - Urdu Point
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が大規模化し（感染8,376件、死亡4,042件、致死率約48%）、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで周辺国への拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは本流行を5月にPHEICと宣言済み。Africa CDCは周辺国への波及リスクを警告しており、国際支援の継続的必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: หมอจิรรุจน์ เตือนโคราช ไข้หวัดใหญ่ระบาด เด็กดับแล้ว 1 เผยสัญญาณอันตราย ต้องรีบพาลูกไปโรงพยาบาล
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Jiruruj warns Korat of flu outbreak; one child has died; reveals dangerous signs; you must rush your child to the hospital.
article.articleSummary: On 5 October 2026, Dr. Jiruruj Chomchai, a pediatric respiratory and critical-care specialist at Maharaj Nakorn Ratchasima Hospital, warned of a continuing influenza outbreak in Nakhon Ratchasima Province (Korat), Thailand, where one death has occurred: a roughly 7-year-old overweight child with no major comorbidities. Flu cases can lead to severe complications in children. Red flags requiring urgent hospital care include: rapid or labored breathing with chest retractions; cyanosis; severe dehydration (no urination for 8 hours, dry mouth, absent tears); altered mental status or seizures; severe muscle pain hindering movement; fever >40°C despite antipyretics; and fever in infants under 3 months. High-risk groups should receive antivirals promptly (e.g., Oseltamivir): obesity (BMI ≥95th percentile); age under 5 (especially under 2); chronic conditions (asthma, heart, lung, kidney, liver, blood disorders, diabetes); neurological/developmental disorders; immunodeficiencies (HIV on ART, cancer, chronic steroids). Outbreak persists in urban and district areas; schools may close around 6 October.

triage.headline_ja: ジルルット医師、コラートでインフルエンザ流行を警告、子供1人死亡 危険な兆候を示す—早急に病院へ
triage.triage_reason: ナコンラチャシマ県における季節性インフルエンザの地域的流行で小児死亡例が1件報告されているが、IHR基準の該当はほぼなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念も見られないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの地域流行に関する医師からの注意喚起記事。学校閉鎖の可能性があり継続的な感染拡大が見られるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えず、地域医療機関内での対応が可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: В Израиле госпитализировали пациента с подозрением на лихорадку Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Israel, a patient was hospitalized with suspected Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Israel is investigating a hospitalized case of suspected Ebola fever. A patient who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is isolated at a medical center. The Ministry of Health notes the case is preliminary; the patient will undergo necessary examinations and laboratory testing. Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs via direct contact with an infected person showing symptoms or with blood, bodily fluids, or secretions. There are no confirmed Ebola cases in Israel. In June, two patients with similar symptoms tested negative; both had visited the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルでエボラ出血熱の疑いのある患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国から帰国した患者がイスラエルで疑い例として入院・検査中だが、確定診断は出ておらず対象国での発生状況も本記事からは確認できないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本事例はイスラエルでの疑い例（検査待ち）であり、確定例はなし。患者はDRCからの帰国者だが、記事はDRC国内でのエボラ流行発生を直接報じているわけではないため、DRCをverified_locationsには含めない。6月にも同様の疑い例2件があったがいずれも陰性であった点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 718 Orang di Purworejo Diduga Keracunan MBG, Hasil Lab Ungkap Makanan Positif E.Coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 718 People in Purworejo Suspected MBG Poisoning, Lab Results Reveal E. coli-Positive Foods.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination was detected in meals served by Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) Kaliboto 2 in Bener, Purworejo Regency, Central Java, linked to the Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program. A total of 718 people were suspected of MBG poisoning after consuming the meals on 17 September 2026, with symptoms including diarrhea, nausea, and dizziness. Laboratory results confirmed E. coli in both the rice and the accompanying dishes, providing a confirmed cause rather than a suspicion. As of 5 October 2026, all affected individuals have recovered. Authorities plan a comprehensive evaluation of the MBG Kaliboto 2 operations, focusing on kitchen procedures, food safety standards, and environmental cleanliness around the kitchen, and will screen all MBG beneficiaries—students, toddlers, and pregnant women—to prevent recurrence and strengthen food-safety controls in Purworejo.

triage.headline_ja: プルウォレジョで718人がMBG給食による食中毒疑い、検査結果で食品からE.coli陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 単一の給食施設由来の食中毒事例で、原因が特定され全員回復済み。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念もない。
triage.notes: 政府の無償栄養給食プログラム（MBG）関連の食中毒事例で国内的な関心はあるが、既に原因究明・全員回復しており公衆衛生上の継続的リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: 120 influenza deaths reported in Keralam, 11,319 cases till Oct
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Keralam has caused 120 deaths this year, nearly triple the 43 fatalities in all of 2025, with 11,319 cases reported through October 3 and 145 cases in the first three days of October. About 110 deaths occurred in the past four months. Experts attribute the surge to monsoon-related factors: heavy rains, humidity, and crowded Onam gatherings, amplified by increased testing. The rise is not unique to Keralam; Delhi and other states are affected as well. Dr. Rajeev Jayadevan says monsoon-driven spread underpins most of India. Dr. Sunny P. Orethel notes enhanced testing inflates reported cases. Influenza presents with fever and body pain; the elderly and people with diabetes, cancer, kidney or liver diseases, or obesity are especially vulnerable. Vaccination is urged; annual flu vaccine and pneumococcal vaccine can prevent complications. An expert panel proposed making flu vaccination mandatory for 65+, but implementation has stalled.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でインフルエンザによる死者120人、10月までの感染者数は11,319人
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州のインフルエンザ死亡者数が前年比約3倍に急増し、デリー等他州にも拡大していることから異常性・重症度の観点でIHR基準を2つ満たすため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行だが、モンスーン要因と検査拡大により死亡者数・症例数が前年比で大幅増加。ケララ州だけでなくデリー等インド各地で同様の傾向が見られる点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Spatial-temporal heterogeneity in tuberculosis incidence and its association with socioeconomic factors in South Sulawesi
article.articleSummary: TB remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia; this study analyzes tuberculosis incidence in South Sulawesi across 24 districts from 2018–2023. Reported TB incidence varied markedly between districts with an overall upward trend and widening disparities, and high-burden areas shifted over time rather than persisting. Districts frequently reclassified across incidence categories, indicating unstable patterns. Global Moran's I suggested no consistent spatial clustering, while the Breusch-Pagan test showed strong spatial heterogeneity. Using a Nonparametric Geographically and Temporally Weighted Regression with Truncated Spline (NGTWR-TS), researchers found nonlinear threshold effects and substantial spatial-temporal variation in how socioeconomic conditions relate to incidence. Consistent correlates included mean years of schooling, open unemployment rate, and the Human Development Index, all positively associated with district CIR. The results imply district-specific interventions addressing education, employment, and development to counter dynamic, localized vulnerabilities in TB incidence as of 2023; implications for policy in South Sulawesi.

triage.headline_ja: 南スラウェシ州における結核発生率の時空間的異質性と社会経済的要因との関連
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究論文であり、社会経済要因とTB発生率の統計的関連を分析したもので、新規の公衆衛生緊急事態や異常事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 研究論文であり、2018-2023年のレトロスペクティブな疫学分析。既知の疾患（結核）の既存データに基づく統計研究であり、新興感染症イベントのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kemarin, cegah penyakit antraks hingga hilirisasi nikel ubah ekonomi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yesterday, preventing anthrax and nickel downstreaming changed the economy.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax case in Dadapayu Village, Kalurahan Dadapayu, Semanu District, Yogyakarta Special Province prompts strengthened animal-health controls as Gunungkidul Regency receives intensified support. The Directorate General of Livestock and Animal Health says the response is integrated, involving regional governments and field veterinarians to enhance surveillance and control. In economic news, CORE Indonesia economist Yusuf Rendy Manilet says nickel downstreaming is reshaping Indonesia’s economy by raising value added, boosting state revenue (PNBP), and promoting domestic processing. In Bali, National Economic Committee chair Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan invites Tsinghua University to collaborate on AI research at KEK Kura-Kura Bali in Denpasar, aiming for a swift partnership. Separately, Kadin urges a data-driven, selective protection of the domestic market; Bapanas considers transport subsidies for chicken to stabilize prices and ensure supply.

triage.headline_ja: 昨日のニュース：炭疽病対策からニッケル下流化による経済変革まで
triage.triage_reason: ジョグジャカルタ州グヌンキドゥル県での炭疽菌（家畜）症例に対する通常の動物衛生対応に関する記事であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。経済ニュースの一部として扱われ社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ジョグジャカルタ特別州（グヌンキドゥル県セマヌ郡）での家畜炭疽症例に対する地域政府の対応強化を報じるもので、ヒト感染の報告はない。バリ州の言及はAI研究協力に関する別トピックであり、炭疽とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: 87 dengue cases reported in five days in Lucknow
article.articleSummary: 87 dengue cases were reported in Lucknow over five days (Sept 29–Oct 3), bringing the year’s total to 342, according to local health authorities. Post-monsoon rainfall caused waterlogging, creating breeding sites for Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that transmit dengue. The city spans 110 wards, with five malaria inspectors and teams handling vector control. In the immediate post-rain period, authorities shifted to case-based source reduction, deploying anti-larva spraying and fogging in areas with more cases. Warm daytime temperatures and high humidity are cited as factors promoting mosquito survival and transmission, with October typically a dengue peak month as conditions stabilize. Ongoing measures include regular fogging and anti-larva spraying citywide, coordinated with other departments. Residents are urged to prevent water accumulation around homes, regularly empty coolers and flower pots, dispose of discarded tyres, and use mosquito nets and repellents to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウで5日間に87件のデング熱症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加であり毎年発生する予想可能な事象だが、症例数増加と地域拡大の可能性があるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: インド・ラクナウにおける季節性デング熱の増加報告。毎年10月はデング熱のピーク期とされ、地元当局が対策（防除、噴霧等）を実施中。重症度・死亡例の記載なし。マラリアについては言及があるが本記事の主題はデング熱。

article.articleHeadline: Winter aespa Kena Herpes Zoster! Penyakit Apa Itu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: aespa's Winter Contracted Herpes Zoster! What Is That Disease?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, aespa member Winter has been diagnosed with herpes zoster (shingles) following a hospital examination. Herpes zoster results from reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus, the same virus that causes chickenpox, remaining latent after infection and reactivating with age or immune compromise. Symptoms include unilateral pain, itching, tingling, or numbness, followed by a vesicular rash that crusts; fever, headache, chills, and fatigue may occur. The condition is not directly contagious, but blister fluid can spread varicella-zoster to someone who has not had chickenpox or vaccination, potentially causing chickenpox. Treatment involves antivirals (acyclovir, valacyclovir, famciclovir) and pain management; patients should cover lesions and maintain hygiene. No case counts or outbreak details provided.

triage.headline_ja: aespaのウィンター、帯状疱疹に罹患！その病気とは？
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の帯状疱疹罹患に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 個人の健康状態に関する芸能ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。地域(Indonesia)はメディア発信地であり、発症国を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 歐家榮：猴痘存傳播鏈　惟部分與陌生男接觸　無法聯絡性伴侶
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ou Jiarong: Monkeypox transmission chain remains; only some had contact with unfamiliar men; unable to contact sexual partners.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox cases rise in Hong Kong with 29 infections reported this year, including 22 local transmissions and 7 imported cases; 20 new cases since August, of which 15 are local and 5 imported. Genomic analysis of 20 August-onset cases shows identical viral sequences in some, confirming a common source, while multiple transmission chains exist. Contact tracing is hampered as many patients could not provide sex-partner contact details. All cases involve male-to-male sexual contacts; high-risk behaviors include encounters with unfamiliar men, multiple partners, and inconsistent condom use. About 60% of cases reported finding partners via dating apps. In response, authorities have intensified social-media outreach and dating-app campaigns, expanded vaccination services for high-risk groups, and opened an additional monkeypox vaccination centre at the Centre for Health Protection (CHP) building.

triage.headline_ja: 歐家榮氏：サル痘の感染連鎖は継続中、一部患者は見知らぬ男性との接触のみで性的パートナーと連絡が取れず
triage.triage_reason: 香港で複数の感染連鎖を伴うサル痘の地域内伝播が継続しており、接触者追跡が困難で当局が追加のワクチン接種体制を強化していることから、流行可能性と行政的関心の高まりが認められる。
triage.notes: 香港（特別行政区）の事例は対象国リストのChina (1814991) に分類。記事は性的接触による複数感染連鎖の継続と接触者追跡の困難さ、ワクチン接種体制強化を報告しているが、重症度や死亡例の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: وزير الخارجية الفرنسي يؤكد التزام بلاده بمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French Foreign Minister reaffirms his country's commitment to fighting Ebola.
article.articleSummary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barro reaffirmed Paris's commitment to eradicating Ebola after visiting the Democratic Republic of Congo, focusing on Ituri Province and Bunia, the eastern outbreak epicenter since May. He said Ebola respects no borders, underscoring the need to root out the virus effectively. Barro highlighted the role of French researchers and humanitarian workers, whose globally recognized expertise is delivering care and addressing the spread of the virus. The visit centered on Ituri in eastern DRC to bolster ongoing efforts against the Ebola outbreak rooted in Bunia. No specific case counts are provided in the report, and it emphasizes international support for control measures in the region.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、エボラ対策への自国の取り組みを再確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する国際的な関与・支援表明であり、エボラという重症度の高い疾患かつ国際的関心が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスとの外交関係・支援表明が中心で、具体的な症例数や流行状況の詳細は記載なし。既知の進行中アウトブレイク（2026年5月以降、イトゥリ州ブニア）への言及であり、新規シグナルというより継続状況の確認報道。フランス（Paris/France）は発生地域ではなく訪問元であるためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: وزير الخارجية الفرنسى يؤكد رغبة بلاده فى تعزيز جهود القضاء على وباء إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French Foreign Minister confirms his country's desire to bolster efforts to eradicate the Ebola epidemic - Youm7
article.articleSummary: France's Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs, Jean-Noël Barro, announced Paris's intention to intensify efforts to eradicate the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. After visiting Bunia in Ituri Province, the eastern epicenter since May, Barro said France would bolster support to curb transmission, save lives, and bring the outbreak under control. The trip also included engagements in the Ituri region, with the aim of reinforcing political, humanitarian, and health dimensions of the response and signaling a new phase in mobilizing France alongside local authorities, the United Nations, and other humanitarian actors. French researchers and humanitarian workers, highly regarded globally, are on the front lines providing care and containment. The visit underscores France's commitment to eradicating Ebola and acknowledges that the virus knows no borders, requiring a coordinated international response.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、エボラ流行撲滅に向けた取り組み強化の意向を確認 - Youm7
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行に対し、フランスが国際支援強化を表明した記事であり、重大な公衆衛生イベントとして社会的・政治的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月からイトゥリ州ブニアを中心に継続中のエボラ流行に対するフランスの外交的・人道的支援表明に関するもの。新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクのフォローアップ記事だが、国際的な対応強化という重要な動きのためPICKUPと判断。フランス・パリは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" بالكونغو إلى 8376 حالة وتحذيرات من انتشاره بإفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Ebola cases in the Congo to 8,376, with warnings of its spread in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,376 cases and 4,042 deaths, according to the DRC Ministry of Health. The outbreak continues to spread across the country, prompting warnings that neighboring states face spillover risk. Jean Kasia, director-general of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, warned that the virus threatens regional stability as it remains active nationwide. France's Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot pledged increased support to curb the outbreak, cautioning that surveillance lapses could hasten a resurgence. The United Nations has urged additional resources for outbreak response, and the World Health Organization noted in May that the outbreak constituted a Public Health Emergency of International Concern with elevated regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数が8,376人に増加、アフリカでの拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がPHEICとされ、死亡者数4,042人・感染者8,376人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、近隣国への越境拡大リスクや国際支援の必要性が明確なため。
triage.notes: フランスは支援表明国として言及されているが発生国ではないため除外。WHOは本アウトブレイクを5月にPHEICと認定済み。

article.articleHeadline: Hidden Mycobacteria in Cattle Carry Genes Linked to Drug Resistance
article.articleSummary: India (Ludhiana) study of bovine non-tuberculous mycobacteria (NTMs) from cattle and buffaloes examined 193 clinical samples (101 feces, 21 nasal swabs, 13 transtracheal washes, 30 tissues, 28 blood). Using direct PCR and culture-based isolation, 18 NTMs were confirmed after hsp65 genus screening and species-level PCR. Mycobacterium vaccae dominated (66.7% of isolates). The team screened four resistance-associated genes—rpoB (rifampicin), katG (isoniazid), rpsL (streptomycin), and gyrA (fluoroquinolones). rpoB was detected in 88.9% of isolates (primarily M. vaccae), katG in 16.7%, gyrA in 5.6%, while rpsL was not amplified. Findings fill a gap in Indian bovine NTM resistance data and have implications for diagnostic interpretation and bovine TB surveillance, highlighting environmental mycobacteria as common bovine associates.

triage.headline_ja: 牛に潜む非結核性抗酸菌、薬剤耐性関連遺伝子を保有
triage.triage_reason: 研究室ベースの学術調査であり、ヒトまたは動物集団における実際の疾病発生・流行を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は牛由来の非結核性抗酸菌（NTM）の薬剤耐性遺伝子に関する学術研究報告であり、疾病発生イベントではないため対象国のverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia steps up anthrax control measures in Yogyakarta after positive samples
article.articleSummary: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) has been detected in livestock in Dadapayu Village, Gunungkidul, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, prompting intensified control measures. Following laboratory confirmation of positive samples, authorities conducted an epidemiological investigation on Sept 11, 2026, then disinfected affected livestock shelters and treated animals on Sept 12. On Sept 14, antibiotics and vitamins were given to 88 goats and 11 cattle. Vaccination for livestock in the surrounding area began on Sept 28 after the antibiotic window ended. The response is integrated: investigations, animal health services, disinfection, vaccination, and ongoing laboratory testing, with surveillance continuing. Humans exposed to affected animals or products received treatment and prophylactic medications. Any meat not cooked or consumed was destroyed. Residents are urged not to slaughter, process, or consume sick or unexpectedly dead livestock and to report cases to animal health officers. Zoonotic risk emphasized by OIE.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、陽性サンプル確認後にジョグジャカルタで炭疽対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 家畜における炭疽発生で、人への暴露者には予防投薬が実施され被害は限定的。ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはなく、現地当局により管理されているが、土壌中の芽胞残存による継続的曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 炭疽はインドネシアの一部地域（ジョグジャカルタ等）で散発的に発生する風土病的性質を持つ。現地当局による疫学調査・消毒・ワクチン接種・人への予防投薬など対応は迅速かつ体系的に実施されており、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc sốt xuất huyết Dengue chuyển nặng, cảnh giác biến chứng xuất huyết tiêu hóa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children with dengue fever progress to severe illness; beware of gastrointestinal bleeding complications.
article.articleSummary: On 5 October 2026, Hue Central Hospital reported a successful treatment of a 15-year-old patient, C.T.H.N., in Hue City, with Dengue fever complicated by life-threatening gastrointestinal bleeding. The illness began with three days of fever, headache, and dark vomit, followed by about 150 ml of hematemesis and a drop in blood pressure. Endoscopy showed a bleeding duodenal ulcer, controlled with hemoclip and adrenaline after resuscitation and blood transfusion. Ongoing bleeding required over 6,000 ml of blood products: 5,400 ml red cells, 500 ml plasma, and 3 platelets. After about five days, the patient stabilized and was discharged after two more weeks of monitoring. Authorities warn dengue can progress rapidly; seek urgent care for vomiting blood or black stools. CDC Hue reports 282 dengue cases this year with no deaths; Phú Xuân Medical Center has 94. Preventive measures include mosquito control and consulting about the Qdenga vaccine for ages 4+, with eligibility considerations.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のデング熱重症化、消化管出血合併症に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の治療報告であり、デング熱はベトナムにおいて既知の流行病。死亡例なく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleSummary: Anthrax case detected in Kalurahan Dadapayu, Kapanewon Semanu, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta (DIY), prompting intensified animal-disease controls in Gunungkidul as of 2026-10-05. Field teams in full PPE conducted handling and sterilization at the discovery site to prevent wider transmission. The Ministry of Agriculture (Kementerian Pertanian) stated the response is integrated with local government and veterinary personnel under the Directorate General of Livestock and Animal Health (Ditjen PKH). No details on case counts, clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection source were disclosed. The report appears amid broader Indonesian news on nickel downstreaming and AI research in Bali, but centers on enhanced surveillance and containment of animal diseases following the anthrax finding.

article.articleHeadline: IOM: Multi-Country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak - Situation Report No. 20 (21 - 27 September 2026)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé) with 8,116 confirmed cases and 3,924 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%) as of 27 September 2026. Across 63 health zones in 7 provinces, Ituri accounts for 76.2% of cumulative cases, maintaining its position as the outbreak epicenter; the daily number of new confirmed cases has declined but transmission persists across multiple provinces. On 27 Sept, 49 new confirmed cases and 23 deaths were reported (18 community deaths), with Ituri (27), North Kivu (18), and Haut-Uélé (4) most affected. National contact follow-up rate stands at 75.9%, highlighting ongoing challenges in surveillance, case investigation and timely care. The outbreak unfolds within a complex humanitarian and mobility context, with cross-border movements and preparedness activities in neighboring countries. IOM supports response in DRC, Uganda, Burundi, Rwanda and South Sudan, and preparedness in Angola, CAR, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of the Congo, Tanzania and Zambia under IASC activation.

triage.headline_ja: IOM:多国間ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク状況報告書第20号（2026年9月21日～27日）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,116人の確定症例、致死率48.3%という大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、複数州への伝播と国境を越えた人の移動により国際的拡大リスクが高く、IASC活動化による国際支援も行われているため。
triage.notes: ザンビア、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国、エチオピア、ケニア、タンザニアなどはIASC活動化下での備え（preparedness）活動の対象国であり、実際の感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。実際の症例・死亡はDRC（イトゥリ、北キブ、オートウェレ州）でのみ報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Anthrax Case Detected in Yogyakarta as Indonesia Steps Up Disease Control
article.articleSummary: Anthrax detected in Dadapayu Village, Gunungkidul, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, with authorities stepping up control as of Oct 4, 2026. The Agriculture Ministry’s Directorate General of Livestock and Animal Health coordinates an integrated response: epidemiological investigations, livestock health services, disinfection, vaccination, laboratory examinations, animal health monitoring, and risk communication. An epidemiological trace conducted on Sept 11 aimed to map the incident, assess surrounding livestock, and collect samples. On Sept 12, shelters were disinfected and animals requiring care treated, with vitamins given to healthy livestock in the area. By Sept 14, antibiotics and vitamins were administered to 88 goats and 11 cattle in Dadapayu Village. Vaccinations began on Sept 28 for nearby livestock after antibiotic treatment. Officials urge residents not to slaughter, process, distribute, or consume sick or dead livestock and to report promptly; follow instructions of animal health officers and consult them before moving livestock from monitored areas. Surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、ジョグジャカルタで炭疽菌感染確認、感染症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（ヤギ・牛）における炭疽発生で、現時点で人への感染報告はなく、当局が既に疫学調査・消毒・ワクチン接種などの対応を実施中。人獣共通感染症であり監視継続中のため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm phổi do tụ cầu vàng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonia caused by Staphylococcus aureus.
article.articleSummary: A single case in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam describes a 20-year-old with pneumonia caused by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) confirmed by blood culture, following a lip wound near the mouth that likely served as the entry portal. Symptoms included chest pain and mild dyspnea; labs showed leukocytosis and elevated CRP. Chest CT revealed bilateral dense lung consolidations with pleural effusions and features consistent with septic emboli. After treatment, the patient recovered, pleural effusions resolved, and was discharged. The report emphasizes that MRSA pneumonia/sepsis can arise from hematogenous spread from non-respiratory infection sites (e.g., skin wounds, dental infections) rather than solely via the lower respiratory tract, and highlights the need for prompt evaluation of atypical presentations.

article.articleHeadline: How Congo's Ebola Epidemic Got So Bad So Quickly
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, had killed more than 3,900 people since May, making it the second-largest on record and affecting seven provinces; the epidemic likely began spreading in January. The World Health Organization declared a health emergency in May, but Mangala's response only ramped up in August. By September, treatment capacity remained limited: a planned center near Mangala, to be run by Alima, was still a patch of red earth. At Mangala’s regional hospital, patients with suspected Ebola circulated in a central courtyard; five nurses and a doctor contracted Ebola, and one nurse died. The government stopped paying hospital staff at the crisis onset, harming morale. Symptoms include fever and vomiting; blood samples were sent for testing. New weekly cases peaked in August per Africa CDC, with access hindered by rough roads and insurgent checkpoints.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行はいかにして急速に悪化したか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は死者3,900人超・史上2番目の規模で7州に拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるオーストラリア（State of South Australia, Commonwealth of Australia）は記事サマリーの主題と無関係であり誤付与と判断し除外した。Ituri州はDRC国内の地域のため、国家単位でDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: 1.3K tested +ve for dengue in Chennai in September, GCC says cases on decline
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Chennai, India, reached 4,592 cases through September 2026 with no deaths; total this year exceeds 4,500. September alone accounted for 1,293 infections; 16,254 people have been tested. Officials say the situation is stabilising and cases are declining, though prevention remains intensive. Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) deploys 3,703 mosquito‑control workers, runs over 100 fever camps daily, and uses about 1,250 larvicide-spraying machines; drone spraying covers water bodies, including Cooum. Fines of Rs 7.2 lakh were issued last month for failing to clear breeding sources. Monsoon-related breeding risk persists; Chennai has 3,000+ km of stormwater drains and 250 km of highways drains, with desilting of 1,400 of 1,600 km completed. A Rs 13.5 crore cut‑and‑cover drain from IIT Madras to the South Buckingham Canal is under construction. Finance: Rs 1,100 crore to clear contractor dues, Rs 300 crore loan, Rs 100 crore for monsoon works, plus World Bank/JICA support.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで9月に1,293人がデング熱陽性、GCCは症例減少と発表

triage.notes: モンスーン期の蚊媒介リスクは継続するが、死亡者なし・症例減少傾向であり、地方自治体の通常業務範囲内の対応として管理されている。

article.articleHeadline: Head Lice in Thai Schools Carry Mutations Linked to Pyrethroid Resistance
article.articleSummary: Head lice infestation (Pediculus humanus capitis) in eastern Thailand's Chonburi Province shows emerging pyrethroid resistance. In a May–July 2024 survey of 960 schoolchildren across five public schools, overall pediculosis prevalence was 20.42% (95% CI 17.91–23.11%), higher in rural than urban settings. Logistic regression linked infestation with sex, school level, hair length, and reported pediculicide use, suggesting possible cycles of treatment failure or rapid reinfestation. Molecular analyses confirmed lice identity and placed samples in mitochondrial clades A or C. Crucially, knockdown resistance mutations in the voltage-gated sodium channel gene—T917I and L920F—were detected, with homozygous resistant genotypes found in lice from four schools, indicating established pyrethroid resistance in local populations. Resistant lice were found in children with and without reported permethrin treatment history, implying community-wide circulation. Findings published in Parasites & Vectors.

triage.headline_ja: タイの学校でピレスロイド耐性に関連する変異を持つアタマジラミが確認
triage.triage_reason: アタマジラミの殺虫剤耐性に関する学術研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名Coccidioidomycosisはメタデータと記事内容（アタマジラミのピレスロイド耐性）が一致しておらず、Bluedotの分類ミスと考えられる。アタマジラミ寄生は公衆衛生上の重大イベントではなく、学術的サーベイランス報告である。

article.articleHeadline: Russia Plague Scare: Suspected Pneumonic Plague Case in Siberia Puts Authorities on Alert
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk, Siberia: a 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute reportedly broke a tube containing pneumonic plague bacteria on Sept 25 and died Oct 2. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says the woman had pneumonia of unknown cause and has not publicly confirmed plague; testing reportedly detected no microorganisms from her work. Precautionary measures include about 200 people under medical observation or isolation and heightened hospital restrictions. The United States, including a Trump administration official, says it is monitoring the situation with the CDC; no wider community transmission has been confirmed. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, spreads via respiratory particles and can be fatal if untreated; antibiotics are highly effective with early treatment. WHO notes three historic plague pandemics, with no global pandemic in the last 100 years; Madagascar 2017 and India 1994 are cited as regional precedents. Focus remains on testing and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト警戒：シベリアで肺ペスト疑い症例、当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 研究所内事故による肺ペスト疑い死亡例で深刻性・異常性は高いが、公式確認なく地域拡大の証拠もないため続報を注視。対象国（ロシア）はモニタリング対象国リスト外のため地域的観点でも優先度は限定的。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しないためverified_locationsは空。記事中のIndia・Madagascarは過去の歴史的事例の言及であり、現在の発生国ではない。公式にはロシア当局はペストと確認しておらず、原因不明の肺炎として扱われている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Peste polmonare, i sintomi, il contagio le cure: tutto quello che c'è da sapere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic Plague: Symptoms, Transmission, and Treatments — Everything You Need to Know.
article.articleSummary: Nine swine plague outbreaks have been confirmed in Lombardy, Italy, caused by Yersinia pestis. Pneumonic plague is the most severe form and may arise directly or as a complication of untreated bubonic plague. Transmission to humans occurs mainly via infected fleas, contact with tissues or fluids of infected animals, or respiratory spread from a patient with pneumonic plague; close contact is usually needed. Pneumonic incubation is typically 1–4 days. Symptoms begin with fever, chills, headache, and weakness, then pneumonia with dyspnea, chest pain, and bloody sputum; untreated pneumonic plague can kill within 18–24 hours, with near 100% mortality. Early antibiotics within 24 hours plus respiratory support markedly improve survival (about 10% mortality). Isolation and droplet precautions are essential; close contacts receive prophylaxis. Endemic foci in Madagascar, DRC, Peru, Mongolia, Central Asia, Siberia, and SW United States. Europe risk is zero as of 2026-10-05. A laboratory-origin case highlights biosafety; Irkutsk cited.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト：症状、感染経路、治療法——知っておくべきすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペスト（特に肺ペスト）に関する一般的な解説記事であり、シベリア（ロシア）の実験室起源症例やイタリア・ロンバルディアの事例を中心に扱っている。対象国（DRC等）は流行地として言及されるのみで、実際の発生事例として報じられていないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの解説記事で、主な話題はシベリア（イルクーツク）での実験室起源症例とイタリア・ロンバルディアでの豚ペスト（原文の混乱の可能性あり）事例。DRC・マダガスカル・ペルー・モンゴル等は常在流行地として一般情報の中で言及されているのみで、対象国リストに該当する実際の発生事例ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: New Infectivity Atlas Maps Which Sarbecoviruses Can Latch Onto Human and
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, investigators mapped infectivity for 46 sarbecoviruses against 66 ACE2 orthologs (48 bat-derived from 11 families) using pseudotyped vesicular stomatitis virus with spike proteins and luminescent entry readouts, producing a cross-species infectivity heatmap. Phylogeny divides viruses into clade 1 (1a: SARS-CoV-1 relatives; 1b: SARS-CoV-2 relatives, including RaTG13 and pangolin viruses), clade 2 (majority with a double RBM deletion and ACE2-independent entry), and clade 3 (BtKY72, Khosta-2). Clade 1b pangolin viruses PCoV-GD and PCoV-GX show broad ACE2 compatibility, infecting most non-bat mammalian ACE2s; RaTG13 exhibits a restricted host range despite high spike similarity to SARS-CoV-2. WIV1 (bat) bridges human and bat ACE2 usage. Clade 2 viruses do not use ACE2; Clade 3 species show limited to modest ACE2 usage. Across all 46 viruses, none of NRP1, CD147, AXL, TMEM106B supported infection, reinforcing ACE2 as the primary entry receptor. The study identifies two bat species with human-like ACE2 receptors, flagging them for surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい感染性アトラスが、どのサルベコウイルスがヒトおよびコウモリの受容体に結合できるかをマッピング
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実験室ベースの基礎研究論文のサマリーであり、実際の感染症イベント（患者、確定例、流行）を報告していない。疾患名にVesicular Stomatitisが挙げられているが、これは研究の技術手法（ウイルス運搬体）として使用されているに過ぎず、実際のVesicular Stomatitis発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが中国を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーから明らかなように、本記事は実験室での病原体受容体結合研究であり、実際の地理的感染症イベントではない。患者報告や確定例がなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" بالكونغو إلى 8376 والوفيات إلى 4042 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 8,376 and deaths to 4,042.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have reached 8,376 with 4,042 deaths, according to the national health ministry. Jean Kasia, Director-General of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, warned that the virus continues to spread and threatens neighboring countries. The United Nations has urged additional resources to combat the epidemic. In May, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing elevated regional risk. The report highlights ongoing transmission within the DRC and underscores the need for strengthened cross-border surveillance and international support to curb spread.

article.articleHeadline: 沈阳一家三口吃炒蛋中毒 涉事鸡蛋曾水洗后存放
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family of three in Shenyang poisoned after eating scrambled eggs; the implicated eggs had been rinsed and stored.
article.articleSummary: Shenyang, Liaoning Province, China: a family of three developed food poisoning after eating scrambled eggs; the implicated eggs had been rinsed and stored. Experts warn that washing eggshells can remove the natural protective coating, increasing entry of bacteria such as Salmonella. Sun Jing, researcher at the Hubei Academy of Agricultural Sciences and scientist with the National Waterfowl Industry Technology System egg product processing, explains that the eggshell has microscopic pores and a gelatinous protective film that forms after laying to block microbes and retain moisture. Once this film is damaged by washing, bacteria can enter via pores even under refrigeration, raising contamination risk. If washed eggs cannot be cooked promptly, refrigerate and cook thoroughly before consumption. Additional storage tips: wipe light dirt with a dry cloth; avoid heavily soiled eggs; do not freeze eggs; store with the large end up; and prevent cross-contamination by keeping eggs separate from other foods.

article.articleHeadline: Peste polmonare a Irkutsk: cosa ne sappiamo davvero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague in Irkutsk: What do we really know.
article.articleSummary: Irkutsk region: a 27-year-old female lab worker at the Institute of Bacteriology of Siberia and the Far East in Shelekhov near Irkutsk died after a brief hospitalization with severe pneumonia, reported Oct 2. At least 197 people are under medical observation, with more than 100 hospitalized; Irkutsk public events were canceled and some reports claim hospitals are under a three‑week quarantine. Official statements as of Oct 4 from Rospotrebnadzor describe the patient’s illness as pneumonia of unspecified etiology; laboratory samples showed no pathogens linked to her work, and there is no public confirmation of Yersinia pestis. Anna Popova traveled to Shelekhov for an emergency meeting, with the governor noting conflicting statements from officials. If pneumonic plague is confirmed, it is the most virulent form, transmitted person-to-person via respiratory droplets with up to 100% fatality if untreated, and incubation can be as short as 24 hours. No secondary cases reported among identified contacts; Beijing 2019 cases cited as precedent. Lab‑incident risks in infectious disease work remain a concern.

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: France Pledges More Support to Fight DR Congo Ebola Outbreak As Deaths Top 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern DR Congo has killed 4,042 and infected 8,376 since the outbreak began in Bunia, Ituri, on May 15. The outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola event in history, though weekly cases have fallen—from 850 cases and 470 deaths in mid-July to 490 cases and 230 deaths in September—while transmission remains active in several hotspots. North Kivu now accounts for 40% of new confirmed cases since late August. France pledged €13.4 million for Ebola response from January to July, and Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visited Bunia to press for more humanitarian funding ahead of a Paris conference on October 6. The WHO warns the outbreak could exceed West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of 11,000. An imported case in France involved a doctor who tested positive after returning from a DRC mission on June 23, and later recovered. Nineteen zones had no cases for three weeks.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surge to 8,376 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues with 8,376 reported cases. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya warns sustained transmission within the DRC maintains a heightened risk of cross-border spread to neighbouring countries, driven in part by ongoing population movement. The World Health Organization underscores that ongoing transmission poses a regional threat. During a visit to the DRC, French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot reaffirmed France’s support for outbreak response and emphasized vigilance to prevent resurgence. Persistent transmission and cross-border mobility raise concerns for regional public health security, prompting continued monitoring and international cooperation as of 5 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Rusya'da veba SON DAKİKA! Rusya'da veba salgını mı başladı, kaç kişi öldü?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Russia - BREAKING NEWS! Has a plague outbreak started in Russia, and how many people have died?
article.articleSummary: In Russia's Irkutsk region, 28-year-old lab worker Darya Shipilova at the Institute for Plague Control Research died, prompting questions about a plague outbreak. Allegations she handled a Yersinia pestis sample have not been confirmed by authorities. Rospotrebnadzor says the death is due to unknown-origin pneumonia, with no microorganisms linked to professional activity detected. About 200 potentially exposed individuals are under medical surveillance; none have developed symptoms and tests were negative. Preventive quarantine measures are in place at some facilities, but there is no confirmed plague outbreak. For context, the World Health Organization notes plague still occurs in some countries, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar. The current status remains unconfirmed pending laboratory confirmation and epidemiological assessment as of 2026-10-05.

article.articleHeadline: 买鸡蛋洗干净先放雪柜？一家三口食炒蛋中毒 专家:越洗越易养菌！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wash eggs clean before refrigerating after buying? A family of three poisoned by fried eggs; expert: the more you wash, the easier it is to breed bacteria!
article.articleSummary: Salmonella infection struck a family of three in Liaoning, China, after a dinner of fried eggs; all developed fever, severe abdominal pain and vomiting and were hospitalized. Lab tests confirmed Salmonella. Investigators linked the outbreak to washing eggs before refrigeration, which removes the shell’s protective coating and lets bacteria enter the egg through pores, accelerating contamination in the fridge. Health authorities advise: dry-wipe dirty eggs rather than rinsing; if washing is necessary, do so only just before cooking; store eggs with the larger end up to keep the air cell at the top, and keep unwashed eggs in the original carton or a separate container to prevent cross-contamination. If eggs have been washed, consume them within 3 days after cooking.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Apakah Berbahaya? Bukan Flu Biasa, Bisa Sebabkan Komplikasi Serius!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A: Is it dangerous? Not just the common flu, it can cause serious complications!
article.articleSummary: Oseltamivir reduces pneumonia complications by up to 50% in patients infected with Influenza A. Influenza A is one of four main influenza types (A, B, C, and D) cited by the Indonesian Ministry of Health. In humans, A and B drive seasonal influenza, with Influenza A having greater pandemic potential due to its capacity for genetic change. The virus evolves via antigenic drift (small, gradual mutations) and antigenic shift (major reassortment) that can yield new A strains capable of widespread human transmission. Subtypes are defined by surface proteins hemagglutinin (H) and neuraminidase (N); common human subtypes include A(H1N1) and A(H3N2), while some animal-origin subtypes can infect humans. While not always causing severe disease, Influenza A requires attention due to its variability and potential for new strains.

article.articleHeadline: White House monitoring suspected plague outbreak in Russia after lab technician dies, 197 isolated
article.articleSummary: White House is monitoring a suspected plague outbreak in Russia after the death of 28-year-old laboratory technician Darya Shipilova at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Shelekhov, near Irkutsk. She was admitted September 29 with severe pneumonia, placed on a ventilator, and died two days later. Conflicting accounts place the illness with a broken test tube of live bacteria, a field expedition in Buryatia near the Mongolia border, or a return from Thailand. Russia's Rospotrebnadzor rejects the broken-tube explanation, saying no microorganisms linked to her work were found; death is classified as pneumonia of unknown cause and the epidemiological situation is described as stable. As of October 2, 197 people who may have contacted Shipilova were quarantined or under medical observation; none became ill. Hospitals in Irkutsk imposed quarantines; Irkutsk Aluminium Plant workers were asked to wear masks. Social media reactions were skeptical and alarmed.

article.articleHeadline: मक्खी-मच्छर से फैल सकता है लंपी, पशुपालक ऐसे रखें गोवंश का ध्यान, जानिए टिप्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy skin disease can spread through flies and mosquitoes; here's how livestock owners should care for their cattle — tips.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy skin disease (LSD) is spreading among cattle in Meerut, Western Uttar Pradesh, prompting an intensified vaccination drive and improved farm hygiene. Since July, the Veterinary Department has been actively vaccinating; in Meerut's 2,09,488 cattle, about 1,12,000 have been vaccinated, with the rest due in coming days. LSD is contagious and can spread from one animal to another; flies and mosquitoes can transmit the infection. Chief Veterinary Officer Pavitrajit Singh says vaccination is ongoing and accessible; farmers should use mosquito nets where possible and maintain cleanliness around animals. For supportive care, Giloy water can be offered and Neem water used for bathing; wounds may be treated with Betadine after veterinary consultation. Farmers in rural areas should contact the local veterinary department to arrange vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Red Cross Driver Dies After Ebola Response Mission in DRC
article.articleSummary: Ismael Mulindwa, a Uganda Red Cross Society driver, died after almost a month of treatment following deployment to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support the Ebola response. Mulindwa’s death came after an attack on the Red Cross team in the DRC during the Ebola operation; he died as a result of injuries sustained on duty. He was buried in Kabimbiri, Uganda (off Kayunga Road). Mulindwa was described by URCS as a dedicated ambulance worker whose service touched many lives and built strong community ties, and as a peacemaker at home who valued family and service. His passing follows Uganda’s World Health Organization declaration of Ebola-free status slightly more than a month earlier, underscoring ongoing risks faced by aid workers in Ebola response operations in the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: تجربة دواء جديد للوقاية من إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A trial of a new drug to prevent Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 250 people joined a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to test Obildesivir, a Gilead antiviral used as post-exposure prophylaxis against Ebola virus, specifically the Bundibugyo strain, which currently lacks a licensed vaccine or therapy. The study aims to enroll about 1,000 adults and children over 12 who have had contact with laboratory-confirmed cases in the past five days; participants will receive either the drug or a placebo and be followed daily for 21 days. The effort comes as Ebola continues to spread in eastern Congo, with thousands of infections and deaths across multiple provinces. In parallel, authorities began vaccinating healthcare workers with Ervebo, effective against another Ebola lineage, though its protection against Bundibugyo is under study. Researchers hope Obildesivir can prevent disease among exposed individuals, reducing transmission and breaking the outbreak chain.

triage.notes: 記事は治験（Obildesivir）に焦点を当てているが、背景として東部コンゴで複数州にわたるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の継続的な流行が報告されており、既存ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性も未確定なため、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Cosa sappiamo del presunto caso di peste polmonare in Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What do we know about the suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia?
article.articleSummary: In Russia’s Irkutsk region, a 28-year-old lab technician at the Irkutsk plague research institute died on October 2 in a Shelekhov hospital, prompting extraordinary precautions. Four Irkutsk city hospitals were quarantined and about 200 contacts were under observation. Rospotrebnadzor has not confirmed plague, stating the death was due to pneumonia of unknown origin and that tests found no microorganism linked to her work. Local media reported possible pneumonic plague; Irkutsk Governor Kobzev convened an emergency meeting. The neighboring Republic of Buryatia’s governor, Alexei Tsydenov, said a woman there died “probably of plague,” with no active foci, citing Rospotrebnadzor. Pneumonic plague is highly contagious via respiratory droplets. Global plague data (2019–2025) report 2,646 confirmed cases and 423 deaths, mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar.

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ISPA di Kabupaten Tangerang Tembus 30 Ribu, Melonjak 2 Bulan Terakhir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) cases in Tangerang Regency exceed 30,000, rising in the last two months.
article.articleSummary: Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) cases in Tangerang Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia rose to about 30,000 by the end of September 2026, with officials suspecting influenza A among them. Laboratory confirmation of the specific viruses has not been performed. The surge follows a two-month rise: 19,000–25,000 cases prior to August 2026, increasing to 28,000–30,000 in August–September. Most patients receive care at primary health facilities (Puskesmas) or BPJS-covered clinics; severe cases go to hospital emergency departments. ARI symptoms include cough, fever up to 40°C, dizziness, and body pains, closely resembling influenza. Officials attribute the increase partly to prolonged dry air and weaker immunity, noting the trend is particularly concerning for children. No mention of imported/exported cases is made; current data reflect domestic transmission within Tangerang Regency.

article.articleHeadline: 3,832 Child Leprosy Cases Challenge India's 2027 Goal
article.articleSummary: India reported 3,832 new child leprosy cases in 2025–26, 91.6% above the target of 2,000, signaling ongoing transmission. Thirty-seven newly diagnosed children had Grade-2 disability at detection, indicating nerve or eye damage before diagnosis. Across all ages, 91,783 new leprosy cases were reported in 2025–26; children accounted for 4.18%, and 1,945 patients had Grade-2 disability at detection. Leprosy (Hansen disease) is mainly skin and peripheral nerves; transmission is believed to occur via droplets from prolonged close contact with untreated cases. Multidrug therapy with rifampicin, dapsone, and clofazimine is given for six to twelve months, depending on classification. A district is considered to have interrupted transmission after five consecutive years with no new indigenous child cases; India targets this by 2027. Despite national elimination in 2005, prevalence fell to 0.57 per 10,000 in 2025, yet tens of thousands of new cases continue yearly.

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για πανώλη στη Ρωσία: Νεκρή 28χρονη επιστήμονας #StarGrNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over plague in Russia: 28-year-old scientist dead #StarGrNews.
article.articleSummary: Plague alarm in Siberia’s Irkutsk region after the death of 28-year-old Darya Sipilova, a researcher at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Control, with about 200 people under medical surveillance. Sipilova died Oct 2 in an ICU in Selezhov; a vial containing Yersinia pestis reportedly broke on Sept 25, and she was hospitalized with severe pneumonia on Sept 29. Russian authorities (Rospotrebnadzor) say pneumonia of unknown origin and that tests found no microorganisms linked to her work; the epidemiological situation is described as stable. Quarantine measures have been imposed at several medical facilities; hospitals in the region reportedly closed for up to three weeks, and a mask mandate was enforced at an Irkutsk aluminum plant in Selezhov. China reports a confirmed bubonic plague case; authorities initially avoided using the word plague. The White House is monitoring the situation. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is treatable with antibiotics if caught early; untreated, it is nearly always fatal.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jharkhand: About 30 children who returned from an educational excursion in Khunti are ill; the Health Department has started an investigation.
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand, Khunti district, Karra block: about 30 students from PM Shri Higher Secondary School Tilmi fell ill after returning from an educational excursion on 3 October. By 5 October, they exhibited vomiting, diarrhea, high fever, and abdominal pain; several were admitted to Karra Community Health Center. Doctors say conditions are under control. Health authorities suspect the illness may be linked to the 3 October excursion. The school had taken students to Gurukul in Dodma village, Torpa block, where meals were prepared by the children; some pupils reportedly ate food from stalls near the picnic site. The cause remains unconfirmed—possible contaminated food or an infectious illness. Investigations are underway, with surveillance intensified in Tilmi, Masco, and Barvadag villages. Medical teams are visiting homes; medicines are provided as needed. The district hospital is on alert for any deterioration.

article.articleHeadline: newsGP - Dengue vaccine available in Australia
article.articleSummary: Qdenga, a live-attenuated dengue vaccine, is now available in Australia. ATAGI recommends it for people aged four or more with a confirmed or likely dengue history travelling to endemic areas, or those without history planning prolonged or repeated visits. For four-and-over individuals without dengue history planning short trips, vaccination can be considered on an individual risk-benefit basis. It is given in two 0.5 mL doses at least 12 weeks apart; both are essential, with no booster evidence yet. Dengue is a globally expanding disease, with about 100 million symptomatic cases annually. In Australia, nearly all notified cases are acquired overseas; top destinations Indonesia, Thailand, India, Vietnam and Fiji account for about one-third of short trips. In 2024 there were 2381 notifications; 2025 saw 1863. Local outbreaks have occurred in northern/central Queensland and the Torres Strait from importations; vaccination may be used during local outbreaks on public health advice. There are four serotypes; infection with one confers lifelong protection against that serotype, but a second infection with a different serotype can be fatal.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gwalior, with changing weather, the Lumpy Skin Disease outbreak has reduced; the number of cattle reaching Ratwai Gaushala has declined; up to 60,000 vaccinations administered.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Gwalior district in Madhya Pradesh reports relief from Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cattle as seasonal changes dampen transmission. Vector-borne spread via flies, mosquitoes, and ticks during the monsoon has decreased with rainfall stopping and sunlight rising. The daily influx of LSD-affected cattle to Ratwai Gaushala has fallen from five–ten to one–two, with municipal and veterinary teams isolating and relocating infected animals. A district-wide vaccination drive has immunized over 60,000 cattle using the Goatpox vaccine. Official counts record about 65 LSD-related deaths, though livestock groups say the true figure is higher. At Ratwai Gaushala, around 20 infected cattle remain in an isolation ward under treatment with antibiotics and multivitamins. Symptoms include lumps on the body, fever, and lethargy. Authorities urge continued vigilance and prompt veterinary care for suspected cases; Dr. Dilip Gupta, Deputy Director of Animal Husbandry, is cited.

article.articleHeadline: China's Vaccine Assistance Strengthens Pakistan's Livestock Disease-control Efforts
article.articleSummary: China donates 300,000 veterinary vaccine doses to Pakistan to combat lumpy skin disease (LSD) and Brucella melitensis, aiming to strengthen sustained surveillance, vaccination, cold-chain management, and veterinary coverage in rural areas. Pakistan’s livestock subsector accounts for 62.45% of agricultural value addition and 14.64% of GDP in FY2025-26, with 55.86 million cattle, 47.74 million buffaloes, 44.59 million sheep and 95.83 million goats. The WOAH underscores vaccination, early detection, biosecurity and movement controls for LSD; brucellosis is a zoonosis with significant economic impact. Pakistan sought greater investment in animal health at a September FAO meeting and is developing an electronic Animal Disease Reporting and Surveillance System as part of One Health. Meat exports totaled 114,046 tonnes worth $530.25 million in FY2025-26; 2.38 million kg of boiled beef to China in 2025 (up 177%). The program aims to progress to technology transfer, diagnostics, laboratory development and local vaccine production under CPEC Phase II.

article.articleHeadline: Endothelial Angptl2 Emerges as Central Driver of Influenza-Linked Lung
article.articleSummary: Influenza-associated pulmonary fibrosis is driven by endothelial Angptl2. In Hangzhou, China, researchers at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine linked vascular Angptl2 to fibrotic remodeling using human transcriptomics, a murine H1N1 model, and single-cell sequencing. Angptl2 expression rises in endothelial cells during disease and is elevated in bronchoalveolar lavage from fibrotic patients versus non-fibrotic controls. In Angptl2 knockout mice, fibrosis is attenuated with preserved lung architecture and reduced extracellular matrix. Mechanistically, Angptl2 binds the α5β1 integrin on endothelial cells, activating MAPK and PI3K-AKT signaling to promote endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndMT). EndMT cells secrete endothelin-1, triggering NF-κB activation in neighboring fibroblasts to become matrix-producing. A protective Rgs2-positive endothelial population expands in Angptl2-deficient mice, suggesting Angptl2 normally suppresses this state. Findings reveal a vascular-endothelial axis linking acute viral injury to chronic scarring and highlight potential therapeutic targets.

article.articleHeadline: Apenas 19% dos pais no Brasil sabem que meningite pode ser fatal | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Only 19% of parents in Brazil know that meningitis can be fatal | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: World Meningitis Day survey in Brazil shows 89% of parents consider meningococcal meningitis serious, yet only 19% know it can be fatal within hours. Among youths aged 15–25, awareness of rapid progression is 10%. Serogroup B has been the most prevalent in Brazil since 2023. The study also finds 21% of parents believe meningitis starts with severe symptoms; only 29% of parents and 24% of youths recognize adolescents and young adults as vaccination targets. About 30% of parents with unvaccinated children expect vaccination to be discussed during medical visits. Rodrigo Nascimento, medical vaccines director at GSK Brazil, notes initial symptoms like fever, headache, and vomiting can resemble other illnesses, delaying care, and stresses urgent medical attention and preventive vaccination when recommended. The Human8 survey for GSK involved 6,003 respondents across six countries; in Brazil, 1,001 participants (501 parents, 500 youths) were surveyed May 20–June 12, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Manila logs 38 new dengue cases, bringing total to 3,555
article.articleSummary: Manila logged 38 new dengue cases on Monday, raising the city’s year-to-date dengue total to 3,555, according to the Manila Health Department’s W.I.L.D. (water-borne diseases, influenza, leptospirosis, and dengue) report using data from the EDCS-IS as of 7 a.m. on Oct. 5. The same report records 23 new influenza-like illness (ILI) cases, 5 new severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) cases, and 5 new leptospirosis cases; no new cholera, typhoid fever, or confirmed COVID-19 cases. From Jan. 1 to Oct. 5, Manila totals stand at 3,555 dengue, 2,100 ILI, 1,612 leptospirosis, and 478 SARI cases, with typhoid 82, COVID-19 100, and cholera 4. The MHD emphasizes ongoing monitoring of W.I.L.D. diseases, particularly during the rainy season, and urges residents to remain cautious.

article.articleHeadline: Karta kuge: Smrtonosna bakterija pobjegla iz laboratorija u Sibiru?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Map of the Plague: Did a Deadly Bacterium Escape from a Laboratory in Siberia?
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Siberia, a 28-year-old laboratory worker at the Institute for Plague Research died after developing severe pneumonia; Russian authorities have not confirmed Yersinia pestis as the cause. Nearly 200 people who may have been exposed were identified, several medical facilities were quarantined, and public events canceled as investigators probe possible lab-safety breaches. The U.S., via the State Department and CDC, is monitoring the case and urging Russia to publish complete information. Globally, WHO maps show plague persists in multiple regions. From 2019–2025 there were 3860 suspected cases, 2646 confirmed, and 423 deaths. Confirmed cases occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Madagascar, Uganda, China, and Mongolia; suspected cases in Brazil, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and Ecuador. Most confirmed cases are in Africa, especially DRC and Madagascar, accounting for about 98% of confirmed cases. Pneumonic plague is dangerous form and can spread person-to-person via droplets; antibiotic treatment is crucial.

article.articleHeadline: Rabies and the missing deaths: Why do India's official numbers differ so sharply from estimates? |Explained
article.articleSummary: India aims to eliminate dog-mediated human rabies by 2030 but lacks a single national death tally. IDSP-IHIP logged 54 human rabies deaths in 2024; 21 in 2022 and 50 in 2023. The Registrar General's MCCD counted 66 deaths in 2022 and 271 in 2023, but these are medically certified deaths and cover only a fraction of totals. Rabies is not nationally notifiable, though the NCDC is pushing states to notify under their laws; many deaths occur outside formal health systems, hampering surveillance. In four months of 2026, Tamil Nadu recorded 2.63 lakh dog bites and 17 rabies deaths. A Lancet Infectious Diseases study led by ICMR estimates about 5,726 deaths in India, derived from a large community survey (337,808 people in 60 districts across 15 states) and a probability model; about 9.1 million animal bites yearly (including 5.6 million dog bites). The gap arises from differing surveillance, certification, and model-based approaches.
