She developed severe pneumonia and died despite mechanical ventilation on October 1. Authorities imposed a lockdown in the area, with 197+ contacts quarantined and tested; all results were negative. The incident raised fears of cross-border spread, but Indian Medical Association officials clarified that the infection is pneumonic plague and the immediate risk to India is very low. They noted the disease’s rapid progression with fever, cough, and difficulty breathing, and that an infected person would be quickly detected and isolated at airports if travel occurred. The focus remains on heightened surveillance, even as no domestic or international cases outside Russia are reported.

triage.headline_ja: 研究所から流出した危険なウイルス…インド人に影響は？専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: 発生事案はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所内事故による肺ペストであり、接触者197人以上は全員陰性で封じ込めが確認されている。対象国（インド含む）への国際的拡大は報告されておらず、インド側専門家も自国への影響は極めて低いとしている。
triage.notes: 事案発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。インドは記事中で言及されているが、実際の発症・感染はインド国内で発生していないためverified_locationsには含めない。研究所内事故による単発例で、接触者は全員陰性、ヒト-ヒト感染の拡大は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bafwasende : mise en œuvre d'un Centre de traitement d'Ebola de 20 lits (médecin chef) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bafwasende: Implementation of a 20-bed Ebola Treatment Center (Chief Medical Officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) of 20 beds is being implemented in Bafwasende territory, Tshopo Province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo. The facility will allocate 12 beds for confirmed Ebola virus disease cases (6 men, 6 women) and eight beds for suspected cases (4 men, 4 women). International Medical Corps (IMC) has launched the bidding process and applicants have submitted files; construction work has not yet begun. Epidemiologically, the Bafwasende health zone currently reports eight confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including three deaths. This initiative aims to strengthen isolation and care capabilities amid the ongoing Ebola situation in the region. No further clinical details or transmission sources are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: バフワセンデでのエボラ出血熱:20床のエボラ治療センター設立(医療責任者)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確認症例8例・死亡3例が報告されており、治療センター新設が進められていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべき案件。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く国際的に重要視される疾患であり、International Medical Corpsによる治療センター設立準備が進んでいることから国際支援が既に動いている。感染源・伝播経路の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: РСТ не располагает информацией о вспышке Коксаки среди россиян во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST has no information about a Coxsackievirus outbreak among Russians in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, the Russian Union of the Tourism Industry (RST) reports no information about a mass Coxsackievirus outbreak among Russian tourists in Vietnam, though isolated cases cannot be ruled out since Coxsackie is seasonal. RST is continuing to verify details with tour operators serving Vietnam. Telegram channel Mash claimed on July 29 at 04:30 that an outbreak occurred at Amiana Resort Cam Ranh, affecting several Russian families, but no mass outbreak has been confirmed; no outbreak in Antalya is reported. Coxsackievirus is an enterovirus spread via close contact and contaminated water or food; symptoms typically include fever, rash, and mucosal lesions. Children are most at risk, and most infections are mild. RST emphasizes ongoing inquiries and notes that reports remain preliminary while operators on the Vietnamese direction are consulted.

triage.headline_ja: RST、ベトナムにおけるロシア人観光客間のコクサッキーウイルス集団感染に関する情報はないと発表
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのリゾートでの集団感染の噂があるが、公式には否定・未確認であり、情報が限定的であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Telegram上の未確認情報に基づく噂であり、RSTは公式に集団発生を否定。トルコ・アンタルヤでの発生も報告なし。コクサッキーウイルスは季節性があり小児に多いが重症度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bruselas sigue "de cerca" la situación tras un posible brote de peste en Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brussels is closely monitoring the situation after a possible plague outbreak in Russia.
article.articleSummary: EU closely monitors a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia, Russia, after a US alert tied to Irkutsk region. The European Commission is in contact with ECDC and awaits reliable epidemiological and laboratory data. A 28-year-old woman who worked at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East died in a hospital in Shelejov; authorities are investigating two scenarios: infection acquired in Thailand or an accidental lab exposure. Rospotrebnadzor reports pneumonia of undetermined etiology, with no confirmed illnesses among contacts. Several Irkutsk hospitals have been quarantined amid suspicion of pneumonic plague. The EU emphasizes improved post-COVID preparedness, including medicine stockpiles, pharmaceutical industry readiness, and cross-border cooperation with WHO. Plague is a bacterial disease treatable with antibiotics, rare in Europe for decades but still present in other continents.

triage.headline_ja: ブリュッセルは、ロシアでのペスト発生の可能性を受けて状況を「注視」している
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト疑いによる死亡例と病院隔離があり、EUが監視を強化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域データにタイが含まれるが、記事内ではタイは感染源の可能性として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）である。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 4 080 morts et 66 nouveaux cas, selon l'INSP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 4,080 deaths and 66 new cases, according to the INSP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) totals 8,442 confirmed cases and 4,080 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), per INSP Situation Report 141 dated Oct 2, 2026; outbreak began May 15, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 66 new cases were confirmed, including 22 community deaths; 2,213 have recovered and 846 are in isolation or treatment. Seven provinces are affected: Ituri (6,370 cases, 2,933 deaths; 75.5% of national total), Nord-Kivu (1,657/979), Haut-Uélé (352/146), Bas-Uélé, Sud-Kivu, Sud-Ubangi and Tshopo. 64 of 167 health zones and 246 of 3,104 health areas are affected. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; Bas-Uélé has vaccinated 1,147 people under a research protocol. Contact tracing is 73.1% (target 95%); 22 community deaths show ongoing transmission outside facilities. Peak behind us; response shifting to zonal scale; Barrot visited Bunia Oct 3.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：INSPによると死者4,080人、新規症例66人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（死亡4,080人、致死率48.3%、7州に拡大、地域社会での死亡継続）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: フランス保健相(Barrot)がBuniaを訪問するなど国際的関心が高まっている。ワクチンは未承認で、研究プロトコル下でのみ接種実施中。接触者追跡率73.1%（目標95%未達）、コミュニティ内死亡22件は感染拡大継続を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Peste polmonare, cos'è e come si cura: il caso in Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague: what it is and how it is treated—the case in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Plague case in Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia: a woman died October 2 after pneumonia; she worked at a plague research center. Authorities imposed preventive measures; about 200 people who had contact with her were quarantined or under medical surveillance. Restrictions were imposed in four Irkutsk hospitals, limiting visits, new admissions, and patient movement. Investigations continue to determine the infection's origin and the pneumonia's nature. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, circulates mainly among wildlife via fleas; human infection arises from flea bites or contact with infected animal tissues. It transmits via respiratory droplets and requires close contact with a symptomatic patient; it remains less easily transmitted than many respiratory diseases. Antibiotics, including fluoroquinolones, are effective; cases may require respiratory support. The bacterium persists in animal populations, with sporadic human cases in Africa, Asia, and the Americas; DR Congo and Madagascar are affected; this Irkutsk case is a warning, not a resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト：それは何か、どのように治療されるか——シベリアでの症例
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究施設の職員が肺ペストで死亡し、約200人が検疫・医学的監視下に置かれるなど、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事例であり、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア・イルクーツク（シベリア）のペスト研究施設職員の死亡例であり、対象国リストに該当なし。DRCおよびマダガスカルは記事中で『散発的な人間の症例がアフリカ・アジア・米州で見られる』という一般的背景説明として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan Warga Sukabumi Mendadak Alami Diare Massal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of Sukabumi residents suddenly hit by a mass diarrheal outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mass diarrhea outbreak hits Sukabumi, Indonesia, affecting 27 residents across three kampungs in Desa Cikujang, Gunungguruh District, Sukabumi Regency. On October 4, 2026 around 12:30 WIB, residents from Gunungguruh RT 033/RW 016, Lebak Muncang RT 039/RW 019, and Legok Nyenang RT 042/RW 021 suddenly fell ill and were treated at the Gunungguruh Community Health Center (Puskesmas Gunungguruh). A pregnant woman was hospitalized; 17 patients recovered and 9 were under ongoing medical observation. Rapid response by combined police, village officials, and Puskesmas staff conducted house-to-house assessments and evacuated patients to care facilities. The illness is suspected to stem from drinking non-potable water; authorities emphasized water safety and continued medical monitoring to prevent deterioration.

triage.headline_ja: スカブミ住民数十人が突然の集団下痢症に見舞われる
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域での集団下痢（27名）で原因は不衛生な水の可能性があり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、原因病原体不明のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因病原体不明（Unknown Illness）。水系感染が疑われるが検査結果等の続報が必要。地域は村落単位（Desa Cikujang）に限定され、現時点で国際的インパクトは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : un bourgmestre encourage à se rendre au CTE en cas d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: a mayor urges people to go to the Ebola Treatment Center in case of Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, capital of Tshopo Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, urges residents to seek Ebola treatment promptly. Mayor Simon Lowawa of Makiso commune told the public not to fear the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Kisangani, saying early presentation improves chances of recovery. He noted cure rates at the Kisangani center are high, with more survivors than deaths, reinforcing confidence in medical staff. A doctor who recovered at the center was showcased during a briefing for mayors and neighborhood leaders on Ebola. The briefing emphasized that everyone must participate: the population, authorities, each according to their role. The mayor urged that if anyone shows Ebola signs in neighborhoods, it should not cause panic; the immediate action is to take the person to the nearest hospital.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:市長がエボラ疑い時には治療センターへ行くよう呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ出血熱の治療啓発活動が行われており、現地で症例が継続的に発生していることを示唆するため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療センターへの受診を促す啓発活動が主題だが、キサンガニでの継続的なエボラ症例発生を示しており、コンゴ民主共和国における既知のエボラアウトブレイクの一部と考えられる。詳細な症例数・死亡者数などの定量データは記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Самые тяжёлые времена впереди: в сети вспомнили предсказание Жириновского о чуме в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The hardest times are ahead: online users recalled Zhirinovsky's prophecy about a plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Russia confronts renewed attention to Vladimir Zhirinovsky’s 2020 warning about biological threats, focusing on plague (Yersinia pestis) near its borders. The discussion notes that proximity to outbreaks in neighboring Mongolia and China undermines Russia’s safety, predicting hard times—famine, unemployment, and other diseases—follow hard quarantine after initial fatalities. The trigger event is the October 2 death of a 28-year-old laboratory assistant, Darya, who worked on antibiotic-susceptibility analyses of Yersinia pestis, using samples from natural foci in Siberia. The incident rekindles concern about forgotten diseases and the risks faced by researchers attempting to prevent spread. The report provides no specific outbreak counts or imported/exported case details.

triage.headline_ja: 最も厳しい時代がこれから来る：ネット上でジリノフスキーのロシアにおけるペスト予言が話題に
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアの研究者1名がペスト菌研究中に死亡したという単発の出来事を基に、政治家の過去の「予言」を引用した陰謀論・扇情的な内容であり、具体的な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。対象国における実際の発生も確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内の研究所関係者1名の死亡事例を発端とした、政治家の過去発言をめぐるネット上の話題であり、モンゴルや中国での『アウトブレイク』は文脈的言及に留まり具体的根拠は示されていない。対象国（モンゴル・中国）での実際の発生確認はできず、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ ഈ വർഷം ഇതുവരെ ഫ്ലൂ ബാധിച്ച് 120 മരണം; ഒക്ടോബർ വരെ 11,319 കേസുകൾ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kerala, 120 deaths from influenza this year so far; 11,319 cases as of October.
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, influenza has caused 120 deaths and 11,319 cases as of October 2026. Experts link the surge to monsoon rains, Onam crowds, and increased testing; the rise is not limited to Kerala, with Delhi and other Indian states reporting similar seasonal spread across much of the country. Influenza presents with fever and body pains; older adults, especially those with lifestyle diseases, cancer, or obesity, are at higher risk of severe illness. Health professionals caution that low vaccination uptake fuels fatalities. Vaccines are available, including the annual influenza vaccine and pneumococcal vaccine, which help prevent illness and complications. Guidance recommends vaccination for those over 60 and individuals with diabetes, cancer, or kidney diseases. A 2022 expert committee led by Dr. B. Ekbal urged making flu vaccination mandatory for people aged 65 and older, but no action has been taken yet.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で今年これまでにインフルエンザによる死者120人、10月までに11,319例の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、死亡例は多いが新規性・異常性は低い。ただし高齢者等のハイリスク層での重症化とワクチン接種率の低さが懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、モンスーンやオナム祭りによる人出増加、検査数増加が背景。ワクチン接種率の低さが死亡者数増加の一因とされる。デリーなど他州でも同様の季節性流行が報告されているが、国際的な拡大や渡航制限の懸念はない。

article.articleHeadline: Gần 50 trẻ mắc tay chân miệng, cảnh báo dấu hiệu bệnh nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 50 children diagnosed with hand, foot and mouth disease; warning signs of severe illness.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 50 children diagnosed with hand, foot and mouth disease at Quang Ninh Provincial Pediatric Hospital in Vietnam, with most cases classified as level 1–2a. The outbreak involves Enterovirus-related HFMD, primarily Coxsackie A16 and Enterovirus 71 (EV71). EV71 can cause severe complications such as encephalitis, meningitis, pneumonia, and myocarditis, potentially resulting in death; initial symptoms can be subtle, and disease may progress rapidly within 24–48 hours. HFMD mainly affects children under five. Common signs include sores on hands, feet, and mouth, high fever above 39°C, irritability, vomiting, and crying; some children show minimal external signs, hindering early diagnosis. Transmission is direct person-to-person via saliva, nasal secretions, and feces. No specific antiviral exists; management is supportive. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, avoiding crowded places, isolating affected children, and monitoring for warning signs such as persistent fever, lethargy, poor feeding, drooling, tremors, or ataxia.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の子供約50人感染、重症化の兆候に警告
triage.triage_reason: EV71関連の手足口病はベトナムで季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、現時点では一施設での約50例に留まるため、重症化リスクはあるものの国際的拡大や異常事態の証拠はない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 手足口病（HFMD）はベトナムで毎年流行する既知の感染症であり、EV71型は重症化リスクがあるため注意が必要だが、現時点では一地域の医療機関報告に留まり、全国的な急増や国際的波及の兆候は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia investiga una posible infección de peste pulmonar en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Investigates a Possible Pneumonic Plague Infection in Siberia
article.articleSummary: A possible pneumonic plague case in Siberia prompts outbreak concerns around Irkutsk. A 28-year-old woman, an employee at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East, died in a hospital in Shelekhov, with two suspected scenarios: infection in Thailand or a laboratory incident (a broken pathogen vial). Rospotrebnadzor reports pneumonia of unknown etiology and confirms no contacts have fallen ill or tested positive. A U.S. White House source told Axios that Washington is monitoring the situation. Four Irkutsk hospitals have been quarantined on suspicion of pneumonic plague; restrictions include restricted ward access and no visits. Governor Igor Kobzev held an emergency meeting and announced contingency actions. All contacts are under medical surveillance; to date, none show symptoms and all tests are negative. Officials urge relying on Rospotrebnadzor’s official statements rather than rumors.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアで肺ペスト感染の可能性を調査
triage.triage_reason: イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストの疑いで複数病院が隔離されるなど、重篤性と異常性が認められ、米国も注視するなど国際的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。タイでの感染の可能性は推測段階であり、事実確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: دواء تجريبي في مواجهة إيبولا... هل تنجح التجربة في وقف أخطر تفشٍ في الكونغو؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An experimental drug in the fight against Ebola... Will the trial succeed in stopping the deadliest outbreak in the Congo?
article.articleSummary: An experimental antiviral, Obildesiver, developed by Gilead, is being tested as post-exposure prophylaxis to prevent Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s current outbreak. The trial operates at an Ituri region health center in eastern DRC and enrolls contacts of confirmed cases, including health workers and relatives. More than 250 participants have enrolled, with about 1,000 expected; participants are randomized to receive either the drug or a placebo. Daily monitoring spans 21 days, with a final 42-day follow-up. If effective, the intervention could break transmission by offering protection after exposure before symptoms appear, complementing vaccines that require time to confer immunity. Some health workers have been vaccinated with Ervebo (against other Ebola strains), though its efficacy against Bundibugyo remains under study. WHO warns the outbreak exceeds tracing capacities, with thousands infected and killed, raising fears of surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of about 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策の実験的治療薬...コンゴにおける最も深刻な感染拡大を食い止められるか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行が継続しており、WHOが追跡能力を超えていると警告、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の死者数を上回る恐れがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri地域）での流行のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認されないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: РСТ не нашел данных о вспышке вируса Коксаки у россиян во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST did not find data on a Coxsackievirus outbreak among Russians in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Russian Union of the Travel Industry (RST) says there is no evidence of a mass Coxsackievirus outbreak among Russian tourists in Vietnam, though seasonal isolated cases may occur. Mash Telegram had claimed a spike at Amiana Resort Cam Ranh in Cam Ranh, but RST reports no data supporting a mass infection and is continuing to verify information with Vietnamese tour operators. Coxsackievirus is an enterovirus transmitted via close contact, water, and food, causing fever, rash, and mucosal lesions. Infections commonly affect children and are usually mild. The article notes ongoing vigilance at vacation hotspots and emphasizes that no laboratory-confirmed large outbreak is cited. No imported/exported case details are provided; related background includes a past request by Rospotrebnadzor for Turkish data on Coxsackie infections.

triage.headline_ja: RST、ベトナムでのロシア人観光客間のコクサッキーウイルス感染拡大の情報は確認されず
triage.triage_reason: 集団発生を示す証拠がなく、公的機関（RST）が否定しており、重症度・国際的拡大の懸念も低いため見送りとする。
triage.notes: SNS(Telegram)発の未確認情報を公式団体が否定した内容。ロシア・トルコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué ocurre en Rusia? Hospitales entran en cuarentena por misteriosa infección
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is happening in Russia? Hospitals go into quarantine due to a mysterious infection.
article.articleSummary: In the Irkutsk region of Russia, hospitals are quarantined over a suspected highly dangerous infection, with at least four facilities (including a pediatric hospital) under restrictions for up to three weeks and no patient visitation. No official diagnosis has been announced; Rospotrebnadzor classifies the case as pneumonia of undetermined etiology, and the Irkutsk–Far East Institute of Plague Research reports no pathogen-related emergencies. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an emergency meeting; contacts of the patient remain under medical surveillance and no confirmed cases have emerged. The death of a 28-year-old woman, an employee at the institute, occurred in a Shelekhov hospital. Meduza mentions two scenarios: infection during travel to Thailand or a laboratory-related incident. The Kremlin urges reliance on official data; the US has warned of a potential pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで何が起きているのか？謎の感染症により病院が隔離措置に
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト疑いによる病院隔離と死亡例が発生し、米国も肺ペスト流行の可能性を警告するなど国際的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は感染経路の仮説の一つとして言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生を示すものではないため verified_locations には含めない。公式な病原体診断（ペスト確定）は未発表で、現時点ではRospotrebnadzorは原因不明肺炎として分類している。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : 18 victimes d'Ebola inhumées en une journée à Biakato - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: 18 Ebola victims buried in one day in Biakato
article.articleSummary: 18 Ebola victims were buried October 4 in Biakato, capital of the Babila-Babombi chiefdom, Mambasa territory, Ituri. The outbreak persists across several Mambasa health-zone localities; the World Health Organization deployed a rapid response team to Mambasa and Mandima, with UNICEF and World Food Programme support for medicines and PPE. In Mambasa, three patients recovered and left a treatment center, underscoring the importance of early care. A Ebola treatment center in Mambasa is under construction, and a laboratory now provides results within about 48 hours. In Biakato, religious leaders from Lwemba, Biakato, Maiwano and Teturi pledged to relay prevention messages. Nationally, as of October 2, 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.4%). Authorities urge handwashing and rapid reporting of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：ビアカトで1日にエボラ犠牲者18人が埋葬される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率48.4%と深刻、WHO・国連機関が緊急対応中であり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 全国で8,300症例、4,018死亡（致死率48.4%）、7州に拡大中の既知のアウトブレイクの継続報道。WHO・UNICEF・WFPが対応支援中。

article.articleHeadline: Peste polmonare in Siberia, cosa sappiamo davvero: la provetta rotta, il laboratorio di Irkutsk e i dubbi sul contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague in Siberia, what do we really know: the broken vial, the Irkutsk laboratory, and the doubts about contagion.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk, Siberia, linked to Yersinia pestis raises questions about a potential laboratory incident. A 28-year-old technician, Darya Shipilova, at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute died after severe pneumonia. Russian officials have not confirmed a lab accident or plague in the victim; Rospotrebnadzor reports pneumonia of undetermined etiology and says testing found no microorganisms linked to her work. Around 200 people are under health surveillance. Timeline suggests Sept 25 an alleged broken vial containing Y. pestis, Sept 29 hospital admission, and death occurring Oct 1–2. Two infection hypotheses are under review: acquisition in Thailand, from which she recently returned, or exposure from the broken vial at work. The Kremlin urges relying on official statements. The U.S. and EU monitor the situation, with White House, State Department, CDC, and ECDC seeking verified information.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの肺ペスト、本当にわかっていることは何か：割れた試験管、イルクーツクの研究所、感染経路をめぐる疑問
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、研究所由来の可能性を含め異常性が高く、米露当局・国際機関（CDC/ECDC）が注視しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にThailandが含まれるが、これは患者の渡航歴に基づく感染経路仮説の一つであり、実際の発症・確認事例はロシア（イルクーツク）で生じているためThailandは対象外とした。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。続報でラボ事故の真偽や感染拡大の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Should India Upgrade Health Concern Over Russian Pneumonic Plague Outbreak Fear Expert Replies
article.articleSummary: As of 05 Oct 2026, a 28-year-old laboratory technician in Russia's Irkutsk region died from a suspected pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis, triggering renewed attention. The Siberian case is being monitored, but experts say there is no immediate threat to India and no need to upgrade concern. Pneumonic plague spreads via respiratory secretions; coughing, sneezing, or talking can release infectious particles. WHO notes plague is a zoonotic disease caused by Y. pestis, presenting as bubonic (painful lymph node swellings), septicaemic, or pneumonic forms. Incubation is typically 1–7 days. Bubonic plague has a case-fatality ratio of 30–60% if untreated; pneumonic and septicaemic forms are always fatal without antibiotics. Antibiotics are effective, and early diagnosis/treatment save lives. India maintains vigilance for unusual infections, but Russia's outbreak does not warrant heightened alarm.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの肺ペスト流行懸念、インドは警戒レベルを引き上げるべきか？専門家が回答
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で検査技師1名が肺ペスト疑いで死亡という単発事例であり、専門家はインドへの直接的な脅威はないとしている。対象国での発生ではなく、国際的拡大の証拠も現時点でないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにRussiaとIndiaが含まれるが、Russiaは対象国リストに含まれず、Indiaは実際の発生国ではなく記事内でリスク評価の対象として言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。単一の死亡例であり、感染源（検査室内曝露の可能性）や二次感染の有無など情報が不足しているためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Přenáší se mezi lidmi, úmrtnost je téměř stoprocentní. Co je plicní mor, který se zřejmě objevil v Rusku?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transmitted between people, the mortality rate is nearly 100 percent. What is the pneumonic plague that has apparently appeared in Russia?
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis–caused pneumonic plague is one of the deadliest infectious threats, capable of airborne person-to-person spread. In Russia, southern regions and adjacent Central Asian areas host long-standing natural foci in wild rodents; historical waves include the 1910–1911 Manchurian outbreak near the China–Russia border. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets; incubation is typically 1–3 days, sometimes as short as 24 hours. Without timely antibiotics, mortality approaches 100% as the disease rapidly causes severe pneumonia, chest pain, cough with rapidly increasing dyspnea and blood-tinged sputum, followed by septicemia and multi-organ failure with cyanosis. Death often occurs within 2–3 days from onset if untreated. Early diagnosis and therapy within 24 hours are crucial. Antibiotics include streptomycin, gentamicin, doxycycline, or ciprofloxacin. Russian public health authorities, led by Rospotrebnadzor, monitor plague foci, vaccinate residents in risk-border areas with Mongolia and China, warn against handling wild rodents, and maintain quarantine and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 人から人へ感染し、致死率はほぼ100％。ロシアで出現したとされる肺ペストとは何か？
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの一般的な医学解説とロシア当局の監視体制についての記事であり、具体的な新規症例・発生地域の確定情報がない。対象国（中国・モンゴル）は国境監視の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）である。
triage.notes: 記事は肺ペストに関する一般的・歴史的解説記事であり、ロシアでの具体的な新規発生事例の確認情報が本文サマリーに含まれていない。発生地域として挙げられた中国（内モンゴル自治区・満州里）やモンゴルは、過去の歴史的流行や国境監視体制の文脈での言及であり、現在進行中の発生国として確認できない。続報で具体的な症例報告が出た場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lungepest: Dette er symptomene
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague: These are the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Daria Shipilova (28), a laboratory technician at a pest research institute in Irkutsk, Siberia, died on 2 October in Shelekhov after severe pneumonia; her death has sparked fears of pneumonic plague in Russia. Some outlets call it a possible pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis, but authorities say she had pneumonia of unknown origin and have found no organisms linked to her work. Local media allege a lab incident (breaking a pest bacterium vial on 25 September), but this is unverified. The case has triggered extensive measures: nearly 200 potential contacts are under medical surveillance; hospitals in the Irkutsk region are quarantined; an aluminum plant in Shelekhov requires masks. Rospotrebnadzor says the situation is stable. WHO notes pneumonic plague transmits via respiratory droplets and requires rapid antibiotics and isolation. Symptoms include fever, cough, shortness of breath, and bloody sputum. Most human plague cases 2019–2025 occurred in the DRC and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト：これが症状です
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で原因不明の重症肺炎により1名が死亡し、肺ペストの疑いが報じられ検疫・接触者調査などの大規模な公衆衛生対応が取られているため、情報は未確定だが社会的関心・行政対応ともに高く、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州における原因不明肺炎（肺ペスト疑い）による死亡例であり、対象国リストに該当する国（DRC等）は過去の統計情報として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。病原体の確定（Yersinia pestis）はされておらず、当局は原因不明の肺炎としている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Жириновский в 2020 году предупреждал об угрозе "чумы" для России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhirinovsky warned in 2020 about the threat of a plague to Russia.
article.articleSummary: On a 2020 warning by Vladimir Zhirinovsky, then leader of Russia’s LDPR, about the threat of plague to Russia amid the COVID-19 pandemic, the politician warned of heavy consequences and suggested quarantine could follow fatal cases, citing dangers near Russia’s borders with Mongolia and China. In response to reports of a potential plague flare, Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov urged reliance on official statements from Rospotrebnadzor rather than rumors. Rospotrebnadzor officials stated that no incidents were recorded at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute while handling pathogenic microorganisms. The piece cites further details from Vechernyaya Moskva regarding plague danger, but the article contains no reported plague outbreak or laboratory-confirmed cases in Russia. It frames the issue as a warning and concern rather than a current outbreak, with no new imported/exported case counts provided. As of 2026-10-05, these remain precautionary discussions.

triage.headline_ja: ジリノフスキーは2020年にロシアへのペストの脅威について警告していた
triage.triage_reason: 2020年の過去の政治的発言を振り返る記事であり、現時点でのペストやCOVID-19の発生・流行事例は報告されていない。実際の公衆衛生上の脅威は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年の政治家の警告発言を振り返る内容で、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。Rospotrebnadzorはイルクーツク抗ペスト研究所での事故はないと確認しており、現状は憶測レベルの報道。対象国リストに含まれる国（ロシア・モンゴル・中国）での実際の発生は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : les agents du gouvernorat appelés à une vigilance accrue contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: governorate officials urged to step up vigilance against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola vigilance in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 5 October 2026. Public service workers were urged to heighten vigilance and strictly follow barrier measures amid the Ebola threat. Governor Paulin Lendongolia led a sensitization session, stressing daily exposure from office visitors of unknown origin and health status and the need to prevent transmission through avoiding physical contact, using disinfectants, and regular handwashing. He urged provincial service chiefs to cascade preventive instructions to their teams and maintain ongoing awareness to strengthen collective vigilance. The governor cited the recent disappearance of a health worker involved in patient care as a warning sign, underscoring the necessity for strict adherence to preventive measures at work and at home. No case counts or laboratory confirmations are reported; the focus is readiness, risk communication, and prevention to avert Ebola spread.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラへの警戒強化を州庁職員に呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例や検査陽性報告はなく、行政による予防的警戒喚起の段階だが、エボラという重篤な疾患であり医療従事者の失踪という懸念情報もあるため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 症例数・検査確定情報なし。保健従事者の失踪という不穏な情報があり、既存のDRC国内エボラ流行との関連性について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bantul Pastikan Belum Ada Kasus Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bantul Health Office Confirms No Influenza A Cases Yet.
article.articleSummary: Bantul Health Office in the Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia, reports no confirmed influenza A cases to date, despite rising national reports. Surveillance continues in Bantul as influenza A remains a concern. The head, Agus Tri Widiyantara, says no laboratory-confirmed positive influenza A results have been reported yet. He notes that national increases are not directly linked to the long dry season in DIY; viral mutations likely drive more transmissible strains. Influenza A is a seasonal flu often causing outbreaks with abrupt onset and potential complications if untreated. Incubation is typically 1–4 days; high fever over 38°C with chills, muscle and joint pains, and severe body aches are common, along with dry cough, headache, fatigue, sore throat, and nasal congestion. In children, vomiting or diarrhea may occur. Preventive measures include annual vaccination, hand hygiene, masks in crowded places, and healthy PHBS such as adequate sleep, nutritious diet, and exercise.

triage.headline_ja: バントゥル保健局、インフルエンザA型の症例はまだ確認されていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: バントゥルでは症例未確認であり、国内他地域での増加も通常の季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と見られ、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも低い。
triage.notes: 記事はバントゥルで症例が確認されていないことを明言しており、季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な注意喚起の内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : la sensibilisation communautaire contre Ebola encouragée par une élue provinciale - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Community sensitization against Ebola encouraged by a provincial councilwoman - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Tshopo province, on 5 October 2026 hosted a community Ebola prevention sensitization led by provincial councilwoman Angel Mbo and organized through her foundation. The event framed community outreach as a key tool to prevent an Ebola epidemic, urging residents to take prevention messages seriously, continually remind family, neighbors and peers to adhere to barrier measures, and adopt behaviors that reduce transmission. Mbo called for ongoing vigilance, responsibility in all living settings, and active support for authorities and response teams engaged in the Ebola response. The initiative highlights local leadership and neighborhood engagement as essential components of public health risk communication in Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ出血熱：州議会議員による地域啓発活動がエボラ対策を後押し
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応チームの存在を示唆する記述はあるが、本記事は地域啓発活動の報告であり、新規症例数や発生状況など具体的な疫学情報が含まれていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は『エボラ対応チーム』への言及があり、既存の対応活動が進行中であることを示唆するが、具体的な症例数・発生規模等の情報はないため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Da orientação à ação: como a Zoonoses protege a população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From Guidance to Action: How Zoonoses Protects the Population
article.articleSummary: Belém's Unit of Zoonoses Surveillance (UVZ) under the Municipal Health Secretariat coordinates vaccination, disease monitoring and health education to prevent infections that move between animals and people. Activities include risk investigations, population guidance, animal follow-up, diagnostic sampling and public outreach across the city. Diseases monitored include leptospirosis, sporotrichosis, leishmaniasis and rabies. During the Verão Livre de Zoonoses campaign, about 4,000 people were reached, 2,500 educational materials were distributed, and 258 rabies vaccine doses were given to dogs and cats in Icoaraci, Outeiro, Mosqueiro and Cotijuba. Rabies vaccination totals: 2025 — 57,954 animals (32,496 dogs; 25,458 cats); Jan–Aug 2026 — 12,684 doses (6,315 dogs; 6,369 cats). Bat surveillance for rabies risk logged 13 field sorties and 35 samples in 2025, then 14 sorties and 53 samples through Aug 2026; 34 bat carcass samples in 2025 and 57 by Aug 2026. Suspected feline sporotrichosis recorded 1,553 attendances in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: ガイダンスから行動へ：人獣共通感染症対策課がどのように住民を守っているか
triage.triage_reason: ベレン市の動物由来感染症監視・予防活動に関する行政広報的な記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は通常の公衆衛生プログラム（狂犬病ワクチン接種、動物監視等）の実施報告であり、新規または異常な感染症発生の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Krievijā ziņo par iespējamu plaušu mēra gadījumu; SPKC skaidro riskus Latvijā
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are reports of a possible pneumonic plague case in Russia; SPKC explains the risks in Latvia.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague case reported in Russia's Irkutsk region prompts Latvia’s SPKC to assess very low international spread risk as of 2026-10-05. Media outlets The Moscow Times and Meduza described ~200 people hospitalized for observation after contact with a patient who reportedly died from pneumonic plague; official confirmation from WHO/ECDC of death or broad quarantine is lacking. SPKC emphasizes that prompt diagnosis, patient isolation, contact tracing, and effective antibiotics can contain spread. Latvia remains vigilant and ready to implement infection control measures if needed. The article notes plague is not a global problem today but persists in natural foci. WHO data (2019–2025) indicate six countries in two regions with laboratory-confirmed human plague: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Madagascar, Uganda, China, and Mongolia. Together these six countries account for 3,847 of 3,860 globally reported possible plague cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペストの疑い例が報告、SPKC（ラトビア疾病予防管理センター）がラトビアにおけるリスクを説明
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペストの疑い例（死亡例を含む）と接触者約200人の経過観察入院が報告されており、IHR基準のうち『重大な公衆衛生影響』『異常・予想外』の2つに該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。ただし対象国（監視対象リスト）には該当せず、国際拡大リスクは公式に『非常に低い』と評価されている。
triage.notes: 主要な発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事内でDRC・中国等が言及されているのは2019〜2025年のWHO統計上の『確認済みペスト報告国』としての背景情報であり、今回のイベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO/ECDCによる死亡例や検疫措置の公式確認は未了であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bruselas sigue "de cerca" un posible brote de peste en Rusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brussels continues to closely monitor a possible plague outbreak in Russia.
article.articleSummary: European Commission is closely monitoring a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia, Russia, after reports of a case near Irkutsk. The United States warned of a possible pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region, while Russian authorities urged calm. A 28-year-old woman, employed at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk, died in a hospital in Shélejov. Investigations consider two scenarios: infection in Thailand after recent return, or accidental laboratory exposure from a broken tube containing pathogens at work. Irkutsk hospitals have been quarantined amid suspected plague; officials describe the illness as pneumonia of undetermined etiology with no confirmed contacts. The EU is in contact with WHO and notes improved preparedness since COVID-19, including stockpiles, pharma rules, and response equipment. Plague is bacterial, treatable with antibiotics, and has not been endemic in Europe for decades, though outbreaks occur in the Americas, Africa, and Asia, including the US.

triage.headline_ja: ブリュッセル、ロシアでの可能性あるペスト発生を「注視」
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑い例でシベリアの病院が検疫下に置かれ、死亡例も発生。EUが欧州委員会レベルで注視し、米国も警告を発するなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事例発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストには含まれない。タイでの感染可能性も言及されているが、これはあくまで推測段階の曝露シナリオであり、実際の発症・診断はロシアで生じているため、Thailandはverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: रूस में कोरोना से 1000 गुना खतरनाक प्लेग लीक, भारत के लोगों पर कितना खतरा है?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague leak in Russia 1,000 times deadlier than coronavirus; how much danger does it pose to the people of India?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague leak in a Siberian, Russia laboratory led to a fatality and global alerts. A 28-year-old woman died after exposure when a glass shattered during handling of pneumonic plague agents; about 200 contacts were quarantined. Russia says the deceased was Mongolian, with no Siberian link, raising questions about India’s risk but suggesting no direct spread to Russia. U.S. outlets reported Washington’s alert and a White House statement. In Irkutsk, at least four hospitals were quarantined for three weeks, with restrictions on patient contact. Russia has quarantined all 200 contacts and officials say there is no evidence of wider transmission. The broader plague context cited by WHO (2019–2024) notes around 4,000 suspected cases in five years, mainly from China and Mongolia, underscoring perceived but unconfirmed import/export risk.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでコロナウイルスの1000倍危険とされるペスト菌漏洩、インドの人々へのリスクはどの程度か？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアの研究所で肺ペストが漏洩し死者が発生、200人が隔離されるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象であり、国際的な関心（米ホワイトハウスの声明等）も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の発生地はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク州）の研究所であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インド・中国・モンゴルは記事中でリスク懸念やWHO統計の文脈として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Những vết thương nhỏ tiềm ẩn nguy cơ nhiễm trùng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Small wounds carry a risk of infection.
article.articleSummary: 11-year-old Gia Khanh from Lam Dong, Vietnam, sustained a foot abrasion after a fall while cycling. Although initially asymptomatic, the wound later swelled and he developed fever and loss of appetite, necessitating hospitalization for severe soft-tissue infection (cellulitis) of the foot and several days of antibiotics and observation. The case shows that minor-looking injuries can progress and that unmonitored or poor home care—such as herbal poultices, tobacco paste, toothpaste, or coffee on wounds—may raise infection risk. Early proper wound care is essential: clean dirty wounds with running water, remove debris, and, after animal exposure (bite, scratch, lick), rinse with soap and water for at least 15 minutes, then disinfect and seek medical evaluation for tetanus and rabies risk. Vaccination history guided care; Gia Khanh received a tetanus-containing vaccine and later completed missing doses. Parents should monitor for increasing swelling, redness, pus, fever, or reduced movement and seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 小さな傷に潜む感染のリスク
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例（軟部組織感染症）に関する健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は個人の創傷管理と破傷風・狂犬病予防に関する一般的な健康教育記事であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや集団事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Quarentena por peste bubônica parece o caso de Wuhan', afirma canal, comparando crise na Sibéria com início da pandemia de Covid-19 na China
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine for Bubonic Plague Seems Like the Wuhan Case, says the channel, comparing the crisis in Siberia to the start of the COVID-19 pandemic in China.
article.articleSummary: Bubonic plague triggers quarantine of about 200 people in Shelekhov, Irkutsk region, Siberia, after the first fatality linked to the disease. Darya Shipilova, 28, an assistant at the Irkutsk Institute for the Fight Against Plague, reportedly broke a vial of live bacteria while collecting samples. She developed pneumonia-like symptoms during a field expedition near the Russia–Mongolia border, was hospitalized in Shelekhov on Sept 29, placed on mechanical ventilation, and died on Oct 1. Regional Governor Igor Kobzev declined to name the illness, calling it a dangerous infectious disease and canceling public events, while coordinating with Anna Popova, head of Russia’s sanitary watchdog, who traveled from Moscow to Irkutsk. The report notes the incident draws comparisons to Wuhan’s Covid-19 outbreak, the origin point of a pandemic that caused millions of deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 『腺ペストによる検疫措置はまるで武漢のようだ』とチャンネルが報道、シベリアの危機とコロナ禍初期の中国での状況を比較
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で実験室関連と見られる腺ペストにより死亡例が発生し、約200人が検疫対象となり公的イベントも中止されるなど、深刻性・異常性・社会的関心のいずれも高い。ただし対象国（日本のEBS対象国リスト）には該当しない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州シェレホフ）であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれない。Bluedotの地域タグに含まれる中国（武漢・湖北省）は記事内でCOVID-19起源地としての比較対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため除外した。研究所職員の実験室内感染が疑われる事例であり、国際的な関心度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 十歲男童感染甲型流感嚴重個案｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe case of influenza A infection in a ten-year-old boy | METROHK.com.hk
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports a severe pediatric influenza A (H1) case in a 10-year-old boy. He developed fever, cough, runny nose and dizziness on Oct 2 and was admitted to Prince of Wales Hospital PICU on Oct 4 with PCR-confirmed influenza A and septic shock; he remains critically ill. He had no travel during incubation and has not yet received the 2026–27 seasonal flu vaccine. A household contact had mild symptoms and recovered. Since June, influenza activity has been high: 22 severe pediatric influenza cases, with 16 recovered, 2 stable, 2 severe, 1 critical and 1 death. About 350 school-based influenza-like illness outbreaks have affected over 2,000 people since September. The vaccination program began Sept 17; ~100 schools have joined outreach with a new electronic consent feature, aiming to finish by mid-December. Parents should monitor warning signs and seek urgent care; high-risk households should wear masks and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 10歳男児が甲型インフルエンザの重症例に感染｜METROHK.com.hk
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)の活動増加に伴う重症小児例の報告であり、異常性・新規性は認められないが、重症例・死亡例・学校アウトブレイクが継続しているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランス報告。学校でのインフルエンザ様疾患アウトブレイクが継続中であり、重症小児例・死亡例が報告されているため、今後の流行拡大傾向を注視する必要がある。香港は中国（People's Republic of China, 1814991）に含めて整理。

article.articleHeadline: Peste, da forma polmonare mortalità al 100% che scende al 50% con i "vecchi" antibiotici
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague, pneumonic form mortality at 100% dropping to 50% with 'old' antibiotics.
article.articleSummary: WHO’s bulletin (2019–2025, 10 countries) reports 3,847 suspected plague cases with 423 deaths, a case-fatality around 11%. Most cases occur in DRC and Madagascar, where plague remains endemic, though outbreaks can appear elsewhere. A 28-year-old Siberian researcher died in Shelekhov hospital after an incident involving a contaminated vial, illustrating the threat of pneumonic plague. In 2018 there were 248 cases, with 98% in Madagascar and the DRC. Transmission is chiefly via the rat flea Xenopsylla cheopis, but can occur through direct contact with infected animals or people, inhalation of droplets, or rarely by eating raw contaminated meat. Forms include bubonic plague with enlarged lymph nodes, septicemic, hemorrhagic (Black Death), and pneumonic plague. Pneumonic disease is fulminant, with cough and bloody sputum; mortality is 100% untreated and over 50% even with antibiotics. Treatments include gentamicin, ciprofloxacin, and tetracyclines; diagnosis relies on clinical signs, supported by PCR when feasible.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト、肺ペストの致死率は100%だが『従来の』抗生物質で50%まで低下
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペストに関する一般的な医学解説・統計まとめであり、DRC/マダガスカルは『流行地域』として言及されているのみで新規アウトブレイクの具体的詳細（発生時期・規模・対応状況）が不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの統計データ(2019-2025年、10カ国、3847例・423死亡)とペストの医学的解説が中心。DRCはマダガスカルと並びペストの流行地域として言及されているが、具体的な新規発生状況は不明。シベリアの研究者死亡例は実験室事故によるものであり、対象国リストに含まれないため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 10歲男童確診甲流併發休克 6月底至今累計22宗兒童流感嚴重個案 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10-year-old boy diagnosed with influenza A complicated by shock; since the end of June, a total of 22 severe pediatric influenza cases - Wen Wei Po (Hong Kong)
article.articleSummary: A 10-year-old boy in Hong Kong with influenza A (H1) complicated by septic shock remains hospitalized in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Prince of Wales Hospital. He developed fever, cough, rhinorrhea and dizziness on Oct 2; tested positive for Influenza A (H1) on Oct 4. He had no travel during the incubation period and has not received the 2026/27 seasonal flu vaccine; a household contact recently had mild fever and upper respiratory symptoms but recovered. Since late June, Hong Kong’s flu season has been active at high levels. To date, 22 severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded; outcomes include 16 recovered, 2 stable, 2 severe, 1 critical, and 1 death. In-school influenza-like illness outbreaks since September total about 350, affecting over 2,000 people. The Centre for Health Protection urges vaccination and reinforced hygiene; investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: 10歳の男児がA型インフルエンザに感染しショックを併発、6月末から累計22件の小児重症インフルエンザ症例が発生 - 香港文匯報
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1)によるものだが、小児重症例・死亡例が継続して報告され、学校での集団発生も多数あり、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1)の流行であり、病原体自体は新規・異常ではないが、重症小児例・死亡例・学校集団発生が継続しているため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Латвийские специалисты следят за сообщениями о возможной чуме в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latvian specialists monitor reports of a possible plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Latvia’s Center for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) states the risk of plague spreading beyond Russia is very low, even if a pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Irkutsk Region is lab-confirmed. Media reports cited by SPKC—the Moscow Times and Meduza—claim up to about 200 people were hospitalized under observation after contact with a patient allegedly dying from pneumonic plague. SPKC notes that timely diagnosis, isolation, contact tracing, and effective antibiotic treatment typically limit transmission and prevent large outbreaks. They continue to monitor international health threats to assess risks and organize preventive measures. WHO data cited by SPKC indicate that from 2019 to 2025 six countries across two regions reported laboratory-confirmed human plague: Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Madagascar, Uganda (Africa region), China and Mongolia (Western Pacific region). In total, 3,847 of 3,860 reported cases worldwide have been confirmed; no escalation beyond the country is indicated.

triage.headline_ja: ラトビアの専門家、ロシアでの可能性のあるペスト発生に関する報道を注視
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州での肺ペスト疑い例が検査確定前であり、ラトビア当局は国際的拡大リスクを「非常に低い」と評価しているが、約200人が観察下に置かれるなど経過を注視する必要がある。発生国（ロシア）は対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク州）での肺ペスト疑い症例であり、対象国リストに含まれる中国・DRC・モンゴル・ケニア・マダガスカル・ウガンダはWHOの2019～2025年の過去の確定症例統計として言及されているのみで、本件の発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Slimību profilakses un kontroles centrs komentē mēra izplatības risku Latvijā
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Disease Prevention and Control comments on the risk of measles spread in Latvia
article.articleSummary: SPKC states that, even if a suspected measles case in Russia is laboratory-confirmed, the risk of international spread, including to Latvia, is very low. The organization notes that there is no official confirmation of cross-border spread or mass quarantine by WHO or ECDC. Modern diagnostic methods, patient isolation, contact tracing, and effective antibiotic therapy help contain measles and prevent larger outbreaks. SPKC continues to monitor international public health threats to assess risks and organize appropriate infection prevention measures as needed. WHO data from 2019–2025 show six countries in two regions reporting laboratory-confirmed measles: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Madagascar, Uganda (Africa) and China, Mongolia (Western Pacific). Together these account for 3,847 of 3,860 globally reported possible measles cases.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病予防管理センター、ラトビアにおけるペスト（鼠疫）拡大リスクについてコメント
triage.triage_reason: ラトビア保健当局(SPKC)がロシアでの疑い例について国際拡大リスクは非常に低いと公式に評価しており、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は抗生物質治療・検疫・ロシアでの疑い例といった文脈から、疾患は『Measles（麻疹）』ではなくラトビア語『mēris』＝ペスト（鼠疫）の誤訳・誤分類の可能性が高い。言及されているDRC・ケニア・マダガスカル・ウガンダ・中国・モンゴルはWHOの過去統計（2019-2025）の例示であり、記事の主題（ロシア発生例とラトビアへのリスク）ではないため、対象国として計上しなかった。

article.articleHeadline: الاتحاد الدولي للصليب الأحمر يستنكر استهداف مكافحة الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The International Federation of the Red Cross condemns the targeting of the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-05, the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) condemned the killings of a humanitarian worker supporting the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Ismail Molindwa, an ambulance driver with the Ugandan Red Cross Society, was deployed to assist Ebola virus disease control efforts in the Aru area of Ituri Province, DRC. He sustained serious injuries when his ambulance was attacked on 17 August during ongoing outbreak response operations; he died on 2026-10-05 after receiving specialized medical care. The IFRC extended heartfelt condolences to Ismail's family, colleagues, and the Ugandan Red Cross, and reaffirmed concern about the dangers faced by Red Cross and Red Crescent personnel in risky environments. The federation strongly condemned attacks on humanitarian workers as unacceptable and called for their protection and respect while serving affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字国際連盟、エボラ対応要員への攻撃を非難
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で継続中のエボラ出血熱対応中に人道支援従事者が襲撃され死亡した事案であり、既存のエボラ流行対応の継続性・安全性に関わる重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事項であるため。
triage.notes: 記事自体は人道支援従事者への攻撃に関する報道だが、コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州における進行中のエボラ出血熱流行対応の一環であり、既存流行のモニタリング継続が必要。ウガンダ赤十字所属の職員であるが発生地はDRCのため、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hidden Parasite Split: DNA Reveals Snake Coccidia on the Brink of Becoming
article.articleSummary: DNA analyses reclassify Caryospora jararacae, a coccidian parasite of venomous snakes, within a newly defined species complex spanning five continents. In Rio de Janeiro’s Atlantic Forest, Brazilian researchers collected fecal samples from five Bothrops jararaca and five Crotalus durissus rescued in Miguel Pereira. Oocysts appeared in 60% of jararacas and 80% of rattlesnakes (overall 70%). Morphology showed subspheroidal oocysts ~14×14 μm with a bi-layered wall, Stieda and sub-Stieda bodies. Four non-overlapping loci—three mitochondrial (MAVCOXI, MARI, MACOIII) and nuclear 18S—were sequenced. Brazilian parasites matched Caryospora bigenetica, with 100% identity at 18S, 97.7–99.3% at mitochondrial loci, and 99% across the concatenated dataset. Bayesian and maximum-likelihood trees strongly support a monophyletic clade (PP 0.99, bootstrap 100%). The work confirms Caryospora jararacae as distinct from prior Brazilian records and highlights a broader evolutionary split in snake coccidia, across a five-continental complex.

triage.headline_ja: 隠された寄生虫の分裂:DNAがヘビのコクシジウムを新種誕生の瀬戸際にあることを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はヘビに寄生する原虫(Caryospora属)の分子系統分類学的研究であり、ヒトや公衆衛生への影響は認められない。
triage.notes: ヘビ(Bothrops jararaca, Crotalus durissus)に感染する原虫Caryosporaの分類学的研究であり、ヒト感染症・公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: अंगाला खाज येतेय? इन्फेक्शन नाही 'या' गंभीर आजाराचे असू शकते लक्षण, दुर्लक्ष न करता लगेच जाणून घ्या
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is there itching on your body? It’s not an infection—these could be the symptoms of this serious disease. Don’t ignore them; find out immediately.
article.articleSummary: Shingles (herpes zoster), caused by the Varicella-Zoster virus, reactivates from latent nerve cells after chickenpox. It presents as a painful rash and vesicles on one side of the body, following a dermatomal path, with burning, stinging, itching, and pain; crusting occurs in a few days and most lesions heal in 2-4 weeks. A key complication is postherpetic neuralgia, persisting pain in about 10-18% of cases, more common with age. Facial or periorbital involvement can affect vision; rare cases can cause encephalitis. Studies link shingles to higher risk of stroke and other heart-vascular events, especially in the early days/weeks after infection, possibly via vasculopathy. Prevention in India emphasizes vaccination to prevent reactivation and severe pain. If a household member has shingles, avoid direct contact with lesions and keep them clean and covered; seek medical care promptly to manage symptoms and reduce complications.

triage.headline_ja: 体がかゆいですか？それは感染症ではなく、この深刻な病気の症状かもしれません。無視せずすぐに確認してください
triage.triage_reason: 帯状疱疹（水痘・帯状疱疹ウイルス再活性化）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は個人の健康情報・予防啓発を目的とした一般的なコンテンツであり、特定のアウトブレイクや感染症イベントを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : plaidoyer pour sensibiliser contre Ebola dans des mosquées et écoles à Wanierukula - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Advocacy to raise awareness about Ebola in mosques and schools in Wanierukula - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Advocacy efforts in Wanierukula, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo (Tshopo), aim to raise Ebola awareness in mosques, churches, and schools along National Road 3, 59 km southeast of Kisangani. An outbreak response team led by Leonie Banga conducted advocacy sessions with the imam, church pastors, and school leaders to obtain authorization for educational activities and to disseminate precise Ebola information to communities. Local authorities agreed to allow sensitization within their structures to prepare bases for prevention and life-saving actions. Since the start of the outbreak, Wanierukula has reported one Ebola case, which resulted in death. The outreach emphasizes engaging major community actors to strengthen prevention and early detection in this at-risk area.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州:ワニエルクラのモスクや学校でエボラに関する啓発活動を提唱 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はDRCで既知のアウトブレイク対応が進行中であり、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある疾患であるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCツショポ州で進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに対する地域住民への啓発活動を報じるもの。ワニエルクラで1例の死亡例が報告されており、既存アウトブレイクの一部として評価すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : les volontaires de la Croix-Rouge appelés à la vigilance - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Red Cross volunteers urged to stay vigilant - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains a concern in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Red Cross volunteers are urged to stay vigilant. On 05 October 2026, a parade underscored the ongoing response, including burial of Ebola fatalities, evacuation to an Ebola Treatment Center, and decontamination of homes linked to the disease. A vaccination drive reached 186 volunteers involved in the outbreak response. Those inoculated with Everbo, targeting the Zaire ebolavirus strain, have shown no clinical signs, even among contacts of Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases. The approach remains experimental. Authorities stress continued vigilance, strict adherence to precautions, and preparedness among responders to prevent further transmission as Ebola persists in Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱：赤十字ボランティアに警戒呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北東部キサンガニでエボラ出血熱（ザイールエボラウイルス株）の流行が継続中であり、死亡例・埋葬・治療センターへの搬送・住宅の消毒など深刻な公衆衛生対応が行われている。IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の継続報道。実験的ワクチン（Everbo）接種186人、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株との接触歴を持つ者にも臨床症状なしとの情報あり。国際拡大・渡航制限の言及は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Страховщики не подтвердили информацию о массовой вспышке Коксаки во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Insurers have not confirmed reports of a mass Coxsackievirus outbreak in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Russian insurers have not confirmed a mass Coxsackievirus outbreak among Russian tourists in Vietnam. The Russian Union of Travel Industry (RST) says no unusual situation is detected; Coxsackie-like enterovirus infections occur seasonally, with isolated cases possible in popular resort areas. The association continues to verify information with tour operators serving Vietnam. Social media had claimed Russian vacationers at Cam Ranh resort contracted Coxsackie infection, presenting with high fever, skin rash, and lesions in the mouth. Vietnamese media report a higher-than-last-year incidence of enterovirus infections in 2026, with children under five most affected, particularly in kindergartens. Seasonal upticks are expected in September–October when children return to preschool after summer holidays. No laboratory confirmation or official outbreak designation is reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの保険会社、ベトナムでのコクサッキーウイルス大規模流行の情報を確認せず
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのコクサッキーウイルス（エンテロウイルス）集団発生の噂をロシア側保険業界が否定しており、公式な検査確認や流行宣言もないため、現時点ではフルリスク評価には至らないが、ベトナム側メディアが例年より多い発生を報じているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にロシア人観光客の間での噂と保険業界の否定に焦点を当てており、ベトナム側の公式な検査確認や症例数の詳細は不明。幼児を中心とした季節性エンテロウイルス（手足口病様）の増加がベトナムメディアで報じられているが、ラボ確認や公式流行宣言はない。

article.articleHeadline: Russian lab worker 'dies of suspected plague' as 200 under observation
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, in Irkutsk region (Irkutsk city and Shelekhov) a 28-year-old female laboratory researcher at an anti-plague institute died after possible exposure to pneumonic plague, with nearly 200 contacts under medical observation. The death cause not officially confirmed; pneumonia is of unknown etiology. The inpatient facility treating her has been quarantined, and the region's sanitary-epidemiological status is stable. Pneumonic plague is highly contagious and transmitted via respiratory particles; incubation may be as short as 24 hours, with rapid onset of severe respiratory symptoms and blood-tinged sputum. Untreated cases can be fatal within 18–24 hours; early antibiotics are effective. If this remains isolated, spread may be limited. Globally, 2019–2025 saw >3,800 suspected plague cases across 10 countries, with 423 deaths, chiefly in the DRC and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの検査技師、疑わしいペスト感染で死亡 ― 約200人が経過観察下に
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の抗ペスト研究所職員が肺ペスト疑いで死亡し、約200人が経過観察下にあるなど、重大性と異常性の両面でIHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での発生であり、DRCおよびマダガスカルは2019-2025年の世界的ペスト発生統計の文脈で言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため該当国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases climb to 88 in Prayagraj as October brings surge
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Prayagraj rise to 88 as of 2026-10-05, marking an October surge after a subdued September. SRN Hospital reports six confirmed dengue patients admitted; eight fever cases with dengue-like symptoms arrived on Sunday, four with severe symptoms; blood samples sent for testing; a 30-bed dengue ward reserved. At TB Sapru Hospital (Beli), four patients were admitted by Sunday night, down from six on Saturday; Beli Hospital has 20 beds reserved for dengue. Motilal Nehru Divisional Hospital (Colvin) reserves 25 beds, with five beds at each community health centre. Blood centers report rising demand for platelets. Chief medical officer Dr AK Tiwari urged prompt medical attention for fever with rash. Beli Hospital notes essential medicines stocked and mosquito nets placed; most admitted patients are from urban areas. Platelet transfusions are needed only in critical cases; current patients are improving.

triage.headline_ja: プラヤグラジでデング熱症例が88件に増加、10月に入り急増
triage.triage_reason: インド・プラヤグラジにおける季節性のデング熱症例増加であり、地元病院が病床確保等で対応できている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、異常性も低い。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局（CMO）が対応を指示し、病院は病床・医薬品を確保済み。重症患者は改善傾向にあり、季節的な流行の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Décès suspect en Sibérie : pourquoi la peste est-elle encore étudiée en 2026 ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspicious Death in Siberia: Why Is Plague Still Being Studied in 2026?
article.articleSummary: Death of Daria Chipilova, 28, a technician at Russia's Irkutsk Institute for Plague Research (Institute anti-peste d'Irkoutsk) in Irkutsk, Siberia, on 1 October 2026 after hospitalisation for severe pneumonia; she reportedly breached a tube containing Yersinia pestis and may have contracted pneumonic plague. About 200 people who may have been exposed were placed under medical surveillance; more than 100 were hospitalised. No plague diagnosis has been publicly confirmed; Russia's Rospotrebnadzor says samples did not reveal any of the lab pathogens, without specifying the cause of death. Plague remains a zoonosis caused by Y. pestis, transmitted mainly by fleas from rodents; without treatment, mortality ranges 30–100% by form. There is no safe, effective vaccine. Historically devastating in the Black Death (14th century), recent notes include India (1994) and Russia (2013); between 1990–2020 some 50,000 cases were reported to WHO by 26 countries.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアでの不審死：なぜ2026年になってもペストが研究され続けているのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が肺ペスト疑いで死亡し、200人が曝露監視下、100人超が入院という異常事態であり、病原体確定診断は未了だが社会的関心が高く続報監視が必要なためピックアップ。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所関連の肺ペスト疑い事例。インドは1994年の過去事例として言及されているのみで現在の発生国ではないため除外。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列。Rospotrebnadzorは病原体検出を否定しており、診断は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Batuk Tipis-Tipis yang Ternyata TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Mild Cough That Turned Out to Be Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) can present with mild symptoms; a case involved a three-month faint cough with no fever or weight loss, leading to a TB diagnosis. The piece stresses that many TB patients have light early symptoms and delay seeking care, heightening lung damage and the risk of spreading the disease. A simple rule: a cough lasting more than two weeks should be evaluated, regardless of perceived severity. TB can exist as latent infection—no symptoms and not contagious—but can reactivate if immunity weakens (uncontrolled diabetes, HIV, malnutrition, smoking). Indonesia ranks second globally for TB after India, with about 1.1 million new cases in 2024, roughly 10% of global cases, and WHO notes a sizable gap between estimated and detected cases. TB is airborne, not transmitted through shared dishes. After diagnosis, treatment requires regular medication adherence and precautions (e.g., masking) to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い咳だったのに、実は結核だった
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例を題材にした結核に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の症状や診断の重要性に関する一般啓発内容で、インドネシアの既知の結核負担（世界2位、2024年新規症例約110万人）に言及しているが、特定の突発的流行や異常事態を報じるものではない。インドは比較対象として言及されたのみで主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Weather and Pollution Show Little Sway Over Respiratory Pathogens in
article.articleSummary: Kaifeng, Henan Province, China, hosted a retrospective BMC Infectious Diseases study at a sentinel hospital (2023–2025) testing 17 common respiratory pathogens by real-time quantitative PCR in 1,716 patients. Of these, 957 (55.77%) were positive for at least one pathogen; viruses accounted for 40.44% and bacteria 28.03%. Most infections involved a single organism (34.15%), but 21.51% were mixed infections. Children bore the heaviest burden (69.81% positivity) versus adults aged 66+ (35.68%), with negligible sex differences. Urban residents had markedly higher positivity (62.10%) than rural residents (20.28%). Seasonality was evident: Influenza A peaked in winter (20.40%), Rhinovirus in autumn (15.63%). Early environmental correlations included a negative association for influenza B with precipitation (r_s = -0.591, p<0.05) and a positive association for Bordetella pertussis with PM2.5 (r_s = 0.597, p<0.05). The study notes cautious interpretation as weather and pollution links are explored; published 2026-10-05.

triage.headline_ja: 中国中部における呼吸器病原体、気象や大気汚染との関連性は限定的
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院での後ろ向き疫学研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではなく、社会的関心も低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 学術研究の報告であり、アウトブレイクや新規異常事態の報告ではない。季節性インフルエンザ・百日咳・ライノウイルス等の通常の病原体検出状況を分析したもの。

article.articleHeadline: In Philippines, woman's arm and leg start shaking, then MRI reveals suspected worm eggs
article.articleSummary: Suspected neuroschistosomiasis due to Schistosoma japonicum diagnosed after a Philippine woman experienced a sudden minute-long episode of shaking in her right arm and leg; MRI showed a bright cluster of nodules with surrounding fluid in the left frontal lobe, prompting suspicion of brain-lodged worm eggs. S. japonicum, the most common blood fluke in the Philippines, is found in the Philippines, China, and parts of Indonesia (now absent in Japan). The parasite's life cycle begins when eggs shed in urine or feces reach water, infect snails, which release cercariae that penetrate unbroken skin and migrate through the lungs, heart, and liver before maturing. Eggs trapped in tissue trigger inflammation and organ-specific damage; adult worms may persist in vessels without symptoms. The case adds to reports of snail-borne infections elsewhere, including rat lungworm in California and related concerns in Europe and Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンで女性の腕と脚が震え始め、MRIで寄生虫卵の疑いが判明
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンにおける単一症例（神経住血吸虫症疑い）の医学ニュースであり、集団感染やアウトブレイクの兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例報告であり、カリフォルニアの広東住血線虫（rat lungworm）やブラジル・欧州の関連懸念は参考情報として触れられているのみで、主題はフィリピンの住血吸虫症疑い例。中国・インドネシアは病原体の分布域として言及されているが実際の発生事例ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mystinen keuhkotauti tappoi tutkijan Venäjällä - tämä "rutosta" tiedetään
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious tuberculosis killed a researcher in Russia - this "plague" is known.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, in Irkutsk, Russia, a 28-year-old female researcher at an infectious-diseases facility died from a mysterious lung illness described as pneumonia of unknown origin. Nearly 200 people are under health surveillance after the death. Federal agency Rospotrebnadzor says tests on the deceased’s samples did not reveal microorganisms linked to her work. Authorities quarantined the hospital unit and restricted other wards; regional hospitals reportedly closed. Local officials initially speculated about plague, but the Burjatia region denies an ongoing plague epidemic. The deceased had recently traveled to the Republic of Buryatia for work, and those exposed are being tested and traced. Irkutsk region and Buryatia lie in southern Siberia. NBC/CNN report most plague cases occur in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, with WHO documenting over 3,800 suspected cases and 423 deaths from 2019–2025 across 10 countries.

triage.headline_ja: 謎の肺疾患でロシアの研究者が死亡 - この「ペスト」について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の肺炎により研究者が死亡し、病院が隔離措置を取るなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象であり、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRC・マダガスカルはペストの世界的background情報として言及されているのみで、本事象の発生地ではない。原因病原体は未特定（当局は研究者の業務関連微生物は検出されなかったとしている）で、ペスト疑惑は地域当局により否定されている。続報で原因病原体の特定・感染拡大の有無を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Could dengue vaccination help Bangladesh curb the worsening outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Bangladesh worsened in 2026: as of October, 245 deaths and 79,620 hospitalised since January, with September alone recording 148 deaths. WHO recommends Takeda’s Qdenga (TAK-003) for children 6-16 in settings with high transmission, two doses three months apart; it has been WHO-prequalified since 2024, but prequalification is not equivalent to national marketing approval. Bangladesh has not launched a national Qdenga programme; WHO emphasizes vaccination as part of an integrated strategy, not a replacement for mosquito control, and there are remaining evidence gaps for dengue-naïve individuals. Context shows Bangladesh’s burden: 2025 WHO data report 101,166 cases and 412 deaths by week 50, with global 2024 totals surpassing 14.6 million cases and 12,000 deaths. Countries using Qdenga include Indonesia and Brazil; PAHO’s 2025 indicative price is about $19.10 per dose (~$38.20 for two doses). article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes tingkatkan kesiapsiagaan respons insiden lab wabah di Russia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health boosts preparedness to respond to a laboratory outbreak incident in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health is boosting preparedness to respond to a laboratory outbreak incident in Russia after the death of a worker at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute in Siberia, suspected pneumonia of unknown origin. As of 5 October 2026, there has been no notification via the IHR National Focal Point or WHO Event Information Site about a special alert. Bali's international airports have intensified traveler surveillance through the All Indonesia - Health Declaration System (SSHP), symptom checks (fever, cough, shortness of breath), risk-based assessments of conveyances, and rodent surveillance at entry points. Quarantine staff analyze health declarations to determine if entrants originate from affected countries. Initial detection relies on health declarations and symptom monitoring; symptomatic travelers suspected of an outbreak will be referred to the Infectious Disease Referral Hospital for further care. About 200 contacts of the woman are under medical observation.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、ロシアの研究所でのペスト流行事案への対応準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所で原因不明肺炎（ペスト疑い）による死亡者が発生し、約200人の接触者が観察下にあるなど異常性・重症度が高く、インドネシアが渡航者監視を強化するなど社会的関心も高まっているため。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。インドネシアは渡航者監視強化などの対応国であり、感染症発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。WHO Event Information Siteへの正式通知はまだ行われていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola dehşeti: Vaka sayısı 8 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola terror in Congo: the number of cases has surpassed 8,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 8,000 cases. The Ebola virus, a hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and at Yambuku in the DRC, near the Ebola River after which the disease is named. A major 2014–2017 West Africa outbreak affected Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, with about 30,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths. In eastern DRC’s Ituri province, authorities reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, and an outbreak was declared on 15 May. The May outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola variant, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ恐怖:感染者数が8,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが8,000症例を超え、致死率の高い感染症であり、承認された治療法・ワクチンがない変異株（Bundibugyo）が関与しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事に列挙された他国（スーダン、シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ブルンジ、ギニア）は過去のエボラ流行の歴史的言及であり、今回の2026年アウトブレイクの発生地ではないため除外した。現行の流行はDRC東部イトゥリ州で発生しているBundibugyo株によるもの。

article.articleHeadline: 10-year-old boy in serious condition as influenza surge hits Hong Kong, 2,000 students affected - Dimsum Daily
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a severe pediatric influenza case: a 10-year-old boy developed fever, cough, runny nose and dizziness on 2 October; he presented to Prince of Wales Hospital A&E on 4 October and was admitted to the pediatric ICU the same day. Tests confirmed influenza A (H1); he remains in serious condition. He had no travel during incubation and had not received the 2026/27 seasonal vaccine; a household contact had mild upper-respiratory symptoms and recovered. Since late June, Hong Kong’s influenza season has 22 severe pediatric cases: 16 discharged, 2 stable, 2 serious, 1 critical, 1 death. With widespread community transmission, more than 2,000 people have been affected and about 350 influenza-like illness outbreaks were recorded since schools reopened in September. The vaccination program started 17 September with SIV School Outreach; about 100 schools have hosted outreach, finishing by mid-December. Authorities urge prompt consent and vaccination and remind parents of warning signs and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 香港でインフルエンザ急増、10歳男児が重症化、2000人の学生に影響
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による重症小児例・死亡例が発生し、学校を中心に2000人以上に影響する地域流行が継続しているため、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1亜型)による香港内の流行で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、重症小児例・死亡例の発生と広範な地域内感染により継続監視の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pencegahan Influenza A Menurut Dinkes Tangsel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevention of Influenza A According to the South Tangerang Health Office
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, the South Tangerang City Health Office (Dinkes) urges stronger prevention of Influenza A in South Tangerang, Indonesia. Key measures include thorough handwashing with soap and running water after coughing/sneezing, after blowing the nose, before meals, and after touching shared surfaces. Individuals with respiratory symptoms should limit activities and close contact; wearing masks is advised, especially in public settings. Close contact should be minimized, particularly with children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic illnesses. Indoor air quality should be maintained with good ventilation to ensure adequate air exchange. Influenza vaccination is recommended, especially for high-risk groups, with vaccines updated regularly to match circulating strains. Seek medical care for fever ≥38°C (100.4°F) with cough, runny nose, or sore throat, particularly if symptoms worsen or risk factors are present.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン保健局によるインフルエンザA予防について
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザ予防啓発に関する行政広報であり、異常な発生や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAの一般的な予防啓発であり、具体的な感染者数・クラスター・異常事態の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sekali Lagi, Informasi, Penanganan dan Tip Pencegahan Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Once Again, Information, Management and Prevention Tips for Influenza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Indonesia rose in late September, with sentinel surveillance of 265 specimens yielding 148 positives (56%); the Health Ministry notes this uptick is not an extraordinary surge, but aligns with the annual seasonal pattern, driven by season change, higher mobility and gatherings, and dominant viral subtypes. Influenza is an acute respiratory infection caused by influenza A and B viruses in Indonesia, spread via respiratory droplets and capable of affecting all ages; most cases are mild, resolving in about a week without specific treatment, though vulnerable groups may require hospitalization. Common mild symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, muscle aches, headache, and fatigue. Home care emphasizes rest, hydration, balanced nutrition, and symptomatic relief meds (which do not kill the virus); for children, follow a doctor's guidance. Prevention includes regular handwashing, cough etiquette, masking when sick or in crowds, reducing close contact, and annual influenza vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 改めて:インフルエンザの情報、対処法と予防のヒント
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア保健省自身が例年の季節性パターンであり異常な増加ではないと明言しており、一般向け予防啓発記事のため、重大性・異常性ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの一般啓発記事であり、特定の国を対象国リストに含めるべき異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Gejala Influenza A dan Tanda Bahaya yang Perlu Diwaspadai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of Influenza A and Warning Signs to Watch Out For
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia presents with flu-like symptoms: fever, cough, runny nose, muscle aches, headache, and fatigue, with subtypes H1N1 and H3N2. Sulawesi Health Office chief Evi Mustikawati Arifin warns it can worsen, with warning signs such as persistent high fever, shortness of breath, and decreased consciousness warranting urgent medical care. Children, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with comorbidities are at higher risk for complications and require closer monitoring. Health facilities—from puskesmas to hospitals—are ready for detection, testing, monitoring, and treatment; mild cases may be managed with rest and supportive therapy, while severe cases need additional care. The article emphasizes that influenza is caused by a virus, and hot weather or El Niño do not directly cause it, though extreme conditions may affect health. Preventive tips include hydration, meals, adequate sleep, masks when sick or in crowded places, handwashing, and cough etiquette. Be vigilant, not panicked.
