article.articleHeadline: Influenza A di Banten Capai 387.250 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A in Banten Reaches 387,250 Cases
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Banten, Indonesia number 387,250 as reported by Dinas Kesehatan Provinsi Banten on 5 October 2026. The Health Office notes the spread is very rapid but the risk of emergency is low. Influenza A remains a common illness with fast transmission; symptoms resemble typical flu and are generally self-limiting when immune defenses are strong. Case distribution is nearly uniform across districts and cities in Banten, attributed in part to broad screening across hospitals, clinics, and community health centers. People with influenza-like symptoms should seek care to determine the viral subtype and guide treatment. Preventive measures emphasized include staying hydrated, restful sleep, nutritious foods, regular physical activity, and frequent handwashing with soap and running water to reduce transmission. No significant adverse outcomes reported so far.

triage.headline_ja: バンテン州でのインフルエンザA感染者が387,250人に達する

triage.notes: 地元保健局（Dinas Kesehatan Provinsi Banten）が定例報告として発表。急速な拡大は見られるが、重症化や死亡例の報告はなく、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と判断される。継続的な症例数推移の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تحذر من تفشي مرض الإيبولا في شرق الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations warns of an Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, Ebola virus disease remains active in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths reported to date. The United Nations warns that transmission is accelerating across at least seven provinces, affecting 63 health zones, with Ituri and North Kivu bearing the heaviest burden. Ongoing insecurity, persistent population movements, and displacement, along with limited access to health services, complicate containment efforts and heighten community risk. Recent shifts in North Kivu and South Kivu include new displacements and returns to areas still lacking basic services and facing fragile security. A sustained, effective public health response and adequate aid are required to address the outbreak and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ東部でのエボラ出血熱流行拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で8,067例・死亡3,901例に達し、7州63保健地域に拡大、国連が警告している大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域として記載されているSouth Kivu、Ituriは共にDRC国内の州であり、対象国リストではDRC（203312）としてまとめて計上。致死率が高く（約48%）、UNが警告を発している点から重症度・拡大リスクともに高いと判断。渡航・貿易制限の有無については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 4.000 Ebola-Tote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 Ebola deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control as of October 5, 2026. The Congolese Ministry of Health reports that laboratory-confirmed Ebola deaths have surpassed 4,000, with mortality reported near 50% of all confirmed infections. The article emphasizes ongoing, sustained transmission in eastern DRC, with no end-date or containment milestone provided. Death toll is grounded in laboratory-confirmed cases, but the available text does not specify the total case count or the infection source. There is no mention of imported or exported cases within the excerpt. The figures underscore a severe, ongoing public health crisis in eastern Congo, driven by Ebola virus disease and highlighting continued high fatality in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが制御不能な状態で継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 死亡者数4,000人超、致死率約50%と非常に深刻。総感染者数や感染源、輸入/輸出症例の有無は記事内で不明。続報でのRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Garut Capai 1.051 Positif, Tiga Orang Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases in Garut Reach 1,051 Positive Cases, Three Die
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Garut Regency, West Java, Indonesia, rose sharply in 2026, with 1,051 confirmed positive from January through September and three fatalities. Weather variability, including a dry season with intermittent rain, has created standing water that fosters Aedes aegypti breeding, driving the outbreak. While most patients have recovered after intensive care at Puskesmas clinics or hospitals, officials warn that ongoing transmission persists. Public health actions include community education, mosquito source reduction (PSN), fogging in endemic areas, and regular larval surveillance of bathtubs and water storage. Authorities promote the 3M measures (empty, cover, bury), good personal and environmental hygiene (PHBS), and the one house one jumantik movement to empower households. The Garut Health Office emphasizes that success depends on community discipline; the article is dated Oct 5, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ガルットのデング熱症例、1,051件の陽性確認、3名死亡
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なデング熱の季節的流行であり、死亡例はあるが国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低い。インドネシアで毎年発生する既知の感染症パターンのため、継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、季節的な増加は毎年報告される。地方自治体が対策（フォギング、PSN等）を主導しており、国際支援の必要性は低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bafwasende : un député national appelle à l'intensification de la sensibilisation communautaire - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bafwasende: a national MP calls for intensified community sensitization - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with eight confirmed cases and three deaths in the Bafwasende health zone; the epicenter lies 164 km along RN 4. National MP Justin Bendesana urged intensified community sensitization across the territory, stressing vigilance and strict adherence to preventive measures, including regular handwashing. Residents were advised to seek care for signs such as persistent fever, bleeding from natural orifices, diarrhea, or vomiting and to avoid high-risk physical contact, given EVD's transmission through contact with infected body fluids. No cases have been recorded in the provincial chef-lieu, and much of Bafwasende remains spared. The deputy also urged debunking rumors that Ebola is a human invention. The article date is 2026-10-05.

triage.headline_ja: バフワセンデでのエボラ出血熱：国会議員が地域社会への啓発強化を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例・死亡例が報告されており、致死性感染症のヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR2005の常時通報対象疾患であり、確定8例・死亡3例が報告されている。コミュニティへの啓発活動が行われているが、流言の存在も報告されており警戒継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Soupçons de cas mortel de peste en Russie : les autorités de Sibérie assurent que la situation est "sous contrôle"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected fatal case of plague in Russia: Siberian authorities assure that the situation is under control.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, Daria Chipilova, a 28-year-old laboratory technician at Irkutsk's Institute for the Fight Against the Plague, died from a fulminant infection. Local media had suggested pneumonic plague, but Irkutsk region governor Igor Kobzev said post-mortem analyses found no trace of plague and that the cause is pneumonia of undetermined etiology. Rospotrebnadzor investigations showed no microorganism linked to the woman’s professional activity in her biomaterials. The Irkutsk region health status is described as stable; no other staff have sought medical care since the death. Kremlin spokesperson Dmitri Peskov urged journalists to rely on official Rospotrebnadzor statements rather than rumors. The World Health Organization notes plague is a bacterial disease, and pneumonic plague is highly contagious and potentially fatal if untreated. The WHO cites Madagascar, Mongolia, and China as places where cases are diagnosed; no confirmed local outbreak in Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト感染による死亡疑い例：シベリア当局は「状況は制御下にある」と断言
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の急性感染死という異例の事象で社会的・政府的関心が高いが、当局はペストを否定しており確定アウトブレイクではないため、WPRO基準を満たしつつ続報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 実際の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。記事中のモンゴル・中国・マダガスカルはWHOによる一般的なペスト発生地の例示であり、本イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局はペストを否定し原因不明の肺炎としている。

article.articleHeadline: Новий Ухань? Переполох через чуму в Росії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Wuhan? Panic over plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Russia reports a death from plague in the Irkutsk region. A 28-year-old laboratory technician, Darya Shipilova, at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Control, fell ill at the start of the week and died on 1 October after hospitalization in Shelekhov with severe pneumonia requiring ventilation. Officials imposed a plague‑type quarantine in the Irkutsk region; Shelekhov hospital was closed for quarantine and about 200 contacts are under medical surveillance. Official testing has not confirmed plague; authorities say subsequent tests found no pathogens linked to her work. Some Russian media suggest pneumonic plague as a possibility, but the diagnosis remains unconfirmed. Skepticism surrounds the purported broken‑vial incident. The United States is monitoring the situation, with observers drawing parallels to Wuhan’s early Covid‑19 outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなウーハンか？ロシアでペストによる騒動
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州でペスト研究所職員が重症肺炎で死亡し隔離措置が取られたが、公式診断は未確定。異常性・重大性の観点でIHR基準2項目に該当するためフルRRAでの確認が必要。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。記事中の中国（武漢）への言及はCOVID-19との比較であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。公式検査ではペスト病原体は確認されておらず、診断は未確定の段階。

article.articleHeadline: Peste polmonare in Siberia, quanto dobbiamo preoccuparci? Pregliasco: "Ecco a che cosa fare attenzione"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague in Siberia, how worried should we be? Pregliasco: "Here's what to watch out for."
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, pneumonic plague in Irkutsk region, Russia, with a possible case and the death of a 28-year-old; authorities describe as pneumonia of unknown etiology while investigations proceed. The virologist Fabrizio Pregliasco urges calm, noting that modern surveillance, diagnostics, and effective antibiotics reduce the risk of widespread European spread from a single case. Pneumonic plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and spreads via respiratory droplets, requiring close, symptomatic contact; incubation is short. Prevention for travelers focuses on avoiding contact with rodents and diseased wildlife, protecting against flea bites, and isolating and monitoring close contacts if a case is suspected. The article cautions against assuming Thailand as the infection source without epidemiological evidence. Early diagnosis and prompt antibiotic treatment markedly improve prognosis; when indicated, antibiotic prophylaxis and surveillance follow for contacts.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペスト、どれほど懸念すべきか？プレリアスコ氏「注意すべき点はこちら」
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト（Yersinia pestis）による死亡例が報告され、原因不明の肺炎として調査中であり、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事象としてIHR基準を2つ満たすため。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストには含まれない。タイが感染源である可能性は記事内で明確に否定されており、疫学的根拠がないため除外。周辺のアジア地域（中国・モンゴル等）への波及リスクは今後の情報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Новый Ухань? Паника из-за чумы в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Wuhan? Panic over the plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Russia reports a death from plague linked to an outbreak in the Irkutsk region. 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Control, fell ill early last week and died after 1 October. She reportedly told medical staff that a vial containing live bacteria broke during sample collection. She was admitted to a hospital in Shelekhov on Tuesday with severe pneumonia, placed on a ventilator, and died on Thursday. Irkutsk authorities imposed a COVID-19–style quarantine in the region; the hospital in Shelekhov was closed, and about 200 contacts were placed under medical surveillance. Russian officials have not confirmed plague; further testing reportedly found no organisms linked to her work, though some media references suggest possible pneumonic plague. The case has drawn international scrutiny, with the White House monitoring and calls for travel restrictions; commentators compare it to Wuhan and urge greater transparency.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなウハン？ロシアでペストによるパニック
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所職員がペスト感染(疑い)で死亡し、COVID様の検疫措置や国際的な注目（渡航制限の呼びかけ、ホワイトハウスの監視）が生じており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア（イルクーツク州）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。見出し中の『新たなウハン』は比較表現であり、中国での実際の発生を示すものではない。ペストの確定診断は未公表（当局は否定的な見解を示しつつ、一部報道は肺ペストの可能性を示唆）。

article.articleHeadline: Imponen Cuarentena en Siberia por Sospecha de Peste Pulmonar; Kremlin Pide Calma | N+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine Imposed in Siberia Due to Suspected Pneumonic Plague; Kremlin Urges Calm | N+.
article.articleSummary: Quarantine imposed in Siberia amid a suspected pneumonic plague; the Kremlin urges calm and reliance on official statements from Rospotrebnadzor, with authorities stressing no confirmed plague diagnosis and describing the case as pneumonia of undetermined etiology. Emergency measures followed a briefing by Governor Igor Kobzev; all contacts are under medical surveillance, with no symptoms and negative tests to date. A 28-year-old woman, employee at the Institute of Plague Research for Irkutsk and the Far East, died in Shelekhov, prompting questions about the infection source. Investigations consider two scenarios: infection contracted in Thailand or an accidental laboratory exposure from a broken pathogen tube at work. No plague confirmation yet; inquiries ongoing. A White House source told Axios that the Trump administration is monitoring the situation and weighing possible actions.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペストの疑いにより隔離措置；クレムリンは冷静な対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアでペスト研究所職員が死亡し肺ペスト疑いで隔離措置が取られており、死亡例・異常事態・国際的関心（米政権の監視）が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイは感染源の可能性として言及されているのみで、実際の発症・隔離はロシア国内で発生しているためverified_locationsには含めない。米国の関与は監視レベルであり発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ബംഗ്ലാദേശിൽ അഞ്ചാംപനി വ്യാപനം; കേരളത്തിലും ജാഗ്രത വേണം, വാക്സിനേഷൻ ഉറപ്പാക്കണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Fifth Disease in Bangladesh; Kerala also needs vigilance, vaccination must be ensured.
article.articleSummary: Fifth disease (Measles) spreads in Bangladesh, with Kerala urged to stay vigilant as Malappuram reports cases. In Bangladesh this year, 1,125 deaths; 1,96,418 total cases; 1,74,149 hospitalizations; 1,218 patients with symptoms sought hospital care in the last 24 hours, of which 1,122 were admitted. In Kerala’s Malappuram district, 103 confirmed cases and two boys aged 1 year 10 months died in September. Officials emphasize vaccination to curb transmission. Fifth disease is characterized by red rashes, fever, cough, and vomiting, with a 10–14 day incubation and spread mainly via respiratory droplets. The MR vaccine is the defense under the National Immunization Schedule: first dose after nine months, second after 16 months; if delayed, it can be given up to age five; vaccination is free at government centers. If symptomatic, seek healthcare, reduce contact, maintain hand hygiene, wear masks, and keep sick children out of school until fully recovered.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで麻疹(はしか)が拡大；ケララ州でも警戒が必要、ワクチン接種の徹底を
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュでの大規模な麻疹流行（死者1,125人、累計症例19万超）がインド・ケララ州マラプラム県にも波及し、同地域で103例確認・児童2名死亡と重症例・死亡例を伴う国際的拡大が見られるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はバングラデシュでの麻疹大流行だが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インド・ケララ州マラプラム県での実際の症例・死亡例が確認されているためIndiaのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS en alerta: Trabajador de laboratorio en Rusia muere por sospecha de peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO on alert: Laboratory worker in Russia dies of suspected pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Approximately 200 people in the Irkutsk region of southern Siberia, near the Mongolia border, are under medical observation after the death of a 28-year-old researcher at a plague-focused institute who developed pneumonia of unknown etiology. Authorities have not confirmed pneumonic plague; the death is attributed to pneumonia with unknown cause, and the hospital where he was treated was temporarily closed and quarantined. The situation remains under surveillance as investigators determine the cause and assess contacts. The United States State Department and the CDC are seeking prompt, transparent information from Russia. Expert commentary suggests a single pneumonic plague case without further infections would likely not spark a large outbreak, though person-to-person transmission via respiratory droplets is possible. Globally, plague-related cases from 2019–2025 exceed 3,800 suspected with 423 deaths, most confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警戒：ロシアの研究所職員が肺ペスト疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の肺炎で研究所職員が死亡し、約200人が経過観察下に置かれるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性も指摘されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。記事中で言及されるDRC・マダガスカルは過去の世界的ペスト症例統計の文脈であり、本イベントの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: नाला निर्माण के दौरान पाइपलाइन टूटने से घरों में गंदे पानी की सप्लाई, गंभीर बीमारियों का खतरा -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During drain construction, a pipeline breaks, causing dirty water supply to homes and the risk of serious diseases.
article.articleSummary: During unplanned drain construction on Debhai Road in Alampur town, Bhind district, a potable water pipeline was ruptured by excavation, allowing sewage-contaminated water to mix with the drinking supply. Residents report foul-smelling, dark water and fear waterborne illness as a result. The contamination raises the risk of diseases including cholera, jaundice (hepatitis), and typhoid, along with gastroenteritis causing vomiting and diarrhea. No laboratory-confirmed cases or outbreaks are mentioned; the article emphasizes potential health hazards. Authorities are urged to immediately repair the broken pipe and ensure safety standards during trenching to prevent further contamination. The community blames the department for lack of precautions and seeks rapid remediation and preventive measures to restore safe drinking water.

triage.headline_ja: 排水路建設中にパイプラインが破損し、家庭への汚水供給と重篤な疾病のリスクが発生
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症例や発生は確認されておらず、水道管破損による潜在的な健康リスクを報じる記事であり、確定症例・アウトブレイクの報告がないため現時点では見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はインフラ事故（水道管破損）による汚染リスクを報じるものであり、実際の症例発生やアウトブレイクの確認はない。地域住民の懸念は高いが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威には至っていない。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rutan Banda Aceh deteksi dini penyakit tuberkulosis warga binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Banda Aceh Detention Center conducts early detection of tuberculosis among inmates.
article.articleSummary: Rutan Kelas IIB Banda Aceh conducted TB screening and routine health examinations for inmates and staff in Banda Aceh, Aceh Besar, with Puskesmas Baitussalam. Hari Kurniawan, head of the facility, stated that ongoing health screening is a key preventive measure to detect tuberculosis and other conditions early and ensure timely medical follow-up. The initiative aims to raise the quality of custodial health services and create a healthier, safer environment for inmates and personnel. Regular screenings reflect a broader public health approach to prevent and control infectious diseases in correctional facilities and highlight sustained collaboration with local health authorities. The report does not provide TB case counts or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: バンダアチェ拘置所、収容者の結核を早期発見する検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核スクリーニング活動の報告であり、症例数や異常な増加等の情報はなく、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は拘置所での定期的な結核検診活動を報じるもので、症例数や検査結果の詳細は不明。公衆衛生上の異常事態ではなく日常的な予防活動の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 8 544 cas confirmés, 4 114 morts... et le Cameroun retient son souffle - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 8,544 confirmed cases, 4,114 deaths... and Cameroon holds its breath.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 8,544 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,114 deaths (case fatality rate 48.2%), with 824 patients hospitalized or in isolation. The Bundibugyo-strain outbreak now spans seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Sud-Ubangi—Ituri accounting for about 75% of cases. Contact tracing is 73.8%, well below the WHO’s 95% target to interrupt transmission. Recoveries total 2,230. Cameroon is on high alert; no cases detected yet, but border surveillance is intensified and regional cooperation under the CEMAC One Health roadmap aims to prevent importation and enable rapid response. The outbreak is the deadliest in DRC to date and could, according to projections, surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa toll; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though clinical trials are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確認症例8,544件、死者4,114人…カメルーンは息を潜める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率48.2%の大規模エボラ流行が7州に拡大し、接触者追跡率がWHO目標を下回っており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確なためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: カメルーンでは症例未検出で国境監視強化段階のため対象国リストに含まれるアンゴラ等も症例確認なし。記事の主題はDRCでの流行拡大であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: هشدار جدی در مورد کووید و آنفلوآنزا؛ چرا وضعیت تنفسی در ایران همچنان "بالای آستانه خطر" است؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serious warning about COVID-19 and influenza; why is the respiratory situation in Iran still "above the danger threshold"?
article.articleSummary: Iran's health ministry warns that despite a relative reduction in COVID-19 cases, the overall burden of respiratory infections (influenza and COVID-19) remains above the high-alert threshold. Influenza activity shows type B predominance (77.5% of positive flu tests); outpatient respiratory infections are at 9.3%, with children bearing the heaviest burden—about 39.3% of influenza cases, mostly under age 5. For COVID-19, positivity declined from 17.4% last week to 13.7% now, but officials caution the drop may be transient as the RV.1 variant circulating. Hotspots include Bushehr at 18.7% positive and Fars at 11.6%; Khuzestan, Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari, and Kerman are at lower alert. Globally, Europe is relatively stable, while East Asia (China, South Korea) reports rising influenza activity and hospitalizations, signaling possible shifts elsewhere. The ministry urges intensified surveillance of new variants and adherence to public-health measures in crowded settings. As of 2026-10-05.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスとインフルエンザに関する深刻な警告：イランの呼吸器疾患状況がなお「危険閾値を超えている」理由とは？
triage.triage_reason: イラン国内の季節性インフルエンザとCOVID-19の活動が警戒閾値を上回っているとの保健省発表だが、重症度や医療逼迫の具体的データが乏しく、対象国（監視リスト）にも該当しないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイランにおける季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19・インフルエンザ）の国内動向であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国・韓国への言及はグローバルな比較文脈に留まり、主要発生地域とは言えないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших лихорадкой Эбола в Конго превысило 8500 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola fever in Congo has exceeded 8,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 8,544 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 4,114 deaths (mortality 48.2%). By Oct 2, 2026, 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths were registered. There are 824 patients with symptoms hospitalized in medical isolation centers or hospitals. Contact tracing coverage stands at 73.8%. The outbreak has spread across 7 of Congo’s 26 provinces. The flare began May 15 in the DRC and Uganda, becoming Africa’s second-deadliest EVD outbreak in modern history. Uganda declared an end to its outbreak on July 28, with the WHO confirming this on Aug 25. The first human Ebola case was recorded in 1976 in the region now called the DRC; this is the 17th EVD outbreak in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染者数が8,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が8,544症例・死亡率48.2%に達し、7州に拡大するアフリカ史上2番目に致命的な流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも流行発生国だが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダの流行は既に終息宣言済み（7/28宣言、8/25 WHO確認）。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայով հիվանդացածների թիվը գերազանցել է 8500-ը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of Ebola patients has surpassed 8,500.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 8,544, with 4,114 deaths (mortality 48.2%). As of October 2, 2026, 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths were reported, with 824 patients hospitalized or isolated for symptoms. Contact tracing coverage is 73.8%. The outbreak has spread to seven of the country’s 26 provinces. The outbreak began on May 15 in the DRC and Uganda, and is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in Africa’s modern history; Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on July 28, with WHO confirmation on August 25. The first Ebola case in modern DRC was in 1976. The current outbreak is the 17th in the DRC’s history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者数が8500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率48.2%、8,544症例・4,114死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が7州に拡大しており、アフリカ史上2番目に致死的な流行とされ、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は2026年7月28日に終息宣言され8月25日にWHO確認済みのため、現在進行中の流行地域としてはDRCのみを含めた。ウガンダ(226074)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bantul mengimbau penerapan PHBS cegah influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bantul Health Office urges the implementation of PHBS to prevent Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, Bantul Regency in Yogyakarta (DIY), Indonesia has no confirmed Influenza A cases. Dinkes Bantul head Agus Tri Widiyantara stated surveillance shows no positive influenza A results in Bantul amid a national uptick. The rise nationwide is not directly linked to the region's dry season; mutations may yield more transmissible strains. Influenza A typically causes sudden high fever (>38°C), chills, myalgias, severe fatigue, dry cough, sore throat, and nasal congestion; children may experience nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Prevention emphasizes annual influenza vaccination, proper hand hygiene, masking in crowds or when unwell, and PHBS—adequate sleep, nutritious diet, and regular exercise to maintain immunity.

triage.headline_ja: バントゥル県保健局、インフルエンザA予防のためPHBS（清潔で健康的な生活習慣）の実践を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: バントゥル県では確認症例なく、全国的な増加傾向も通常の季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発的な内容であり、バントゥルでは確定症例なし。全国的なインフルエンザA増加について言及があるが、インドネシア全体としての異常な公衆衛生事象とは言えず、対象国リストに該当する具体的な発生国としての特定イベントではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Търсенията за "чума" в Google в Русия скочиха с 2800% за седмица
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Searches for "plague" on Google in Russia jumped by 2,800% in a week.
article.articleSummary: Plague fears in Russia after quarantine measures in Shelekhov, Irkutsk Oblast, amid suspected pneumonic plague. Google searches for 'plague' spiked about 2,800% for September 29–October 5, 2026 (vs. the same week last year, ~5,000% YoY). Media reported the death of 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, with claims the cause was pneumonic plague, though officials have not confirmed plague as the cause. One theory says she returned from Thailand; another suggests she was a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute and may have broken a vial containing the pathogen. Rospotrebnadzor reports a pneumonia of unknown etiology in the case, without confirmation of plague. On October 3, Baikalsk authorities urged residents not to travel to Shelekhov; the advisory was later removed. A three-week quarantine was imposed in several hospitals in Irkutsk.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの「ペスト」のGoogle検索が1週間で2,800%急増
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いによる死亡例と検疫措置が発生し、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・渡航制限）が複数該当。確定診断はまだだが社会的関心も急上昇しておりフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（Shelekhov/Irkutsk）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。タイは死亡者の渡航歴に関する未確認の推測として言及されているのみで、タイでの発生ではない。病原体（ペスト菌）の確定診断は未了（Rospotrebnadzorは『原因不明の肺炎』と報告）。続報で確定診断・感染拡大状況を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Russia Plague Scare: Dos & Don'ts For Mumbai Travellers Amid Suspected Case In Irkutsk
article.articleSummary: Suspected plague case in Russia's Irkutsk region prompts caution for Mumbai travellers as of 2026-10-05. A 28-year-old laboratory worker, Darya Shipilova, who worked at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute, died after severe pneumonia; about 200 people who had contact with her are under medical observation. Russian authorities have not confirmed plague; officials describe the illness as pneumonia of unknown origin and note tests have not identified microorganisms linked to her work. No nationwide plague outbreak has been confirmed. Travellers from Mumbai should follow official health advisories, maintain good hygiene, avoid contact with sick or wild animals, and wear masks where required; seek medical care for fever, breathing difficulties, chest pain, cough, or other serious symptoms; keep travel insurance. Do not assume Russia is fully affected or enter quarantined zones, and do not self-medicate with antibiotics. The article cites CDC on pneumonic plague symptoms and emphasizes early medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト疑い:イルクーツクでの疑い例を受けたムンバイ旅行者への注意事項
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで研究所職員がペストの疑いのある肺炎で死亡したが、当局はペストと確認しておらず、国内流行も確認されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疑い例はロシア・イルクーツクで発生しており、ペストと未確認（原因不明の肺炎とされる）。記事はムンバイ旅行者向けの注意喚起であり、インドでの発生事例ではないため、対象国リストに該当する実際の発生地はなし。

article.articleHeadline: กรณีสงสัย 'กาฬโรคปอด' ในรัสเซีย ประเมินความเสี่ยงเข้าไทย 'ยังต่ำ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected case of pneumonic plague in Russia; risk of entry into Thailand remains low.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague in Russia; risk of entry into Thailand remains low. A 28-year-old woman working at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk, Russia, developed severe pneumonia and died on 29 September 2026. At least 197 contacts have been traced; no illness has been detected among them. There is currently no laboratory confirmation that Yersinia pestis caused the death, and no evidence of human-to-human transmission. The Thai Department of Disease Control reports ongoing monitoring and coordination with WHO via the IHR National Focal Point; no travel restrictions or extra border screening are deemed necessary at this time. Plague is classified as a dangerous communicable disease under Thailand’s Communicable Diseases Act BE 2558, with strict surveillance, reporting, and control. If travelers present fever with pneumonia and exposure history, they should be isolated, treated with antibiotics, and investigated promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペスト疑い症例、タイへの流入リスクは現時点で低いと評価
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が重症肺炎で死亡し肺ペストが疑われており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 事例発生国はロシアであり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは監視・リスク評価を行っている立場であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ペスト菌による死亡はまだ検査未確認、濃厚接触者197名に異常なしとのことで、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠は現時点でない。続報（検査結果、追加症例の有無）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: MinSalud alerta sobre riesgo epidemiológico por aumento de enfermedades asociadas al fenómeno de El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of epidemiological risk due to an increase in diseases associated with the El Niño phenomenon.
article.articleSummary: El Niño-driven epidemiological risk in Venezuela is highlighted by spikes in diarrheal diseases and ongoing vector- and water-borne threats. For Sept 13–19, 2026, acute diarrheal cases reached 14,445, up 22.5% week‑over‑week, with a national morbidity rate of 1,641.33 per 100,000; Amazonas recorded the highest diarrheal rate (4,339.47/100k). Dengue activity includes 320 suspected cases in week 37 and a 2026 total of 12,061, with 67.63% without alarm signs, 32.15% with alarm signs, and 0.22% severe; Delta Amacuro shows the highest incidence (107.52/100k). Respiratory diseases total 44,535; pneumonia 2,286, and Amazonas reports the top pneumonia rate (21.30/100k). Influenza A H3N2 accounts for about half of positives (402/2,699; 14.89%); age clusters 5–19 and 20–39 years predominate. Malaria year‑to‑date 71,970; week 37 yields 977 cases (952 autochthonous, 25 imported), Bolívar leading with 51,895. Yellow fever 11 cases (3 deaths); rabies 6 human cases and 37,583 suspected bites. Emphasized preventive measures include sanitation, mosquito control, safe water, and avoiding stagnant waters, amid national 51.63% notification coverage.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、エルニーニョ現象に関連した疾患増加による疫学的リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラにおいてエルニーニョに伴うデング・マラリア・黄熱・狂犬病・インフルエンザA等複数疾患の増加が保健省により公式に警告されており、重症例・死亡例も報告され社会的関心（政府発表）がある。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラの保健省(MinSalud)によるエルニーニョ関連疾患の国内統計報告であり、言及されているAmazonasはベネズエラ国内のアマゾナス州を指す。発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが記事の主題はベネズエラであり、対象国リストにVenezuelaは含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Ebola BVD Outbreak: LTC Situation Report (Telecoms) #12 (Reporting period: 15 - 30 September 2026)
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola BVD Outbreak: LTC Telecoms Situation Report #12 (reporting period 15–30 September 2026) documents telecoms-enabled support across Bunia, Mongbwalu and Kisangani as part of the Ebola response. Inter-agency coordination, connectivity planning, security communications, power solutions and information management are foregrounded to sustain operations while scaling services in priority response locations. These arrangements aim to ensure rapid deployment of communications, power and information-management capabilities to frontline teams during ongoing Ebola control measures. LTC Telecoms has finalised a 12-month budget for equipment and response-centre requirements for a ten-hub operation, with confirmation of eight outstanding hub locations critical to validate site-specific requirements. The report underscores the ongoing role of telecoms in supporting the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱BVDアウトブレイク：LTC通信状況報告書#12（報告期間：2026年9月15日～30日）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応に関する報告であり、疾患の重篤性・ヒトーヒト感染リスク・国際支援の必要性が確認されるため、フルリスク評価の継続・確認が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する通信インフラ支援の運用報告であり、新規症例数や死亡者数などの疫学的更新情報は含まれていない。既存の対応継続状況を示すものであるが、エボラという疾患特性上、国際的拡大・支援必要性の観点から継続的な注視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: North Kivu's Ebola outbreak spreading like a megafire as new hotspots multiply
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, has intensified since early September, now accounting for about 40% of all newly confirmed cases nationwide, up from 24% at end-August. New hotspots emerge weekly, while treatment capacity remains insufficient. MSF describes the situation as 'like fighting a megafire,' with multiple simultaneous outbreaks and unpredictable transmission. Butembo has shown a slight decline in confirmed cases, but neighboring Beni is rising. As of 28 September, 34% of confirmed patients are treated in non-specialized facilities due to bed shortages and diagnostic delays, increasing transmission risk. Butembo, home to ~2 million people, previously had only two Ebola treatment centres; two more recently opened, but substantial capacity is still needed. MSF supports three facilities: Kitatumba Treatment Centre (29 beds), UCG Transit Centre (16 beds for suspected), and Musienene Transit Centre (5 beds). Over 60% of Ebola deaths occur in the community; urgent mobilization of stakeholders is urged to expand capacity and ensure quality care in Butembo and North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: MSF：北キブ州のエボラ流行が大規模火災のように拡大、新たなホットスポットが多発
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の拡大が継続し新規感染ホットスポットが多発、治療能力不足で地域医療が逼迫しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: MSFによる現地支援活動の報告であり、治療能力不足・地域社会内での死亡率の高さ（60%超）が強調されている。続報でのケース数・致死率の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Antraks Kembali Muncul di Gunungkidul, Pakar: Sporanya Bisa Bertahan 90 Tahun di Tanah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax resurfaces in Gunungkidul, expert: its spores can survive for up to 90 years in soil.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) re-emerged in Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, announced Oct 5, 2026. The Agriculture Ministry is strengthening animal-disease controls in the area after a renewed case. Expert Dr. Slamet Raharjo warns spores can form protective capsules and survive up to 90 years in soil, making eradication difficult. Outbreaks tend to be environmental: high humidity or wet soil after rain can wake dormant spores and infect susceptible livestock. Anthrax is highly lethal for ruminants such as cattle and goats, with rapid incubation and severe organ damage, especially the spleen; death may occur before clear clinical signs. Signs include sudden high fever, restlessness, lethargy, and refusal to eat; after death, thick dark blood may exude from natural openings. If sudden death occurs, report to local authorities (Puskeswan, veterinarian, or Department of Agriculture) and do not open or slaughter carcasses.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥルで炭疽が再発、専門家「芽胞は土壌中で90年生存可能」
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（牛・ヤギ）における致死性の高い炭疽の再発事例であり、人獣共通感染症として今後ヒトへの波及が懸念されるため、WPRO基準の重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当し、政府（農業省）の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は家畜（牛・ヤギ）における炭疽の再発に関するもので、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されていない。グヌンキドゥルは過去にも炭疽発生歴がある地域であり、土壌中の芽胞の長期残存性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Agra News: खसरे से तीन मौत के बाद तीनों गांवों में लगाए गए टीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agra News: Vaccines administered in all three villages after three measles deaths.
article.articleSummary: Dinpur village on the Badaun-Kasganj border (also called Niyaz Ali Nagla) reported two deaths due to measles, prompting a rapid public health response. Authorities have launched vaccination drives in three villages and deployed teams to conduct house-to-house surveys, organize health camps, and distribute medicines. On Monday, physicians from Ganjdundwara Community Health Centre treated measles-affected children at a local camp and administered vaccines to other children to prevent further cases. The effort emphasizes immunization gaps and early treatment to curb transmission and reduce mortality, with ongoing outreach to ensure coverage across the affected area. Authorities are coordinating with district health officials to monitor cases and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: アグラニュース：ディンプルで麻疹による3人の死亡後、3つの村でワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州の村落で麻疹により2名（見出しでは3名）の死亡が報告され予防接種対応が行われているが、規模は局地的で国際的拡大の兆候はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 地元ヒンディー語紙の報道で、国内地区保健当局が対応しているローカルな麻疹アウトブレイク。死亡者数や予防接種率等の詳細情報が不足しているため、フルリスク評価の前に続報を確認することが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia llama a la calma ante reportes de posible brote de peste en Siberia que monitorea EE. UU.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia urges calm amid reports of a possible plague outbreak in Siberia that the United States is monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Possible plague case in Siberia prompts vigilance from Moscow and Washington. The Kremlin urges following Rospotrebnadzor reports and ignoring rumors. A 28-year-old female employee of the Institute of Plague Research for Irkutsk and the Far East died in a hospital in Shélejov. Rospotrebnadzor classifies the death as pneumonia of unknown etiology; none of the patient’s contacts have fallen ill or tested positive. Investigators are evaluating two hypotheses: infection acquired in Thailand, from which she recently returned, or an accidental lab incident involving a breached tube containing pathogens at her workplace. US Secretary of State Rubio said the United States is closely monitoring the Irkutsk case, where a plague researcher died and about 200 people are under observation. There is no alarm, but a focused approach, according to officials.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアでのペスト感染疑いの報道に対し冷静な対応を呼びかけ、米国も監視
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎（ペストの疑い）で死亡し、米国務長官が監視を公言するなど国際的関心が高く、異常性・重大性の観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは患者の渡航歴（感染源の仮説）として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。接触者に陽性者はおらず、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia reports anthrax case in Yogyakarta
article.articleSummary: Anthrax case reported in Dadapayu Village, Gunungkidul, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, prompting integrated control measures. The Ministry of Agriculture, via Director of Animal Health Hendra Wibawa, reports epidemiological investigations, livestock health services, disinfection, vaccination, and laboratory examinations. Gunungkidul Agriculture and Food Agency conducted an epidemiological investigation on Sept 11, 2026 to trace the incident, assess nearby livestock, and collect samples. On Sept 12, disinfection of affected shelters and animal treatment were carried out. Antibiotics and vitamins were administered to 88 goats and 11 cattle in Dadapayu Village. Anthrax vaccinations began on Sept 28 for livestock in the surrounding area after antibiotic treatment ended. Public guidance urges not to slaughter, process, distribute, or consume livestock that are sick or have died suddenly. Authorities include the Ministry of Agriculture, local agencies, and Antara Indonesian News Agency. Report date: 2026-10-05.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、ジョグジャカルタで炭疽症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（ヤギ・牛）における炭疽発生で、人への感染報告はなく、既に疫学調査・消毒・ワクチン接種等の対応が実施済み。インドネシアでは地域的に周期発生する既知の事象であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 家畜（ヤギ11頭・牛11頭、計88頭が治療対象）の炭疽発生であり、ヒトへの感染症例は記事中に記載なし。地方当局による対応（疫学調査、消毒、抗生剤投与、ワクチン接種）が既に実施されており、インドネシアでは炭疽の地域的発生が周期的に見られるため異常性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Coimbatore Corporation intensifies dengue checks at theatres, public places
article.articleSummary: Dengue control measures in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, have intensified across cinema theatres, hotels, marriage halls, community halls, parks and other mass gathering sites in five zones and 100 wards. The Coimbatore Corporation, led by Commissioner Katta Ravi Teja, conducted joint cleanliness and dengue prevention drives, removing waste, clearing stagnant water and inspecting containers that could breed mosquitoes. In the Central Zone, mosquito larvae were found in a water-filled theatre container, resulting in a ₹50,000 fine for the establishment. Similar inspections occurred at hotels, parks and other public places. Dengue awareness programmes were held on five streets—Manish Nagar (Nallampalayam), Gurusamy Nagar (Kalveerampalayam), MGR Nagar, Green Field and Hatco Colony—featuring short films, fever screening camps, nilavembu drinks and leaflets, plus activities for children. The city will conduct these 'Dengue Awareness Street' sessions every Saturday across all five zones, covering 6,959 streets.

triage.headline_ja: コインバトール市、劇場や公共の場でのデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性デング熱対策・啓発活動に関する行政広報であり、異常な流行拡大や重症事例の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州コインバトールにおける定例的なデング熱予防・清掃活動と啓発キャンペーンの実施を報じたもので、症例数や流行拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Чернышова объяснила, чем опасны новые штаммы гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Chernyshova explained how dangerous the new influenza strains are.
article.articleSummary: Influenza strains described as not more severe than seasonal flu but still dangerous due to risk of pneumonia, myocarditis, and bronchitis. The variants, first detected in Hong Kong last year, informed the updated vaccine for the current season. In Moscow on October 5, doctors urge vaccination in October to allow immunity to develop ahead of the seasonal peak. Patients cannot discern the strain from symptoms; only laboratory PCR testing can identify the specific variant. While vaccination does not guarantee full protection from infection, it reduces the risk of severe illness and hospitalization and is part of ongoing seasonal influenza monitoring for public health.

triage.headline_ja: チェルヌィショワ医師、新型インフルエンザ株の危険性を説明
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する通常の予防接種啓発記事であり、重症度や異常性、国際的拡大リスクなどの基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 香港での株検出は昨年のことであり、現在の発生地ではなくワクチン更新の背景情報として言及されているのみ。記事の主題はロシア・モスクワでの季節性インフルエンザ予防接種啓発であり、対象国リストに該当する発生国はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à la Tshopo : les élèves d'une école primaire sensibilisés à l'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: Primary school students educated about Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) awareness education for primary school students in Ubundu, Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 5 October 2026, at EP Madula near PK 23 on the Ituri road in Bakumu-Mandombe sector, provincial deputy Ghislain Mogenya Baraka led prevention instruction, stressing hygiene and regular handwashing with water and soap to curb Ebola transmission. School authorities expressed thanks for the deputy’s initiative and for providing handwashing stations with liquid soap and additional supplies to strengthen hygiene measures within the school. The activity forms part of Ubundu territory’s broader community outreach to bolster Ebola prevention, especially in schools, through proper hygiene practices and dissemination of preventive messages.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州でのエボラ:小学校の児童がエボラについて啓発教育を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラに関する記事だが、新規感染事例ではなく学校での予防啓発活動の報道であり、実際の発生状況や症例情報が不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行地域（コンゴ民主共和国ツショポ州ウブンドゥ）における予防啓発活動を報じるものであり、新規症例や発生状況についての具体的情報は含まれていない。地域の政治家が学校で衛生教育を実施した内容が中心。エボラが地域で継続的な懸念事項であることを示唆するが、現在の流行状況・症例数等の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Triệt phá đường dây đưa hơn 10.000 tấn heo nhiễm chất cấm ra thị trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crackdown on a trafficking ring that shipped more than 10,000 metric tons of pigs contaminated with banned substances to the market.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City police dismantled a large trafficking ring that shipped more than 10,000 tonnes of pigs fattened with the banned growth promoter Salbutamol to markets in Ho Chi Minh City, Đồng Tháp and other Southern provinces. Since January 2026, the scheme generated over 600 billion VND in illicit profits. In late July 2026, authorities inspected three trucks and found 280 market pigs positive for Salbutamol, including 80 also positive for African swine fever. Expanded raids in Đồng Nai uncovered 3,909 pigs (>500 tonnes) across multiple farms positive for Salbutamol; all were culled. The Salbutamol source was Nguyen Thi Trinh Nu of Vĩnh Long, who in mid-2025 marketed a product from Thailand and Cambodia at 375,000 VND/kg to enhance fattening. The ring mixed 100 g of Salbutamol with 300 kg of feed for 100 pigs, fattening them in about 30 days. Authorities seized over 1,000 kg of Salbutamol and warned against use of banned additives; seven suspects faced food safety charges, one trafficking charge, and bribery-related charges, with ongoing investigations.

triage.headline_ja: 1万トン超の禁止薬物混入豚を市場に流通させた密売組織を摘発
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は違法成長促進剤サルブタモール混入豚の密売摘発事件であり、ASFは摘発過程で一部の豚に陽性反応が出たという副次的情報に過ぎず、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は食品安全・違法薬物密売事件が主題であり、ASF(アフリカ豚熱)は摘発された一部の豚に陽性反応が見られたという付随的事実に過ぎない。タイ・カンボジアはサルブタモールの供給元として言及されているが、ASF発生国としての言及ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumonic plague in Siberia, what we really know: the broken test tube, the Irkutsk laboratory and doubts about contagion
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague concerns erupt in Irkutsk, Siberia, after 28-year-old lab technician Darya Shipilova dies of pneumonia of unknown origin following reports of a September test-tube break containing Yersinia pestis. She was hospitalized on September 29 in Shelekhov and died October 2. Russian authorities have not confirmed viable plague bacteria; the Kremlin urges reliance on Rospotrebnadzor. All identified contacts are under surveillance with negative tests and no symptoms; the incubation period is 1–7 days. Two hypotheses persist: infection in Thailand during recent travel or exposure from a workplace accident at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute for Siberia and the Far East. No nationwide hospital quarantines, though restrictions existed in Shelekhov. EU and US monitoring bodies, along with WHO, track the situation; Y. pestis is rare in Europe and treatable with antibiotics, with timely treatment deemed essential.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの肺ペスト、実際に何が分かっているのか：壊れた試験管、イルクーツクの研究所、感染への疑念
triage.triage_reason: イルクーツクの研究所職員がペスト菌(Yersinia pestis)関連の原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、WHO・EU・米国の監視対象となっている点で異常性と重篤性が高く、IHR基準2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常予想外）に該当するためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 主要な発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。タイへの渡航が感染経路の仮説として挙げられているが、確定情報ではなく実際の発症地点ではないため除外。ペスト菌の生存確認は未了で、死因も未確定である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Imponen cuarentena en varios hospitales de Siberia por sospecha de peste pulmonar, mientras el Kremlin descarta el caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine imposed in several hospitals in Siberia due to suspected pneumonic plague, as the Kremlin rules out the case.
article.articleSummary: Death of Daria Ch., 28, a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Institute for the Study of the Plague in Siberia, triggers concern for pneumonic plague after a broken tube. A special commission concluded the cause of death as pneumonia of undetermined etiology, with no confirmed plague. Quarantines affected at least four medical facilities in the Irkutsk region, including a pediatric hospital, with hospitalization-area restrictions and visitor bans for up to three weeks. The regional health service has not officially diagnosed pneumonic plague; two scenarios are under review: infection in Thailand or an accidental lab exposure. All contacts are under medical observation; none show symptoms and testing is negative to date. The European Commission is monitoring the situation, stressing transparent data sharing and cross-border cooperation. No confirmed outbreak; authorities emphasize plague is treatable with antibiotics if present.

triage.headline_ja: カザフスタンではなくシベリアの複数の病院で肺ペスト疑いにより検疫措置、クレムリンは否定
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑いで複数病院が検疫されたが、死因は未確定肺炎とされ公式診断は出ていない。情報不足で確定的判断ができないため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・シベリア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイでの感染経路の可能性が言及されているが、これは未確定の仮説であり、記事の主題はロシア国内の事案であるためタイは含めない。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.ติดตามกรณี "กาฬโรคปอด" ในรัสเซีย ประเมินความเสี่ยงนำเข้าเชื้อสู่ไทยอยู่ในระดับ "ต่ำ"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health monitors a pneumonic plague case in Russia; the risk of importing the pathogen into Thailand is assessed as 'low'.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control reports a suspected pneumonic plague case in Russia, with import risk to Thailand assessed as low. A 28-year-old woman employed at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk Oblast died on 29 September 2026 after severe pneumonia of unknown cause. At least 197 contacts are under monitoring; to date, none have become ill. There is no laboratory confirmation of Yersinia pestis and no evidence of human-to-human transmission; the case remains under investigation with WHO liaison through the IHR National Focal Point. The import risk is considered low due to the localized nature of the event and lack of community spread, and WHO has not issued travel advisories. Pneumonic plague is a form of plague caused by Yersinia pestis and can spread via respiratory droplets; control relies on rapid diagnosis, isolation, antibiotic treatment, and contact tracing. No additional travel restrictions or screening are deemed necessary at present.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ロシアでの肺ペスト症例を監視、タイへの病原体輸入リスクは『低い』と評価
triage.triage_reason: ロシアで肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、IHR基準上『重篤』『異常』に該当する可能性があるため、国際的監視対象としてフルRRAへ進める価値がある。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。タイは輸入リスク評価のみを実施しており、国内発生は確認されていない。Yersinia pestisの検査確定はまだなく、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠もない。

article.articleHeadline: Sospecha de peste pulmonar en Siberia hace cerrar hospitales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected pneumonic plague in Siberia forces hospitals to close.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Siberia’s Irkutsk region faced concern over suspected pneumonic plague tied to the Irkutsk Institute for plague research after the death of a 28-year-old laboratory technician, Daria Ch. A reported broken vial raised alarms of plague, prompting rumors of quarantines in at least four facilities, including a pediatric hospital, with visits restricted for up to three weeks. Regional authorities and a special expert commission subsequently attributed the death to pneumonia of undetermined etiology, and Rospotrebnadzor stated the diagnosis remained undetermined with no confirmed pneumonic plague; all close contacts are under medical observation and testing has been negative. Investigations consider infection acquired in Thailand or an occupational accident involving a broken tube. The European Union is monitoring the situation; plague is bacterial and antibiotic-treatable, but rare in Europe.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペスト疑いにより病院が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 研究所勤務者の死亡例を巡り肺ペスト疑いが浮上し病院隔離措置が取られたため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）が2つ該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、タイは感染経路の推測地として言及されているのみで対象国リスト該当地域での発生は確認できない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。その後の検査で肺ペストは否定され、原因不明の肺炎とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Scabies: The invisible skin infection that is more than skin-deep
article.articleSummary: Scabies, caused by Sarcoptes scabiei, remains a neglected tropical disease in India, disproportionately affecting marginalized communities from Baiga Adivasis in Chhattisgarh to Kondh tribals in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, and the labouring poor of Bihar and Gujarat. Budhram, a 12-year-old at a Baiga residential school in Chhattisgarh, and his mother and siblings endure relentless itching, sleepless nights and social hardship; local injections provide partial relief at high cost. Transmission is via close contact, with outbreaks in dormitories, hospitals, prisons and refugee camps; reinfection is common due to unwashed clothes and bedding, limited water, and overcrowding. Globally, Global Burden of Disease 2021 data report about 206.6 million people infected at any time and roughly 622.5 million new cases annually. In 2017, WHO designated scabies a Neglected Tropical Disease. Control requires mass community treatment: boiling clothes, distributing extra garments, applying antiscabies lotion, and providing tablets and antibiotics, with strong community participation.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬：見た目以上に深刻な「見えない」皮膚感染症
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬はインドで以前から知られる顧みられない熱帯病であり、突発的・異常な公衆衛生事象ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 疥癬はWHOが2017年に顧みられない熱帯病に指定した慢性的・地域的な公衆衛生課題であり、特定のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。社会経済的背景の特集記事であり、緊急シグナルとしての性質は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Com Super El Niño, casos de dengue no Brasil poderão variar de 1 milhão a 5,6 milhões em 2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With a Super El Niño, dengue cases in Brazil could range from 1 million to 5.6 million in 2027.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a dengue surge linked to Super El Niño, with 2027 projections from InfoDengue and Fiocruz around 1.7 million cases, potentially ranging 1 million to 5.6 million. In 2024, dengue affected over 6.5 million Brazilians and caused more than 6,000 deaths. Takeda markets Qdenga, the only dengue vaccine approved in Brazil, under a two-dose regimen. In the public SUS system, vaccination targets 10–14-year-olds; in private networks, 4–60-year-olds. Program milestones include a first contract for 15.6 million doses delivered by end-2025, a second contract for 18 million doses in 2026–2027, and about 4 million doses delivered in July 2026. From Jan 2024 to Aug 2026, 21.7 million doses distributed to the PNI, with 12.6 million doses administered by Sep 2026 to over 8 million people; globally >30 million doses. Two-dose completion in Brazil ~54%; real-world data show 87.9% effectiveness against hospitalizations and 73.1% against symptomatic dengue. Butantan vaccine suspensions cited; Takeda says no link to Qdenga.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーエルニーニョにより、ブラジルのデング熱症例数は2027年に100万から560万に変動する可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで毎年流行する風土病（デング熱）に関する将来予測・ワクチン接種プログラムの解説記事であり、新規または異常な公衆衛生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2027年に向けた将来予測とワクチン接種プログラム（Qdenga）の進捗報告が中心であり、突発的な異常事象の報告ではない。デング熱はブラジルの風土病として既知であるため、新規シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Parasita invade cérebro de cavalos e deixa pesquisadores de olho - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A parasite invades horses' brains and leaves researchers on the lookout - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Two Criollo horses in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, were studied after a rare parasite invaded the nervous system in 2021 and 2023. The nematode Halicephalobus gingivalis was detected in nervous tissue and other organs; histology showed inflammation and larvae near blood vessels, while rabies tests were negative. Genetic analysis placed the Brazilian isolates in Lineage 3, the same lineage as samples from other countries, providing a molecular identifier for these cases. The parasite normally inhabits the environment and rarely infects mammals, but central nervous system involvement can be fatal, leading to euthanasia in both cases due to irreversibility. Although the episodes occurred on different properties with almost two years between them, the study found no evidence the Criollo breed is more susceptible. Clinicians and breeders should monitor for sudden neurological changes and seek veterinary care, recognizing that such symptoms have multiple potential causes.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫が馬の脳に侵入、研究者が注視 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ではなく稀な線虫(Halicephalobus gingivalis)による馬の神経疾患の症例報告であり、人獣共通感染症としての証拠やヒトへの感染拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名が'Rabies'とタグ付けされているが、記事内容は狂犬病検査が陰性であったことを示しており、実際の原因は稀な線虫感染症（馬の症例、2頭のみ）。ヒトへの感染リスクの記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 300 Million Deaths, 90% Fatality, and One Virus That Is Almost Always Deadly | What If Show
article.articleSummary: HIV origins trace to the 1800s, likely from hunting chimpanzees in Central Africa; spreads via sex and injection drug use. Untreated HIV progresses to AIDS with immune-system damage. By end-2020 37.7 million lived with HIV; antiretroviral therapy controls infection, but no cure. Smallpox, caused by variola virus, killed hundreds of millions and spread via skin contact and droplets; eradicated in 1977 by vaccination. Marburg virus disease, an African hemorrhagic fever carried by fruit bats; incubation up to 21 days; rash and organ dysfunction; no specific treatment—supportive care; avoid bats. Ebola, six strains, drove 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak with up to 90% fatality; outbreaks 1976 in South Sudan and DR Congo; transmission via body fluids; vaccines like Ervebo deployed in Guinea and DR Congo. Rabies spreads mainly from dogs; symptoms include difficulty swallowing, drooling, and behavior changes; almost 100% fatal after symptoms appear; preventable by pet vaccination and avoiding wild animals.

triage.headline_ja: 3億人の死者、致死率90%、ほぼ常に致命的な一つのウイルス | What If Show
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は歴史的・教育的な感染症総説コンテンツであり、特定の現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIV、天然痘、マールブルグ病、エボラ、狂犬病に関する一般的・歴史的な解説記事であり、特定の現在の発生事象の報告ではない。DRC・ギニア等はエボラ過去流行の文脈で言及されているのみで、現行の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : face à des foyers d'Ebola qui se multiplient, les centres de traitement au bord de la saturation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: as Ebola outbreaks multiply, treatment centers near capacity.
article.articleSummary: Since early September 2026, North Kivu Province faces an alarming resurgence of Ebola, with multiple foci in Beni and Butembo. As of 28 September, 34% of confirmed Ebola cases were hospitalized in general facilities not equipped to handle the disease, due to saturation of dedicated centers and diagnostic delays, increasing nosocomial transmission risk. The province accounts for about 40% of new confirmed cases nationally, up from 24% at end-August, signaling rapid spread. MSF describes the outbreak as firefighters facing a megafire; capacity to absorb patients remains limited. In Butembo, two specialized centers existed until recently; two new centers have opened, but care in non-specialized facilities remains below standards. MSF supports three sites: Kitatumba Ebola Treatment Center (29 beds), UCG Transit Center (16 isolation beds), Musienene Transit Center (5 beds). Community engagement and trust are emphasized to promote early care and isolation; urgent scale-up of human and logistical resources across the province is urged.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:エボラの感染拡大地が増加する中、治療センターが飽和状態に近づく
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ感染が急速に拡大し、治療施設が飽和状態で院内感染リスクも高まっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: MSFが『消防士が巨大火災に直面している』と表現するほど深刻な状況で、診断の遅延や専門施設の不足により一般医療施設での院内感染リスクが増大している。全国新規確認症例の約40%を北キブ州が占め、急速な拡大傾向を示す。

article.articleHeadline: 'না মানুষ' থেকে ছড়ায় নিপা-ইবোলা, মাথাব্যথা ডেঙ্গুও! এবার জেলায় জেলায় ওয়ান হেলথ কমিটি রাজ্যের
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah-Ebola spreads from 'Na Manush', headache and dengue too! Now district-by-district One Health Committees across the state.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, the state is establishing district-by-district One Health Committees to curb cross-species disease spread, spotlighting Nipah and Ebola linked to 'Na Manush,' and noting dengue. One Health requires coordination among veterinarians, environmental specialists, local administration, and food-safety officers to monitor infection sources and vectors in animals and the environment, not just treat humans. The new committees will include district magistrates, chief medical officers, Deputy Director of the Animal Resources Development Department, the district medical college principal, divisional forest officer, veterinary laboratory in-charge, municipal officer, district panchayat president, and rural development officer, forming multidisciplinary teams at every district. Professor Siddharth Joarder of the State Veterinary and Fisheries University backs the plan, citing Nipah from fruit bats and rising antibiotic resistance as concerns; the approach aligns with WHO, OIE, FAO, and UNEP initiatives that stress integrated health beyond borders after SARS, MERS, Ebola, and COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 「ナ・マヌシュ」から人間以外へ広がるニパ・エボラ、頭痛とデング熱も！今度は県ごとにワンヘルス委員会を州が設置
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な新規感染症例の発生報告ではなく、西ベンガル州による予防的なワンヘルス体制整備に関する行政施策の記事であり、現時点で緊急性のあるアウトブレイクの証拠はないが、ニパ・エボラへの言及があるため継続注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例報告ではなく、西ベンガル州政府が人獣共通感染症対策としてワンヘルス委員会を設置するという予防的・制度的施策の報道。ニパウイルスやエボラは過去の懸念事例として言及されているのみで、新規アウトブレイクの発生は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: La UE alerta ante posible foco de peste neumónica en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EU warns of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: European Union authorities monitor a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia following a death in the Irkutsk region. The 28-year-old woman, employed at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research, died in Russia; the United States issued an alert after the death. Russian health agency Rospotrebnadzor classifies the case as pneumonia of undetermined etiology and reports no symptoms among close contacts. Pneumonic plague is caused by a bacterium and is treatable with antibiotics; Europe has not reported plague in over fifty years, though cases occur elsewhere. The EU emphasizes strengthened cross-border health cooperation and preparedness measures adopted after COVID-19, including stockpiled medicines and transparent epidemiological data via WHO channels. Meduza cites the patient may have been infected in Thailand or due to a laboratory accident. The case remains under investigation with no confirmed/unconfirmed link yet to imported or exported cases as of 5 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: EU、シベリアでの肺ペスト発生の可能性について警告
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト研究所勤務者の死亡を受け、EUおよび米国が警戒を発令。欧州では50年以上報告のない疾患であり、国際的関心が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 10歲男童染甲流併發休克留醫　開學後350校爆發涉逾2000人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 10-year-old boy infected with influenza A develops shock and is hospitalized; after school starts, outbreaks in 350 schools involve more than 2,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1) infection in Hong Kong: a previously healthy 10-year-old boy is hospitalized in the pediatric intensive care unit with influenza A (H1) and shock, confirmed by laboratory testing. He had no recent travel and was not vaccinated for the 2026/27 seasonal flu. A household contact recently had mild upper respiratory symptoms but recovered. Since September school start, about 350 school-based influenza-like illness outbreaks have been reported, affecting more than 2,000 people. The influenza season began in late June with high activity; 22 cumulative severe pediatric influenza cases: 16 recovered/discharged, 2 stable, 2 severe, 1 critical, and 1 death. Health authorities urge schools and families to maintain preventive measures as community transmission remains widespread; the Centre for Health Protection continues investigation into the case.

triage.headline_ja: 10歳男児が甲型インフルエンザに感染しショック状態で入院　開学後350校で発生、2000人超に影響
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、香港で重症小児例と学校での集団発生が多数報告されているが、新興・異常な病原体ではなく例年の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)の流行で、香港衛生当局（Centre for Health Protection）が調査・対応中。重症小児例22例（死亡1例含む）、学校アウトブレイク350件超と規模は大きいが、既知の季節性病原体であり国際的な異常事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Venäjän mahdollisesta ruttokuolemasta ei ole tullut Suomeen tietoa virallisia reittejä
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There has been no information reaching Finland about Russia's possible plague death through official channels.
article.articleSummary: Plague in Russia: No official information has reached Finland about a possible death in the Irkutsk region (South Siberia). Finnish authorities rely on media; THL chief Leif Lakoma says no official channels have provided details. Media reported a laboratory technician died of suspected pneumonic plague after a broken test tube, with potentially exposed contacts quarantined. Irkutsk governor Kobzev cited unknown-cause pneumonia; Rospotrebnadzor said samples showed no microbe linked to the profession. Under IHR, plague is not automatically mandatorily reported; criteria include severe public health threat, international spread, or travel restrictions. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis; transmission mainly via fleas, with hundreds of cases annually in tropical, lower-hygiene countries such as DR Congo and Madagascar. Pneumonic plague can spread between people in close contact but is treatable with antibiotics if treated early. In Finland, any case would trigger THL notification and tracing; such an event is unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト感染死の可能性について、公式ルートを通じたフィンランドへの情報提供はない
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の検査技師が肺ペストの疑いで死亡したと報道されているが、ロスポトレブナゾルは病原体との関連を否定しており、公式確認が取れていない。情報が錯綜しており続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク州）における肺ペスト疑い死亡例であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRC・マダガスカルはペスト流行地域としての一般的言及に過ぎず、本件の発生国ではない。公式情報と報道内容に矛盾があり、確定情報待ちの段階。

article.articleHeadline: LIRAa aponta redução da infestação por Aedes aegypti em Feira de Santana, mas município segue em situação de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIRAa indicates a reduction in Aedes aegypti infestation in Feira de Santana, but the municipality remains on alert.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil, shows LIRAa rapid survey results on October 2, 2026 indicating Aedes aegypti infestation reduced but still in alert. The IIP (House Infestation Index) is 2.00% and the Breteau index is 2.17%. IIP <1% is satisfactory; 1-3.9% is alert; >3.9% is at risk. The municipality remains in alert, though lower than prior surveys. High-infestation neighborhoods include Queimadinha, Centro, and Tomba. Control measures include fumacê fogging and area blockades, with intensification by the municipal health secretariat. The reduction attributed to vector-control teams and community cooperation; continuous measures recommended: keep water tanks closed, eliminate standing water in containers like plant pots, tires, bottles; regular yard and gutter checks to remove breeding sites. Surveillance data guide intensified house-to-house visits and targeted insecticide application in high-risk zones, continuing vigilance for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission.

triage.headline_ja: LIRAaによる調査結果、フェイラ・デ・サンタナでのネッタイシマカ(Aedes aegypti)感染指数は減少も、市は依然警戒状態を継続
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の感染指数（LIRAa）に関する定期的なベクターサーベイランス報告であり、感染指数は警戒レベルに留まるものの減少傾向であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の報告はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル国内の蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）の媒介蚊指数モニタリングに関する地方自治体レベルの定期報告であり、実際の症例数増加等の情報は含まれていない。自治体による通常の対策活動の範囲内であり、国際的な懸念には至らない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : à Goma, une ONG aide les enfants confrontés à la guerre et à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In Goma, an NGO helps children affected by war and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In Goma, the NGO Assistance Samaritaine aux Vulnérables organized a solidarity day for particularly vulnerable children, handing out school supplies and Ebola protection kits. The initiative aims to meet essential needs while raising awareness of prevention measures for an Ebola outbreak affecting several eastern territories of the Democratic Republic of Congo. Espoir Kikuni, the NGO's head, notes that orphans are often overlooked in awareness campaigns, and emphasizes educating them on the virus. Beyond material aid, a mental-health and psychosocial support program operates in beneficiary schools to assist children traumatized by conflict, displacement, and precarious living conditions, with the goal of breaking the intergenerational cycle of trauma. Teachers observe concentration difficulties, aggression, and withdrawal linked to poverty and displacement. Two years after fighting in Goma, health and educational initiatives seek to stabilize the children's lives and rebuild resilience amid ongoing Ebola-related concerns.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: ゴマで、NGOが戦争とエボラに直面する子どもたちを支援
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラ流行（コンゴ東部）に関する人道支援活動の記事であり、新規感染拡大や症例数など具体的な疫学情報は含まれていないため、新規シグナルとしての判断材料が不足している。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ流行下での人道支援・教育活動に焦点を当てたものであり、新規アウトブレイクの発生や拡大を示す情報は含まれていない。既存の疾病監視対象として継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Разпространение на чума: Конференция по темата е предвидена там, където от чума умря млада лаборантка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of the plague: A conference on the topic is planned at the site where a young female laboratory technician died of the plague.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician, Daria Shipilova, died of pneumonic plague on Oct 2 in Shelekhov District Hospital, Irkutsk Oblast. An 18th Interstate Scientific-Practical Conference of CIS member states on current problems of sanitary protection from the import and spread of plague and other dangerous infections is planned in Irkutsk for Oct 21–22, per a June 22 Rospotrebnadzor order and conference notices. The organizing committee includes Rospotrebnadzor’s Plague Research Institute “Microbe” and the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Control, where Shipilova worked. The event is budgeted at 13 million rubles; organizers will cover travel for participants from 10 capitals (Beijing, Ulaanbaatar, Minsk, Baku, Yerevan, Tashkent, Bishkek, Astana, Ashgabat, Dushanbe), visas, medical insurance and translation from Chinese. An Oct 20 Baikal Lake excursion (363,000 rubles) and a gala dinner for 165 attendees (1.2 million) are planned; 307,000 rubles allocated for media coverage. Kremlin spokesman Peskov urged adherence to Rospotrebnadzor.

triage.headline_ja: ペストの拡散：若い検査技師がペストで死亡した施設で、同テーマの会議が予定されている
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所で発生した単発の実験室感染（肺ペスト）による死亡事例であり、対象国（中国・ベラルーシ等は会議参加国として言及されているのみ）での発生ではなく、二次感染や地域拡大の情報もない。
triage.notes: 死亡事例はロシア（イルクーツク州）の研究所職員における実験室内感染であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中の中国・モンゴル・ベラルーシ等はCIS会議への参加国として言及されているだけで、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Regular classes at Cusat School of Engineering shift online after chickenpox outbreak
article.articleSummary: Four chickenpox cases reported from a hostel block over the past few days at the School of Engineering, Cochin University of Science and Technology (Cusat) in Cochin prompt a five-to-six-day shift of all classes online, announced on 5 October 2026. Classes will resume after assessment in consultation with the health department. Hostel residents are advised to vacate the premises to prevent further spread; students in other hostels and departments are instructed to wear masks and observe hand hygiene, given chickenpox is airborne and communicable. The campus is implementing precautionary measures per health authority protocol to monitor and curb transmission and prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: チキンポックス(水痘)発生によりコーチン科学技術大学工学部の通常授業がオンラインへ移行
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は既知の疾患で単一寮での小規模発生に留まり、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 水痘は飛沫感染するが既知の疾患であり、大学寮内の限定的な発生で地域保健当局により通常の対応がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: Mystery plague outbreak in Russia causes mass quarantine - The...
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, technician at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia in Shelekhov near the Mongolian border, died after hospitalization for pneumonia of unknown origin. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says no micro-organisms linked to the employee’s duties were detected. The hospital area has been quarantined; other regional hospitals closed; public events canceled; a criminal case opened over potential safety violations. About 200 people remain under observation as authorities investigate a suspected, possibly dangerous infection; official statements have been inconsistent, with some sources referencing plague. Some reports tie illness to a Thailand trip. The regional government and Kremlin have sought to control information, while international observers monitor developments. The incident has prompted widespread scrutiny and concerns about lab safety and transparency in Russia."}{

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで謎の疫病発生、大規模隔離措置

article.articleHeadline: Russia plague scare: White House monitors suspected case as experts assess pandemic risk
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Irkutsk region has prompted scrutiny, though authorities have not confirmed plague and describe the illness as pneumonia of unknown origin. A 28-year-old female employee at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died between October 1 and 2; she reportedly may have been exposed to Yersinia pestis, with reports she broke a test tube containing live bacteria on September 25. Nearly 200 contacts have been placed under medical observation; several facilities have imposed quarantine, but tests in those under observation have been negative and no symptoms have appeared. Rospotrebnadzor says no microorganisms linked to the woman’s work were detected and the regional epidemiological situation remains stable. The White House and European Commission are monitoring; no travel restrictions yet. Pneumonic plague is treatable with antibiotics; more information is needed to determine whether this is an isolated incident, occupational exposure, or wider transmission. No immediate India threat.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト感染疑い:ホワイトハウスが監視、専門家がパンデミックリスクを評価

triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。インドへの言及は『現時点で脅威なし』という文脈のみで実際の発生ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。研究所職員の実験室内曝露が疑われる事例で、接触者200名は陰性・無症状。ヒト-ヒト感染の確証はなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Peste polmonare in Siberia: morta scienziata e ospedali chiusi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague in Siberia: a female scientist died and hospitals closed.
article.articleSummary: Four hospitals in Irkutsk are under quarantine for suspected pneumonic plague, including a pediatric hospital, after a 28-year-old woman who worked at the Irkutsk–Far East Plague Research Institute died in Shelekhov last week. Two contagion hypotheses are being evaluated: infection contracted in Thailand, or an accidental exposure from a broken pathogen vial at work. Rospotrebnadzor characterizes the case as pneumonia of unknown etiology and so far none of the patient’s contacts have fallen ill or tested positive. The Kremlin urged calm and to rely solely on official statements from Rospotrebnadzor, while the White House, via Axios, is monitoring the situation and weighing possible actions. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an emergency meeting; wards in quarantined hospitals have strict visitation restrictions, with no family visits, and it remains unclear whether all Irkutsk hospitals are closed.

article.articleHeadline: Rusijoje - įtarimai dėl maro: simptomai gali pasireikšti per kelias valandas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia — Suspicions of plague: symptoms may appear within a few hours.
article.articleSummary: In Russia’s Irkutsk region, East Siberia, a 28-year-old laboratory technician, Darija Shipilova, died amid suspected plague cases. About 200 people were hospitalized for potential exposure, with three Irkutsk hospitals placed under three-week quarantine, events canceled, and mandatory mask use. Official confirmation of plague was not publicly released, but state and independent media allege she contracted pneumonic plague, possibly from handling live Yersinia pestis at a plague research institute near Irkutsk; some reports linked exposure to travel near the Mongolian border, though regional authorities denied outbreaks in Buryatia or border areas. Approximately 197 people suspected of exposure were isolated for surveillance; several Irkutsk hospitals were closed. Rospotrebnadzor said no pathogen-related incidents at the institute, noting unknown-etiology pneumonia among staff and a stable epidemiological situation in Irkutsk and Shelekhov. Pneumonic plague is highly transmissible via respiratory droplets; WHO notes three forms—bubonic, pneumonic, septicemic—with widespread global activity and about 4,000 suspected cases (2019–2025), mainly in Africa (DRC, Madagascar), Asia, and the Americas.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト疑い：症状は数時間で現れる可能性
