triage.notes: 本事例の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中のDRC・マダガスカル言及はWHOの世界的ペスト発生状況に関する背景情報であり、本イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Чума легко передается от человека к человеку? Нет. Она очень опасна? Да. Может ли произойти очередная пандемия? Нет. Коротко отвечаем на важные вопросы о чуме -- Meduza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is plague easily transmitted from person to person? No. Is it very dangerous? Yes. Could another pandemic occur? No. Brief answers to the important questions about the plague — Meduza.
article.articleSummary: 1 October 2026: a hospital in Shelekhov, Irkutsk Oblast, closed amid suspected dangerous infection; media later reported 28-year-old Darya Shipilova died of pneumonic plague, though officials cite pneumonia of undetermined etiology and have not confirmed plague. Plague remains dangerous but far less common and has not caused pandemics since the mid-20th century, aided by antibiotics and reduced rat–flea contact. In Russia it now mainly affects spillover from wild animals; in 2016 a boy contracted it after skinning marmots. The United States averages about seven cases a year, chiefly flea bites; Africa bears most outbreaks (DRC with an Ebola outbreak ongoing, and Madagascar had >2,000 cases in 2017). Russia has 11 natural foci, but in 2025 the pathogen was found in only three; vaccination occurs in risk zones, though efficacy is uncertain and boosters are frequent. Bubonic and pneumonic forms; untreated mortality 30–60% (bubonic) and up to 100% (pneumonic); early antibiotics within two days improve outcomes; pneumonic transmission requires close contact via droplets.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは人から人へ容易に感染するのか？ いいえ。非常に危険なのか？ はい。再びパンデミックが起こり得るのか？ いいえ。ペストに関する重要な質問への簡潔な回答 — Meduza
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロシア（イルクーツク州）での肺ペスト疑い死亡例を契機としたペストに関する一般解説記事であり、対象国（DRC等）への言及は背景情報・統計としての言及に留まり、主題となる発生国ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生事象はロシア・イルクーツク州における肺ペスト疑いの死亡例（公式には未確認）。DRCのエボラ流行やマダガスカルのペスト流行は記事中で背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事が報じる具体的新規イベントではないため、対象国リストには含めない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Peste : pulmonaire, symptômes, transmission, quels traitements ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague: pneumonic, symptoms, transmission, what treatments?
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, has three main forms: bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic. Bubonic is the most common, with swollen lymph nodes (buboes) in the armpits, neck, or groin, transmitted mainly by fleas from infected rodents. Septicemic plague is the most severe, spreading through the blood and may result from untreated bubonic disease or direct flea introduction into a vessel. Pneumonic plague is the most contagious, spreading via respiratory droplets and can be transmitted person-to-person; it may develop from bubonic or septicemic forms. Incubation differs: bubonic 3–7 days; septicemic a few hours; pneumonic 1–2 days, with death typically in 2–3 days without antibiotics. Symptoms range from fever, chills, and headaches to buboes, abdominal pain or vomiting, and severe cough with bloody sputum and chest pain in pneumonic cases. Reservoirs are wild rodents; fleas are vectors; other small mammals can be involved. France reports no cases since 1945; ongoing foci exist in Madagascar, DRC, Peru, the southwestern U.S., and China.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：肺ペスト、症状、感染経路、治療法について

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en Asia y Europa: sospecha de peste pulmonar obliga el cierre de hospitales en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Asia and Europe: Suspected pneumonic plague forces the closure of hospitals in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague in Irkutsk region, Siberia, Russia, after the death of a plague institute worker from pneumonia. A suspected lab accident involving a broken tube with pathogens prompted quarantine in four medical centers, including a pediatric hospital, with visiting restrictions. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an emergency meeting; all identified contacts are under medical observation; so far none exhibit symptoms and all tests are negative. Rospotrebnadzor attributes the death to pneumonia of undetermined etiology and says no pathogen-related emergencies were recorded at the institute. Investigations explore a travel-related exposure in Thailand or potential occupational exposure. The case has drawn international interest; the European Commission is monitoring and coordinating with the ECDC, underscoring the need for reliable epidemiological and laboratory information.

triage.headline_ja: アジアとヨーロッパで警戒：肺ペスト疑いでシベリアの病院が閉鎖

article.articleHeadline: Filariasis Cases Cluster Near Mosquito Breeding Grounds on Indonesian
article.articleSummary: On Belitung Island, Indonesia, lymphatic filariasis persists despite mass drug administration. A 2019 cross-sectional survey in Suak Gual (Selat Nasik Subdistrict) and Lasar (Membalong Subdistrict; sub-villages Batumana, Dudat, Ulin) enrolled 671 residents to assess Brugia malayi–driven disease, diagnosed via nocturnal thick blood smears collected after dark. Researchers geolocated homes and mapped water bodies with Mansonia mosquito breeding habitat (macrophyte-rich, floating vegetation in swamps/ponds). Spatial analyses showed strong clustering of infections near such habitats: Clark-Evans R=0.380, p<0.001 in Suak Gual; R=0.432, p<0.001 in Batumana. Ulin showed weaker association (R=0.654, p=0.026) that did not survive Bonferroni correction; Dudat (R=0.856, p=0.434) showed no significant clustering. Findings, published in Acta Parasitologica, suggest integrating habitat-targeted vector control with ongoing or renewed mass drug administration to reduce transmission and prevent recrudescence.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの島で、蚊の繁殖地付近にフィラリア症の症例がクラスター化していることが研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 2019年の学術研究（空間疫学分析）に関する報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や急性アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019年に実施された横断研究の学術論文発表に基づくものであり、リアルタイムのアウトブレイク報告ではない。リンパ系フィラリア症は既知の風土病であり、既存の集団投薬（MDA）プログラムの効果と蚊媒介生息地の関連を評価する研究内容。

article.articleHeadline: Nach möglichem Laborunfall mit Pestbakterien: wie gefährlich sind die Erreger?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a possible laboratory accident with plague bacteria: how dangerous are the pathogens?
article.articleSummary: A potential laboratory accident in Irkutsk, Russia, involving a worker at a plague-control lab, sparked death reports by a neighboring governor, later denied by Russia’s disease control agency. Regardless, the episode highlights how rare but dangerous plague infections can occur in labs. From 2000–2021, only two documented laboratory infections with Yersinia pestis occurred globally, the last in 2009 (Chicago). In Europe, fewer than ten labs handle infectious plague agents, including Berlin’s Robert Koch Institute and the Spiez lab in Switzerland, where strict biosafety measures are described (inward airflow, protective suits, and filtered air). Plague infections result from a chain of errors; inhaled aerosolized bacteria cause pneumonic plague, while bubonic plague presents with swollen lymph nodes and can be fatal within 24 hours if untreated. Antibiotics are effective if given within 18 hours; pneumonic plague requires isolation. No licensed global vaccine; research includes an Israeli mRNA vaccine candidate. WHO 2019–2025 reports 3,847 cases and 423 deaths, with outbreaks outside Europe (e.g., Madagascar, Mongolia; Brazil suspected).

triage.headline_ja: ペスト菌による研究室事故の可能性：病原体はどれほど危険か？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究室での事故疑いに関する記事であり、死亡報告は当局により否定されている。対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）のいずれにも該当せず、監視対象地域でのアウトブレイクでもないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・イルクーツクでの研究室事故疑いが主題。ブラジルやマダガスカル、モンゴルは世界のペスト発生状況の文脈で言及されているに過ぎず、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国に該当する発生なし。

article.articleHeadline: US 'closely monitoring' after Russian lab worker 'dies of suspected plague'
article.articleSummary: US closely monitors after a Russian lab worker dies of suspected pneumonic plague in Irkutsk, Siberia. The 28-year-old female researcher at an anti-plague institute died following pneumonia of unknown origin; exact cause not confirmed. About 200 contacts are under observation, with quarantine in the inpatient facility in Shelekhov near the Mongolia border. Sanitary-epidemiological status in Irkutsk city, Irkutsk region, and Shelekhov is described as stable. WHO warns pneumonic plague is highly contagious via respiratory droplets, with an incubation as short as 24 hours and rapid onset of severe respiratory symptoms; untreated disease can be fatal within 18–24 hours, though early antibiotics are effective. If isolated, experts suggest the case may end there. From 2019–2025, 10 countries reported over 3,800 suspected plague cases to WHO, with six having confirmed infections, mostly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, and 423 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所職員が疑い肺ペストで死亡、米国が注視

triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州シェレホフで発生。モンゴル国境付近だが現時点で国際的拡大の証拠はなし。DRC・マダガスカルは過去の疫学統計として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないため対象国として含めず。対象国リスト（ロシア、モンゴル、米国は非対象）に該当する発生国がないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Cosa sappiamo sul presunto caso di peste polmonare in Siberia, dov'è nel mondo e come avviene il contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What we know about the suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia, where in the world it is and how transmission occurs.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Siberia, early October saw the sudden death of 28-year-old lab technician Darya Shipilova, prompting quarantine of 189 contacts amid unverified reports of pneumonic plague. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has not confirmed plague, stating pneumonia of unknown origin, while regional officials referred to a suspected highly dangerous infection; unconfirmed media speculation cited a lab incident or exposure in Buryatia near Mongolia. There have been no cases in Italy or Europe. The disease is caused by Yersinia pestis, with rodent reservoirs; transmission is mainly by fleas, but pneumonic plague can spread via respiratory droplets between people. The World Health Organization notes bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic forms; primary pneumonic disease incubates in 1–3 days and can be rapidly fatal (18–24 hours) if untreated. Antibiotics (streptomycin, gentamicin, tetracyclines, or chloramphenicol) given within 24 hours improve outcomes; close contacts require seven days of prophylaxis. Endemic foci exist in Asia (Russia, China) and Mongolia, with global vigilance ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで疑われる肺ペスト症例について判明していること：発生地域と感染経路
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで肺ペストの疑い例による死亡と189人の接触者隔離が発生しており、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州、ブリヤート共和国）およびモンゴル近郊であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。中国は風土病的発生地として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局はペストを未確認（原因不明の肺炎としている）段階であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bali minta daerah waspada temuan sembilan influenza tipe A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bali Health Office Urges Regions to Be Vigilant After Nine Cases of Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Nine cases of influenza A detected in Bali as of Oct 5, 2026; Bali Health Office (Dinkes Bali) asked districts/cities to heighten early alert. Of 113 samples submitted from influenza-like illness and severe acute respiratory infection cases to the national reference lab, nine were positive for influenza A; patients have recovered and were not hospitalized. Two sentinel facilities conducted testing; surveillance uses ILI and SARI definitions. Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) remains the most common reason for visits to health facilities, especially puskesmas. Most influenza A cases are mild. Dinkes Bali warns vigilance because infection can worsen in vulnerable groups, causing dyspnea, pneumonia, or death in severe cases. Preventive measures include circulating a memo to districts, education via health promotion, puskesmas, and regional health offices; advising masking when needed. Transmission mainly via respiratory droplets, and possibly contaminated surfaces; crowded indoor spaces with poor ventilation, schools and childcare centers identified as high-risk.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州保健局、インフルエンザA型9例の発見を受け地域に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの軽症例9例で重篤例や異常な流行パターンは報告されていないが、保健当局が注意喚起をしているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランスの一環であり、全例軽症・非入院。保健当局によるルーチンの警戒喚起と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Un presunto brote de peste neumónica en Rusia preocupa a EEUU y Europa: "Lo estamos vigilando"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected outbreak of pneumonic plague in Russia worries the U.S. and Europe: "We are monitoring it."
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk, Russia triggers cross-border alert. A laboratory worker, Darya Shipilova, 28, died; origin of infection unclear. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor calls it pneumonia of unknown origin; potential sources include a broken test tube at the Irkutsk Epidemiology Laboratory or infection acquired in Thailand. Authorities imposed quarantines at several medical facilities in Irkutsk region, placing nearly 200 contacts under medical observation; quarantine durations up to three weeks in at least four facilities, including a pediatric hospital. If confirmed, it would be Russia’s first plague case in about a decade; last confirmed in 2016 in Altai Republic near Mongolia, in a child who survived after marmot exposure. Kremlin and local governor downplay alarm; reports say those under observation are asymptomatic and negative. The US and EU monitor closely, urging transparency; plague is bacterial and treatable with antibiotics if treated early.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペスト感染疑いの発生、米欧が懸念「注視している」
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、約10年ぶりのロシア国内症例の可能性があるため異常性が高く、国際的監視（米欧）も生じておりIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 感染源としてタイでの感染可能性が示唆されているが、事実として確認された発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストにロシアは含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。タイは感染源の推測に過ぎず、実際の発生地として確認されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ahead of Northeast monsoon, Virudhunagar district gearing up to prevent dengue-causing mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: Virudhunagar district is proactively preventing dengue ahead of the Northeast monsoon after recording five dengue cases in September and eight in October. District Collector Sharanya Ari ordered officials to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding grounds, prevent stagnation of rainwater in homes and public spaces, and keep water tanks closed while maintaining environmental cleanliness. Fogging will be conducted in fever-infested areas, and medical camps will be organized. Continuous monitoring will cover office buildings, schools, colleges, industrial units, and public places to curb Aedes mosquito breeding, with inspections of offices every Thursday. The meeting was attended by District Rural Development Agency Project Director Vanathi, Joint Director (Medical Services) Dr. Kaliraj, and various Health Officers, outlining steps to avert dengue spread during the upcoming monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: 北東モンスーンを前に、ヴィルドゥナガル県がデング熱媒介蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 少数のデング熱症例に対する予防的な行政対応であり、公衆衛生上の重大な影響や異常性は認められず、通常の季節的対策の範囲内である。
triage.notes: インド・タミルナードゥ州ヴィルドゥナガル県における9月5件、10月8件のデング熱症例に対する予防的対策の記事。地方行政レベルの通常対応で、規模・重症度とも限定的。

article.articleHeadline: В Иркутске пройдет конференция СНГ по чуме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CIS plague conference to be held in Irkutsk.
article.articleSummary: Interstate CIS conference on sanitary protection against plague and other dangerous infections will be held Oct 21–22 in Irkutsk, Russia, hosted by the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute. The event’s budget reportedly covers 13 million rubles for attendees’ travel from Beijing, Ulaanbaatar, Minsk, Baku, Yerevan, Tashkent, Bishkek, Astana, Ashgabat and Dushanbe. In Irkutsk Oblast, media reported the death of Darya Shipilova, an employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute, from plague, while Rospotrebnadzor stated she had pneumonia. Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan have heightened precautionary measures in response. A Dozhd broadcast cited a magazine publisher claiming knowledge of a probable plague outbreak in Irkutsk Oblast. The article highlights concerns about plague risk and international participation in the conference, though official confirmation of an outbreak beyond the cited death and pneumonia diagnosis remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツクでCIS諸国によるペスト会議が開催予定
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州での事例であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国（北京）は会議参加者の出身地として言及されているのみで、感染症発生の主題国ではないため除外。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州における職員の死亡例（当局は肺炎と発表、メディアはペストの可能性を報道）と、CIS諸国によるペスト対策会議の開催について。発生地域として北京・ウランバートル等多数の都市が付与されているが、これらは会議参加者の出身都市であり、実際の感染症発生地ではないため、対象国リストには該当する国がない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : présence des partenaires et couverture des besoins dans la riposte Ebola -- Septembre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Presence of Partners and Coverage of Needs in the Ebola Response — September 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of September 2026 involved 94 health actors across seven provinces, with uneven coverage: 58 in Ituri and 57 in North Kivu, 6 in Haut-Uélé, and 2 in Bas-Uélé. By September 27, the outbreak affected 63 health zones in seven provinces. Ituri registered 6,182 cases and 2,848 deaths (about 76.2% of all confirmed cases). North Kivu reported 1,541 cases and 914 deaths. Security challenges and access difficulties constrained interventions. Analysis prioritizes reinforcing Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uélé, while providing targeted support to Tshopo; Sud-Kivu and Sud-Ubangi should maintain preparedness and surveillance. Recommendations call for redeploying resources, ensuring a minimum package of services, and mobilizing mobile teams. A weekly health-zone coverage mapping, integrating transmission, performance, and accessibility, aims to reduce operational gaps and safeguard essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ対応における支援団体の展開状況とニーズ充足状況 ― 2026年9月
triage.triage_reason: DRCで63保健区・7州にわたる大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、致死率が極めて高く（イトゥリ州76.2%）、治安・アクセス上の課題により対応が制約されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（複数州・63保健区）に関する対応状況報告。新規発生ではなく進行中のアウトブレイクの経過報告だが、規模・死亡率・治安上の制約から継続的な監視と評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes tingkatkan kesiapsiagaan respons insiden lab wabah di Russia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health boosts preparedness to respond to a laboratory outbreak incident in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Ministry of Health boosted preparedness after a laboratory outbreak incident in Russia, where a lab worker died amid pneumonia suspected of unknown origin. As of 5 October 2026, there was no notification via IHR NFP or WHO Event Information Site about the incident. Bali’s international airports and seaports have intensified traveler screening using the All Indonesia - SSHP health declaration system, with risk-based assessments of transport, and surveillance of rats and fleas at entry points. Quarantine health officers analyze health declarations to determine if travelers originate from affected countries, and symptomatic cases suspected of plague are referred to Infectious Disease Referral Hospitals. Early detection relies on health declarations and symptom checks (fever, cough, shortness of breath). About 200 people who contacted the deceased, who worked at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia, are under medical observation. Officials urge monitoring of global and national developments.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、ロシアでの疫病（ペスト）研究所事故を受けて対応準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染事例はロシア（対象国外）の研究所職員1名の死亡に限られ、インドネシアでは確定症例はなく予防的な検疫強化にとどまるため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 実際の疫病（ペスト）関連死亡事例はロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは渡航者スクリーニング強化など予防的対応のみで、国内発生は確認されていないためverified_locationsは空とした。原因病原体や感染経路（肺炎様症状、原因不明）の詳細情報が不足しており、WHOへのIHR通報も未実施（2026年10月5日時点）。

article.articleHeadline: La peste rusa que inquieta al mundo: más de 200 personas están aisladas y hay un muerto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Russian plague that unsettles the world: more than 200 people are quarantined and there is one death.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is suspected in the Irkutsk region, Siberia, after the death of a 28-year-old female researcher and quarantine measures across at least four hospitals. About 200 contacts are under strict medical surveillance; hospital visits are restricted, with potential extensions up to three weeks. Authorities are examining whether the infection occurred during a recent trip to Thailand or due to a laboratory accident involving a broken tube at the Institute of Peste Research in Irkutsk and the Far East. The victim died in a hospital in Shélejov, a satellite city of the regional capital. Although the suspected transmission is human-to-human via respiratory secretions, local health authorities and Rospotrebnadzor have not confirmed plague; some sources call the case pneumonia of undetermined etiology. An emergency meeting was held on 2 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 世界を不安にさせるロシアのペスト：200人以上が隔離され、1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いで死亡例と約200人の接触者隔離が発生し、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が指摘されているため、重大性・異常性・拡大リスクの観点からフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 主発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイは患者の渡航歴に関連して言及されているのみで、発生国ではないが、感染経路調査の対象として言及されているため参考情報として記載。公式には肺ペストと未確定（Rospotrebnadzorは未確認、病因不明の肺炎と呼ぶ情報源もあり）。

article.articleHeadline: 台风过后生饮山泉水！内地男惊爆重症感染　诱发休克器官衰竭险死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drinking raw mountain spring water after the typhoon! Mainland Chinese man develops a severe infection that triggers shock and organ failure, nearly died.
article.articleSummary: A 61-year-old man in Mainland China developed severe leptospirosis after drinking raw mountain spring water following a typhoon. Despite family boiling water for safety, he continued to consume it raw for several days, leading to chest tightness, abdominal pain, then rapid deterioration with septic shock and multi-organ dysfunction. Laboratory confirmation identified Leptospira infection; he received aggressive antimicrobial therapy and organ-supportive care and survived. Leptospirosis is a zoonotic disease, with Leptospira bacteria residing in the renal tubules of rodents and livestock and shed in urine, contaminating soil and water. Flooding and flooding-related mudflows mobilize bacteria into surface water, making even seemingly clear spring water dangerous. Public health guidance emphasizes avoiding untreated water after floods and ensuring proper water treatment or boiling before consumption to prevent infection. The article notes warnings from health authorities about waterborne transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 台風後に山の湧き水を生飲み！中国本土の男性が重症感染を発症、ショックと臓器不全を誘発し九死に一生
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大や異常性は認められず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 台風後の生水摂取による単発のレプトスピラ症重症例。ヒト-ヒト感染性なし、集団発生の報告もないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Russia's Irkutsk hospitals deny plague quarantine reports
article.articleSummary: Four Irkutsk hospitals denied social media claims of a three-week plague quarantine after the death of Darya Shipilova, 28, an employee at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute. Nearly 200 people exposed were placed under observation, with 189 hospitalized, but Rospotrebnadzor reported no plague and Shipilova died of pneumonia of unknown etiology. Initial reports of a lab accident and pneumonic plague were rejected; commissions found no infection at work or travel to Thailand. The Shelekhov district hospital closed inpatient wards temporarily; the Irkutsk aluminium smelter introduced masking for workers. Two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus cases appeared among contacts. The last Russian human plague case was in 2016 (Altai). The EU, US, and Uzbekistan have tightened monitoring. The WHO identifies active plague foci in Central Asia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan).

triage.headline_ja: ロシア・イルクーツクの病院、ペスト隔離の報道を否定
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の原因不明肺炎による死亡と189人の入院があったが、公式にはペストは否定されており、発生国（ロシア）はCEPR対象国リストに含まれないため、直接のフルRRA対象ではないが続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での原因不明肺炎死亡例とペスト疑惑の否定であり、タイへの渡航歴も否定されている。CEPR対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand等）はいずれも主題国ではないためverified_locationsは空。Thailandは『渡航歴なし』という否定文脈でのみ言及。

article.articleHeadline: Dia Mundial de Combate à Meningite: infectologista do Humap-UFMS alerta para prevenção - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Meningitis Day: infectious disease specialist from Humap-UFMS warns about prevention - Ponta Porã Informa - News from Ponta Porã - Mato Grosso do Sul and Pedro Juan Caballero - Paraguay
article.articleSummary: World Meningitis Day highlights early recognition, rapid care, and vaccination to prevent bacterial meningitis, which can progress quickly and cause seizures, neurological deficits, hearing/vision loss, or death. Bacterial meningitis spreads via respiratory droplets; primary pathogens include Neisseria meningitidis (meningococcal), Streptococcus pneumoniae (pneumococcal), and Haemophilus influenzae type B (Hib). Meningococcal disease can cause meningococcemia with hypotension and septic shock, and purpuric rash. Do not delay care: hospital assessment, labs, and lumbar puncture when indicated are crucial; start antibiotics early if bacterial meningitis is suspected. Vaccination is key: meningococcal C (two doses at 3 and 5 months), meningococcal ACWY booster at 12 months and advised for 11-14-year-olds, plus pneumococcal and Hib vaccines. In Mato Grosso do Sul, 34 cases and 8 deaths reported through week 17 of 2026; no outbreak. Maintain vaccination and seek care swiftly.

triage.headline_ja: 世界髄膜炎デー：Humap-UFMSの感染症専門医が予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 世界髄膜炎デーの啓発記事であり、通常の予防啓発内容。アウトブレイクなしと明記されており、異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はBrazil（Mato Grosso do Sul州）での通常の症例数報告（週17時点で34例・8死亡）と予防啓発であり、明示的に『アウトブレイクなし』と記載されている。Brazilは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD Klaten 2026 Turun Signifikan, Dinkes Ingatkan PSN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Klaten Dengue Fever Cases Decline Significantly in 2026, Health Department Reminds PSN
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Klaten Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, fell sharply in 2026. As of week 39, Klaten recorded 138 dengue cases with one death, far below the 2025 figure of 463 cases and three deaths in the same period. Health officials credit the decline to intensified vector control and community participation, but warn against complacency. Klaten Health Department head Anggit Budiarto urged continued PSN (mosquito nest eradication) activities and active jumantik larval monitoring, along with ongoing public education about Aedes aegypti-borne disease risks. He noted that the synchronized PSN campaign and heightened environmental hygiene awareness are key to interrupting the dengue virus transmission cycle. The department reiterates that PSN and jumantik remain central to minimizing risk and sustaining the downtrend through community gotong royong.

triage.headline_ja: クラテン県のデング熱症例、2026年に大幅減少 保健局はPSN（蚊の巣撲滅）の継続を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比で大幅に減少しており、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。通常の季節性疾患管理に関する報道。
triage.notes: 症例数は2025年の463件・死亡3名から2026年は138件・死亡1名に減少しており、ベクター対策の成果が強調されている。シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa identifica estratégia molecular contra a leishmaniose cutânea
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study identifies a molecular strategy against cutaneous leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Cutaneous leishmaniasis caused by Leishmania braziliensis in Brazil and the Americas may be tackled by a new approach from USP Ribeirão Preto. Researchers from FCFRP report identification of the first covalent inhibitors of the parasite’s essential enzyme dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (DHODH), key in pyrimidine production for DNA and RNA synthesis. Barbiturate-derived compounds were developed to form a covalent bond with DHODH, achieving enzyme engagement and potential long-lasting inhibition. The work, published in the Journal of Medicinal Chemistry, highlights Thamires Quadros Froes as the lead author, with postdoctoral work at Craft under Maria Cristina Nonato and Flávio da Silva Emery. While not yet therapeutics, these compounds offer a starting point for designing more effective, selective, and safer treatments for leishmaniasis, aiming to move beyond older, toxic regimens.

triage.headline_ja: 研究、皮膚リーシュマニア症に対する分子戦略を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は治療薬開発に関する基礎研究の報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は創薬・薬理学研究に関する内容であり、感染症発生事例の報告ではないため、対象国の発生情報としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Peste en Russie : des hôpitaux en quarantaine malgré les démentis officiels
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Russia: Hospitals in Quarantine Despite Official Denials
article.articleSummary: More than 60 employees at the Institute of Plague of Siberia and the Far East in the Irkutsk region, southern Russia, have been placed in isolation after the October 2 death of 28-year-old lab technician Daria Chipilova. Sources cited by Sibir.Realii report that staff have been in quarantine since Friday; by October 3, no tests were positive, though workers reportedly slept on chairs due to bed shortages. Russian media circulated unconfirmed explanations: that Chipilova developed pneumonic plague after returning from Thailand, or that she accidentally broke a tube containing plague agent without reporting the incident. On October 4, Rospotrebnadzor stated there is no emergency situation affecting the institute. The developing situation highlights potential plague exposure and ongoing quarantine measures, with laboratory confirmation pending and no confirmed cases reported yet.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト：公式否定にもかかわらず病院が隔離措置
triage.triage_reason: シベリア・ペスト研究所の職員死亡後、60名超が隔離され肺ペストの可能性が報じられており、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクや継続曝露の懸念があるため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてロシア（イルクーツク）とタイが挙げられているが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの言及は『死亡した技師がタイから帰国後に発症した可能性がある』という未確認の噂に過ぎず、タイでの発生事実はないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。実験室起源の感染である可能性と、意図的な事故隠蔽疑惑も報じられており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил информацию о вспышке вируса Коксаки в отеле Вьетнама
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested information about a Coxsackievirus outbreak at a hotel in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-05, Russia’s consumer health watchdog Rospotrebnadzor said it has sent formal requests to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and to the Russian Association of Tour Operators (ATOR) about a Coxsackievirus outbreak at a hotel in Cam Ranh, Vietnam, after several Russian tourists developed symptoms during their stay. The requests seek official data on the investigation results and an assessment of the risk of further epidemiological deterioration under the existing sanitary-epidemiological cooperation agreement. The agency notes the need for enterovirus precautions: wash hands with soap before meals and after public places, use only bottled or boiled water, and thoroughly wash fruits and vegetables with bottled or boiled water. If fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, or other symptoms occur, including after returning from resort destinations, seek urgent medical care.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ベトナムのホテルで発生したコクサッキーウイルスの集団発生について情報を要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのリゾートホテルでロシア人観光客に感染症状が確認され、ロシア当局が公式調査を要請しているが、詳細な症例数や重症度など情報が不足しているため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コクサッキーウイルス（エンテロウイルス）はアジアで小児に流行しやすい病原体だが、本件は観光客間での発生報告であり国内の公衆衛生危機とは異なる可能性がある。続報でベトナム国内の感染拡大状況や症例数の詳細を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Two Mpox Clades Now Circulate in Pakistan, Genomic Surveillance Reveals
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) clades IIb and Ib co-circulate in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, per a surveillance study from Aug 1, 2024–Apr 16, 2026. First genomic detection of Clade Ib in Pakistan alongside ongoing Clade IIb (lineage A.2.1). Of 137 suspected cases, 29 were RT-PCR confirmed; four high-viral-load samples were sequenced on Illumina iSeq. cohort: median age 31 (range 0.6–80); 68.9% male, 27.6% female, 3.4% transgender. All had vesiculopustular rash; fever 82.8%; musculoskeletal pain 37.9%; genital/perianal lesions 34.5%; sore throat 24.1%. Two deaths among confirmed cases. Imported infections 44.8% (n=13); secondary 17.2% (n=5); locally acquired 20.7% (n=6); probable local 17.2% (n=5). Phylogeny shows links to sequences from Pakistan, the United States, Nepal and Thailand, indicating international travel–driven seeding amid labor migration.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタンで2つのMpoxクレードが同時流行、ゲノムサーベイランスで判明
triage.triage_reason: パキスタンで初めてClade Ibが検出され、既存のClade IIbと共流行していることが判明。確定29例中2例死亡、二次感染・地域内感染も報告されており、国際的な労働移住に伴う拡散リスクも示唆される。
triage.notes: 本イベントの主発生地はパキスタン（Khyber Pakhtunkhwa州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。タイ・米国・ネパールは系統解析上の関連配列として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため除外した。Clade Ibの新規検出は国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、フルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил данные у Вьетнама из-за вируса Коксаки у туристов
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data from Vietnam regarding Coxsackievirus among tourists.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor (Russian consumer health watchdog) has requested official data from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) after reports of Coxsackievirus infection among Russian tourists at a hotel in Cam Ranh, Vietnam. The agency seeks results of the investigation and an assessment of the risk of a worsening epidemiological situation under existing sanitary–epidemiological cooperation agreements. Similar information requests were previously sent to Thailand and Turkey: in Thailand a 1.5-year-old child developed a widespread rash in Khao Lak; in Turkey, cases including children occurred at IC Santai Family Resort in Belek. Preventive measures for enterovirus infections emphasized: thorough handwashing, using bottled or boiled water, washing fruits/vegetables, avoiding questionable pools, and avoiding contact with symptomatic individuals. If fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, rash, headache, or diarrhea develop after travel, seek medical care. An expert notes antibiotics are ineffective against Coxsackievirus; infections are typically self-limiting.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ツーリストのコクサッキーウイルス感染を巡りベトナムにデータを要請
triage.triage_reason: ロシア人観光客間でコクサッキーウイルス感染例が複数国（ベトナム・タイ・トルコ）で報告され当局が調査要請しているが、重症度や拡大状況の詳細情報が不足しているため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: コクサッキーウイルス（エンテロウイルス属）は通常軽症・自然軽快する疾患であり、ロシア当局による情報収集段階。トルコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU emite alerta y Rusia impone cuarentena por posible peste pulmonar en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. issues alert and Russia imposes quarantine for possible pneumonic plague in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Irkutsk region in Siberia triggers quarantines across at least four medical facilities, including a pediatric hospital, amid suspicions of pneumonic plague. Quarantines last up to three weeks with strict patient isolation and no family visits; authorities have not officially confirmed plague. Governor Igor Kobzev held an emergency meeting; all contacts are under medical observation with no symptoms and negative tests so far. A 28-year-old woman, an employee at the Irkutsk and Far East Institute of Plague Research, died in Shélejov; Meduza suggests a plague link. Rospotrebnadzor states pneumonia of undetermined etiology and has not confirmed plague, with two suspected sources: infection in Thailand after return or an accidental break of a test tube containing pathogens at work. The Kremlin urges calm and adherence to official statements, while the White House and Axios monitor the situation for potential actions.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が警告を発令、ロシアはシベリアで肺ペストの疑いにより病院を隔離
triage.triage_reason: シベリアで肺ペスト疑いの死亡例が発生し、複数医療施設が隔離措置を取り、米国が警告を発令するなど国際的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイは死亡した職員の渡航歴（感染源候補）として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア国内の事象として継続的な続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Môžu vyvolať rakovinu: Vedci jasne ukázali na nebezpečné vírusy aj baktériu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They may cause cancer: Scientists clearly pointed to dangerous viruses and a bacterium.
article.articleSummary: Globally in 2024, infections caused about 2.3 million cancers, 12% of all new cancers; Helicobacter pylori responsible ~760,000 cases and HPV ~750,000; HBV 360,000; EBV 260,000; HCV 160,000. H. pylori mainly non-cardia gastric cancer; HPV mainly cervical cancer. Other pathogens include KSHV, HTLV-1, MCV, HIV and three parasites. EBV infection common but cancer develops in a small subset; EBV linked to some stomach cancers and certain lymphomas. Prevention is feasible: HPV and HBV vaccines; H. pylori treatable with antibiotics; HCV curable with antivirals; HIV/HBV/HCV testing and treatment; safe injection practices; condoms; PrEP. 2024 regional distribution: East Asia ~990k cases (42% globally); Sub-Saharan Africa 25%; LMICs account for 77% of infections-related cancers. Emphasizes prevention and access to care worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: がんを引き起こす可能性：科学者たちが危険なウイルスと細菌を明確に指摘
triage.triage_reason: 世界的な感染症起因のがんに関する科学的・統計的レビュー記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常なアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界的な感染症関連がんの統計レビューであり、中国・上海は発生地域として付与されているが本文中で特定の地域的アウトブレイクには言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Russian 'Plague' Scare Sends Social Media Into a Frenzy: 'Another Wuhan'
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, a suspected plague scare in Russia triggered online panic after reports that 28-year-old lab worker Daria Shipilova died following exposure to a dangerous pathogen at an anti-plague institute in Siberia on September 25. Russian officials say there is no confirmed plague; Shipilova’s death is described as pneumonia of unknown origin. About 200 people are under medical observation, and several facilities remain quarantined as a precaution. The White House says it is monitoring the situation, while the State Department tracks developments with the CDC. No laboratory-confirmed cases or outbreak have been announced. In the discourse, observers invoked Wuhan comparisons and biothreat fears. Russian authorities have noted hospital quarantines and a visit to Irkutsk by the country's top public health official, with the FSB involved in the response.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの『ペスト』騒動がSNSを大パニックに：『またウクタの再来』
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所で研究者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、約200人が経過観察下にあるが、当局はペスト確定例なしとしており、情報不足のため続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（対象国リストに非該当）。ロシアはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。武漢・中国への言及は比喩的な連想にすぎず、実際の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: کاهش تالاب‌ها خطر ابتلا به آنفلوآنزای حاد پرندگان را افزایش می‌دهد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Loss of wetlands increases the risk of contracting avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Loss of wetlands increases the risk of avian influenza among wild birds. As of 2026-10-05, an environmental expert warns that winter cold and habitat degradation—stress, poor nutrition, and reduced habitat quality—drive transmission, with migration amplifying spread. The virus shows higher activity in winter and in mountainous, cold regions, correlating with elevated mortality among waterfowl. At Miqan Lake in Markazi Province near Arak, severe cold has led to substantial bird die-offs in recent years. The expert states the virus does not transmit to humans and claims it was imported from China and is man-made; no human infections have been reported to date. Since 2016, the virus has entered the country seriously, causing considerable losses and threatening domestic poultry and broader livestock farming nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: 湿地の減少が鳥インフルエンザ感染リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: イランの野鳥における鳥インフルエンザに関する環境専門家の見解記事であり、ヒト感染例はなく、対象国での発生でもないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はイランの野鳥における鳥インフルエンザと湿地減少の関連についての環境専門家の見解。中国は「輸入された、人工的なもの」という専門家の主張の中で言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。対象国リストにイランは含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia pone en cuarentena hospitales de Siberia por un posible caso de peste neumónica, pero asegura que las pruebas dieron negativo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia quarantines hospitals in Siberia over a possible case of pneumonic plague, but says tests came back negative.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Russia’s Irkutsk region in Siberia quarantined several hospitals over a possible pneumonic plague after a 28-year-old lab technician at the Irkutsk and Far East Plague Research Institute died from pneumonia in Shélejov. No confirmed diagnosis; post-mortem tests did not detect Yersinia pestis. Quarantines cover at least four hospitals, including a pediatric center, with restricted visits and up to three weeks of restrictions; about 200 contacts under observation. Authorities cite two hypotheses: infection acquired in Thailand or an accidental lab breach; neither has been confirmed. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an emergency meeting; all contacts are asymptomatic and testing negative. Rospotrebnadzor describes the case as pneumonia of undetermined etiology. U.S. monitoring has been noted; WHO and CDC have not issued formal statements. Pneumonic plague is the most contagious plague variant, transmitted person-to-person via respiratory droplets; the 2017 Madagascar outbreak involved over 2,000 cases and 171 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアの病院を肺ペスト疑い例で検疫隔離――検査結果は陰性と発表
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト研究所職員の原因不明肺炎による死亡を受け複数病院が隔離され、約200人が経過観察下に置かれるなど公的対応が大規模だが、検査ではYersinia pestisは検出されず確定診断に至っていない。異常性・重症度・社会的関心の観点からフルRRAでの精査が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染経路の仮説（渡航歴）として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。検査結果は陰性でYersinia pestis未検出、原因不明肺炎として扱われている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Bangkalan lakukan kolaborasi lintas sektor untuk tangani TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangkalan Regency Government undertakes cross-sector collaboration to tackle TB.
article.articleSummary: Bangkalan Regency, East Java, is spearheading cross-sector collaboration to craft the 2027 Tuberculosis Regional Action Plan (RAD-TB) to prevent TB spread in the district. TB cases total 1,028 in Bangkalan. Control relies on multi-sector collaboration beyond health services, with regional government agencies (OPD) contributing according to duties to ensure integrated efforts. The RAD-TB aims to align directions and roles across OPDs and act as a concrete guide for prevention, treatment, and control, not merely a document. In addition to strengthening health services, authorities emphasize expanding socialization and education about TB symptoms, the importance of screening, and treatment adherence to interrupt transmission. They expect RAD-TB outcomes to translate into programs and on-the-ground actions, enhancing a directed, integrated TB response and community protection.

triage.headline_ja: バンカラン県政府、結核対策に向け分野横断的連携を実施
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の地方風土病であり、通常の行政計画策定に関する内容で、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核対策計画（RAD-TB）策定に関する行政報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил Минздрав Вьетнама о ситуации с вирусом Коксаки в стране
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor asked Vietnam's Ministry of Health about the Coxsackievirus situation in the country
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has sent formal inquiries to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia regarding media reports of Coxsackie virus infections at one hotel in Cam Ranh, Vietnam. The notices follow claims of an enterovirus outbreak with symptoms including fever up to 40°C, skin rash, and stomatitis. There are no verified cases in Russia; insurers reportedly did not detect an uptick in Coxsackie-related claims, and the situation is described as within typical autumn-season levels. Preventive guidance from Rospotrebnadzor emphasizes standard enterovirus precautions: thorough handwashing with soap before meals and after public places, consuming only bottled or boiled water, avoiding swallowing pool water and swimming in pools with questionable hygiene, and thorough washing of fruits and vegetables. A similar information request was sent to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ベトナムのコクサッキーウイルス感染状況についてベトナム保健省に照会
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの特定ホテルでのコクサッキーウイルス（エンテロウイルス）感染報告に対しロシア当局が照会を行った段階で、確認症例や大規模感染の証拠はなく、季節性の範囲内とされているため現時点ではシグナルとしての重大性は低いが、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ロシアは観光客受け入れ国としての照会主体であり、感染発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ベトナム国内の単一ホテルでの報告に基づくもので、確認症例数や公式発表は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Affects Backyard Poultry; Telangana Blocks Feed, Poultry Movement From Andhra Pradesh
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) has affected a small number of backyard poultry birds in Telangana, prompting enhanced surveillance and blocking the movement of poultry, eggs, and feed from Andhra Pradesh via check posts. Measures follow bird flu reports in Anantapur, AP. Commercial Telangana broiler farms remain protected through biosecurity; backyard holdings show greater exposure to migratory birds. Symptoms to watch include coughing and sneezing; officials warned poultry associations to monitor flocks. Checkposts along trade routes have been instructed not to permit broiler or layer birds and eggs from AP, and movement of poultry feed from affected areas is restricted. Despite restrictions, Hyderabad chicken shops and egg sales continued, with some price increases noted (about ₹300/kg for chicken, up from ₹230).

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザが裏庭養鶏に影響；テランガナ州がアンドラ・プラデーシュ州からの飼料・家禽移動を規制
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（特にバックヤード飼育）のみに影響する動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、国内の州間家禽移動規制に留まるため公衆衛生上の重大性は低い。
triage.notes: 疾患タグに『Human Infection with Avian Influenza』とあるが、記事本文はバックヤード家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生と州間流通規制について述べており、ヒト感染の報告は確認されない。鶏肉・卵の価格上昇など経済的・行政的関心は見られるが、公衆衛生上の深刻度は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en Rusia: qué es la peste neumónica y cómo se transmite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Russia: What is pneumonic plague and how is it transmitted?
article.articleSummary: Death of 28-year-old laboratory technician Daria Shipilova in Irkutsk, Siberia, triggers a regional health response: five hospitals quarantined for about three weeks and around 200 contacts under observation as results determine cause. The case concerns pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis; plague has bubonic, septicemic, pharyngeal, and pneumonic forms—the latter attacking the lungs and capable of person-to-person spread via droplets. Primary transmission is flea bites from infected animals; other routes include contact with infected animal tissues/fluids, or consuming raw/undercooked meat (pharyngeal). Symptoms: fever, chills, headaches, weakness; pulmonary form includes cough, chest pain, shortness of breath, bloody mucus. WHO notes incubation can be as short as 24 hours; early antibiotics are lifesaving. Animal plague exists on multiple continents except Oceania, with Madagascar, DRC, and Peru among high-endemic regions. In Irkutsk, authorities investigate possible lab exposure; unconfirmed report of a broken tube; measures under Rospotrebnadzor.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで警戒：肺ペストとは何か、どのように感染するのか
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで研究室技術者が肺ペストで死亡し、病院隔離・接触者観察が行われるなど、異常かつ公衆衛生上重大な事案でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 事例の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク（研究室関連曝露の可能性）であり、対象国リストには含まれない。DRC・マダガスカル・ペルーは記事中でペスト流行地域として一般的に言及されているのみで、本件の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases in Metro down - DOH
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in Metro Manila hospitals have declined to 126 admissions across the 20 DOH-run hospitals being monitored, with five still pending, a 79% drop from 592 on Sept. 2. Of those admitted, 45 patients are on hemodialysis, while 141 dialysis machines remain available for inpatient use. Nationwide this year, 11,965 leptospirosis cases have been recorded, up 46% from last year’s 8,189. Reported symptoms include fever, vomiting, nausea, muscle pain, headache and reddish eyes. The Department of Health urges people exposed to floods to seek medical advice even if asymptomatic to prevent complications and death. The data indicate a continuing improvement in Metro Manila’s leptospirosis hospital situation within the National Capital Region as of 2026-10-05.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の症例、メトロマニラで減少傾向 - 保健省
triage.triage_reason: 全国的には前年比46%増と症例数が多いが、メトロマニラでは改善傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な緊急事態とは言えないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は人獣共通感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はせず、洪水後の環境曝露によるもの。メトロマニラでは症例数が大幅減少（79%減）しており、改善傾向にある。全国の年間症例数は増加しているが、季節性の洪水関連疾患として既知の対応枠組みがある。

article.articleHeadline: Médico alerta sobre meningite, doença que evolui rapidamente para quadro grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor warns about meningitis, a disease that rapidly progresses to a serious condition.
article.articleSummary: Meningitis can rapidly progress to severe illness. In Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, doctors warn on World Meningitis Day that bacterial meningitis can deteriorate within minutes, causing neurological impairment, hearing loss, vision changes, or death. Key bacteria: Neisseria meningitidis (meningococcal), Streptococcus pneumoniae (pneumococcal), and Haemophilus influenzae type B (Hib); meningococcemia can cause shock and sepsis. Suspected meningitis requires urgent hospital evaluation, including lumbar puncture for cerebrospinal fluid analysis; initiate antibiotics early when bacterial meningitis is suspected. Vaccination remains central to prevention but no single vaccine covers all causes. Brazil's SUS 2026 calendar offers meningococcal C (two doses at 3 and 5 months) and meningococcal ACWY booster at 12 months; ACWY also for 11–14-year-olds; pneumococcal and Hib vaccines (pentavalent) are part of protection. SES data (May 2026) show 34 meningitis cases and 8 deaths in the state (6 Campo Grande, 1 Corumbá, 1 Dourados), underscoring surveillance and early care.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が髄膜炎について警告、急速に重篤化する疾患
triage.triage_reason: 特定地域における髄膜炎の一般的な啓発記事であり、世界髄膜炎デーに合わせた医療情報提供が主目的。症例数・死亡者数は報告されているが、異常な増加やアウトブレイクを示す記述はなく、情報は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マトグロッソ・ド・スル州における髄膜炎（髄膜炎菌・肺炎球菌・インフルエンザ菌b型）の一般的な啓発・予防接種情報が中心。SESデータでは2026年5月時点で34例・8死亡と報告されているが、これが通常の発生動向からの逸脱かどうかは記事から判断できない。アウトブレイクや急増を示唆する情報はなく、World Meningitis Dayに合わせた定期的な健康啓発記事と考えられる。
