article.articleHeadline: കുസാറ്റിൽ ചിക്കൻപോക്സ് പടരുന്നു; ക്ലാസുകൾ ഓൺലൈനാക്കി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox spreads in Kusattil; classes moved online.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox and fever outbreaks spread across Kusat hostels in Kalamassery campus. In Sahar Hostel, 20 BTech students were diagnosed with chickenpox on Sunday, prompting authorities to close the hostel and switch classes online from Tuesday through Saturday. The Alukanand Hostel on campus and nearby private hostels are also affected. In the preceding days, many students had fever; by Monday chickenpox was confirmed. Internal exams for non-first-year students were slated to begin from Monday, but the fever cluster has prompted changes to exams and academic activities. Several students are reported to have H1N1 fever. The report highlights ongoing transmission with multiple hosts involved; no infection source is specified in the article.

triage.headline_ja: クサートで水痘が拡大、授業をオンラインに切り替え
triage.triage_reason: 大学寮内での水痘・H1N1様発熱の集団発生だが、重症度や detailed な感染規模は不明であり、国際的拡大の可能性は低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 水痘は既知の感染症で季節性・局地的な集団発生。H1N1の併発が報告されているが詳細不明。大学寮という閉鎖環境での拡大が続く可能性があり、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Transmission, traitement... Qu'est-ce que la peste pulmonaire, dont un cas aurait été mortel en Russie?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transmission, treatment... What is pneumonic plague, of which one case is said to have been fatal in Russia?
article.articleSummary: One suspected fatal pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Irkutsk region involves a 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute, potentially infected from a broken test tube. Up to 200 close contacts are in quarantine. Authorities say the death result is pneumonia of undetermined etiology pending a special commission; Kremlin and regional officials urge reliance on official Rospotrebnadzor statements and say the situation is under control. Plague is mainly transmitted to humans by fleas from wild rodents, with possible human-to-human spread via respiratory droplets. Since 1990–2020, about 50,000 cases were reported to WHO across 26 countries; current foci include Madagascar, the DRC, the Western United States, and Central Asia; Europe has no native or recent imported cases. Antibiotics are effective when started early; bubonic form mortality about 50%, pneumonic form 100% without antibiotics. Pneumonic disease can develop within three days of exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 伝播・治療とは…ロシアで1例が死亡したとされる肺ペストとは何か？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所で肺ペスト疑い死亡例が発生し、濃厚接触者200人が隔離されるなど、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に2つ該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州の抗ペスト研究所内での検査技師の実験室内感染疑い事例。DRCやマダガスカル、米国西部は『現行の流行地』として背景説明に挙げられているのみで、本記事の発生国ではないため対象国リストからは除外（verified_locationsは空配列）。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄實驗室疑病原外洩 研究員死於不明肺炎 | 危險病原外洩 | 肺鼠疫病 | 武漢疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian lab suspects pathogen leakage; researcher dies of unknown pneumonia | Dangerous pathogen leakage | Pneumonic plague | Wuhan outbreak
article.articleSummary: In Siberia, Russia, a epidemiology research institute reports a suspected dangerous pathogen leak. A 28-year-old female laboratory assistant died; about 200 people who had contact with her have been hospitalized or placed under observation. The White House is monitoring the incident and urged Russia to disclose accurate information. On Sept 25, the assistant reportedly broke a vial containing the agent of pneumonic plague (Yersinia pestis) and promptly fell ill, dying on Oct 2. Russian authorities have not confirmed plague infection, stating the death as pneumonia of unknown etiology and maintaining that the local outbreak remains stable. Hospitals implemented isolation measures following the incident. Public scrutiny over transparency has grown, with comparisons to the early Wuhan outbreak. Published Oct 5, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所で病原体漏洩の疑い、研究員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡｜危険病原体漏洩｜肺ペスト｜武漢の疫病と比較
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの研究施設で病原体（ペスト菌の疑い）漏洩による死亡例と約200人の濃厚接触者の隔離・観察が報告されており、国際的関心（米ホワイトハウス）も高く、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・シベリアの研究所で発生したものであり、対象国リストにロシアは含まれていないため verified_locations は空。記事中の武漢言及は比較のための言及であり、実際の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 19 Ribu Warga Bandar Lampung Sudah Diskrining TBC, 2.607 Positif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 19,000 Bandar Lampung residents have been screened for TB, with 2,607 testing positive.
article.articleSummary: TB screening in Bandar Lampung, Indonesia: as of September 2026, 19,228 suspected tuberculosis cases were screened, with 2,607 testing positive. Of those, 2,299 patients have begun treatment and remain under care; free TB testing and medications are provided. District health authorities involve posyandu cadres and families to ensure adherence, along with home visits. Since July 2026, TB screening has been integrated into the Free Health Check program (CKG) across 31 puskesmas and 294 screening loci, targeting about 29,400 people by end-2026; by September, ~30% of target achieved. In 2025, 36,201 were screened with 4,301 positive; 3,980 treated (92.54%), including 3,009 Bandar Lampung residents; 2,695 cured and 314 still in treatment. Emphasis on education about symptoms, transmission, and completing therapy, with cross-sector collaboration (Social Service, Kodim) to accelerate case finding and aim for TB elimination by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: バンダルランプン市民1万9000人がTBCスクリーニングを受け、2,607人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核スクリーニング活動の進捗報告であり、異常な流行や急激な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。既存の対策プログラムが順調に機能していることを伝える定例的な報告。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の疾患であり、本記事はインドネシア・バンダルランプン市における既存のスクリーニング・治療プログラムの実施状況報告。2030年までのTB撲滅目標に向けた通常業務の一環であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la Banque mondiale réaffirme son soutien à la riposte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: The World Bank Reaffirms Its Support for the Ebola Outbreak Response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, the World Bank reaffirmed its support to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and its Ituri province in the Ebola outbreak response, during the arrival in Bunia of Ronald Mutasa, Senior Health Manager for Africa at the World Bank. Mutasa praised provincial authorities' coordination and community outreach, noting more than 100 partners engaged and awareness activities in churches, schools, and other platforms. The visit underscored Bank involvement through the national outbreak response team, backing the health response and the safe reopening of schools. The Bank plans to maintain support until the outbreak ends and aims to contribute to a durable strengthening of Congo's public health system so that future epidemics can be detected rapidly and addressed effectively.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:世界銀行がエボラ出血熱流行への対応支援を再確認 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する継続的な国際支援の動きであり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため既知のアウトブレイクの継続モニタリング案件としてフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行に対する世界銀行の支援継続を報じるもので、新規症例数や致死率等の疫学詳細は記載されていない。既知アウトブレイクの進展状況として継続注視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uele : l'église Kimbanguiste s'implique dans la riposte contre l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Upper Uele: the Kimbanguist Church takes part in the response to the outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Haut-Uele Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with active involvement from the Kimbanguist Church in Isiro as of October 5, 2026. Pastor Alphonse Bakunda, provincial head, states the church respects the Congo state and follows health authorities’ measures. Governor Jean Bakomito has been raising awareness on eradicating Ebola, disseminating guidance through church networks to communities across the six territories. In a recent assembly in preparation for a large ceremony in Kamba, pastors were trained to further educate communities on Ebola prevention and barrier measures. Reported preventive actions include installing handwashing kits for each ceremony, maintaining distancing, and a formal ban on handshakes or hugs. The church and its adherents have embraced the Ebola response as part of ongoing outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: 上ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：キンバング主義教会が流行対応に参加 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）上ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある疾患であるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC上ウエレ州における既存エボラ流行への宗教団体（キンバング主義教会）の対応を報じたもの。ナイジェリア（Kebbi State）は地理タグの誤りと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: В АТОР не располагают информацией о заболеваниях Коксаки во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ATOR has no information on Coxsackievirus infections in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: 5 October 2026 update: No evidence of a mass Coxsackievirus outbreak among Russians in Vietnam. Rospotrebnadzor has sent an official request to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and to ATR following media reports about Coxsackievirus infections. ATR says it has not received any official inquiry, and tour operators and insurers report no data indicating mass illness at Vietnamese resorts, including Cam Ranh. Yulia Alcheyeva, director of Euroins Travel Insurance, says no Coxsackie cases have been recorded in Vietnam in recent months; if a mass event occurred, it would likely be evident to large operators. Coxsackie is an enterovirus transmitted via close contact and contaminated water/food; illness typically presents with fever, rash, and mucous membrane involvement, often mild and more common in children. Rospotrebnadzor has provided guidance on protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: ATORはベトナムでのコクサッキーウイルス感染症に関する情報を把握していない
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの集団感染の証拠はなく、公式機関も報告を受けていないため、現時点でシグナルとしての根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人観光客に関するメディア報道への反証・否定情報であり、実際の発生を裏付ける情報はない。ベトナム保健省やATRからも公式な報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Presunto brote de peste pulmonar en Siberia activa alertas en el mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia triggers worldwide alerts.
article.articleSummary: Hospitals in Russia's Siberian Irkutsk region have quarantined several facilities amid suspicion of pneumonic plague, according to Liudi Baikala. At least four institutions, including a pediatric hospital, imposed quarantines of up to three weeks with restricted visitation. A 28-year-old woman, employed at the Irkutsk and Far East Institute of Plague Research, died last week in Shélejov; authorities cite pneumonia of unclear etiology, with two possibilities: infection in Thailand or an accidental lab tube rupture with pathogens. Rospotrebnadzor says no emergencies linked to pathogens were reported at the institute, and all contacts are under medical observation with no symptoms and negative tests. The United States issued an alert; Russia urged calm and reliance on official statements, while the EU monitors. Pneumonic plague is transmitted via droplets and requires prompt antibiotic treatment; laboratory confirmation is needed.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペストの疑いのある発生、世界的な警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト疑いの患者が死亡し、複数の病院が検疫措置を取るなど、深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象でIHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価へ進める。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）のためverified_locationsは空配列。記事中でタイでの感染可能性にも言及されているが、これは感染経路の推測の一つであり、実際の発生地・主題はロシア・シベリア地域であるため対象国としては扱わない。接触者は陰性でヒト-ヒト感染の証拠は現時点でなく、Rospotrebnadzorは研究所内での病原体漏洩事案を否定している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les autorités médicales congolaises font état de plus de 8500 cas confirmés et 4100 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Congolese medical authorities report more than 8,500 confirmed cases and 4,100 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with 8,544 confirmed cases and 4,114 deaths reported by the National Public Health Institute as of Oct 3. The Ministry of Health notes 824 patients hospitalized or in isolation and 2,230 recoveries; overall case fatality rate 48.2%, with 73.8% of contacts followed. Highlights include 17 patients declared cured after two negative tests—12 in Ituri, 4 in North Kivu, 1 in Haut-Uélé. Authorities verified 2,800 alerts and investigated 490 suspected cases, transferring 239 to treatment centers. Figures remain subject to adjustment with provincial confirmations. On Oct 2, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said new infections had fallen significantly and that control of the eastern outbreak had been regained, with the peak believed to be behind them.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国当局、確認症例8,500人超、死者4,100人超と報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.2%の大規模エボラ流行で死者4,000人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 保健大臣は新規感染の大幅減少とピークを過ぎた可能性に言及しているが、依然として大規模な流行が継続中であり注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Imponen cuarentena tras sospecha de peste pulmonar en hospitales de Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine imposed after suspected pneumonic plague in hospitals in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Quarantine imposed after suspected pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region, Siberia. A 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk and Far East Institute of Plague Research died in a hospital in Shélejov, amid reports of pneumonia of unknown etiology. Rospotrebnadzor said the diagnosis had not been established as pneumonic plague. Investigations consider two scenarios: infection in Thailand, from which she recently returned, or an accidental laboratory exposure from a broken tube containing pathogens at her workplace. Quarantines have been imposed in at least four medical facilities, including a pediatric hospital, with visits restricted for up to three weeks. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an emergency meeting; all contacts are under medical observation, none symptomatic and all tests negative so far. The United States and European Union monitor the situation; Kremlin urges reliance on official Rospotrebnadzor statements.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの病院で肺ペスト疑いにより隔離措置
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑いによる死亡例が確認され、国際的な監視（米・EU）も行われているためIHR基準に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴が感染源候補として挙げられているが、感染がタイで発生したと確認されていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro : distribution prochaine des moustiquaires imprégnées annoncée à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: Upcoming distribution of impregnated mosquito nets announced in Isiro - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Haut-Uele, in northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, will host a forthcoming distribution of long-lasting insecticide-treated nets (LLINs) in the coming days, a malaria-prevention drive separate from the ongoing Ebola virus disease response. Provincial Health Minister Afounde Afongenda stressed that Ebola has dominated attention, but malaria remains a daily concern, with cases reported at every health facility. The campaign aims to have women ensure households, especially children, sleep under nets to reduce malaria transmission and improve environmental hygiene. Emmanuel Arama, government spokesperson for Haut-Uele, added that the LLIN distribution is not linked to Ebola control. He urged residents to ignore social media misinformation, stigmatization, and other messages about Ebola. The message was delivered at the governor’s residence as part of ongoing public health communication.

triage.headline_ja: イソロでのエボラ関連報道：マラリア予防のための防虫処理済み蚊帳の配布が近く発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ対応とは別のマラリア予防（防虫蚊帳配布）キャンペーンに関する広報であり、新規の感染症発生や症例急増等の具体的な疫学情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応と並行して行われるマラリア予防（蚊帳配布）活動の広報であり、エボラに関する誤情報・偏見への注意喚起も含まれる。エボラの新規症例や流行状況に関する直接的な情報はないため、トリアージ上は見送りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: রাশিয়ায় প্লেগ, ভারতের কতটা ভয়? কী ভাবে ছড়ায় 'ব্ল্যাক ডেথ'-এর জীবাণু?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Russia, how much should India fear? How does the 'Black Death' pathogen spread?
article.articleSummary: Russia reports suspected pneumonic plague in Irkutsk after a young female researcher dies in a lab incident involving live Yersinia pestis; officials are investigating, but Rosptotrebnadzor says the death is due to pneumonia and not confirmed plague. About 200 people have been quarantined and at least five hospitals closed as containment measures and event cancellations are implemented. Pneumonic plague directly affects the lungs and spreads via respiratory droplets, while bubonic plague involves swollen lymph nodes and septicemic plague blood infection. The episode has sparked concern about spread to India, but Indian doctors and bodies including the IMA and NCDC say there is no current evidence of transmission or immediate risk as of October 5, 2026; investigations continue. Watch for fever, cough, shortness of breath, and extreme weakness.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト、インドはどれほど恐れるべきか？「黒死病」の病原体はどのように広がるのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所で生きたペスト菌を扱っていた研究者が死亡し、肺ペスト疑いとして約200人が隔離、病院が閉鎖される事態となっており、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性もあることから、スクリーニング基準に複数該当し社会的関心も高いためPICKUPとする。
triage.notes: 事案の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。インドは本記事で「懸念」の対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではなく、インド当局（IMA・NCDC）も現時点で伝播の証拠はないとしているため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。死因は当局によりペストではなく肺炎とされており、確定診断は未了。

article.articleHeadline: SC Takes Cognisance Of Death Of 7-Year-Old Andhra Girl After Anti-Malaria Dose
article.articleSummary: Chloroquine-related death of seven-year-old girl in Gollaguppa, Yetapaka mandal, Polavaram district, Andhra Pradesh, triggers Supreme Court suo motu cognisance as High Court instructed to closely monitor probe. Jamuna, a Class 2 Koya tribal student, died hours after receiving a chloroquine tablet during a malaria-prevention drive on September 1, after malaria cases were detected in the village near the Andhra-Telangana border. An FIR has been filed; investigators await a Forensic Science Laboratory report to determine whether the medicine or its batch caused illnesses among villagers. In the drive, Lakshmipuram Primary Health Centre administered chloroquine to 71 people; at least five malaria cases had been reported in the village. Dozens were treated; 52 villagers were admitted, including 28 shifted to a government hospital in Bhadrachalam, Telangana; all recovered and were discharged the next day. Chief Minister Naidu ordered a probe.

triage.headline_ja: 最高裁、マラリア予防薬投与後に死亡したアーンドラ州の7歳少女の件を自発的に審理
triage.triage_reason: マラリア予防薬（クロロキン）投与後の死亡事例であり医薬品安全性・医療過誤の性質が強く、マラリア感染自体は村で5例と小規模。FSL調査結果待ちで原因未確定のため情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本件はマラリア予防投薬（クロロキン）後の死亡に関する医薬品安全性・司法審理の記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクとしての性質は限定的。村でのマラリア症例は5例のみで、51名が治療・回復しており感染拡大の兆候はない。FSL（法科学研究所）の調査結果により薬剤起因性が判明次第、続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Imponen cuarentena en varios hospitales de Siberia por sospechas de una misteriosa infección
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine imposed in several hospitals in Siberia amid suspicions of a mysterious infection.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague prompts quarantines across multiple Irkutsk region hospitals in Siberia, with at least four facilities—including a pediatric hospital—restricting admissions and visits for up to three weeks. Officials have not officially confirmed plague; all contacts of the index patient are under medical observation, none have symptoms, and tests are negative to date. The 28-year-old employee of the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East died last week in Shelekhov after pneumonia of undetermined etiology. Two hypotheses under study: infection contracted in Thailand or an accidental laboratory exposure from a breached vial. Rospotrebnadzor reports no emergencies linked to pathogens at the institute. The European Commission and United States have issued alerts and are monitoring, with the EU coordinating via the ECDC and emphasizing data transparency.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの複数病院で謎の感染症疑いにより検疫措置
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いによる死亡例が発生し、複数病院で検疫が実施され、EU・米国が監視を強化しているため、IHR基準の複数項目（重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州（シベリア）で発生。タイは感染経路の仮説として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Venäjällä pelätään ruttoa - THL:n asiantuntija kertoo, millainen tauti on kyseessä
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague feared in Russia — THL expert explains what kind of disease it is.
article.articleSummary: Possible plague in Russia's Irkutsk region triggers uncertainty; a 28-year-old female laboratory worker died, with reports she handled live Yersinia pestis; officials later hedged, noting the woman may have died from pneumonia of unknown cause. Rospotrebnadzor denies workplace incidents involving pathogens and says the Irkutsk situation is under control. THL has limited information, relying on Russian media; no Finland-wide measures are planned. If Russia faced a cross-border health threat, it would usually notify WHO; no such notification is confirmed. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and presents as bubonic plague or pneumonic plague, the latter requiring close, prolonged contact to spread. Globally, plague affects animals mostly; humans see a few hundred cases annually, with recent outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar. EU/EEA indigenous cases have been absent for decades. Antibiotics are effective if started early; without treatment, plague can be fatal.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト感染が懸念される ― THL専門家がどのような疾患か解説
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で検査技師がペスト感染の疑いで死亡したが、当局は詳細を否定・ヘッジしており情報が錯綜。対象国での発生ではなく、現時点では続報を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での単発の疑い例であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCやマダガスカルは『過去の流行事例』としての背景説明に過ぎず、現在進行中のイベントではないため verified_locations には含めない。当局が感染事実を否定しており、情報の確度が低い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 7 enfants meurent chaque jour en moyenne, les moins de 5 ans les plus exposés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Seven children die on average each day, the under-fives are the most at risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 961 children under 18 since May 15, with 2,071 minors infected. From Sept 5 to 27, confirmed cases rose from 6,604 to 8,116 and deaths from 3,175 to 3,924. Among deaths, 623 were under five; the under-five case fatality rate is 61%, versus 48% overall. Save the Children warns one in four cases and one in four deaths involve a child, signaling acute risk to the youngest. Since the start, at least 180 children have lost both parents or guardians. Over the last three weeks, 81.5% of deaths occurred in communities rather than treatment centers. Urgent calls to strengthen prevention, bring care closer to communities, and provide psychosocial support for affected children.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 コンゴ民主共和国：1日平均7人の子どもが死亡、5歳未満が最も高リスク
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、致死率の高さ（全体48%、5歳未満61%）、感染者・死者数の急増、コミュニティ内死亡の割合の高さから公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 既知の継続流行（2026年5月開始）に関する最新統計報告。感染者数・死亡者数ともに増加傾向にあり、特に5歳未満児への影響が深刻。国際的な人道支援の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Flooded Faizullahganj: Water-borne diseases' risk spikes; health staff on alert
article.articleSummary: Flooding in Faizullahganj raises the risk of water‑borne diseases such as diarrhoea, hepatitis A, cholera and typhoid from contaminated water and food, with leptospirosis, skin and respiratory infections, and snakebite also monitored. The health department has intensified surveillance and preparedness, conducting household health surveys in Faizullaganj led by Dr Asma with ASHAs and ANMs, and deploying mobile medical units to flood‑affected areas. Hospitals have reserved beds to manage potential increases: 10 beds at Ram Sagar Mishra Hospital and 10 beds at Bhau Rao Devras Hospital, along with adequate stocks of medicines and anti-snake venom. Officials, including Dr Kuldeep Verma and Dr NB Singh, emphasize floodwater carries dirt, microorganisms and insecticides contributing to illness. The district health office reports multiple medical teams and MMUs; centers are instructed to maintain essential medicines during the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水に見舞われたFaizullahganj：水系感染症のリスク急増、保健当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による水系感染症（コレラ、腸チフス、A型肝炎等）のリスクが報告されているが、実際の患者発生数や確定症例の報告はなく、予防的な監視・準備態勢の段階であるため情報不足。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生ではなく、洪水に伴うリスク増大への保健当局の予防的対応（サーベイランス強化、病床確保等）を報じたもの。具体的な患者数や症例報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por un posible brote de peste pulmonar en Siberia tras la muerte de una investigadora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning of a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia after the death of a female researcher.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague outbreak investigated in the Irkutsk region of Russia after the death of a 28-year-old woman who worked at Irkutsk and the Far East Institute of Plague Research. She died in a hospital in Shelekhov; origin under study includes infection in Thailand or a laboratory accident involving pathogens. The United States issued an alert; Kremlin urged calm while Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor reports pneumonia of undetermined etiology and has not confirmed plague; none of the patient’s contacts have fallen ill. Reports from Liudi Baikala claim multiple Irkutsk hospitals, including a pediatric hospital, are under quarantine for up to three weeks for suspected pneumonic plague, though authorities have not officially confirmed the disease. Governor Igor Kobzev held an emergency meeting, with contacts under medical observation and no symptoms reported. EU/ECDC monitor, emphasizing data transparency and cross-border cooperation; plague is bacterial and treatable with antibiotics; Europe has not seen an outbreak in decades.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで研究者の女性が死亡、肺ペスト発生の可能性で警戒
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、複数病院の隔離措置や米・EUによる監視が行われていることから、重篤性・異常性・国際的関心が高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生・死亡・隔離措置はロシア・イルクーツク州で確認されており、対象国リストに含まれない。タイでの感染可能性は調査中の仮説であり、確定情報ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Muerte por peste pulmonar en Siberia causa preocupación y activan cuarentena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death from pneumonic plague in Siberia raises concern and quarantine is activated.
article.articleSummary: Death of a 28-year-old laboratory technician in Irkutsk, Siberia region, from suspected pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis triggers quarantine of five hospitals and medical surveillance for about 200 contacts. Authorities investigate whether infection was acquired in Thailand, from where the woman recently returned, or due to an accidental breakage of a pathogen-containing tube at her workplace, a high-containment institute. Rospotrebnadzor reports the illness as pneumonia of undetermined etiology; so far no contacts have developed symptoms and all tests have been negative. The US White House notes monitoring of Russia's situation; the European Commission and the ECDC are in close contact and emphasise the need for timely, transparent epidemiological and laboratory data. No confirmed secondary cases at this time; contingency plans are in place.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペストによる死亡、懸念拡大し検疫体制発動
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、5つの病院が検疫対象となり約200人の接触者が監視下に置かれている。米・EU当局も状況を注視しており、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある重篤な感染症としてIHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染源として調査中と記載されているが、記事の主題である発症・検疫の場はロシアであるため、タイは verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 8 bin 544'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of cases in the Ebola outbreak in Congo has risen to 8,544.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports updated Ebola outbreak figures: 8,544 confirmed cases and 4,114 deaths, with 2,230 recoveries since the outbreak began; 17 more people recovered in the last 24 hours. Response efforts continue across seven provinces in 64 districts where Ebola cases have been detected. The virus originated near a village beside the Ebola River, giving the disease its name. In Ituri province, eastern DRC, authorities recorded 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths before the outbreak was declared on May 15. Health officials note that the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant has no approved treatment or vaccine. Ongoing surveillance and containment measures are in place as the response remains active across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数が8,544人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7州64地区にわたり8,544症例・4,114死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないブンディブギョ型であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスには承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、7州64地区に拡大している大規模アウトブレイク。致死率も高く（約48%）、国際的な注視と支援が必要と考えられる。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Россияне заболели вирусом Коксаки во время отдыха во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians contracted Coxsackievirus during their vacation in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, several Russian families contracted Coxsackievirus (an enterovirus) while vacationing at Amiana Resort Cam Ranh in Cam Ranh, Vietnam. An eight‑month‑old child developed a fever up to 40°C, followed by a rash and painful oral ulcers; a local hospital diagnosed Coxsackievirus, with the mother subsequently developing similar symptoms. Reports indicate additional cases among Russian tourists at the same hotel, with some guests told only to change rooms and lacking medical care or warnings about further infections. Earlier in September, a Russian schoolchild reportedly contracted Coxsackievirus on Vietnamese resort premises, with a physician initially diagnosing it as an acute respiratory infection. Coxsackievirus belongs to enteroviruses and typically presents with high fever, rash, and painful mouth lesions. No details on lab confirmation beyond the hotel diagnosis are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人がベトナム旅行中にコクサッキーウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病様疾患（コクサッキーウイルス）がベトナムのリゾート地でロシア人観光客に発生しているが、検査確定や規模の詳細が不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: コクサッキーウイルスは一般的なエンテロウイルス感染症で小児に多く、通常は軽症。ロシアのメディアはホテルの対応不備（検査や警告の欠如）を批判しているが、公衆衛生上の重大リスクを示す情報はない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: रशियात नवा व्हायरस लॉकडाऊनची भीती, लॅबमधून बाहेर पडला कोरोनाचा भाऊ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, fear of a new virus and lockdown; did the coronavirus's brother escape from the lab?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague outbreak scare in Russia after the death of a 28-year-old female researcher at Siberia’s Shelekhov Anti-Plague Institute. The fast-acting lung-targeting disease is feared to spread via respiratory droplets; nearly 200 people are under quarantine, the hospital sealed, and masks mandated for aluminum-plant workers as the city goes on high alert. Investigations are ongoing by Russia’s main infectious disease agency into a possible leak of a deadly biological agent. WHO says if timely antibiotics are administered, the illness can be cured. Whether the agent is plague or bacterial pneumonia remains unconfirmed; the article notes it has not been proven to mirror the coronavirus in its global threat. There is currently no definitive evidence of imminent spread to India or beyond, and officials urge against panic.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで新たなウイルスへの恐怖、ロックダウンの懸念；コロナウイルスの「兄弟」が研究所から流出したのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアの研究所関連者の死亡と肺ペスト疑いで約200人が隔離されているが、病原体の確定診断がなく対象国（インド等）への拡大の明確な証拠もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（対象国リストに含まれない）。インドは記事中で「拡大の確証はない」と明記されており、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。病原体（ペストか細菌性肺炎か）も未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Единичен случай или опасност от пандемия: Колко опасна е чумата?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Single Case or the Threat of a Pandemic: How Dangerous Is the Plague?
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026 in Shelekhov, Irkutsk Oblast, a district hospital ward was closed over suspicion of an 'exceptionally dangerous infection.' Media later disclosed 28-year-old Darya Shipilova died there from pulmonary plague; officials cautioned there is no official confirmation of plague, labeling the illness pneumonia of unknown etiology. Plague remains endemic in Russia with 11 natural foci, though in 2025 the pathogen was detected in only three; vaccines are administered to tens of thousands annually, but effectiveness is uncertain and booster schedules are regionally variable. Globally, plague persists mainly through contact with wild rodents and their fleas; pneumonic plague enables person-to-person spread via droplets with prolonged exposure. Bubonic plague mortality with antibiotics is about 14%; untreated 30-60%; pneumonic form can reach near 100% without treatment. Outbreaks occur in Africa (DRC, Madagascar) and sporadic cases in the US and China; EU heightened readiness for Russia's plague situation.

triage.headline_ja: 単発例か、パンデミックの脅威か：ペストはどれほど危険か？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト疑いによる死亡例が発生し、特別に危険な感染症として病棟閉鎖措置が取られた。肺ペストは人-人感染が可能で致死率が高く、EUも警戒を強めていることから異常性・重症度・流行可能性の観点でフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州シェレホフでの肺ペスト疑い死亡例。DRC・マダガスカル・中国・米国は背景情報として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため対象国リストに該当しても verified_locations には含めず、ロシア自体も対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。公式にはペスト確定診断はなされておらず『原因不明の肺炎』とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: രാജ്യത്ത് കുഷ്ഠരോഗം വര്‍ധിക്കുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leprosy is increasing in the country.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) is rising in India. Last year, 91,783 new cases were recorded—the world’s highest tally, with Brazil (22,901) and Indonesia (16,292) next; together these three account for 78.3% of global cases, per the NLEP 2025-26 report. Globally, 2025 saw 167,356 cases, with India contributing the majority. In the past year, 3,832 Indian children were diagnosed, more than double the 2,000 target; 37 had Grade-2 disabilities at diagnosis, signaling irreversible impairment. WHO notes about half of the 8,344 global child cases are in India. By 2027, district-level action under the National Strategic Plan 2023-27 aims to curb transmission. All 31 states/UTs have reached the 1 per 10,000 elimination target, except five states—Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, Odisha—and one UT above it. Intensified household contact screening and Nikush 2.0 digital system monitor detections; 1.11 million ASHA workers screened 48,027 new cases. Delays in diagnosis drive pediatric spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国内でハンセン病（レプラ）が増加している
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病はインドで長年管理されている慢性疾患であり、今回の記事は国家プログラム（NLEP）による年次統計報告であって急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大のリスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド国内のハンセン病新規症例増加と国家戦略計画(2023-27)の進捗を報告する統計的内容。ブラジル・インドネシアは症例数比較のための言及に留まり、記事の主題はインドの状況である。慢性感染症であり急性アウトブレイクではないため、EBSシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Etah News: रसूलपुर गढ़ौली में 15 दिन में बुखार से चार की जान गई, झोलाछाप बिगाड़ रहे हालत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Etah News: In Rasulpur Garouli, four people have died of fever in 15 days; quacks are worsening the situation.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, Rasulpur Gadouli in Etah district's Marhara block reports four fever deaths within 15 days, with dengue positive in at least one case (24-year-old Pawan died in Agra after dengue positivity). His family alleges a quack refused treatment when platelets fell to ~12,000, prompting transfer to Agra. Authorities note additional dengue-positive deaths in Agra over the same period. An elderly 100-year-old Yatendra died recently; three patients over 80 died during treatment in Kasganj and Agra. Local MLA Veerendra Singh Lodhi visited the village to console families and review containment. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Rajendra Prasad dispatched MMU, block-level, and district teams to treat fever cases, with 50–60 patients observed among about 2,500 voters. Officials pledged action against quacks and a formal inquiry into the deaths.

triage.headline_ja: Etahニュース：ラスールプル・ガドウリで15日間に熱病により4人が死亡、無資格医が状況を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: インド・エター県で複数の発熱死亡例とデング熱陽性が確認されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低く、局地的な発生であり情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの地方で季節的に流行する疾患であり、本件はEtah県・Agra県における局地的なクラスターと見られる。無資格医療者（quack）による不適切な対応が問題視されているが、国レベルでの公衆衛生緊急事態としての報告はなく、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Paris s'engage dans la riposte au pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola — Paris pledges to join the country's response.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak receives international backing as France pledges support. In Kinshasa's Cité de l'Union africaine, President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi on Friday, October 2, held talks with French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot, accompanied by Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba and Deputy Foreign Minister Noëlla Ayaganagato, to review bilateral cooperation, the eastern security crisis, and the government's strategy to combat Ebola. Barrot praised the long-standing Kinshasa-Paris links and said he will travel to Bunia to back the response and operationalize France's commitments under a protocol on fighting impunity and reparations for sexual violence in conflicts. The discussions underscore continued international engagement against Ebola in the eastern DRC and coordination between Kinshasa and Paris.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱 — フランスが同国の対応支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、フランスが国際支援を表明。IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たし、国際的関心・支援ニーズも明確であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける既存のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへのフランスの外交的支援表明に関するもの。新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクへの国際協力強化を報じている。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rubio: Russian pneumonic plague outbreak warrants attention - NewsFire.GR | English Version
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, a suspected deadly pneumonic plague outbreak is tied to Russia’s Irkutsk Oblast at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia. A 28-year-old laboratory researcher, Daria Shipilova, died after pneumonia of unknown origin while under quarantine, triggering hospital isolation and facility containment. The U.S. State Department and CDC are monitoring the case with Moscow, noting many details remain unverified and urging rapid, transparent information sharing. Secretary Rubio called the death serious attention with U.S.–Russia travel severely limited. Pneumonic plague is highly dangerous and spreads via airborne particles; without rapid antibiotic treatment it is typically fatal. Global cases are rare; historic outbreaks include 1910–1911 Manchuria with ~60,000 deaths. The episode heightens biosafety concerns at high-containment labs amid broader lab-origin anxieties.

triage.headline_ja: ルビオ氏:ロシアの肺ペスト流行は注視が必要
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、米国務長官が公に懸念を表明、米露間の渡航制限にも言及されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 事案の中心はロシア・イルクーツク州の抗ペスト研究所における研究者の死亡例であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。発生地域に中国（内モンゴル・満州里）が含まれるが、これは1910-1911年の満州ペスト流行への歴史的言及であり、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。詳細情報（感染経路、二次感染の有無等）は未検証であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Primavera do Leste vacina 235 animais em nova ação contra a raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Primavera do Leste vaccinates 235 animals in a new anti-rabies campaign.
article.articleSummary: Primavera do Leste, Brazil, conducted a new anti-rabies vaccination campaign, vaccinating 235 dogs and cats at two city sites, Jardim Europa and Condomínio Pioneiro, on Oct 3. The rabies vaccination effort aims to strengthen animal protection and reduce the public health risk posed by rabies. The Municipal Health Secretariat urges owners to keep vaccines up to date and take advantage of itinerant vaccination days. Environmental Surveillance teams will continue delivering vaccination across Primavera do Leste throughout October, expanding access. Upcoming sessions include Oct 12 in Volta Grande (afternoon after 3 PM); Oct 17 in Buritis III and Buritis Universitário after 3 PM; Oct 24 in Jardim Universitário, Vertentes, and Poncho Verde III after 3 PM; Oct 25 in Belvedere after 3 PM; and Oct 31 in Jardim das Américas after 3 PM. Daily vaccination is available at the Environmental Surveillance facility in Jardim Riva, 7:30 AM–5:30 PM.

triage.headline_ja: プリマベーラ・ド・レステ市、新たな狂犬病予防キャンペーンで動物235頭にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的なペットへの狂犬病ワクチン接種活動を報じる内容であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は犬猫への定期的な狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、ヒトまたは動物における狂犬病の発生事例を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite pode matar em poucas horas, mas maioria dos pais desconhece rapidez da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis can kill within a few hours, but most parents are unaware of how quickly the disease progresses.
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, awareness of meningococcal meningitis' rapid progression is low: only 19% of parents know it can kill within hours, and just 10% of 15–25-year-olds recognize the speed. The global Human8/GSK study (6,003 participants across six countries; Brazil n=1,001) reveals gaps in recognizing signs, vaccination status, and eligible groups. Among Brazilians, 29% of parents and 24% of youths see adolescents and young adults as vaccination targets; 25% of youths are unsure if they were vaccinated. Meningococcal disease, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, can present as meningitis or meningococcemia and progress rapidly to severe sequelae such as hearing loss, balance/coordination problems, or neurological impairment. Brazil recorded 486 cases and 96 deaths in 2025 (case-fatality 19.8%). Serogroups B and C are most frequent; ACWY vaccination is indicated for 11–14-year-olds. High trust in healthcare professionals persists, though some parents use AI for vaccine information.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎は数時間で死に至る可能性があるが、多くの親はその進行の速さを知らない
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける髄膜炎菌感染症の認知度調査と年間統計（2025年486例・死亡96例）を報じる内容で、新規アウトブレイクや急激な増加を示す情報はないが、致命率の高さから継続的な注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発調査に基づく報道であり、特定のアウトブレイクイベントではない。致死率19.8%という既存統計は深刻だが、新規性・異常性は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: PRESUNTO BROTE DE PESTE PULMONAR EN SIBERIA ACTIVA ALERTAS INTERNACIONALES
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia activates international alerts.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague in Irkutsk region, Siberia, Russia, triggers international alerts as authorities monitor contacts of a patient; no official confirmation of plague yet. Four medical facilities, including a pediatric hospital, are under quarantine for up to three weeks with restricted visits. An emergency meeting and contingency plan were activated; contacts remain under medical surveillance. A 28-year-old woman, employee of the Institute for Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East, died in a hospital in Shélejov; Rospotrebnadzor reports the pneumonia case has undetermined etiology and has not confirmed plague. Investigations consider possible infection during a recent trip to Thailand or potential occupational exposure, though no related incidents are reported at the institute. The United States is monitoring the situation; the European Union is in contact with the ECDC. Officials urge reliance on official communications and caution against rumors.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペスト感染の疑い、国際的な警戒活動が発動
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑い例で死亡者が発生し、複数医療機関が隔離措置を取るなど重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があり、国際的な監視・警戒が既に発動されているためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は感染経路調査の一環として言及されているのみで、タイでの発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: EU pide a Rusia que aborde 'rápida y abiertamente' la muerte de una trabajadora sanitaria que combatió la peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU asks Russia to address 'swiftly and openly' the death of a healthcare worker who fought the plague.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague in Siberia, Russia: the death of 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, a worker at Irkutsk’s Institute of Research against the Plague, from pneumonia of unknown origin, prompted hospital quarantine. The U.S. State Department urged Russia to disclose information quickly and accurately, saying they are monitoring with the CDC and partners regarding a presumed fatal pneumonic plague case in the Irkutsk region. Pneumonic plague can spread person-to-person via airborne transmission and is almost always fatal without rapid antibiotics. Annual cases are rare and typically occur in Africa, not spreading widely. A historic outbreak in Manchuria (Oct 1910–Apr 1911) killed about 60,000; masks and Tarbagan marmot hunters are cited as factors. The piece notes global concern linked to theories that COVID-19 leaked from the Wuhan Institute of Virology, with over 1.2 million American deaths cited. Travel between the U.S. and Russia remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: EUはロシアに対し、ペストと闘った医療従事者の死について『迅速かつ公然と』対応するよう求める
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの原因不明肺炎（肺ペスト疑い）による死亡例があり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と米国務省・CDCの監視対象になっている点から、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本イベントはロシア（イルクーツク州）で発生しており、対象国リストに該当する国（中国等）は記事中で歴史的事例・COVID起源論の文脈でのみ言及されているため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por posible peste pulmonar en Rusia: EE. UU. pide transparencia y Europa sigue el caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert over possible pneumonic plague in Russia: U.S. calls for transparency and Europe monitors the case.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague case in Siberia's Irkutsk region, Russia, after a woman's death. The European Commission is monitoring the situation, in contact with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control and the WHO, stressing transparency and cross-border data sharing. The U.S. notes plague is caused by a bacterium and is treatable with antibiotics, urging reliable epidemiological and laboratory information. France 24 cites two scenarios under study: infection in Thailand, or exposure from an accidental breakage of a test tube with pathogens at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research. Russia's Rospotrebnadzor reports pneumonia of undetermined etiology; no contacts have fallen ill or tested positive. The deceased worked in Shélejov near Irkutsk; authorities say no confirmed secondary cases. The EU highlights improved preparedness since COVID-19, including drug reserves and lab readiness, to manage potential cross-border health threats.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペストの疑い:米国が透明性を要求、欧州も注視
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑い例による死亡者が発生し国際的な関心が高まっているが、病原体の確定診断や二次感染の有無など重要情報が不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ロシア・イルクーツク州での肺ペスト疑い例が主題であり、対象国リストにロシアは含まれない。タイでの感染説は未確定の推測シナリオであり、確定情報がないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка COVID: пассажиров из Таиланда не пустили в рф без проверки температуры
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID outbreak: Passengers from Thailand were not allowed into Russia without a temperature check.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak in Thailand (2026) with about 140,000 cases since the start of the year and 26 deaths, around 65,000 of which occurred during the monsoon season; most fatalities involve the elderly or those with chronic illnesses. In Russia, passengers arriving from Bangkok are not allowed to disembark at Sheremetyevo International Airport until their temperature is checked using a thermal camera, as a quarantine precaution tied to the outbreak. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details, transmission sources, or infection origin beyond this border-control action. The incident highlights ongoing border health screening for travelers from regions with rising COVID-19 activity in Southeast Asia, though no other imported/exported case specifics are given.

triage.headline_ja: COVIDアウトブレイク：タイからの搭乗者はロシアで体温検査なしでは入国できず
triage.triage_reason: タイでCOVID-19の季節性流行（感染14万人、死亡26人）が継続しているが、新規性・重篤性の高い情報はなく、ロシア側の検疫強化のみが報じられている段階のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ国内のCOVID-19季節性流行とロシア（対象国外）の空港検疫対応を報じているが、検査結果・変異株情報・感染経路等の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: TB Masih Mengancam, Pemkab Bangkalan Ungkap Langkah Baru Lewat Kolaborasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Still Threatens, Bangkalan Regency Government Unveils New Measures Through Collaboration.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis remains a priority in Bangkalan Regency, East Java, where authorities report 1,028 TB cases. On Oct 5, 2026, Deputy Regent Fauzan Ja'far chaired the development of the Regional Tuberculosis Action Plan (RAD-TB) 2027 through cross-sector collaboration to align district agencies' roles and resources for prevention, treatment, and control. Officials stress TB is highly infectious and containment requires multisector engagement beyond the health department; RAD-TB should function as a practical guideline, not merely a document. The plan emphasizes strengthening health services and expanding community education on TB symptoms, the importance of testing, and adherence to treatment to interrupt transmission. The objective is to translate RAD-TB into concrete programs and field actions in Bangkalan, leveraging public awareness and community involvement for sustainable TB protection.

triage.headline_ja: 結核は依然として脅威、バンカラン県政府が連携による新たな対策を発表
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシア・バンカラン県において既知の地域流行病であり、地方自治体による通常の対策計画策定に関する行政的な報道であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は風土病的に継続する課題であり、本記事は地方政府の行動計画策定に関する通常業務の報道。緊急性や異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite exige vacinação em dia e diagnóstico rápido, alerta especialista - Bsb Flash
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis Requires Up-to-Date Vaccination and Rapid Diagnosis, Expert Warns - Bsb Flash.
article.articleSummary: By 2026-10-05, Brazil has 8,623 confirmed meningitis cases this year, including 641 in the North region; Amazonas reports 112 cases and Pará 431, the region’s highest. World Meningitis Day on Oct 5 underscores vaccination and rapid diagnosis, especially for children; elderly and immunocompromised individuals face higher risk of severe disease. Meningitis inflames the brain and spinal cord membranes, caused by viruses, bacteria, fungi, parasites, or non-infectious factors. Bacterial meningitis is most dangerous, chiefly due to meningococcus, pneumococcus, and Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib). Meningococcal transmission occurs via respiratory secretions, with close contacts potentially needing antibiotic prophylaxis. Pneumococcal and Hib infections can arise from asymptomatic carriage; Hib cases have declined with vaccination. Fungal, parasitic, and tuberculous meningitis are rarer, mainly in immunocompromised individuals. Public vaccination covers meningococcus, pneumococcus, Hib; private sector includes MenB. Diagnosis relies on clinical assessment, lumbar puncture with CSF analysis, blood cultures, and molecular tests; early treatment reduces death and sequelae.

article.articleHeadline: MSF warns of Ebola surge in DRC's North Kivu province
article.articleSummary: Ebola surge in DR Congo's North Kivu region prompts MSF warning of expanded outbreak. As of Oct 2, WHO records 4,082 deaths and 8,463 cases since the Bundibugyo strain emerged, with no vaccine or specific treatment available. Mid-May marked the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak; Ituri, North Kivu and Haut-Uele provinces host the majority across seven provinces. North Kivu now accounts for nearly 40% of newly confirmed cases, described by MSF as a megafire with hotspots expanding weekly. Treatment capacity is stretched; by late last week, 34% of confirmed patients were treated in non-specialised facilities, raising transmission risk for patients and healthcare workers. Bed shortages force referrals, compounding delays. More than 60% of Ebola-related deaths occur in the community, highlighting trust issues and delayed care. MSF calls for expanded treatment capacity in North Kivu, particularly in Butembo, to curb spread and improve outcomes.

article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak prompts fever screening for travelers from Thailand to Russia. At Moscow’s Sheremetyevo Airport, passengers arriving from Bangkok are not allowed to exit the aircraft until a temperature check is completed, with sanitary-epidemiological control officers using a thermal imager onboard. In Thailand, as of early 2026 there have been about 140,000 COVID-19 cases, with roughly 65,000 occurring during the monsoon season; the year has recorded 26 deaths, most among older adults and individuals with serious chronic illnesses. The measures reflect ongoing cross-border precautions amid the Thai outbreak and travel-related transmission concerns. The report does not specify laboratory confirmation details or infection sources for the Russian screening. Published 2026-10-05.

article.articleHeadline: La peste fa ancora paura? Il caso della ricercatrice morta in Siberia riapre una domanda che credevamo chiusa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the plague still feared? The case of the female researcher who died in Siberia reopens a question we thought was closed.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old researcher at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia died after rapid pneumonia. About 200 potential contacts are under observation; several Irkutsk hospitals have imposed precautionary quarantines; the US says the situation is monitored. It remains unconfirmed whether Darya Shipilova died of pneumonic plague; authorities report pneumonia of unknown etiology and say no pathogens linked to the institute were identified, with no incidents at the facility. A media claim that a vial of Yersinia pestis was broken on Sept 25 is unproven. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, spreads by respiratory droplets and can progress rapidly; incubation up to 24 hours; untreated, it can be fatal within 18-24 hours. Early antibiotics and isolation improve outcomes; close contacts receive surveillance and prophylaxis. WHO notes ongoing cases in the DRC and Madagascar. Observational measures do not prove an outbreak; microbiological confirmation is pending.

triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所勤務の研究者が急速進行性肺炎で死亡し、約200人の接触者が観察下にあるなど、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事象であり、病原体確認待ちのため続報が必要だが初期スクリーニングではIHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクでの研究者死亡事例であり、DRCおよびマダガスカルはWHOの既知進行中症例として文脈的に言及されているのみで、本事例の発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当する verified_locations はなし。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれていない。病原体（Yersinia pestis）の確認は未了で、研究所内での事故（ガラス瓶破損）も未証明。

article.articleHeadline: Cos'è la peste e come si trasmette
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the plague and how is it transmitted?
article.articleSummary: Siberia's recent death of a 28-year-old woman, Daria Shilipova, amid unconfirmed reports of plague underscores that Yersinia pestis persists in nature, carried by small mammals and fleas. This Gram-negative bacterium causes plague, a zoonosis with stable foci in Africa, Eurasia, and the Americas, maintained via contaminated terrain, rodent reservoirs, and fleas. The World Health Organization details three forms: bubonic (lymphatic), pneumonic (lungs), and septicemic (blood). Early symptoms vary; bubonic features swollen lymph nodes, while pneumonic presents chest pain, cough, and dyspnea and can be fatal within 24 hours. Antibiotics are effective if started promptly, typically continued for about two weeks depending on response. Globally, Africa remains the main theater; 2019–2025 suspected cases stayed under 4,000, with 2025 suspected cases under 200. The DRC reported 54 cases; Madagascar 51 confirmed cases, illustrating ongoing localized activity in Africa.

article.articleHeadline: Alarma en Siberia: esto sabemos sobre la cuarentena por sospecha de peste pulmonar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Siberia: What we know about the quarantine for suspected pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Authorities in Irkutsk Oblast restricted access and quarantined several hospitals in the Siberian region amid suspected pneumonic plague, though officials have not confirmed the disease. Independent outlets cited possible plague cases among staff, but Rospotrebnadzor says the 28-year-old woman who worked at the Institute of Anti-Plague Research of Siberia and the Far East died from pneumonia of unknown origin; tests found no pathogens linked to her work. Four facilities reportedly remained in quarantine, with visitation bans up to three weeks. Contacts included two people positive for a common-cold–causing virus and two for COVID-19; others tested negative. Two exposure scenarios are under study: recent travel to Thailand or an accidental laboratory incident. The governor convened an emergency meeting; the Shélejov aluminum plant urged precautionary masking. No official confirmation of pneumonic plague exists.

article.articleHeadline: Dżuma w Rosji. To ona była pacjentką zero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague in Russia. She was patient zero.
article.articleSummary: Darja Szypiłowa, a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Institute Against Plague, ruptured a vial containing Yersinia pestis on September 25. She deteriorated and was hospitalized in Szelechowo, dying October 1–2 from pneumonic plague, per sources cited by The Insider via Baikal People. Hospital quarantine followed; contacts were tested and isolated, with ambulances carrying contacts escorted by Federal Security Service cars from October 1. Telegram channels speculated infection during a work trip to Buryatia, but the regional head denied any local plague foci near the Mongolian border. Her family alleges misdiagnosis as severe COVID-19 and late antibiotics. Szypiłowa, who graduated in 2022 from Irkutsk State Medical University, is described as patient zero; one theory links infection to Thailand. Outside the security zone, personnel wore protective suits and masks, and personal items and phones were prohibited.

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения Эболой в Конго превысило 8,5 тыс. человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infection cases in Congo has surpassed 8,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 8,500 infections. As of October 3, 2026, the Ministry reports 8,544 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,114 deaths, with 824 patients currently in isolation or hospitalized. Case fatality stands at 48.2%, while contact-tracing efficiency is 73.8%. Response measures continue across seven provinces and 64 affected health zones. The milestone follows earlier reports of rising tolls and the World Health Organization noting the virus had spread to new areas. In response, authorities have launched mass vaccination campaigns to curb transmission. The outbreak remains ongoing, with health authorities intensifying monitoring and vaccination efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Punjab to intensify Hepatitis C screening, strengthen transfusion safety
article.articleSummary: Punjab will intensify Hepatitis C screening and bolster transfusion safety, targeting a lower Hepatitis C positivity rate through rigorous screening, early treatment linkage, comprehensive tracking, and strict blood-safety protocols. Health minister Dr Balbir Singh announced during National Voluntary Blood Donation Day celebrations in Chandigarh, pledging expanded NAT and CLIA testing to shrink diagnostic windows and curb transmissions of HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C. Punjab maintains 198 licensed blood centres (49 government, 7 military, 142 private/trust); in 2025-26, 5,44,167 units were collected across 6,583 camps, with government centres contributing 1,78,382 units, of which 1,77,583 (about 99.6%) came from voluntary donors. Four focal areas aim to transform transfusion services and healthcare, including motivating youth to donate and transitioning from ‘Star Donors’ to ‘Star Motivators.’ Districts Patiala and Sangrur were best performers; Pathankot is a Saksham District; Fazilka, Muktsar, Amritsar, Kapurla, Mohali and Bathinda named Surakshit Districts. HIV 95-95-95 cascade milestones were also highlighted.

The reports contemplate whether a plague outbreak has begun in the region and draw comparisons to a Wuhan laboratory incident. The piece explains differences between bubonic and pneumonic plague, highlighting the potential for human-to-human transmission with pneumonic forms. Public health authorities and laboratories are monitoring for onward spread, with the United States also tracking developments. Dated 2026-10-05, the article centers on initial cases and containment measures without confirmation of a larger outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: बदायूं में बुखार का कहर: डीएम के तेवर से जागा स्वास्थ्य महकमा, सर्वा गांव में 75 लोग बुखार से पीड़ित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever wreaks havoc in Badaun: DM's stern stance spurs the health department into action; 75 people in Sarva village are afflicted with fever.
article.articleSummary: On 5 October 2026, in Sarva village of Bisouli tehsil, Badaun district, Uttar Pradesh, 75 residents were found to have fever. District Magistrate Avnish Rai ordered a rapid health response; a team led by the SDM Bisouli with AC MO, MOIC and health workers conducted door-to-door checks. Initial laboratory tests ruled out malaria (52 parasite tests negative), dengue (30 negative; one dengue ELISA sample sent for confirmation), and typhoid (10 samples negative). Health officials note that prior antibiotic or antimalarial use may mask early infections, potentially yielding negative results in initial testing; symptoms may evolve in 1-2 days. Nine people with viral fever were already admitted to private hospitals. No definitive diagnosis yet; authorities remain vigilant and continue monitoring.

article.articleHeadline: Javier Clemente (76 años): 'Entrenar a Camerún es lo más difícil que he tenido en la vida. Eto'o me contó que era tradición que el capitán llevase siempre a dos o tres de su cuerda. Fuimos a Mauricio, que es como jugar contra el tonto de la bellota y en Congo entró el cólera'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Javier Clemente (76 years old): 'Coaching Cameroon is the hardest thing I've ever had to do. Eto'o told me that it was a tradition for the captain to always bring along two or three of his own men. We went to Mauritius, which is like playing against the village idiot, and in Congo cholera broke out.'
article.articleSummary: Javier Clemente, a 76-year-old Basque football manager, recalls his toughest assignment coaching Cameroon (2010–2011). After a 3-0 victory in Mauritius, Cameroon faced Congo, where a cholera outbreak struck as they prepared for a match, prompting vaccination of all players on Thursday before Friday kickoff. Clemente confronted captain Samuel Eto'o over a long-standing custom of two to three trusted players accompanying the squad, a dispute that implicated the Cameroonian minister of Sports, Michael Zoah. The minister ultimately intervened to reinstate Benoît Assou-Ekotto after Clemente had expelled him. Amid tensions and a fragile setup, the federation dismissed Clemente in 2011 after failing to secure funds for the continental competition (the 2012 Africa Cup of Nations).

article.articleHeadline: Plague may have resurfaced in Russia. But this isn't the Black Death. -- Meduza
article.articleSummary: On Oct 1, 2026, the district hospital in Shelekhov, Irkutsk region, closed after a suspected 'especially dangerous infection.' Reports name 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute, as deceased from pneumonic plague, though authorities say pneumonia of unknown cause pending confirmation. Plague persists but is far less common and has not caused a pandemic since the mid-20th century; transmission is mainly from wild animals, with pneumonic plague spreading between people via respiratory droplets during prolonged close contact. Without treatment, bubonic plague mortality is 30–60%; pneumonic plague can reach 100%. Early treatment within two days improves outcomes. WHO advises antibiotics for anyone within 2 meters of a plague patient in the past 10 days. Russia has 11 endemic foci, but in 2025 the bacterium was detected in only 3. Vaccination occurs for tens of thousands annually, but protection fades and boosters are required ( yearly or every six months if risk worsens). Globally, plague remains most common in the DRC and Madagascar, with an ongoing Ebola outbreak in DRC.

triage.notes: 主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での肺ペスト疑い死亡例であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（DRC、マダガスカル等）は『世界的にペストが多い地域』としての背景情報として言及されているに過ぎず、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。確定診断待ちの段階であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dug Wells and Crowded Cities: New Model Maps Fecal Contamination Risk in
article.articleSummary: Nearly 95 million urban Indonesians draw part of drinking water from groundwater; about 68% lack safely managed drinking water. Among households using self-supplied groundwater as their main source, E. coli was detected in 69% of samples, and 21.2% exceeded the WHO high-risk threshold of 100 CFU/100 mL, a contamination linked to a 54% higher risk of diarrhea. Using a source–pathway–receptor framework calibrated to the SKAM-RT 2020 survey (21,829 households; 847 with dug-wells/boreholes; 619 analyzed), the study built a nationwide risk ranking to map microbial contamination risk. Four predictors remained: water source type (dug-wells vs drilled boreholes) with dug-wells at 2.9× higher odds of high E. coli, aquifer lithology, rainfall in months prior, and population density. Locations underlain by solid/volcanic rock showed ~40% lower odds than unconsolidated sediment or limestone. This work offers a cost-effective screening tool to focus safety measures where contamination risk is highest while piped water expansion continues.
