article.articleHeadline: NOVI SMRTONOSNI VIRUS U RUSIJI? Istraživačica umrla od upale pluća nepoznatog porekla, hitno se oglasili iz Amerike
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Deadly Virus in Russia? Female Researcher Died of Pneumonia of Unknown Origin; America Issues Urgent Statement.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old female researcher at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Research in Siberia and the Far East died of pneumonia of unknown origin; Russian authorities have not confirmed the cause. The World Health Organization warns pneumonic plague is highly contagious and can spread person-to-person via respiratory droplets, with incubation up to 24 hours and rapid onset of severe respiratory symptoms, often with blood-tinged sputum; untreated disease can be fatal within 18-24 hours, though early antibiotics are effective. About 200 people who were in contact with the researcher are under surveillance; the hospital in Shelekhov near the Mongolia border was quarantined. Authorities say there is no confirmed link to pathogens she worked with. U.S. officials are monitoring the case, calling for transparency; experts view it as a rare laboratory accident with limited spread potential. Globally (2019–2025), >3,800 suspected plague cases were reported in 10 countries, with 423 deaths, mainly in the DRC and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで新たな致死性ウイルス？ 原因不明の肺炎で女性研究者死亡、米国が緊急声明
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所研究者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストの可能性が指摘されているが、当局は原因を未確認としており、約200人の接触者が監視下にあるものの拡大は限定的と専門家は見ている。情報が確定していないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。DRC・マダガスカルは過去の世界的ペスト統計の文脈で言及されているのみで、本事例の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: НОВИ СМРТОНОСНИ ВИРУС У РУСИЈИ? Истраживачица умрла од упале плућа непознатог порекла, хитно се огласили из Америке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New deadly virus in Russia? A female researcher died of pneumonia of unknown origin; an urgent statement was issued from America.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is under investigation after a 28-year-old researcher at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Research in Russia died from pneumonia of unknown origin. Authorities say the exact cause remains unconfirmed and there is no evidence linking the illness to pathogens she handled; about 200 contacts are under surveillance in Irkutsk Oblast, Irkutsk city, and Shelekhov near the Mongolia border. The World Health Organization warns pneumonic plague is the most contagious form and can spread via respiratory droplets; incubation can be as short as 24 hours, with rapid onset of severe respiratory symptoms, sometimes with bloody sputum, and untreated disease can be fatal within 18-24 hours, though early antibiotics are effective. The U.S. and Moscow are monitoring the situation. Globally, six countries have confirmed plague cases (mostly DR Congo and Madagascar) with 423 deaths, and 10 countries reported over 3,800 suspected cases to WHO since 2019.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで新たな致死性ウイルス？原因不明の肺炎で研究者死亡、米国が緊急声明
triage.triage_reason: イルクーツクのペスト研究所研究者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストの可能性が調査中。重症度・異常性ともに高く、米露双方が監視体制を強化しているため、フルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: DRC・マダガスカルは世界的なペスト発生状況の統計として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題イベント（ロシア・イルクーツク）とは別件のため対象国リストから除外。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。確定診断（ペスト菌検出）はまだ行われていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Centros antiébola en Kivu del Norte (RDC) están cerca de su capacidad máxima, alerta MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola treatment centers in North Kivu (DRC) are nearing full capacity, MSF warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola treatment centers in North Kivu, DRC, are at capacity limits as MSF warns, with North Kivu accounting for about 40% of new confirmed cases in the country. By late August, 24% of new infections were in the province, fueling rapid spread. MSF reports space shortages force the transfer of confirmed patients to other centers, increasing transmission risk and compromising care quality. Butembo's MSF Ebola Treatment Center head, Stéphanie Hoffmann, says the crisis resembles firefighting a megafire with multiple outbreaks. Since the outbreak was declared May 15, the Congo has recorded 8,442 cases and 4,080 deaths, 2,213 recoveries, and 846 hospitalized or in isolation. Case fatality rate around 48.3%; contact tracing 73.1%. The outbreak affects 64 health zones across seven provinces, including Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North and South Kivu, and Ubangi del Sur. Uganda's outbreak linked to DRC ended Aug 26 with 20 cases, 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ治療センターがほぼ満床に、MSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.3%、累計8,442症例・4,080死亡という大規模かつ継続中のエボラアウトブレイクで、複数州・国境を越えた拡大実績（ウガンダ）があり、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連アウトブレイクは8月26日に終息（20症例、2死亡）と報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内で7州64保健地域に拡大中であり、治療キャパシティ逼迫が継続的な感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: सुपौल : 23 हजार पशुओं को लंपी से बचाव को लगेगा टीकाकरण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Supaul: Vaccination will be given to 23 thousand animals to protect against lumpy skin disease.
article.articleSummary: Supaul district, Bihar, launched an LSD (Lumpy Skin Disease) vaccination drive to protect 23,000 cattle in Chandpipar Ward 9 of the Chandpipar Panchayat in the Saraygarh block, with immunization conducted from October 5 to October 20. The program was inaugurated by Mukhiya Ganesh Ram and Animal Husbandry Officer Dr. Amitabh, who jointly cut the ribbon. Lumpy Skin Disease is a viral illness in cattle transmitted by biting flies and mosquitoes; affected animals develop nodules on the body, which rupture to form wounds, and commonly exhibit fever and swelling of the legs. The vaccination campaign aims to shield livestock in the area from LSD and prevent outbreak across the block.

triage.headline_ja: スパウル：2万3千頭の家畜をランピースキン病から守るためワクチン接種実施
triage.triage_reason: 動物のランピースキン病に対する予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な拡大は認められない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生当局による予防的ワクチン接種プログラムの告知記事であり、ヒト感染症としての緊急性は見られない。LSDは動物のみに感染するウイルス性疾患でヒトへの感染性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 18 nouveaux décès enregistrés en deux jours à Biakato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 18 new deaths recorded in two days at Biakato.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to surge in Ituri Province, with 18 deaths recorded in two days in Biakato, Mambasa territory, as of Oct 5, 2026. Since the outbreak began, over 4,100 people have died from Ebola, with nearly 75% of fatalities in Ituri, one of the epidemic's major hotspots. Local civil society actors say the upsurge reflects poor public awareness of preventive measures and multiple logistical difficulties hindering response teams. Key constraints include reduced mobility of health teams due to fuel shortages for the single ambulance serving Mandima Health Zone, and the absence of a mobile laboratory in Biakato; samples from suspected cases must be transported to Komanda, more than 100 kilometers away, delaying case investigations and contact tracing. In response, the WHO has deployed a rapid response team to the Mambasa and Mandima health zones to intensify interventions and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州エボラ出血熱：ビアカトで2日間に18人の新たな死亡が記録される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な拡大と多数の死亡（2日間で18人、累計4,100人以上）、対応体制の不備が確認されており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響の懸念からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが迅速対応チームを派遣しているが、燃料不足や移動検査室の不在など対応能力の限界が指摘されており、継続的な感染拡大のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Esto sabemos cuarentena hospitales Siberia sospecha brote peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This we know: quarantine of Siberian hospitals; suspected plague outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Quarantines have been imposed on four Siberian Irkutsk region hospitals amid suspected pneumonic plague, per independent Liudi Baikala. Hospital quarantines include a pediatric facility; visits restricted; patient-family contact limited; quarantines up to three weeks. Authorities say no official diagnosis of plague has been issued. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an emergency meeting; authorities are conducting health measures and contingency planning; all contacts of a patient are under medical observation; to date no one shows symptoms, and tests are negative. A 28-year-old female employee at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East died last week in a hospital in Shélejov. Rospotrebnadzor reports the diagnosis as pneumonia of unknown etiology. Two scenarios under study: infection in Thailand or possible accidental lab incident. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington is monitoring the situation; EU also follows closely; Russia calls for calm.

triage.headline_ja: これが分かっていること：シベリアの病院を隔離、ペスト流行の疑い
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州でペスト研究所職員の死亡と肺ペスト疑いにより複数病院が隔離されており、国際的な監視（米国務省・EU）も入っていることからIHR基準の複数該当が見込まれる。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州（シェレホフ、イルクーツク市）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイでの感染の可能性は2つの仮説の一つとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生国として確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 138 fall ill after consuming prasad at religious ceremony in Majuli
article.articleSummary: 138 people fell ill after consuming prasad at a religious ceremony in Teliyabari village, Majuli district, Assam. The ceremony was held on Saturday, with symptoms onset reported on Sunday, prompting medical attention for the affected individuals. They were admitted to Pitambar De Goswami Hospital at Garmur, where most are recovering. Majuli MLA Bhuban Gam, accompanied by Majuli district commissioner Ratul Chandra Pathak, visited the hospital to review care and directed authorities to ensure comprehensive treatment for all affected individuals. Officials said they will examine the food served at the ceremony and conduct tests to determine whether contamination caused the illness. The exact cause can be confirmed only after food samples are analyzed and the investigation is completed.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州マジュリの宗教儀式でプラサード（供物）を食べた138人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一の食中毒・食品汚染疑いの集団発生で、原因・感染性は未確認。ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、原因究明待ちのため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品汚染）の疑いで、感染症というより集団食中毒事例の可能性が高い。原因は食品サンプル分析待ち。地元当局（MLA、district commissioner）が対応中で、重症者は報告されていない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu: Anantapur outbreak raises fresh concerns in state
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza continues to spread in Andhra Pradesh, with the latest outbreak confirmed in Anantapur district. Since February 2024, initial epicentres were poultry farms in Chatagutla village, Podalakur mandal (Nellore district) and Gummalladibba, Kovur mandal. In 2025, eight epicentres across the state affected poultry in East Godavari, West Godavari, Eluru, Krishna, Kakinada and Kurnool; about 1.78 lakh birds were culled, with broader estimates of deaths or culling exceeding five lakh. A March 2025 human case involved a two-year-old girl from Narasaraopet in Palnadu district who died after infection. In February 2026, H5N1 resurfaced with confirmations in Annamayya and Chittoor districts; four locations were designated as outbreak epicentres, followed by Anantapur. Authorities are studying transmission routes, including migratory birds, movement of roosters and chickens across states, and poultry-product movement.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：アナンタプールでの発生が州内に新たな懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性(人的死亡例・大量殺処分)と異常性(ヒトH5N1感染死亡例の発生)の2つに該当し、複数州にまたがる継続的な拡大がみられるためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 2024年以降アンドラプラデシュ州内で断続的にH5N1が発生し、2025年3月にはヒト感染による死亡例（2歳女児）も確認されている。2026年2月以降、新たな発生地域（アンナマヤ、チットール、アナンタプール）が報告されており、渡り鳥や家禽移動によるさらなる拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Una mort en un laboratori de Sibèria encén les alarmes: Pesta pulmonar?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A death in a Siberian laboratory triggers alarms: Pneumonic plague?
article.articleSummary: In Shelekhov, Irkutsk region, a 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Siberian Anti-Plague Research Institute died of pneumonia of undetermined origin, triggering international health alerts over a possible pneumonic plague. Russia's Rospotrebnadzor classifies the case as pneumonia of unclear etiology. The EU Commission says it is monitoring closely with ECDC/WHO, seeking timely, transparent data. Two scenarios: infection contracted in Thailand, from which the worker had recently returned, or an accidental breach of a pathogen-containing tube at the institute. Rospotrebnadzor says no work-related microorganisms were found in samples and regional epidemiology is stable; none of her contacts have fallen ill or tested positive. Quarantine measures cover the hospital area; other regional hospitals reportedly restricted admissions; numbers under observation range from dozens to about 200. Aluminum plant nearby urged masks; authorities urge calm. Virologist Rasmussen notes pneumonic plague is deadly but not highly transmissible, requiring high exposure.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの研究所で死亡者、肺ペストの疑いで警戒
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の肺炎による研究所技師の死亡がロシア・EU・WHO/ECDCレベルで国際的な警戒を引き起こしており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすため。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州シェレホフで発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染源の可能性として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での症例確認や発生の記述はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Υπό διερεύνηση το ύποπτο κρούσμα πανώλης στη Ρωσία - 189 άτομα υπό παρακολούθηση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Suspected plague case in Russia under investigation — 189 people under surveillance.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization is monitoring reports of a suspected plague case in eastern Siberia, Russia, after a female worker died at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Control on Oct 2. Official confirmation of plague as the cause has not been established. About 189 people are under medical surveillance due to possible exposure; about 197 contacts reported, with 189 under hospital or close medical monitoring. No symptomatic secondary cases have been reported to date. The case has prompted extensive contact tracing and preventive measures in regional hospitals. While pneumonic plague is possible and can spread via respiratory droplets between close contacts, laboratory tests are not yet confirming Yersinia pestis. The WHO states it has advised and supported Russian authorities, and that all known contacts are being tracked. Globally, plague remains endemic in parts of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, but no confirmed outbreak in Russia.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:ロシアでペスト疑い症例を調査中—189人を経過観察
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究施設職員の死亡例があり肺ペストの可能性が指摘されているが、病原体確認は未了で二次感染例も報告なし。対象国（ロシア）はリスト外のため情報不足の経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア(イルクーツク)であり対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。DRC・マダガスカルは地理的言及（流行地としての言及）であり、本事例の発生国ではないため除外。病原体確認（Yersinia pestis）がまだなされていない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Health team surveys 7,858 homes for mosquito larvae | Kanpur News
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, Kanpur district health teams surveyed 7,858 premises for mosquito larvae, inspected 895 houses, and found larvae in 26; larval sources were destroyed in 42 houses. Residents were advised to prevent standing water, avoid waterlogging, use mosquito protection measures, and wear clothing that fully covers the body. A malaria department team conducted on-site dengue case verification in Sanigawan, performing fever surveys, testing, source reduction and public awareness activities, according to district malaria officer Arun Kumar Singh. In Chandar Nagar health camp, seven patients were tested for malaria, dengue and typhoid; none tested positive for malaria. Preventive measures were completed for two dengue cases reported in Sharda Nagar and Manjhavan-Ramaipur in Copperganj.

triage.headline_ja: 健康チームが蚊の幼虫調査のため7,858世帯を調査 | カンプルニュース
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性デング・マラリア対策活動を報じる内容であり、異常な拡大や重症化の兆候はなく、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による日常的な蚊媒介性疾患サーベイランス・予防活動の報告であり、流行拡大の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: திருவள்ளூா் பகுதியில் தொழிற்சாலை, நிறுவனங்களில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் தடுப்பு நடவடிக்கை: தொழிலக பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் சுகாதாரத்துறையினா் வலியுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever prevention measures in factories and establishments in the Tiruvallur area: Labour safety and health departments stress.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, dengue prevention measures are being enforced in factories and establishments in Tiruvallur district, near Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Director of Labour Safety and Health Ilangovan and Deputy Director Kavitha Divya ordered immediate action. Factories in Chennai-adjacent areas including Tiruvallur, Kummidipondi and SIDCO must remove mosquito-breeding items—drums, tires, plates, tins, and other containers—and keep water tanks tightly closed. Daily cleaning of drains and wastewater channels, and ensuring rainwater drainage is functional, are required, with weekly inspections for potential breeding sites. Remove water-holding materials promptly; apply larvicides in water bodies; trim shrubs and maintain grounds. Install mosquito nets and screens where feasible. If breeding sites are found, workers should report, and those with fever with severe headache, body pains, or rash should be sent to hospital. Each factory should form a dengue-prevention committee or appoint a health officer and report actions with photos to Tiruvallur and Chennai districts.

triage.headline_ja: ティルヴァッルール地域の工場・事業所におけるデング熱予防対策：労働安全衛生局が強調
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の恒常的な予防・啓発活動を伝える行政指導の記事であり、症例急増や異常な流行拡大の報告はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の予防対策（蚊の発生源除去、委員会設置等）に関する行政指示を報じるもので、実際の感染者数増加や異常発生を示すデータは含まれていない。毎年の季節的対策の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: साइबेरिया में 'किलर प्लेग' से हड़कंप: एक महिला टेक्नीशियन की मौत, क्या भारत पर भी मंडरा रहा है खतरा? - siberia pneumonic plague death sparks concern in russia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Killer Plague Sparks Panic in Siberia: Death of a Female Technician, Is India Also at Risk?
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, in Siberia’s Irkutsk region near Shelekhov, a 28-year-old female technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute reportedly died last week from suspected pneumonic plague, triggering a hospital quarantine and heightened surveillance for about 200 people connected to the facility. Russian authorities assert the deceased had pneumonia of unknown origin with no conclusive evidence linking it to plague pathogens; however, some local reports claim pneumonic plague. The hospital’s quarantine, suspension of admissions/discharges, and ongoing tests reflect precautionary measures. Among those exposed, two developed common cold viruses and two tested positive for COVID-19; others were negative. The nearby Irkutsk Aluminum Plant has made masking mandatory for workers. U.S. officials say the case is being watched without panic, while India currently sees no immediate threat. Indian Medical Association notes plague is caused by Yersinia pestis with bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic forms; pneumonic plague is most dangerous and can be fatal within 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで『殺人ペスト』騒動:女性技師が死亡、インドにも脅威か?
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所関連施設で技師が肺ペスト疑いで死亡し、約200人が曝露監視下に置かれ隔離措置が取られている。異常性・重篤性が高くIHR基準2項目に該当するため精査が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドは『脅威はない』という文脈で言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。ロシア当局は肺ペストとの確定的関連性を否定しており、原因不明の肺炎として扱っている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 中共內部預估疫情將持續半年 二千萬人死亡 | 中國疫情 | 病毒變强 | 火化場
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCP internal estimates the outbreak will last six months; 20 million people dead | China's outbreak | the virus grows stronger | crematoriums
article.articleSummary: China faces a renewed COVID-19 crisis during the October holidays, with crematorium data indicating a surge in deaths among young to middle-aged adults—predominantly 20s–40s; the youngest death recorded as 25 after overnight shifts in Shandong. An official (pseudonym Chen) warns that holiday travel has accelerated spread, and infection-driven inflammation can trigger a hypercoagulable state leading to thrombosis and sudden death, with younger patients affected. The circulating variants are BA.3.2, carrying about 70–75 spike protein mutations, roughly double those of the earlier JN.1; the newer PJ.2.1 variant has 78 mutations and stronger receptor binding. Authorities estimate the outbreak could last until April 2027, with as many as 20 million deaths. Nucleic acid testing has been intensified and multiple strains may be active (3–4 lineages). Some Sichuan residents allege concealment by authorities, fueling public concern.

triage.headline_ja: 中共内部予測：流行は半年続き2000万人死亡か｜中国の感染状況｜ウイルス強毒化｜火葬場
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株の出現や若年層の急死、2000万人死亡という極端な予測など複数の懸念材料があり、社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価への移行を検討すべきだが、情報源（NTDTV）の信頼性・匿名情報への依存に強い留意が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はNTDTV（大紀元系）による報道で、匿名の「陳氏」情報源や四川住民の隠蔽告発など未検証情報に基づく。2000万人死亡予測やBA.3.2・PJ.2.1変異株の詳細（70〜78個のスパイク変異）はWHOや中国当局の公式発表との照合が取れておらず、信頼性に強い留保が必要。フルRRAに進める場合は独立した公式情報源（WHO、中国CDC等）による裏付けを最優先で確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitària per pesta pulmonar a Rússia després de la mort d'una dona: què se'n sap?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert for pneumonic plague in Russia after the death of a woman: what is known?
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague suspicion in Russia after the death of a laboratory worker in the Siberian Irkutsk region. The victim, Daria Shipilova (28), who worked at the Irkutsk and Far East plague research institute, died after pneumonia; two scenarios under review: infection in Thailand or an accidental exposure from a pathogen tube at the workplace. Authorities have not officially confirmed plague; Rospotrebnadzor cites pneumonia of undetermined etiology. Reports suggest up to about 200 people are under observation, though officials say currently no symptoms and tests are negative. Regional hospitals have been quarantined for up to three weeks with strict visitation bans. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is the most virulent form and can spread via respiratory droplets, with a potentially 24-hour incubation. The EU (ECDC) is monitoring closely; the US has issued an alert but says there is no cause for alarm.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペスト警戒、女性死亡を受けて：何が分かっているか
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の死亡と原因不明肺炎による地域病院の隔離措置があり、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性に該当し、国際機関（ECDC・米国）も注視していることから社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染経路の仮説の一つとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ロシア自体の感染拡大・原因は現時点で未確定（公式にはペスト未確認、原因不明肺炎として扱われている）。

article.articleHeadline: NanoViricides Provides Additional Details on the Phase II Clinical Trial of NV-387 Oral Gummies as a Treatment for Ebola as the Outbreak Continues to Expand and Has Taken Over 4,000 Lives
article.articleSummary: NV-387 Oral Gummies (NVC NV-387) pursuing Phase II for Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease (BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Phase IIA enrollment began Sept 23, 2026, with a small, cautious sample to establish a tolerable dosage regimen; Phase IIB will be a randomized trial to evaluate efficacy. NV-387 aims to reduce viral load; achieving undetectable levels could enable recovery, though organ recovery may lag and some damage could persist. The BDBV outbreak is expanding: Ituri stabilized but Nord Kivu now accounts for about 40% of national confirmed cases, with limited treatment capacity (29 beds in centers, ~20 transit beds). As of Oct 2, 2026, confirmed cases reached 8,300 and deaths 4,018 (crude CFR ~48%; IFR ~67%). Eastern DRC experiences new cases under rebel control; thousands of refugees fled a camp after deaths, raising spread risk. The USA has provided nearly $1.4B in humanitarian aid. COMPETING efforts include PARTNERS (MBP134, Remdesivir) and obeldesivir PEP trials; NV-387 offers an orally deployable alternative potentially harder for the virus to escape.

triage.headline_ja: NanoViricides社、エボラ治療薬NV-387経口グミ剤の第II相臨床試験について追加詳細を発表 ― 感染拡大が続き死者4,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例8,300例・死者4,018例（致死率約48%）に達する大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が拡大中であり、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確。
triage.notes: 米国は人道支援資金拠出国として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。北キブ州・イトゥリ州はDRC国内の州であり、DRCとして集約。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitaria por peste pulmonar en Rusia tras la muerte de una mujer: ¿qué se sabe?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert for pneumonic plague in Russia after a woman's death: what is known?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-05, Russia reports a suspected pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region, Siberia, after the death of 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, a worker at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East. She died after pneumonia symptoms required ventilatory support in Shelekhov. Hospitals in the region have been quarantined for up to three weeks; authorities say nearly 200 people are under medical observation, but no one is symptomatic and all tests to date are negative. Two infection scenarios are under review: acquisition in Thailand or an accidental lab incident involving a broken tube containing pathogens. The disease is caused by Yersinia pestis; pneumonic plague is highly virulent and transmissible via respiratory droplets, though early treatment within 24 hours improves outcomes. The European Commission is monitoring with ECDC; the United States has issued a precautionary alert but says it is not alarm.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペストによる女性の死亡、公衆衛生警戒：何がわかっているか
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでペスト研究所職員が肺ペストで死亡し、実験室事故の可能性や国際的な監視（ECDC・米国の警戒）があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。タイでの感染可能性は推測段階であり、確定した発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めなかった。実験室事故説が有力視されており、バイオセーフティ上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: واکنش کرملین به گزارش‌ها درباره طاعون در روسیه: به شایعات و سخنان بی‌اساس توجه نکنید
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Kremlin's response to reports about the plague in Russia: Do not pay attention to rumors and baseless statements.
article.articleSummary: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov urged the public to ignore rumors of plague in Russia, directing scrutiny to official statements from Rosptotrebnadzor. The federal service said the health and epidemiological situation in Irkutsk and Shlkhov remained stable after rumors of pneumonic plague circulated. A female employee of the Institute of Anti-Plague Science died on 10 Mehr 1405 from pneumonia of unknown origin; extensive laboratory testing found no microorganisms linked to plague in her samples, and none of her colleagues reported infectious symptoms in the prior 10 days. Rosptotrebnadzor reiterated that plague foci along Russia’s borders—near Kazakhstan, Mongolia, China, Azerbaijan, and Georgia—remain under surveillance, with 11 internal and 7 cross-border natural foci identified. In 2026, animal plague activity has been reported in the border region with Mongolia. Infectious-disease expert Genady Onishchenko says the case is unlikely plague; incubation is about seven days, and plague is bacterial and antibiotic-responsive.

triage.headline_ja: クレムリン、ロシアでのペストに関する報道に反応：噂や根拠のない発言に注意を払わないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: イルクーツクでの肺ペスト疑い例はロシア当局の検査で否定され、感染症の病原体は検出されていない。公式に『状況は安定』としており、現時点で確認された感染症イベントとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（イルクーツク州）での肺ペスト疑惑に対するクレムリンおよびロシア疾病管理当局（Rospotrebnadzor）による否定声明。検査の結果ペスト菌は検出されず、死亡例は原因不明の肺炎とされている。対象国リストにロシアは含まれず、言及されている中国・モンゴル等は国境監視対象として触れられているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯疑出现肺鼠疫病例　鲁比奥：美方密切关注暂毋须恐慌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia reports suspected pneumonic plague cases; Rubio: U.S. closely monitoring, no need to panic for now.
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a suspected pneumonic plague case after a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Irkutsk region, fell ill and died; no confirmation of pneumonic plague has been issued. The incident arose when a vial containing pneumonic plague pathogen was broken at lab. The deceased, a 27–28-year-old woman named Daria Shipilova, was admitted with severe pneumonia on Sept 29 and died Oct 1 after three days in hospital. About 197 people with possible exposure are under medical quarantine or observation; Irkutsk hospitals have implemented isolation. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says the death was due to pneumonia with undetermined cause. U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, say there is no need to panic but the situation will be closely monitored; the State Department and CDC are following developments. Hong Kong Health Protection Center notes pneumonic plague is highly contagious via respiratory droplets and carries a high fatality risk if not treated promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペスト疑い症例、ルビオ米国務長官「米国は注視、今はパニックの必要なし」
triage.triage_reason: 研究所内感染とみられる肺ペスト疑い例で死亡者が発生し、約197人が隔離・観察下にあるなど公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が認められ、国際的な関心（米国務省・CDCの監視）も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。記事中の米国・中国・香港への言及は反応・注意喚起のみで発生国ではない。確定診断は未発表（原因不明の重症肺炎として報告）。

article.articleHeadline: Russian Lab Worker Dead, 200 Under Observation After Suspected Lab Leak in Siberia
article.articleSummary: An Irkutsk laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East died last Friday from pneumonia of undetermined origin. The 28-year-old (Daria Shipilova) had recently returned from trips to the Mongolian border and possibly Thailand; authorities say the death is not confirmed as linked to a lab leak. About 200 people who had contact with her are under observation; two hospitals and a local children's clinic were quarantined, with rumors of the Institute also under restriction. Public events in Irkutsk were canceled, and some eyewitnesses reported protective-suit teams in the streets. The WHO said no cause of death has been officially confirmed and that the public-health risk to the general population appears low; all contacts have been identified and monitored, with no illnesses reported so far. The U.S. State Department urged transparency; no microorganisms linked to her professional activity were detected in samples.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのラボ職員死亡、シベリアでの研究所流出疑惑を受け200人が経過観察下に
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の肺炎による研究所職員の死亡、検疫措置、WHO・米国務省の関与など国際的関心が高く、IHR基準の2項目（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。ただし対象国での発生ではない点に留意。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストには含まれない。タイはへ渡航歴として言及されているのみで発生地ではないため除外。モンゴルも国境訪問歴の言及にとどまり対象国リスト外。WHOは一般住民へのリスクは低いとコメントしているが、原因病原体が未確定であり続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Plague Death Sparks Outbreak Concerns. Should We Be Worried?
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague death at a plague research institute in southeastern Russia triggers quarantine of dozens of contacts near Shelekhov. Officials say risk to the United States is very low; U.S. State Department and the CDC are monitoring developments, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying there’s no cause for alarm. All individuals who had contact with the lab worker have been identified, examined, and placed under medical observation with daily laboratory tests. Pneumonic plague, which infects the lungs, can spread via airborne droplets and is the most dangerous; it is curable with antibiotics if treated within about 24 hours, but untreated it can be fatal in 1–6 days. Plague remains rare today, with occasional cases in the western United States, Asia, and Africa; the Black Death killed tens of millions in 14th-century Europe and Eurasia. As of Oct. 5, no infections among contacts have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: 疑わしいペスト感染死亡が発生、アウトブレイクへの懸念が高まる。心配すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所職員が肺ペストで死亡し、濃厚接触者が隔離されるなど異常な事態であり、空気感染の可能性がある致死的感染症のため、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア（イルクーツク州シェレホフ）の研究所職員に関するもので、対象国リストに該当する国は含まれていない。タイ（バンコク）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、Bluedotの誤判定と考えられるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 2,500 country chickens die as bird flu hits Anantapur poultry farm in Andhra Pradesh
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed at a poultry farm in Siddarampuram village, Bukkarayasamudram mandal, Anantapur district, Andhra Pradesh, after around 2,500 country chickens died. The outbreak followed introduction of new birds reportedly from Adilabad, Telangana; samples were sent to NIHSAD, Bhopal, with confirmation received. Authorities imposed a 10-km containment radius, quarantined the premises and associated materials (eggs, poultry manure, silage, soil), and disposed of dead birds by burial or cremation. Movement of chickens and eggs into and out of the village is restricted for three months; police deployed to enforce measures. Residents urged to report fever, cold or breathing difficulty and to follow official advisories on handling/consumption of poultry products. The incident echoes February 2025 APwide outbreaks (over 5 lakh birds culled) and February 2024 Nellore farm cases, highlighting ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州アナンタプルの養鶏場で鳥インフルエンザが発生、在来鶏2,500羽が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（動物）における鳥インフルエンザの発生であり、ヒトの感染例は報告されていない。封じ込め措置は取られているが、過去にも同様の発生が繰り返されており、人獣共通感染症としての監視継続が必要なためWATCHと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽（鶏）の鳥インフルエンザ発生に関するもので、ヒトの感染報告はない。アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州当局による検疫・移動制限・殺処分等の対応が取られている。過去（2025年2月、2024年2月）にも同地域で類似の発生歴があり、継続的なサーベイランス対象。テランガーナ・マディヤプラデーシュは発生地ではなく、感染源や検査機関の所在地として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Российскую Сибирь, вероятно, всколыхнула эпидемия чумы: масштабы пандемии и сам факт распространения болезни российские власти скрывают - что известно
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A plague outbreak probably rocked Russian Siberia: the scale of the pandemic and the very fact of the disease's spread are being concealed by the Russian authorities — what is known.
article.articleSummary: Bubonic plague outbreak in Russia's Siberia, Irkutsk region, with one death and about 200 people placed under quarantine. Authorities closed hospitals and imposed quarantine on the Shelekhov area, with mask mandates at an Irkutsk aluminum plant. The first victim, 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, an employee at the anti-plague research institute, died around October 2; suspicions point to either a broken vial or exposure during a work trip to Buryatia, though no official cause has been confirmed. Laboratory tests reportedly found no pathogens linked to her work; officials say the death was due to pneumonia of unknown etiology and that the epidemiological situation in Irkutsk and the Shelekhov district remains stable. International attention followed media coverage (The Sun; White House monitoring). Ukrainians say cross-border spread is unlikely; Madagascar and Congo remain active plague foci.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア・シベリアでペスト流行の疑い：パンデミックの規模と感染拡大の事実をロシア当局が隠蔽している可能性—判明していること
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州での腺ペスト関連死亡と約200人の検疫という重大事案だが、対象国（ロシアは対象外）に該当せず、公式な死因も未確定で情報が錯綜しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中にDRCとマダガスカルへの言及があるが、これらは既知のペスト常在地としての一般的言及であり、本記事の主題イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Le virus de la peste s'est-il échappé d'un laboratoire russe ? Le décès d'une employée sème le trouble, le Kremlin réagit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did the plague virus escape from a Russian laboratory? The death of a female employee raises concerns, the Kremlin reacts.
article.articleSummary: In Siberia, 28-year-old laboratory technician Daria Shipilova died Friday; officially attributed to pneumonia, but local and independent Russian media report she may have been infected after breaking a tube containing Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes pneumonic plague. The incident has sparked scrutiny of a biosafety lab. The Kremlin says the situation is under control and urges reliance on Health Ministry statements, while authorities quarantined about 200 colleagues and contacts and five regional hospitals as a precaution. The United States monitors developments with caution. Pneumonic plague is the most severe form of plague, transmitted by coughing and potentially fatal within two days without rapid antibiotic treatment. Plague cases persist annually in Madagascar, the Congo, China, and the United States (Rocky Mountains). Infectiologist Yves Van Laethem cautions that Yersinia pestis is a classic biowarfare agent, raising questions about the lab’s purpose. No public proof supports the allegations yet.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト菌はロシアの研究所から流出したのか？ 女性職員の死亡が波紋を広げ、クレムリンが反応
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所でペスト菌（肺ペスト）流出の疑いによる死亡事例が発生し、異常性・深刻性ともに高く、バイオセーフティ上の懸念から国際的な注目も集まっているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 主たる事案はロシア（シベリア）での研究所関連の死亡例であり、対象国リストに該当する国（DRC・中国など）は過去の流行地としての背景説明に過ぎず、本イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Російську Сибір, імовірно, сколихнула епідемія Чуми: масштаби пандемії і сам факт поширення хвороби російська влада приховує - що відомо
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian Siberia, apparently shaken by a plague outbreak: the scale of the pandemic and the very fact of the disease's spread are being concealed by the Russian authorities — what is known.
article.articleSummary: Bubonic plague outbreak reportedly hits Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia: one death and nearly 200 people placed in quarantine after contact tracing. Officials describe limited evidence and have shifted language from dangerous infection to pneumonia of unknown etiology. The first victim, Darya Shipilova, 28, a staff member at a preventive research institute; infection source remains disputed—rumors include a broken vial or exposure during a business trip to Buryatia. Laboratory results reportedly found no pathogens linked to her work. The governor says the situation is stable in Irkutsk and the Shelekhov district; two Irkutsk hospitals are quarantined, and mask use is enforced at the Irkutsk Aluminum Plant in Shelekhov. Anna Popova flew from Moscow to Irkutsk to lead response but remains silent. The White House is monitoring; Ukrainian expert Natalia Vinograd says the outbreak is unlikely to spread widely in Russia, and there are no plague foci in Ukraine. Madagascar and Congo remain current plague foci.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア・シベリアで腺ペストの流行か：パンデミックの規模と感染拡大の事実自体をロシア当局が隠蔽―何がわかっているか
triage.triage_reason: イルクーツク州で腺ペストによる死亡例が報告され、約200人が隔離対象となるなど重大性が疑われる一方、当局が診断名を変更し情報を隠蔽している疑いがあり、異常性・公衆衛生リスクの観点からIHR基準を2つ満たすため精査が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントはロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）が主な発生地であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。記事中で言及されるマダガスカル・コンゴ民主共和国は『既存のペスト流行地』としての比較言及であり、本記事の主題ではないため除外。当局による情報隠蔽・診断名変更の疑いがあり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲:刚果(金)战乱中抗击埃博拉
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Fighting Ebola in war-torn DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo amid armed conflict. In Ituri Province, Mambasa Health Zone reports 29 confirmed cases; Nia-Nia Health Zone reports 293 cases. Attacks by Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) threaten mining areas and hinder response, with security incidents along the border with Nord Kivu. UN MONUSCO has redeployed to Mambasa and established a mobile base at Nia-Nia, conducting joint patrols with the Congolese army and coordinating with WHO to facilitate humanitarian access. In Mamove and Sayo, military presence has broadened patrols, though some youths pose potential risks. Ebola burial teams are sometimes attacked; seven Ebola-related funerals were conducted with security support at Bundji, Vulindi, and Kitovo cemeteries in Nord Kivu a week earlier. Ongoing challenges include ambushes, vehicle theft, and crime obstructing outbreak response and access to communities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：戦乱下のコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱と闘う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で300件超の確定エボラ症例が報告され、武装勢力による攻撃やMONUSCO・WHOの介入など、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的対応が必要な状況であるためフルRRAへ移行。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれるロシア（Ivanovskaya Oblast'、Kitovo）は地名の偶然の一致によるBluedotの誤分類と判断し、verified_locationsから除外した。MambasaおよびNia-Nia保健ゾーン（イトゥリ州）での症例集積が主要な発生地。

article.articleHeadline: Assessment of the zoonotic spillover potential of SARS-CoV-2-related coronaviruses from Rhinolophus pusillus bats in Thailand
article.articleSummary: In Ratchaburi, Thailand, 261 Rhinolophus pusillus bats carried coronaviruses at a 16.47% prevalence, including SARS-CoV-2–related lineages. Five complete SARS-CoV-2–related coronavirus genomes were recovered, with one, RpuRB21065, showing high spike and receptor-binding domain similarity to SARS-CoV-2. The RBD bound human ACE2, and the spike protein induced syncytia in vitro. However, sera from SARS-CoV-2–vaccinated individuals effectively neutralized RpuRB21065, suggesting pre-existing SARS-CoV-2 immunity may mitigate current spillover risk. The study serves as proof-of-concept that proactive wildlife surveillance in emerging infectious disease hotspots can yield information with direct public health relevance, even without viral isolation. Findings underscore the value of wildlife monitoring at human–wildlife interfaces in informing pandemic risk assessment in Thailand and similar settings, without reporting any human cases at this time.

triage.headline_ja: タイのコキクガシラコウモリ（Rhinolophus pusillus）におけるSARS-CoV-2関連コロナウイルスのズーノーティック溢出可能性の評価
triage.triage_reason: SARS-CoV-2関連ウイルスの人動物間インターフェースでのコウモリからの溢出リスク評価研究であるが、人での感染症事例報告がなく、現在の溢出リスクはSARS-CoV-2ワクチン免疫により軽減される可能性が高い。予防的サーベイランスの重要性を示す学術報告であり、即座の公衆衛生的脅威はないが、感染症ホットスポットでの監視継続の観点から経過観察が適切である。
triage.notes: 本事例は人での感染症発症を報告していない学術研究である。Rhinolophus pusillus コウモリにおけるSARS-CoV-2関連ウイルスの検出は異常/予想外（WPRO基準）であり、流行しやすさ潜在性があると判断される。しかしながら、ワクチン免疫による中和効果が示唆され、現在の直接的な公衆衛生脅威は低い。パンデミック予防戦略の観点から継続的なワイルドライフサーベイランスの重要性を示唆する報告であり、情報の発展的推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲:剛果(金)戰亂中抗擊埃博拉
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Fighting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid war.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo amid war. In Ituri province, Mambasa health zone reports 29 confirmed cases; Nia-Nia health zone 293 cases. Attacks by Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) concentrate in southern areas near Nord Kivu border, targeting mining sites. MONUSCO has redeployed to Mambasa and opened a mobile base in Nia-Nia, conducting joint patrols with the Congolese military to coordinate with WHO for outbreak response access. In Mamove and Sayo, combat units extend patrol scope, though some local youths pose security risks. Ebola burial teams have been attacked; seven funerals for Ebola victims were conducted a week earlier at Bundji, Vulindi, and Kitovo with security support in Nord Kivu. Overall, ambushes, vehicle theft, and crime continue to impede response and safe community access.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：コンゴ民主共和国、戦乱の中でエボラ対策
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例が複数地域で継続し、武力紛争により対応活動が妨害されるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援が必要な状況であるため。
triage.notes: ロシアの地域情報（Ivanovskaya Oblast, Kitovo）は記事内容と無関係で、Bluedotの地域誤判定と判断し除外した。Kitovoはコンゴ国内の地名として記事に登場するが、座標はロシアのものと重複している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mais um morcego com raiva é encontrado em Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another rabid bat found in Campo Grande.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, recorded the 13th rabies case in a bat in 2026 after confirmation of an infected animal in the Sargento Amaral neighborhood near Horto Florestal. The finding underscores circulation of the rabies virus in urban areas and the need for prevention measures to avoid contact with suspected animals. The Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) reported that of 988 bats collected for suspected disease this year, 13 tested positive for rabies. Despite confirmations, authorities say the situation is not a cause for panic, but requires vigilance. Anyone finding a bat—alive or dead—on the ground or entering homes should not touch it; isolate the area and contact CCZ for collection and lab analysis. Vaccination of dogs and cats is essential; rabies is a viral disease of the nervous system with 100% mortality after symptom onset and can be transmitted by bats and other mammals.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデで狂犬病に感染したコウモリがまた発見される
triage.triage_reason: 動物(コウモリ)での狂犬病確認であり、ヒトへの感染事例はなく、当局も「パニックになる必要はない」としている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められず、既存の監視体制で対応可能なため見送り。
triage.notes: 2026年に入り13件目のコウモリの狂犬病確認事例。ヒトへの感染報告はなく、都市部での野生動物との接触防止・ペットワクチン接種の呼びかけに留まる通常の公衆衛生対応。

article.articleHeadline: WATCH: Marco Rubio Issues Statement on Suspected Plague Outbreak in Russia - 100PercentFedUp.com - by Kaley
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia's Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, after a lab technician died last week from a test-tube incident at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute; localized quarantine measures are in place. Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the State Department is closely monitoring the situation, not a cause for alarm but a reason to stay vigilant, and urges Russia to share developments promptly. NBC News reports a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague in Irkutsk oblast. Pneumonic plague is highly infectious and deadly if untreated, with near 100% fatality, though early antibiotic treatment can reduce mortality to about 17%. The article recalls a historic pneumonic plague outbreak in Manchuria (1910–1911) that killed roughly 60,000 and was suppressed with widespread measures. The piece frames international concern and emphasizes transparency from Russian authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 【注目】マルコ・ルビオ、ロシアでの疑わしいペスト流行に関する声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所事故に起因する肺ペスト疑い例が発生し、致死率が高く異常な事象であること、米国務長官が公式声明を出すなど社会的・政治的関心が高まっていることからIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてロシア・イルクーツク州が記載されているが対象国リストに含まれない。中国（満洲里・内モンゴル）は1910-1911年の歴史的ペスト流行への言及のみで、現在の発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Muerte en laboratorio de peste en Siberia: qué se sabe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death in a plague laboratory in Siberia: What is Known.
article.articleSummary: Death in a plague research institute in Irkutsk, Siberia, linked to a potential pneumonic plague case, as of 5 October. Darya Shipilova, 28, a technician at the Institute of Anti-Plague Research in Irkutsk (Siberia and the Russian Far East), was hospitalized September 29 and died early October 2. Russian health authorities (Rospotrebnadzor) reported pneumonia of unknown origin; analyses found no microorganisms related to her work and no incidents with pathogens at the institute. About 200 people with potential contact are under medical observation or isolation; the Shelekhov hospital has restricted admissions though outpatient services continue. The United States is monitoring the situation with the CDC and other agencies; no confirmed pneumonic plague cases among contacts and no outbreak confirmed. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, spreads via respiratory droplets and requires laboratory confirmation; timely antibiotics are effective. WHO context notes plague remains present with historical endemism in Africa, Madagascar, DRC, and Peru.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアのペスト研究所での死亡事例：何が分かっているか
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所技術者の原因不明肺炎による死亡事例であり、肺ペストの可能性が否定できず、約200人が観察下に置かれ米国CDCも監視するなど社会的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 事例発生地はロシア・シベリア(Irkutsk)であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中のDRC・マダガスカル・ペルー等への言及はWHOによるペストの歴史的流行地域に関する一般的文脈であり、本イベントの発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana dengue cases jump 58% in 20 days; Gurgaon sees highest tally at 65
article.articleSummary:
Dengue in Haryana: 503 cases recorded by Oct 4, 2026, up 58.2% from 20 days earlier (185 new Sept 14–Oct 4; 23 on Oct 4). Gurgaon tops with 65 cases, followed by Panchkula (58), Jhajjar (50) and Rewari (45). No confirmed dengue deaths this year. Of 503 cases, 291 were reported by government hospitals and 212 by private facilities; 24 patients were admitted (13 govt, 11 private), 210 discharged, and 269 treated in OPDs. The state has tested 77,825 samples so far, with 27 dengue labs. Source reduction included 2.31 crore house visits up to Aug 31; larvae found in 64,834 houses and 33,796 notices issued. Symptoms include high fever, headache, body ache, weakness, and nausea; testing is advised for persistent fever. Five-year comparison shows 2021 11,837; 2022 8,997; 2023 8,083; 2024 6,469; 2025 2,626; 2026 503."} } )

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州のデング熱症例が20日間で58%増加；グルガオンが最多65件
triage.triage_reason: インドで毎年発生する季節性デング熱の通常の流行であり、死亡者なし、過去5年間と比較しても症例数は大幅に少なく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 2026年の症例数（503件）は過去5年間（2021年11,837件〜2025年2,626件）と比較して最も少なく、デング熱の季節性流行として通常の範囲内と考えられる。死亡者もゼロであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF alerte à son tour sur une "flambée inquiétante" au Nord-Kivu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF, in turn, warns of an "alarming flare-up" in North Kivu.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an alarming Ebola flare-up, with MSF reporting that nearly 40% of the country's new confirmed cases in September stemmed from this province, up from 24% at end-August. WHO had warned of exponential spread in mid-September and a weekly death toll doubling in the first half of the month. Since May, DRC has declared its 17th Ebola outbreak, spreading from Ituri to seven provinces, with Ituri, North Kivu, and Haut-Uele bearing most cases. By October 2, WHO counted 4,082 deaths among 8,463 cases linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. As of Sept 28, 34% of positive cases were treated in non-specialized facilities due to bed shortages and diagnostic delays, raising transmission risk. MSF calls for urgent mobilization to expand care and ensure quality services in Butembo and across North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：MSFも北キブ州における「憂慮すべき感染拡大」を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行が北キブ州で急拡大しており、致死率が高く治療体制も逼迫していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事内の地域（北キブ、イトゥリ、オートウエレ等）はすべてDRC国内の州であり、発生地域情報はすべて妥当。致死率が約48%と非常に高く、ベッド不足・診断遅延による院内感染リスクも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: بعد تفشيه في الكونغو.. مركز أوروبي: خطر انتقال الإيبولا إلى أوروبا "منخفض جدًا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After its outbreak in Congo, a European center says the risk of Ebola transmission to Europe is very low.
article.articleSummary: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) says Ebola transmission risk from the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak to the EU/EEA remains very low, despite ongoing cases there. Models indicate isolated importations to Europe cannot be ruled out, but multiple imports remain unlikely. As of Oct 2, the DRC reports 8,442 confirmed infections and 4,080 deaths; 846 in isolation; 66 new cases and 38 deaths since the last report; about 2,213 recoveries. Ituri has 6,370 cases and 2,933 deaths; North Kivu 1,657 cases and 979 deaths; others in South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, Bas-Uele and Sud-Ubangi. 64 of 167 health zones are affected; 73.1% of contacts are under follow-up. A healthcare worker who worked in DRC was evacuated to the Netherlands and is in high-level isolation at Leiden UMC. Ebola species include Zaire ebolavirus, Sudan ebolavirus, Bundibugyo ebolavirus; first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行後、欧州センターは欧州への感染リスクを「非常に低い」と発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者数・感染者数が極めて多く、既にオランダへの輸入症例も発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確に認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はECDCによるリスク評価を中心に報じているが、DRC国内の流行規模（8,442例・4,080死亡）が主題であり、ヘルスケアワーカーのオランダへの搬送も発生している。ブルンジ、スーダン、オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : près de 1000 enfants morts d'Ebola depuis le début de l'épidémie, selon Save the Children
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Nearly 1,000 children have died from Ebola since the start of the outbreak, according to Save the Children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues. Since the May 15 declaration, 2,071 children under 18 have been infected and 961 have died, including 623 under five (61% CFR for 0–4 vs 48% overall). Nearly seven children die daily on average. Across all ages, confirmed cases rose from 6,604 on September 5 to 8,116 on September 27, with deaths increasing from 3,175 to 3,924 in the same period. Notably, 81.5% of deaths in the three weeks before Sept 27 occurred in communities rather than in treatment centers, highlighting gaps in care access, community engagement, and trust. At least 180 children have lost both parents or guardians, nearly two per day, underscoring the psychosocial and protective needs of survivors. Save the Children has operated in DRC since 1994, partnering with 13 local groups and authorities to respond across health, nutrition, education, protection, WASH.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行開始以降、ほぼ1000人の子どもが死亡 ― Save the Children報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は確定症例・死亡者数が急増しており、特に子どもの致死率が高く、地域社会での死亡が多いことから公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的な支援が必要な状況と判断される。
triage.notes: Save the Childrenの報告によると、5月15日の流行宣言以降、18歳未満の子ども2,071人が感染、961人が死亡（うち5歳未満623人、CFR61%）。全年齢の確定症例は9月5日の6,604例から9月27日には8,116例に増加、死亡者も3,175人から3,924人に増加。直近3週間の死亡の81.5%が治療施設外（地域社会）で発生しており、医療アクセスや信頼構築の課題が浮き彫りになっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri: World Bank reaffirms its support for the response to the Ebola Outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: World Bank reaffirmed its support for the Democratic Republic of Congo and Ituri province in the Ebola outbreak response, 5 October 2026 in Bunia, following the arrival of Ronald Mutasa, World Bank Senior Health Manager for the Africa region. Mutasa met with the governor's chief of staff and praised provincial authorities for coordination and ongoing awareness campaigns conducted in churches, schools, and other venues. He noted the World Bank's involvement spans health response and efforts to keep schools safely open, and that support will continue until the end of the outbreak. Beyond the immediate epidemic, the Bank aims to strengthen the Congolese health system to enable rapid detection and effective response to future threats. The engagement underscores ongoing partnership with the national response team and the government in Ituri and the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:世界銀行、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応への支援を再確認 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、疾患の重篤性と国際機関（世界銀行）の関与から経過監視・フルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は既存アウトブレイクへの世界銀行の支援継続を報じるフォローアップ記事であり、新規感染拡大や症例数等の具体的データは含まれていない。アウトブレイクが依然継続中であることが示唆されるため、最新の疫学状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Mongbwalu: Pharmacists urged to detect suspected cases early - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Mongbwalu, Djugu Territory, Ituri Province, northeastern DRC, prompts pharmacists to aid early detection. As of 2026-10-05, Mongbwalu pharmacy operators are urged to use non-contact infrared thermometers to screen customers reporting headaches or fever and to refer those with high temperatures or suspicious symptoms to health facilities. Emmanuel Kambale, chairman of Mongbwalu’s pharmacy operators, stresses that medicines requiring prescriptions should not be sold without one and that staff should protect themselves to reduce exposure when handling sick individuals. The guidance emphasizes referral over direct treatment within the pharmacy to support outbreak control during the Ebola outbreak, with no specific case or death counts reported in this piece. The measures aim to strengthen case-finding and rapid medical evaluation at facilities, rather than through retail drug sales.

triage.headline_ja: モングバルの地元市場エボラ出血熱：薬剤師に疑い症例の早期発見を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州モングバルで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、重篤な感染症かつ地域拡大・公衆衛生上のリスクが高いためフルリスク評価に進めるべきである。
triage.notes: 記事は地域薬局における早期発見支援策に関する内容であり、具体的な症例数・死亡数は報告されていないが、既知のエボラアウトブレイク継続中であることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Bafwasende: 20-bed Ebola treatment center being set up (Chief Medical Officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Bafwasende Territory, Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a 20-bed Ebola treatment center being established. Capacity: 12 beds for confirmed cases (6 men, 6 women) and 8 beds for suspected cases (4 men, 4 women). Construction not yet started; International Medical Corps (IMC) has begun staff recruitment. Dr. Marcel Likilo, Chief Medical Officer of the Bafwasende Health Zone, confirms progress. As of Oct 5, 2026, the health zone reports eight confirmed EVD cases and three deaths. The center aims to bolster isolation and treatment and improve outbreak response in the region, pending formal construction. This measure follows ongoing transmission in the territory and underscores efforts to strengthen care capacity with IMC involvement.

triage.headline_ja: バフワセンデのエボラ出血熱：20床のエボラ治療センターを設置中（保健局長）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確定症例8例・死亡3例が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）とWPRO基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価へ進むべき。
triage.notes: 国際医療部隊（IMC）が治療センター設置のためスタッフ採用を開始しており、国際的な支援関与が示されている。致死率や感染拡大の詳細、国際的拡散リスクについては続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 13º caso de raiva em morcego é confirmado em Campo Grande, alerta CCZ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13th bat rabies case confirmed in Campo Grande, CCZ warns.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-05, Campo Grande's Zoonoses Control Center (CCZ) confirmed the 13th bat infected with the rabies virus in the city. In 2026, 988 bats were collected for suspected rabies, of which 13 tested positive. The latest case was found in the Sargento Amaral neighborhood, near Horto Florestal. CCZ advises: do not touch a bat found on the ground or entering a home, isolate the area to prevent contact with people or pets, and contact CCZ for collection and laboratory analysis. The agency also emphasizes vaccinating dogs and cats, as vaccinated animals help prevent rabies transmission to other mammals, including humans. Despite the confirmed positive case, officials say there is no need for panic, but continued vigilance and preventive measures are essential.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデでコウモリの狂犬病13例目を確認、CCZが注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病の散発的な動物事例であり、ヒト感染例の報告はなく、当局も「パニックの必要はない」としていることから、国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例はコウモリ（動物）における狂犬病確認であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。地元保健当局による日常的な監視・啓発活動の一環と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Vraj rozbila skúmavku a o týždeň bola mŕtva, no úrady mor popierajú. Čo vieme o nákaze na Sibíri, kde zasahuje aj FSB?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Supposedly she broke a test tube and a week later she was dead, but authorities deny the plague. What do we know about the infection in Siberia, where the FSB is also involved?
article.articleSummary: Darja Shipilova, 28, a laboratory technician at Irkutsk’s Institute of Epidemiology and Microbiology (Siberia and the Far East), died after admission to a Shelekhov hospital with severe pneumonia around Oct 1–2. Three competing accounts exist: (1) she reportedly broke a vial containing live bacteria during sampling; (2) she returned from Thailand with pneumonic plague; (3) illness after a work trip to Burjatia near the Mongolian border. Burjat officials first denied visiting the region, then suggested the possibility of plague. Russian authorities say no pathogens related to her work were found and no laboratory accident occurred; among contacts were two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus cases. A commission cites pneumonia of unknown origin as the cause. In Irkutsk, over 60 anti-plague institute staff are quarantined inside the building; about 197 people are under medical surveillance. FSB escort ambulances; U.S. authorities, including the CDC, are monitoring. The plague bacterium Yersinia pestis is the concern, but no confirmed outbreak is reported.

triage.headline_ja: 彼女は試験管を割ったとされ、1週間後に死亡したが、当局はペストを否定。シベリアで何が起きているのか？FSBも介入
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所技師がペスト疑いの重症肺炎で死亡し、ラボ事故説やFSB関与など情報が錯綜しているが、当局は感染症発生を否定しており確定情報がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州、ブリヤート共和国）であり、対象国リストには含まれない。タイは彼女がタイから帰国しペスト肺炎になったという未確認の一説にのみ登場し、実際の発生地ではないため除外。当局はペスト発生・ラボ事故の双方を否定しており、原因不明の肺炎とされている。確定情報がないためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia faz contagem de larvas do Aedes em imóveis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia conducts a count of Aedes larvae in properties.
article.articleSummary: Hortolândia conducts Análise de Densidade Larvária (ADL) to monitor Aedes aegypti larvae in residential properties and guide dengue and other arbovirus prevention. UVZ teams visit about 600 properties in each of five city regions, totaling roughly 3,000 dwellings; blocks are randomly selected, and the fieldwork is expected to take about 15 days, weather permitting. During visits, agents collect and count larvae to generate the Breteau index, classified as 0–1 low, 1–4 medium, and above 4 high. ADL is carried out three times yearly—in January, July, and October. This year’s January index was 8.2, July was 3.5, and October of last year was 0.3 (low). Dengue has 2,174 notified cases with 129 positives and no deaths; chikungunya has 31 cases with no positives; Zika has no notified cases. Residents should allow entry; contact UVZ at (19) 3897-3312 or (19) 3897-5974.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランディア市、Aedes幼虫の密度調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 定期的なベクター密度モニタリング活動の報告であり、死亡例なし・症例数も特段の異常増加を示していないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ブラジル・サンパウロ州オルトランディア市における日常的なAedes aegypti幼虫密度調査（ADL）とデング熱等の症例報告。死亡例なし、過去の指数と比較しても特に異常な増加は見られない。地域の公衆衛生活動として通常業務の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: J&K strengthens surveillance of vaccine-preventable diseases
article.articleSummary: Jammu and Kashmir has strengthened surveillance of six vaccine-preventable diseases, including measles, rubella and tetanus, to boost early detection, outbreak investigation and public-health response. The program aims to map disease patterns, monitor trends, identify immunisation gaps, and target interventions in areas with higher case numbers and low immunity. The surveillance system, once supported by the WHO, is being shifted to an indigenous framework under Atmanirbhar Bharat, phased from state level to hospitals, with completion targeted by March 2027. A Srinagar workshop trains health officials in identifying and reporting suspected cases, specimen collection, laboratory protocols, data analysis and uploading to a unified digital portal. Data generated will guide immunisation-gap identification and the development of evidence-based disease-control and vaccination strategies, described as a major public-health exercise with strong departmental commitment.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンム・カシミール州、ワクチンで予防可能な疾患のサーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: これは既存のサーベイランス体制強化に関する行政的な報告であり、実際の疾患アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹・風疹・破傷風などワクチン予防可能疾患に対する監視体制強化のプログラム説明であり、具体的な症例発生や流行の報告ではない。対象国リストに実際の発生国としては該当しないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mesquita participa de seminário regional sobre prevenção e combate às arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mesquita Participates in Regional Seminar on Prevention and Control of Arboviral Diseases
article.articleSummary: Mesquita participated in the Macrorregional Vale do Aço Arboviruses Seminar 2026/2027, held September 30–October 1, 2026, at the Faculdade de Ciências Médicas de Ipatinga (AFYA). The regional meeting gathered health professionals from Vale do Aço municipalities to update knowledge and exchange experiences on the prevention and control of arboviruses transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti, including dengue, zika, and chikungunya. Over two days, topics covered patient care, epidemiological surveillance, and vector-control strategies, with participation by physicians, nurses, endemic disease control agents, and municipal managers. Mesquita's involvement aims to refresh municipal network staff and strengthen prevention, surveillance, and combating arboviruses in the municipality. The event emphasized capacity-building and inter-municipal integration to broaden information sharing and coordinate joint prevention and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: メスキータ、アルボウイルス感染症の予防と対策に関する地域セミナーに参加

triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの地方自治体による予防啓発・研修イベントの報告であり、具体的な感染症の流行・発生状況は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: புதுகை மாவட்டத்தில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு பணிகளில் 535 பணியாளா்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 535 workers in dengue prevention activities in Pudukkottai district
article.articleSummary: 535 workers engaged in dengue prevention activities in Pudukkottai district as of 5 October 2026, per District Collector M. Arunaa. The workforce spans district-level (260), block/zone-level (70), municipality-level (45), town panchayat-level (45), and city corporation-level (160). Fifteen officers were appointed to supervise, including Pudukkottai and Aranthangi health officers, a district disease officer, and an entomology expert. Indoor and outdoor insecticide spraying is planned from 9:00–11:00 and 3:00–5:00. Currently seven dengue patients are admitted and receiving treatment in government and private hospitals in the district. In the affected areas, fogging and larviciding activities have been intensified. The monitoring session was attended by the District Rural Development Project Director, the District Revenue Officer (Kaviri-Kundaar linkage), and district health officials V.C. Hemachand Gandhi, Vijaya Kumar, Municipal Commissioner Kanthiraj, and others.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥッコッタイ県でデング熱予防活動に535人の職員
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域の風土病的流行であり、患者数も少なく通常の行政対応（予防活動の報告）の範疇で、IHR・WPRO基準への該当は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政による通常の季節的デング熱予防対策の報告であり、7名の入院患者のみで大規模発生の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitaria en Siberia tras la muerte de técnica de laboratorio vinculada al estudio de la peste en Irkutsk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert in Siberia after the death of a lab technician linked to plague research in Irkutsk.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician, Daria Shipilova, who worked at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research, died days after hospital admission on September 29 from pneumonia of unclear origin, prompting a public health alert in Siberia, Russia. Initial rumors linked the case to pneumonic plague, but authorities have not confirmed plague as the cause. Rospotrebnadzor reports no organisms tied to Shipilova's work and no laboratory accidents at the institute. In Irkutsk and nearby Shelekhov, epidemiological surveillance and quarantines were implemented in several hospitals, with restricted visitations and medical monitoring of about 200 people in contact with the patient. Mask use was mandated at an aluminum plant in Shelekhov as a precaution. No symptoms have been identified among those monitored. The case triggered speculation about laboratory exposure or travel to Thailand; a special commission is investigating. Pneumonic plague requires rapid antibiotic treatment if confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツクでペスト研究に携わっていた技師の死亡を受け、シベリアで公衆衛生警戒
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所勤務の技師が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストの可能性が疑われている異常事態であり、重症度・異常性ともに高いためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Concerning development after lab worker dies of suspected plague
article.articleSummary: Death of a female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute in Siberia prompts quarantine and medical observation in Irkutsk Oblast near the Mongolia border. The worker, reportedly 28, died last week from pneumonia of undetermined origin; authorities say no microorganisms linked to her work were detected, and there have been no new lab cases. The inpatient facility where she was treated was closed for quarantine, with nearly 200 people who had contact with her under precautionary observation as of Monday. International responses urge transparency: the U.S. State Department calls for accurate information, and the WHO says it is aware of reports of a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague with the cause unconfirmed. Pneumonic plague can spread between people via droplets and requires rapid antibiotics. Global plague data (2019–2025): over 3,800 suspected cases and 423 deaths, mainly in DR Congo and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: 研究所職員がペストの疑いで死亡、懸念される事態の進展
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストの疑いが報告された。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある病原体であり、約200人が経過観察下にあるため、異常性と重大性からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州、モンゴル国境付近）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。DRC・マダガスカルは世界のペスト統計の背景情報として言及されているのみで、本件の発生地ではない。原因（ペストかどうか）は未確定で続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "أطباء بلا حدود" تحذر من ارتفاع "مقلق" بإصابات إيبولا في شمال كيفو بالكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn of an alarming rise in Ebola infections in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is intensifying. Since the Bundibugyo strain emerged, WHO records show 4082 deaths among 8463 confirmed cases. The outbreak began in Ituri in northeastern DRC and has spread to seven provinces, with the majority of cases in Ituri, North Kivu, and Haut-Uele. As of Oct 2, 2026, North Kivu accounts for about 40% of new confirmed infections. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns treatment capacity has reached its limit amid new foci emerging weekly; 34% of confirmed patients were still in non-specialized facilities lacking resources, increasing transmission risk. Bed shortages force referrals, raising community exposure. More than 60% of Ebola deaths occur outside health facilities. Building trust with communities and encouraging early care and isolation are essential to reduce deaths and prevent spread to neighboring regions. There is no vaccine or specific treatment available for Bundibugyo Ebola at present.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でのエボラ感染急増に「憂慮すべき」警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が7州に拡大し、死者4082人・確定症例8463人に達するなど深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン・特効薬が存在せず国際的拡大・支援の必要性も高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO記録による死者数・症例数が極めて大きく、治療キャパシティの限界やワクチン・治療薬の欠如が報告されており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Trabajadora de laboratorio muere por sospecha de peste en Rusia; casi 200 personas bajo vigilancia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lab worker dies of suspected plague in Russia; nearly 200 people under surveillance.
article.articleSummary: A laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Antipeste Institute in Russia's Irkutsk region died last week from pneumonia of undetermined origin; authorities say no microorganisms linked to the worker’s laboratory activities were detected and there have been no new cases among staff. The hospital unit where she was treated has been quarantined and nearly 200 people who had contact with her are under medical observation as of Monday, near Shelekhov (district near the Mongolia border). International partners pressed for more transparency; U.S. State Department urged official confirmation and accuracy, while WHO said it was aware of reports but had not confirmed a cause of death. Russian investigators, led by Rospotrebnadzor, are examining. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis and transmissible via respiratory droplets, requires prompt antibiotic treatment. Global plague context: between 2019–2025, over 3,800 suspected cases reported by 10 countries, mainly in DRC and Madagascar, with 423 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: واکنش کرملین به گزارش‌ها درباره طاعون در روسیه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kremlin's response to reports of the plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Plague rumors in Irkutsk region prompt statements from Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov and RosPotrebNadzor, which says health status in Irkutsk and Sholkhov is stable and to dismiss unsubstantiated claims. A death attributed to pneumonia of unknown etiology, involving a female employee of the Anti-Plague Institute, was reported after comprehensive lab tests found no microorganisms linked to the illness. Authorities say no related cases among colleagues and no ongoing outbreak. Epidemic expert Gennady Onishchenko views the case as unlikely to be plague; the patient had returned from Buryatia, a Russia–Mongolia border area with natural plague foci, where fleas and rodents are vectors. While fleas are currently dormant, plague remains a well-understood, antibiotic-responsive bacterial infection with a seven-day incubation. In 2026, animal plague activity is high near Russia’s borders with Kazakhstan, Mongolia, China, Azerbaijan, and Georgia, with several cross-border foci identified."

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 40 este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has three new measles cases; the total has reached 40 this year.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state, Brazil: Four new cases confirmed on Oct 1, 2026, bringing the total to 40. All new cases are in the capital: two men, 18 and 21, and a 1-year-old infant. Transmission chains identified since June continue to be monitored, with surveillance showing a downward trend; authorities in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo are evaluating closure of the chains. The capital accounts for 36 of 40 cases; 2 in São Bernardo do Campo; 1 in Guarulhos and Santo André. Of the 40 cases, 30 involve unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated individuals. Vaccination is free via SUS using the measles-containing triple viral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) at UBS across 645 municipalities. Target groups: children 12 and 15 months; ages 15 months–29 years require two doses; ages 30–59 at least one dose; health workers two doses. Dose zero for exposed children in SP, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo (6–11 months) not a substitute for scheduled doses.

article.articleHeadline: Varios países asiáticos incrementan sus controles en las fronteras con Rusia por temor a un posible brote de peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several Asian countries tighten border controls with Russia amid fears of a possible plague outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Several Asian countries tightened border controls with Russia amid fears of a possible Siberian plague outbreak after the death of a researcher at an institute handling samples of the plague bacterium. The Kremlin has offered few details, describing the deceased as pneumonia of unknown origin and calling for calm. Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan have imposed border health checks or quarantine measures; Tajikistan conducts temperature screening and symptom interviews for entrants, with workers in disposable protective gear. The United States and the European Union are monitoring the situation. From Siberia, flights connect to Beijing, Shanghai, Bangkok, and Ulaanbaatar; Russian media report reinforced airport checks in Moscow for travellers from Irkutsk, though not officially confirmed. The World Health Organization says the current public health risk appears low, and no positive cases have yet been detected.

article.articleHeadline: 5 confirmed, 24 suspected Hepatitis A cases reported in Valencia City barangay
article.articleSummary: Five confirmed and 24 suspected Hepatitis A cases have been reported in Barangay Lurugan, Valencia City. On October 2, the City Health Office intensified field interventions and surveillance, coordinating with barangay officials, health workers, sanitation personnel, and CHO teams. Teams from the Environmental and Occupational Safety and Health Services Division (ESOHS) and the Epidemiology, Disease Surveillance and Research Division (EDSR) conducted case investigations, health monitoring, environmental and sanitation assessments, and community health education. The CHO will maintain ongoing case monitoring and surveillance, including follow-up of patients and their contacts, and will coordinate with healthcare facilities for reporting, referral, and appropriate medical care. House-to-house Information, Education and Communication activities will continue, emphasizing Hepatitis A prevention, proper handwashing, safe food and water practices, and household sanitation.

article.articleHeadline: What is the plague? What to know after the suspected Russia case
article.articleSummary: Fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague in Russia: a woman in her late 20s, lab worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia, died; dozens have been quarantined in Irkutsk Oblast with no infections reported as of Oct 5. U.S. State Department and CDC are monitoring. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, has three forms; pneumonic is the most virulent and can spread between people. Symptoms include fever, chills, weakness, breathing problems, and coughing, sometimes with blood, appearing after 1–7 days (and can progress within 24 hours after exposure). Transmission via fleas, direct contact with infected tissue, or inhalation of respiratory droplets; early antibiotics are effective. Untreated, pneumonic and septicaemic plague are always fatal, bubonic forms have 30–60% case-fatality. Since 2019–2025, WHO records nearly 4,000 suspected/confirmed cases with outbreaks in Africa (notably DRC and Madagascar), Asia and South America.

triage.headline_ja: ペストとは何か？ロシアでの疑い症例を受けて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの肺ペスト疑い死亡例で、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが複数該当するため。ただし対象国（DRC等）は背景統計の言及に留まり実際の発生地ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク州）での肺ペスト疑い死亡例。DRC・マダガスカルはWHOの2019-2025年統計における過去の流行地として言及されているのみで、本記事の発生地ではないため対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC mueren unos siete niños por día a causa de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, about seven children die each day due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa reports that Ebola is driving a deadly outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, seven children die per day on average. By the end of September, 961 infants have died, with nearly two-thirds under five. The case-fatality rate among children aged 0–4 is 61%, higher than the outbreak-wide 48%. More than 2,000 children under 18 have contracted Ebola, with 961 fatalities. Save the Children warns that at least 180 children have lost both parents or primary caregivers this past month. As of October 3, seven provinces and 64 health zones are affected; 8,544 confirmed cases, 4,114 deaths, 2,230 recoveries, and 824 patients in isolation or hospitalized. The current outbreak is the deadliest in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により毎日約7人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが同国史上最悪規模に拡大しており、7州64保健地区に及び、死亡者4,114人・確定症例8,544人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクは2026年5月15日に宣言され、10月3日時点で7州・64保健地区に拡大、確定症例8,544人、死亡4,114人、回復2,230人、隔離・入院中824人。子ども（18歳未満）の感染者は2,000人超、死亡961人、0-4歳の致死率61%（全体48%を上回る）。同国史上最も致死的なエボラアウトブレイクとされ、国際的な人道支援団体（Save the Children）も関与しており、国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Badaun News: सर्वा में कूड़े के ढेर व गंदगी फैला रही संक्रामक रोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Badaun News: An infectious disease spreading through heaps of garbage and filth in Sarva
article.articleSummary: Four suspected dengue cases were detected in Sarva village, Badaun district, as of 5 October 2026, via kit-based testing after fever reports prompted health officials to respond. A team led by Dr. Annu Agarwal arrived on Monday to assess the situation, supported by lab technicians Rajkumar and Kaushal Kumar. Laboratory confirmation is pending; no confirmed dengue diagnoses or fatalities are reported. The village is described as grappling with sanitation problems, with visible piles of garbage along the main road entering the village, which residents say raises health concerns. The district health department has launched an ongoing public health response, relying on rapid tests while awaiting confirmatory laboratory results.

triage.headline_ja: バダウン・ニュース：サルヴァ村でゴミの山と不衛生が感染症を広げている
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落での疑い症例4件（確定診断待ち）に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大のリスクは認められないため見送りとする。
