article.articleHeadline: Alerta 13º caso de raiva é confirmado em Campo Grande - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Alert: 13th Case Confirmed in Campo Grande - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Campo Grande, Brazil: The rabies virus has re-emerged, with the 13th positive bat in 2026 confirmed by CCZ on Oct 5. Affected region: Sargento Amaral neighborhood near Horto Florestal. So far this year, 988 bats have been collected for suspected rabies tests, of which 13 were positive. The notification reinforces not to capture or handle bats, alive or dead, and to keep children and pets away from locations where bats are found. The CCZ should be contacted to collect the animal and submit it for laboratory analysis. Vaccination of dogs and cats is advised as a primary preventive measure. Rabies can affect mammals, including humans; exposures require prompt medical attention. The situation calls for vigilance, but officials urge residents not to attempt to capture bats themselves, relying instead on specialized services.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病警報：カンポ・グランデで13例目の陽性コウモリが確認
triage.triage_reason: コウモリの狂犬病陽性事例が継続的に確認されているが、ヒトへの感染例は報告されておらず、地域的・局所的な動物由来の公衆衛生監視事案であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: コウモリにおける狂犬病陽性例の継続報告であり、地域保健当局（CCZ）が対応中。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、国際的拡大のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود تحذر من ارتفاع "مقلق" بإصابات إيبولا شمال شرقي الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn of a "worrying" rise in Ebola cases in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, sees a worrying rise in Ebola cases, according to Doctors Without Borders. Since early September, the outbreak has intensified, with the province now accounting for about 40% of newly confirmed infections nationwide. Stefanie Hofmann, MSF’s Ebola Treatment Center coordinator in Butembo near the Uganda border, likened the response to fighting a raging blaze, noting new foci emerging weekly and treatment capacity remaining far below needs. Due to bed shortages, some confirmed patients are being referred to other facilities, a practice that heightens community risk. More than 60% of Ebola-related deaths occur outside health facilities, underscoring the need for early care and isolation. DRC declared the outbreak mid-May after weeks of delay. As of October 2, WHO reports 4,082 deaths among 8,463 cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain, which has no vaccine or specific treatment yet.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国北東部でのエボラ感染拡大に「憂慮すべき」増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部（北キブ州）でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の感染が急増し、致死率も高く、治療能力が逼迫している。ウガンダ国境付近での発生であり国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: WHOによると10月2日時点で8,463症例中4,082人死亡（致死率約48%）。北キブ州が全国新規感染の約40%を占め、ワクチンも特異的治療法もないブンディブギョ株による流行。ウガンダ国境近接地域（ブテンボ）での治療拠点が言及されているが、ウガンダ国内での発生報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: RedeTV! ES: Viana retoma aplicação de fumacê contra dengue, zika e chikungunya - 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RedeTV! ES: Viana resumes fogging against Dengue, Zika and Chikungunya - 2026.
article.articleSummary: Viana, Brazil began a new cycle of Ultra Low Volume fogging to combat mosquitoes that transmit dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The Municipal Health Secretariat will conduct nighttime spraying with two vehicles through October 30. The insecticide is released as a fine, barely visible mist and requires low-light conditions for maximum effectiveness. If it rains, spraying will be suspended and the schedule may be adjusted, since water hinders dispersion of the product. The fumigation follows the Ministry of Health guidelines and is triggered by arbovirus notifications in the municipality. The program operates in cycles rather than year-round, as frequent use can promote mosquito resistance and reduce effectiveness. Residents are advised to maintain prevention measures, such as eliminating containers that can hold standing water, the main breeding ground for mosquitoes.

triage.headline_ja: RedeTV! ES：ヴィアナ市、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策の煙霧消毒を再開 - 2026
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ヴィアナ市における定例的な蚊媒介性感染症対策（煙霧消毒）の実施報告であり、異常な発生急増や重症化等の情報はなく、通常の予防活動の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）に対する定例的な予防的燻蒸活動の報告であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: President Trump Is Not Exactly Reassuring About the Russian Plague
article.articleSummary: as of 2026-10-05, President Trump described a 'pneumonia plague' and cited a suspected outbreak in Russia, noting a quarantine in Irkutsk in Siberia. He claimed the germs have grown stronger and that the response would be provided, saying the United States would help those affected. The article notes that unexplained pneumonia cases in Wuhan, China helped usher in the Covid-19 outbreak, which evolved into a global pandemic. It states roughly 2.05 million people died worldwide from confirmed Covid-19 cases, with the United States accounting for about 400,000 deaths, close to 20 percent of the total. The piece links current discussion to past memory of the Covid-19 crisis and frames the situation in terms of government preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、ロシアの『ペスト』について安心感を与えない発言
triage.triage_reason: トランプ大統領の発言に基づく未確認の『肺炎ペスト』疑惑報道であり、公式な疫学的確認情報（症例数・検査結果等）が存在しないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・イルクーツクでの隔離措置と大統領発言を中心とした政治的コメンタリーであり、公式な医学的詳細（病原体同定、症例数等）が欠如。武漢・COVID-19への言及は過去の類推として用いられているのみで、現在の中国での発生を示すものではない。対象国リストにロシアは含まれず、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ‫ أطباء بلا حدود تحذر من ارتفاع "مقلق" بإصابات إيبولا شمال شرقي الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warn of a 'concerning' rise in Ebola cases in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of a concerning rise in Ebola virus disease in North Kivu, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with outbreak intensifying since early September. The region now accounts for about 40% of all newly confirmed infections in the DRC. Stephanie Hofmann, MSF Ebola treatment center coordinator in Butembo near the Uganda border, described fighting the outbreak as battling a massive blaze, noting new foci each week and severely constrained treatment capacity. Due to bed shortages, confirmed Ebola patients are sometimes referred to other facilities, a move that heightens community risk. More than 60% of Ebola deaths occur outside health facilities; urging early care seeking and acceptance of isolation. Since mid-May, DRC has declared the outbreak after several weeks’ delay. As of October 2, WHO records 4,082 deaths among 8,463 cases linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国北東部でのエボラ出血熱感染増加に「懸念」を表明
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が急拡大し死亡率約48%、治療能力逼迫・コミュニティでの死亡多数とIHR基準複数該当、WPRO基準も全て該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ国境付近での治療拠点の言及はあるが、ウガンダ国内での感染確認は記載なし。WHOデータでは全体8,463症例中4,082死亡（致死率約48%）、ワクチン・特効薬なしのブンディブギョ株による深刻な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Drones ampliam o olhar dos municípios contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drones Broaden the Municipalities' View in the Fight Against Dengue
article.articleSummary: Drone-based aerial mapping enhances dengue control by enabling precise territory surveillance and faster, targeted interventions. The Techdengue program uses drones, geotechnologies, and georeferenced data to identify Aedes aegypti breeding sites and prioritize intervention areas. High-resolution imagery of properties and surroundings helps detect pools, litter, debris, and other conditions conducive to mosquito proliferation. The system currently operates in over 630 municipalities, has mapped more than 260,000 hectares, and identified over 660,000 possible breeding sites. By linking mapped points to precise locations, managers can plan field visits and allocate resources where needed. While focused on dengue, the data can support broader municipal management, with the workflow translating information into on-the-ground actions.

triage.headline_ja: ドローンがデング熱対策における自治体の監視能力を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱対策のためのドローン技術導入に関する内容であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるデング熱の媒介蚊対策技術（ドローン活用）の紹介であり、感染拡大や症例数急増に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Surge Warnings in Eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Outbreak overview: Ebola surge in North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 05 October 2026. The Bundibugyo strain drives the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, for which no specific vaccine or treatment exists. WHO data report 8,463 cases with 4,082 deaths globally for this outbreak. The region accounts for nearly 40% of new confirmed cases, with transmission intensifying since early September. MSF warns that urgent expansion of treatment capacity is needed; weekly new hotspots and severe bed shortages are forcing risky patient transfers. More than 60% of deaths occur outside health facilities, highlighting the need for early care and isolation at the community level. MSF’s Butembo treatment center coordinator notes the critical gap in capacity, urging immediate scale-up to reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の急増警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の症例・死亡数が急増し、治療キャパシティ不足が深刻化しているため、国際的拡大リスクを含めIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO報告で世界的に8,463症例・4,082死亡、北キブ州が新規症例の約4割を占め、治療ワクチン未確立のブンディブギョ株による第17次アウトブレイク。MSFが病床不足と地域内での死亡（施設外死亡60%超）を警告し、緊急の対応拡大を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia investiga un posible caso de peste pulmonar en la región de Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia investigates a possible case of pneumonic plague in the Siberian region.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague case under investigation in the Irkutsk region, Siberia, Russia. Several Irkutsk hospitals are quarantined with strict restrictions on inpatient wards; visits by family are prohibited. Authorities have not publicly confirmed a pneumonic plague diagnosis. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an extraordinary meeting amid the suspected infection of a regional resident. All contacts are under medical observation; to date, none show symptoms and all tests are negative. Meduza reported a 28-year-old woman died days earlier after being diagnosed with pneumonia of unknown etiology, per Rospotrebnadzor. Two hypotheses persist: infection contracted in Thailand during recent travel, or exposure from a broken test tube containing pathogens at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk and the Far East. Rospotrebnadzor notes no current pathogen-related emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリア地域で肺ペスト疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: ペストは重篤かつ稀な感染症であり、死亡例と病院隔離措置が報告されているためIHR基準2項目（深刻性・異常性）に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに非該当のためverified_locationsは空。タイは感染源の仮説（渡航歴）として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生を示す記述ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Hidden Tick- and Flea-Borne Probes in HIV Patients Reveal High Bartonella
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, a cross-sectional study of 75 symptomatic HIV-positive individuals found 62.7% had seroreactivity to Bartonella antigens (most frequently B. henselae, 57.3%; B. vinsonii subsp. berkhoffii II, 44%). Despite serology, molecular testing—qPCR and digital PCR on blood samples with up to 28 days of BAPGM enrichment—detected no Bartonella or Borrelia DNA in any participant. Two participants showed low-positive piroplasmid DNA by dPCR. Clinically, 11 seroreactive patients had systemic manifestations versus 1 non-seroreactive (odds ratio 8.25; 95% CI 1.00–68.2; p = 0.026). Authors note serology may reflect prior exposure, cross-reactivity, or low-level colonization rather than active infection. No active Bartonella or Borrelia infection was demonstrated; the study raises questions about the infectious status of Bartonella exposure in HIV patients in a tropical setting, with potential implications for diagnosis and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: HIV患者における潜在的なマダニ・ノミ媒介性病原体調査、高いバルトネラ曝露を示すが活動性感染なし
triage.triage_reason: 研究報告であり、活動性感染は確認されず、公衆衛生上の緊急性や拡大リスクは認められないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIV陽性者を対象とした血清学的・分子生物学的研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: The Russian Plague
article.articleSummary: Daria Shipilova, 28, a staffer at Russia’s Anti-Plague Research Institute in the Irkutsk region, is believed to have died from pneumonic plague after allegedly breaking a tube containing the pathogen in late September. She fell ill two days later and was hospitalised, with initial diagnoses of coronavirus. The incident prompted quarantines of other Institute employees and border-control measures by neighboring countries around Irkutsk, drawing parallels to COVID-19 and Wuhan. Pneumonic plague transmits via respiratory droplets and has about a 41% fatality rate, markedly higher than COVID-19. The disease is treatable with antibiotics if diagnosed promptly, though early symptoms resemble influenza. The report notes possible antibiotic-resistant strains and raises questions about whether the lab was developing more dangerous strains; authorities’ assurances are met with scepticism, and no other confirmed case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所職員が肺ペストで死亡したとされ、近隣諸国が国境管理措置を取るなど国際的な波及・渡航制限の動きがあり、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にロシア（Irkutsk）および中国（Hubei/Wuhan）が含まれるが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれない。中国はCOVID-19/武漢との比較対象として言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではない。他の確定症例数は不明であり、今後の続報（感染拡大状況、耐性株の有無、WHOへの通報有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Médicos Sin Fronteras advierte sobre posible colapso en centros antiébola en Kivu del Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of possible collapse at Ebola treatment centers in North Kivu.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) treatment centers in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, are at capacity, raising concerns of a collapse in care. North Kivu accounts for about 40% of the country's new confirmed EVD cases, with the province responsible for 24% of new infections by late August, according to MSF. Stéphanie Hoffmann, head of MSF’s Butembo Ebola Treatment Center, warns space constraints force transferring confirmed patients to other centers, increasing community transmission risk, and that care quality at some centers falls short of standards. She calls it multiple fires; containment is impossible while cases rise. Since May 15, DR Congo has logged 8,442 EVD cases and 4,080 deaths as of Oct 2, across 64 health zones in Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ubangi du Sud. The outbreak is the second-deadliest globally, far from the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、北キブ州のエボラ治療センターの崩壊の可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が深刻化し、治療センターの収容能力超過・地域内伝播拡大のリスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北キブ州を中心としたエボラ流行の治療体制逼迫を報じており、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。致死率約48%（4080/8442）と非常に高く、西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande confirma 13º caso de raiva em morcego neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande confirms the 13th case of rabies in a bat this year.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande confirms the 13th bat infected with rabies in 2026. The animal was located within the urban area in the Sargento Amaral neighborhood near Horto Florestal. It was collected and laboratory-confirmed for rabies. Other 2026 bat cases were reported in Vivendas do Bosque, Centro (three), Santa Fé, Jardim Campo Alto, Pioneiros (two), São Francisco, Jardim Bela Vista, Jardim Ouro Preto and Ouro Preto. In total, 988 bats have been collected for suspicion in Campo Grande this year. The last human rabies case in the city occurred in 1968; in the interior, Corumbá had a case in 2015. Prevention emphasizes annual vaccination of dogs and cats. If you encounter a bat: do not touch, isolate, and contact CCZ (general: (67) 3313-5000; after-hours: (67) 2020-1794). Seek 24-hour care if exposure occurs.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデ、今年13例目のコウモリの狂犬病を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病の恒常的な発生報告であり、人への感染事例はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 人への狂犬病感染は1968年以降発生なし。動物（コウモリ）サーベイランスの定例報告であり、予防啓発が主眼。

article.articleHeadline: Pánico en Siberia por la peste pulmonar: confinamientos, controles en los aeropuertos y acusaciones de encubrimiento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic in Siberia over pneumonic plague: lockdowns, airport screenings, and accusations of a cover-up
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia’s Irkutsk region; a 28-year-old laboratory technician, Darya Shipilova, died after pneumonia of unknown origin, with two hundred people quarantined as authorities investigate. The Russian Health Public Agency Rospotrebnadzor reported no Yersinia pestis in Shipilova’s autopsy, while two lines of inquiry consider either lab exposure while handling samples or infection in Thailand, where she recently traveled. Four hospitals, including a maternity ward in Shelekov near Irkutsk, have been confined to observe contacts. Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan have imposed strict border and airport checks. International response includes US CDC and the State Department gathering information; concerns about transparency and possible gain-of-function lab manipulation, with figures suggesting security services may be involved. Incubation for pneumonic plague can be six to seven days; plague is endemic to the region.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペストへのパニック：都市封鎖、空港検査、隠蔽疑惑
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト疑いによる死亡例、200人規模の検疫、隣国の国境・空港規制強化、隠蔽疑惑など、IHR4基準すべてに該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイは感染経路調査の一仮説として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生事例は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。検査結果ではYersinia pestis陰性との報告もあり、確定診断には不確実性が残る。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : à Biakato, 18 morts en deux jours et une riposte soumise à rude épreuve
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: In Biakato, 18 dead in two days and a response put to the test.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province centers on Biakato in Mambasa territory. Eighteen deaths were recorded over a two-day weekend in Biakato, signaling a deadly surge in a province accounting for roughly three-quarters of outbreak fatalities in DRC. In Mandima health zone, the only available ambulance lacks fuel, Biakato has no mobile laboratory, and suspect cases must be transported to Komanda more than 100 kilometers away, delaying confirmation and response. Save the Children analysis through 27 September shows 81.5% of deaths occurred in communities, underscoring late care and weak access to facilities. The pediatric toll is severe: 961 children dead, including 623 under five, with at least 2,071 minors infected; under-five case fatality around 61% versus ~48% overall. The WHO has deployed a rapid-response team to Mambasa and Mandima to bolster local efforts and curb transmission. Emphasis on prevention, rapid case finding, and prompt referral is critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ビアカトでは2日間で18人が死亡、対応は厳しい試練に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急激な死者増加（2日間で18人）と小児死亡率の高さ、医療資源不足による対応の遅れが報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが既に迅速対応チームを派遣しており、既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の悪化事例。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Crna smrt i dalje postoji: Najnoviji podaci pokazuju gde se kuga pojavljuje danas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Black Death Still Exists: Latest Data Show Where the Plague Is Appearing Today
article.articleSummary: Between 2019 and 2025, the World Health Organization recorded 3,860 suspected plague cases globally, with 2,646 laboratory-confirmed and 423 deaths. Confirmed cases occurred in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Madagascar, Uganda, China, and Mongolia; suspected cases were reported in Brazil, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and Ecuador. A Russian case at the Irkutsk plague research institute prompted widespread anti-epidemic measures after a 28-year-old died of severe pneumonia; authorities have not confirmed Yersinia pestis as the cause, but about 200 contacts were identified and some facilities quarantined. Yersinia pestis circulates among small mammals and fleas; pneumonic plague can spread via respiratory droplets and be rapidly fatal without early antibiotics. The WHO notes natural foci exist worldwide except Australia and Oceania and urges rodent population surveillance and rapid treatment to prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 黒死病は今も存在する：最新データが示すペストの発生地
triage.triage_reason: 2019〜2025年のWHOによるペスト症例の累計データを紹介する概説記事であり、対象国（DRC・中国・ブラジル）での具体的な新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではないが、ペスト菌の自然焦点が世界的に存続し流行の可能性が指摘されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2019〜2025年のWHO累計データに基づく概説で、ロシア（イルクーツク）での肺炎死亡例を中心に扱っているが、Yersinia pestisによる確定診断は未了。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC・中国は確定症例、ブラジルは疑い症例として明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Everything YOU need to know about pneumonic plague amid Russia spread
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a suspected pneumonic plague outbreak after a lab technician allegedly died following a broken test tube containing Yersinia pestis. About 200 people and five hospitals across Siberia, including Irkutsk, have been quarantined. The deceased is Darya Shipilova, 28, of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute. The latest Russian case follows none since 2016 in the Altai Republic linked to marmot exposure; this outbreak is in the Irkutsk region of Siberia. Pneumonic plague is the most lethal form and is almost always fatal without rapid treatment within 24 hours of symptom onset. Symptoms include shortness of breath and coughing with blood-tinged mucus; transmission can occur via respiratory droplets between people or through contact with infected animal flesh. Global context shows plague persists in Africa (DRC, Madagascar); the US averages about seven cases per year, mostly bubonic, with no sustained human-to-human transmission. Asian countries have imposed travel restrictions; the White House is monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト拡大を受け、肺ペストについて知っておくべきすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト（致死率が極めて高い）疑い例でロシア人研究者が死亡し、約200人・5病院が隔離される異常事態。アジア諸国が渡航制限を課し、ホワイトハウスも監視するなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本事例の主たる発生地はロシア・シベリア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中でDRC・マダガスカルはペストの世界的背景情報として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en Rusia: ponen en cuarentena hospitales por sospecha de peste pulmonar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Russia: Hospitals Quarantined Over Suspected Pneumonic Plague.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-05, in Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia, a 28-year-old woman, Daria Shipilova, died of severe pneumonia of unknown origin in Shélejov, triggering quarantines at several hospitals. About 200 people in contact with the patient, including roughly 100 medical workers, are under medical observation. Authorities are investigating a possible pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis; however, no laboratory confirmation has been reported and Rospotrebnadzor lists the illness as pneumonia of undetermined etiology. Containment measures include suspending visits and limiting family access in four facilities, including a pediatric hospital. No symptomatic contacts and negative tests have been reported so far. Potential infection sources include a recent trip to Thailand or a laboratory accident; the Institute of Plague Research reports no emergencies linked to pathogens. Pneumonic plague requires rapid antibiotic treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで警戒：肺ペスト疑いで病院が隔離措置
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いによる死亡例が発生し、約200人（医療従事者含む）が経過観察下に置かれ、複数病院で隔離措置が取られていることから、重大性・異常性の両基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は感染源の可能性として言及されているが、タイ国内での発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。検査確認は未報告で、現時点では病原体未確定の肺炎として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Qué es la peste neumónica, cómo se contagia y por qué puede matar en menos de 24 horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is pneumonic plague, how it spreads, and why it can kill in less than 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, transmits by inhalation of respiratory droplets and can spread directly between people in closed spaces. Incubation can be as short as 24 hours; symptoms include high fever, chills, headache, muscle aches, weakness, with cough, breathing difficulty, and sometimes bloody sputum in severe cases. Without treatment, death occurs about 18–24 hours after symptom onset. Rapid antibiotic therapy markedly improves survival, making swift diagnosis essential. Laboratory confirmation relies on identifying Y. pestis in blood or sputum. Public health response requires tracing contacts for surveillance and preventive treatment when needed. The disease persists in natural foci across Africa, Asia, and the Americas, with higher concentrations in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Madagascar, and Peru; sporadic US cases occur in the Southwest. A recent Russian laboratory incident in Irkutsk linked to a 28-year-old technician raised concern about potential exposure, though details remain uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストとは何か、どのように感染し、なぜ24時間以内に死に至ることがあるのか
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国における新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、肺ペストの一般的な解説記事（病原体・感染経路・自然発生地域の説明）であり、具体的な公衆衛生イベントの発生は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はペスト（肺ペスト）に関する教育的解説であり、DRC・マダガスカル・ペルー・米国南西部は『自然発生地域』として一般的に言及されているのみで、現在進行中の具体的な発生事例の報告ではない。ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所事故も対象国リスト外であり詳細不明。具体的な新規症例報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Peste neumónica: qué se sabe del presunto brote en Rusia, qué tan peligrosa es y cuál ha sido la reacción internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic Plague: What Is Known About the Alleged Outbreak in Russia, How Dangerous It Is, and What Has Been the International Reaction.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia followed the death of Daria Shipilova, a 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Irkutsk–Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute in Shélejov, Siberia, on Oct 2 after developing pneumonia while handling samples of Yersinia pestis. About 200 contacts were quarantined and at least four regional hospitals temporarily closed as containment measures were activated. Investigators are weighing an accidental tube rupture containing plague samples versus exposure during a Thailand trip or to an endemic area in Buryatia. Shipilova fell ill in late September, was hospitalized in Shélejov, and died days later. In Shélejov, the Irkutsk Aluminum Plant ordered masks for over 2,000 workers; CNN reported more than 60 institute staff under isolation and roughly 200 close contacts undergoing daily testing. Authorities have sought to minimize risk, noting tests found no pathogens linked to her work. Anna Popova led an emergency meeting; the US and WHO began monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト：ロシアで発生したとされるアウトブレイクについて分かっていること、その危険性、国際的な反応
triage.triage_reason: 研究所関連とみられる肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、約200人の接触者隔離・病院一時閉鎖などの措置が取られ、WHOと米国が監視を開始しており、異常性・重篤性・国際的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。タイ滞在歴は曝露原因候補として言及されているが、実際の発生国ではない。研究所由来の疑いがある肺ペスト症例であり、病原体の性質上、国際的な注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Taiwan reports 12th locally transmitted dengue infection
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports the 12th locally transmitted dengue fever case in Changhua County: a man in his 60s from Changhua City, hospitalized with locally acquired dengue; he has no overseas travel. During incubation, he mainly resided in Changhua County and worked elsewhere. His residence lies about 110 meters from the home of the first locally transmitted dengue fever case type 1 in Changhua County announced on Sept 18, suggesting a community cluster—the first in Changhua since 2023. Further sequencing will assess linkage between the two cases. As of Sept 30, 2026, Taiwan has 178 confirmed dengue cases: 12 locally acquired (10 in Kaohsiung City, 2 in Changhua) and 166 imported, predominantly from Vietnam (43), Indonesia (29), and the Philippines (20). The total is lower than the same period in 2025 (188).

triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia tightens health surveillance over suspected plague in Russia
article.articleSummary: Indonesia tightened health surveillance at international entry points after reports that a Russian laboratory worker died of a severe respiratory illness of suspected plague-related pneumonia. As of Oct 5, Health Ministry official Aji Muhawarman said there was no IHR notification or WHO EIS alert, but proactive measures are being implemented at Bali international airports and seaports. Measures include SATUSEHAT Health Pass checks, symptom monitoring, risk-based assessments of incoming vessels, and vector surveillance for rodents and fleas. Quarantine officers review SSHP submissions to identify travelers originating from or transiting through affected areas. Early detection targets fever, coughing, and shortness of breath; travelers with signs will be referred to infectious disease referral hospitals for isolation and management. Public advised to monitor official updates and maintain healthy habits. In Russia, a 28-year-old worker at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute died; about 200 contacts are under medical observation while investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、ロシアでの疑いペスト発生を受け健康監視を強化

article.articleHeadline: Dua WBP Rutan Negara Bali Suspek TBC, Jalani Pemeriksaan Lanjutan, Dipisahkan Dari WBP Lain
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two inmates at Bali State Detention Center suspected of TB undergo follow-up examinations, separated from other inmates.
article.articleSummary: Two inmates at the Negara Class IIB Detention Center in Jembrana, Bali, are suspected of tuberculosis after a mass health screening conducted on 5 October 2026. The screening of 268 individuals (202 inmates and 66 staff) included symptom checks, physical examinations, blood pressure and blood glucose measurement, and initial TB screening at Aula Garuda Wisnu Kencana Rutan Negara. Two inmates were identified as TB suspects and will undergo sputum laboratory testing for confirmation; they are isolated from others pending results. The screening also detected hypertension and elevated blood glucose in some individuals, who received initial treatment and planned follow-up. Authorities emphasize early TB screening and ongoing health monitoring to protect inmates and staff and support custody processes.

article.articleHeadline: "أطباء بلا حدود" تحذر من تفاقم "إيبولا" بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of a worsening Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is worsening in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF). Since early September, the outbreak has intensified, with North Kivu now contributing roughly 40% of the country’s newly confirmed cases. MSF notes that new outbreak foci are emerging each week, while treatment capacities have reached their limit and remain inadequate to meet needs. The organization warns that the strained treatment facilities endanger current patients and communities in the region, highlighting the critical gap between rising case numbers and care supply. There is a call to scale up treatment capacity and response efforts to curb transmission as new clusters continue to appear weekly in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Land Border Travelers in Ghana Show Sky-High COVID-19 Antibody Levels
article.articleSummary: 92.3% of travelers entering Ghana via ten major land borders in 2022 carried SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibodies, according to a cross-sectional study in BMC Infectious Diseases. From February to July 2022, adults 18+ were recruited at land crossings; blood samples were analyzed with the WANTAI spike-RBD ELISA to detect antibodies blocking spike-ACE2 binding, reflecting immunity from vaccination or prior infection. Pre-border reopening seroprevalence was 95.7% (CI 94.2–97.1); after reopening it was 91.6% (CI 91.0–92.5). The pattern suggests widespread transmission by early–mid-2022 and saturation of immunity across borders. Aflao (east, high traffic) served as the immunological high-water mark; pre-opening, Oseikojokrom and Akanu had lower odds of seropositivity vs Aflao; post-opening, Elubo, Paga, and Sampa also had lower odds. Vaccinated travelers had 2.5x higher odds of neutralizing antibodies than unvaccinated before reopening. Analyses used logistic regression with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q<0.05).

triage.headline_ja: ガーナの陸路国境通過者、COVID-19抗体価が非常に高いレベルを示す

triage.notes: 疾患名にCoccidioidomycosisとあるが記事内容はCOVID-19血清有病率調査であり、疾患名タグと内容が一致していない点に注意。過去の調査研究報告であり、現行の感染症シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hours after rescue, lioness that attacked 5 persons in Gujarat dies; rabies suspected
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected after a lioness in Gujarat’s Amreli district died following rescue. The 2–3-year-old female lioness attacked five people (four villagers and a forest officer) in separate incidents and was captured on Oct 2 from Arjunsukh village, Amreli, before being moved to Krankach Animal Care Centre. It displayed unusual behaviour—biting and abnormal vocalisations—and died about 20 hours after rescue, on Oct 3. Brain tissue samples have been sent to Anand Agricultural University for confirmation; results are pending. The five injured individuals have received anti-rabies vaccine per medical protocol. Officials noted the lioness was solitary and no other lions showed similar symptoms. They described possible rabies transmission routes to the lion, including consumption of rabid prey, contact with infected carcasses, or shared water with rabid animals; transmission risk may be higher in areas with dogs and cattle sharing habitats.

triage.headline_ja: 救助数時間後、グジャラートで5人を襲ったメスライオンが死亡、狂犬病の疑い

article.articleHeadline: Chigger-Borne Scrub Typhus Showed Up as Muscle Spasms in an Unusual Case, and the Kidneys May Be to Blame
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi), transmitted by chiggers, presented unusually in AIIMS Hyderabad as tetany from hypocalcemia and hypophosphatemia, likely due to renal tubular electrolyte loss. The July 2026 Tropical Doctor case report notes the abstract omits age, labs, treatment, and outcome, but calls this a potentially under-recognized metabolic manifestation. Kidney involvement is a known complication; CDC lists kidney or liver failure and other severe outcomes after the first week if untreated. Classic signs are often missing; eschar can be present in as little as 1% to as high as 97% depending on region. In Pondicherry, India, a pediatric series found eschar in 31.6%, rash 7.2%, lymphadenopathy 93.5%, hyponatremia 16.5%, with no deaths. No vaccine exists; doxycycline is the recommended treatment. In the US, Orientia was detected in chiggers in North Carolina parks in 2023, but no human cases.

triage.headline_ja: チガーが媒介するツツガムシ病が筋痙攣として発現した異例の症例、腎臓が原因か

article.articleHeadline: 中国の研究チームが太平洋の深海底で1万種以上のウイルスを発見。99%が未知のもの・・・ :【2ch】ニュー速クオリティ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese research team discovers over 10,000 virus species on the Pacific Ocean's deep-sea floor; 99% are unknown.
article.articleSummary: Chinese researchers claim to have discovered more than 10,000 virus species on the Pacific Ocean’s deep-sea floor, with roughly 99% previously unknown. The article is presented as a Japanese online discussion reacting to this claim, focusing on speculative and sensational commentary rather than peer‑reviewed data. Participants discuss potential pandemic risks from deep-sea viruses, how such organisms might be transmitted to humans, and the biosecurity implications of deep-sea mining and geopolitics (notably China’s seabed activities and Japan’s rare‑earth interests). Several posts express alarm about unknown viruses and speculate about lab origins or accidental release, with some urging preemptive vaccines or broader biosecurity measures. No laboratory confirmation or detailed infection data are provided; the piece reflects public concern and controversial discourse surrounding an unverified deep‑sea virology claim in the Pacific.

article.articleHeadline: MSF Warns Of Worsening Ebola Outbreak In DR Congos North Kivu
article.articleSummary: An alarming surge in Ebola cases has hit North Kivu province in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) to call for an urgent expansion of treatment capacity. Since early September 2026, the outbreak has intensified dramatically, with North Kivu accounting for nearly 40% of all newly confirmed cases nationwide. New hotspots are emerging weekly, while Ebola treatment facilities in North Kivu are operating at full capacity, leaving patients and communities at greater risk. MSF emphasises the urgent need to scale up treatment services to meet rising demand and contain transmission as authorities monitor evolving outbreak dynamics in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でのエボラ出血熱流行悪化を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例が急増し、治療施設が満床となるなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響が見られ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ponen hospitales en cuarentena por sospecha de peste pulmonar en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospitals placed under quarantine due to suspected pneumonic plague in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Four hospitals in Irkutsk region, Siberia, were quarantined over a suspected pneumonic plague case after the death of a 28-year-old woman who worked at the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East. Hospitals, including a pediatric facility, suspended visits and implemented containment measures; some quarantine durations may reach up to three weeks. Russian authorities have not officially confirmed plague; regional officials note no explicit plague diagnosis in official documents. Irkutsk Governor Igor Kobzev announced an emergency meeting, activation of health measures, and a contingency plan. Contacts of the patient are under medical surveillance; none are symptomatic and tests have been negative so far. The death triggers investigation into two exposure routes: a recent trip to Thailand or a possible lab incident involving a broken tube with pathogens at the workplace. Rospotrebnadzor reports pneumonia of unknown etiology, with no confirmed plague. Plague is Yersinia pestis and can spread via fleas or respiratory droplets in the pneumonic form.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペスト疑いにより病院が隔離措置
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト感染が疑われる死亡例が発生し、複数病院が隔離措置を実施。重症度が高く異常事態であり、感染経路（海外渡航歴またはラボ事故）の特定が未了でIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイは感染者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ロシア当局はペスト確定診断を公式には発表していない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: RaillyNews - Ebola Outbreak Reaches 8,300 Cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak reaches over 8,300 confirmed infections worldwide as of 2026-10-06. The Bundibugyo variant drives the surge, with distinctive genetic markers that complicate therapeutic development; high transmissibility in densely populated areas underscores containment challenges. Ebola first emerged in 1976 in Central Africa (Sudan and Zaire, now DRC); animal reservoirs, notably fruit bats, and ecological disturbances fuel spillovers. The virus causes severe hemorrhagic fever; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, sore throat; transmission occurs through contact with infected bodily fluids, not airborne. No widely approved cures; vaccines and antivirals remain under development, hindered by sporadic outbreaks and viral genetic diversity. Global response is strained by security barriers, community mistrust, and weak health systems; effective control requires surveillance, rapid diagnostics, PPE, vaccination strategies, and community engagement. Long-term goals include broad-spectrum vaccines, rapid point-of-care tests, and strengthened health infrastructure, with mRNA platforms offering promise.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者8,300人に到達
triage.triage_reason: 感染者数8,300人という大規模な数字が報告されているが、現在のアウトブレイクの発生国が記事中で明確に特定されておらず（1976年の歴史的起源地への言及のみ）、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は8,300例という大規模な数字を報じているが、現在のアウトブレイクの具体的発生国が明示されていない。DRCとSudanへの言及は1976年の初発生に関する歴史的記述であり、現行の発生地特定には使えない。続報で発生国の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Investigan posible caso de peste pulmonar en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Investigating a Possible Case of Pneumonic Plague in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Irkutsk region in Siberia quarantined several hospitals over a suspected pneumonic plague case, after the death of a 28-year-old woman, an employee of the Institute of Plague Research of Irkutsk and the Far East, in Shélejov. At least four facilities, including a pediatric hospital, imposed hospitalization-area quarantines for up to three weeks; visits are banned. No official confirmation of plague; Rospotrebnadzor describes the death as pneumonia of undetermined etiology. Governor Igor Kobzev held an emergency meeting; contacts are under medical surveillance, none symptomatic and all tests negative so far. Two possible sources are being evaluated: recent travel to Thailand or accidental exposure from a broken tube containing pathogens at work; the institute says no incidents. Pneumonic plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and transmits via respiratory droplets; incubation around 24 hours; untreated can be fatal within 18–24 hours; diagnosis requires laboratory tests; treated with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペストの疑い例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の原因不明の肺炎による死亡を受け、複数病院が隔離措置を取るなど異常性が高く、公衆衛生への影響も深刻な可能性があるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。タイへの渡航歴が感染源候補として言及されているが、タイ国内での発生ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Did a Russian lab worker die from pneumonic plague? What we know -- and don't know
article.articleSummary: Did a Russian lab worker die from pneumonic plague? In Irkutsk, a 28-year-old lab technician died after pneumonia of unknown etiology. Authorities say there is no evidence the illness was connected to pathogens she worked with at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East, though a regional governor suggested plague was possible, later hedging to 'maybe.' Quarantine and medical supervision were imposed on hospital staff and others who had contact with her. The institute, established in 1934, researches plague control and vaccines. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, infects the lungs and spreads via airborne droplets; symptoms include high fever, cough, coughing up blood, and difficulty breathing, and can be fatal if untreated. WHO notes 3,847 suspected plague cases and 423 deaths across 10 countries (2019–2025), mainly in DRC and Madagascar. Rapid response and contact tracing are urged; no confirmed link yet.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所職員は肺ペストで死亡したのか？分かっていること、まだ分かっていないこと
triage.triage_reason: 対ペスト研究所の職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストの可能性が指摘されている。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある重篤な疾患であり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イベントの発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事内のDRC・マダガスカルはWHOの過去統計（2019-2025年の世界的ペスト発生状況）として言及されているのみで、今回の事例の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。死因の確定診断（ペストかどうか）は未確定であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Онищенко исключил распространение вируса Коксаки в РФ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Onishchenko ruled out the spread of Coxsackie virus in Russia.
article.articleSummary: On 6 October 2026, Russian Academy of Sciences academician and epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko stated there is no threat of widespread Coxsackie virus transmission in Russia. He emphasized that import-related outbreaks hinge on timely detection; if those infected currently in Vietnam return home, an epidemic surge is unlikely. For effective anti-epidemic measures, data on the Vietnamese region where exposure occurred are needed. He advised travelers to check the current epidemiological situation in destination countries before travel. The World Health Organization continuously monitors Coxsackie activity across Southeast Asia, with Vietnam included. The enterovirus Coxsackie is highly stable in the environment; Vietnam’s humid, hot climate may prolong survival, warranting heightened risk assessment. In response to reports of Russian cases, Rospotrebnadzor sent formal inquiries to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and to the Association of Tour Operators (ATOR).

triage.headline_ja: オニシチェンコ氏、ロシアにおけるコクサッキーウイルスの拡大を否定
triage.triage_reason: 専門家はロシア国内での感染拡大の可能性を否定しているが、ベトナムでの感染状況（詳細不明）について当局が公式照会を行っており、続報を要する。
triage.notes: 記事の主旨は『ロシアでの拡大否定』という安心情報だが、ベトナムでの渡航者感染に関する情報が不足しており、WHOも東南アジアでのコクサッキーウイルス活動を監視中としている。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue fever vaccine now available in Australia
article.articleSummary: Qdenga dengue vaccine is now available in Australia for the first time, with GPs able to order it under ATAGI guidance. For those aged four and over without prior dengue, vaccination can be considered for short-term travellers based on a risk–benefit assessment; those who have previously had dengue and travel to endemic areas are urged to consider vaccination. The vaccine is administered in two 0.5 mL doses at least 12 weeks apart, and both doses are essential for protection; booster data are lacking. The dengue virus is the fastest-growing global communicable disease, with ~100 million symptomatic cases annually. In Australia, nearly all notified dengue cases are imported by travellers returning from endemic countries; five top destinations—Indonesia, Thailand, India, Vietnam, Fiji—have frequent or continuous transmission. 2024 saw 2,381 dengue notifications in Australia, down to 1,863 in 2025. Common symptoms include fever, headache, chills, muscle/joint pain, fatigue, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and a faint red rash.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱ワクチンがオーストラリアで利用可能に
triage.triage_reason: 記事はオーストラリアでのデングワクチン承認・流通開始を報じるもので、新規の異常な感染拡大やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。言及されている国々は渡航先として一般的な流行地として挙げられているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はオーストラリアにおけるQdengaワクチンの供給開始に関する公衆衛生政策ニュースであり、インドネシア・タイ・インド・ベトナム・フィジーは『流行継続地域』として背景情報的に言及されているのみで、これらの国での具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。そのためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 颱風過後生飲山泉水！陸男驚爆重症感染 引發休克、器官衰竭險死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drinking untreated mountain spring water after the typhoon! Mainland Chinese man suddenly develops a severe infection, triggering shock and organ failure, nearly dying.
article.articleSummary: After a typhoon-triggered flood in mainland China, 61-year-old Lao Yang, who habitually drank untreated mountain spring water, developed severe leptospirosis caused by Leptospira. Despite family efforts to boil spring water after the rains, he continued drinking it raw. Within days he developed chest tightness and abdominal pain, then rapid deterioration with septic shock and multi-organ dysfunction, including heart and kidney failure. Hospitalized, he had laboratory-confirmed Leptospira infection and required aggressive antimicrobial therapy and organ-supportive care; his condition stabilized and he survived. Leptospirosis is a zoonosis shed in the urine of rodents, livestock, and wildlife, contaminating soil and water, especially after heavy rainfall, floods, or landslides. Even clear-looking spring water can be contaminated, so boiling or disinfection before drinking is essential. Public health authorities warn against drinking untreated water or contact with contaminated water or soil.

triage.headline_ja: 台風後に生の山泉水を飲用！中国本土の男性が重症感染を発症、ショックと臓器不全を引き起こし九死に一生
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大や国際的リスクを示す情報はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はヒトヒト感染せず、台風後の汚染水接触による単発の個別症例。公衆衛生上の集団発生報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Santos mantém reforço nas ações contra a dengue mesmo após queda nos casos; três bairros exigem atenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santos maintains reinforcement of dengue-control measures even after a drop in cases; three neighborhoods require attention.
article.articleSummary: Santos, a city in the Baixada Santista on the São Paulo coast, reports an 86.3% drop in dengue cases in 2026, with 620 cases from January to September, down from 4,525 in the same period in 2025. Two hospitalizations and no deaths in 2026 contrast with 17 hospitalizations and six deaths in 2025. The fourth 2026 Larval Density Survey (ADL) began on October 1 and runs through October 30, inspecting about 5,400 properties (roughly 600 per neighborhood) to map infestation risk. Breteau Index ranged from 3.7 in January (alert) to 4.0 in May (risk) and back to 3 in July (alert). Three neighborhoods—Jabaquara, Campo Grande, and Embaré—are at alert for infestation based on female Aedes aegypti captures. March–April had the highest dengue counts (128 each); subsequent months recorded 12–34 cases. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water and securing water storage, plant pots, containers, gutters, and pools.

triage.headline_ja: サントス市、デング熱症例の減少後も対策強化を継続；3地区で注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比86.3%減少し、死亡者もゼロであり、通常の季節的な公衆衛生監視活動の一環として報告されている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル（対象国リストに含まれる）での記事だが、デング熱症例は大幅減少しており、地方自治体による通常の予防的監視活動（幼虫密度調査等）の報告であるため、シグナルとしては見送り。対象国リストにBrazil(3469034)が含まれるため地理情報として記録するが、イベントの性質上PICKUP/WATCHには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Pantau Kematian Peneliti Rusia Diduga Pes, Pintu Masuk RI Diperketat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Ministry Monitors Death of Russian Researcher Suspected of Plague; Entry Points into Indonesia Tightened.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health (Kemenkes RI) is monitoring the death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Russia, amid concerns of a possible plague (Black Death). As of October 5, 2026, there has been no notification via the IHR NFP or WHO EIS. Preparedness is being stepped up at health facilities and entry points, including Bali's airports and seaports, through the All Indonesia-Satu Sehat Health Pass (SSHP) health declarations, symptom observation, and risk-based transport assessment, plus surveillance of rats and fleas at entry. Travel declarations are analyzed to identify overseas Indonesian workers (PPLN) from affected countries. Early detection focuses on fever, cough, shortness of breath, and related signs; suspected plague cases are referred to infectious disease hospitals for testing and treatment. The case follows reports that Darya Shipilova, a female worker at Irkutsk's Antipes Research Institute, died Oct 2, with media speculation about a broken tube containing plague pathogen; confirmation pending.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ロシア人研究者の死亡（ペスト感染疑い）を監視、インドネシアの入国管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの研究者1名の死亡がペスト感染疑いとして報じられているが、確定診断・WHO/IHR通知は未了であり、インドネシアでは予防的な水際対策強化にとどまる。情報不足のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア（イルクーツク州）の研究所従事者の死亡であり、ペスト感染は未確認。インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるが、インドネシア国内での感染事例は報告されておらず、入国管理強化という予防的対応のみのため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: सावधान! रूस में खतरनाक वायरस की दस्तक, दुनियाभर में हड़कंप; US ने मांग ली रिपोर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! The outbreak of a dangerous virus in Russia has sparked worldwide panic; the US has demanded a report.
article.articleSummary: An incident in Irkutsk region, Siberia, where a lab technician at the Anti-Plague Research Institute, Darya Shipilova, died after a live-bacteria test tube broke during analysis, sparked fears of a pneumonic plague; Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor denies the link, saying the death resulted from an unknown pneumonia with no lethal pathogens detected. Neighbouring Buryatia officials consider plague a possibility. The hospital in Shelekhov near the Mongolian border quarantined staff; about 200 people are under surveillance, with hospital admissions halted and several facilities closed. Local authorities canceled public events; masks are required at a nearby aluminum plant. No new infections among institute staff in 10 days, but two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus cases appeared among those exposed. The United States is monitoring with the CDC and has asked Russia for details; Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and Kyrgyzstan tightened border controls with thermal screening. Historical lab leaks cited include Marburg (Germany 1967), influenza (Russia–China 1977), smallpox (UK 1978), and coronavirus (Wuhan 2019).

triage.headline_ja: 警告！ロシアで危険なウイルスが出現し世界的な騒動に；米国が報告を要求
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所で検査技師が死亡し肺炎性ペストの疑いが浮上、近隣国が国境管理を強化し米国CDCも監視・報告要求するなど国際的関心が高いため、フルRRAでの精査が必要。
triage.notes: 事案発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。中国・武漢等への言及は過去の実験室流出事例の歴史的引用であり、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。病原体は未確定（ロシア当局はペストとの関連を否定し原因不明の肺炎と説明）であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Eks Petinggi WHO Soroti Kematian Pekerja Lab Rusia, Ini 5 Hal tentang Penyakit Pes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former WHO Top Official Highlights the Death of a Russian Lab Worker: Here Are 5 Things About the Plague
article.articleSummary: Death of a female laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Russia, amid suspected plague exposure triggers surveillance of about 200 contacts. Official cause of death remains unconfirmed; the deceased reportedly had pneumonia. Russian authorities say sanitary and epidemiologic conditions in Irkutsk are stable. Former WHO Southeast Asia Infectious Diseases Director Prof Tjandra Yoga Aditama outlines five plague facts: plague is Yersinia pestis, a zoonosis; transmission from animals to humans and between humans via contact with infected tissues or inhalation. Plague forms include bubonic (lymph node swelling), septicemic, and pneumonic (lung infection). The lab case reportedly involves pneumonia. Bubonic plague mortality 30-60%, pneumonic plague can be fatal if not treated promptly. Indonesia has had no recent human plague cases but a silent period; BRIN has identified fleas and rat reservoirs in enzootic areas, underscoring vigilance about Russia and Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 元WHO高官、ロシアの検査技師死亡を指摘 ペスト（黒死病）に関する5つの事実
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの検査技師の疑いペスト死亡例は異常性と重症度の観点で注視すべきだが、死因未確定で現地当局は「安定」と発表しており、対象国（インドネシア等）での実際の症例報告はないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生した疑いペスト死亡例であり、対象国リストに該当なし。インドネシアは専門家コメントで言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。約200人の接触者調査中だが死因は未確定。続報（検査結果、感染拡大の有無）を要監視。
